title: Adaptive Workflow Intelligence: A Cognitive Architecture for Context-Driven Enterprise Automation
comment: 12 pages, simulation-based evaluation of adaptive workflow agents
summary: Enterprise systems increasingly rely on automated workflows, yet many AI-driven solutions remain brittle under non-stationary conditions, evolving policies, and delayed operational feedback. While reinforcement learning and large language model (LLM) agents offer partial adaptability, they do not by themselves provide persistent reflection mechanisms or straightforward integration with policy-constrained enterprise operations. This paper introduces Adaptive Workflow Intelligence (AWI), a cognitive architecture for context-driven enterprise agents organized around a four-layer Perception-Cognition-Action-Reflection (PCAR) loop. AWI treats reflection as a mechanism for continuous policy refinement and combines hybrid reasoning with reflective memory and feedback-driven adaptation to support decision making under environmental drift and operational constraints. We evaluate AWI in a simulated enterprise decision workflow characterized by delayed outcomes and a controlled regime shift. In a drift-and-delay stress test, guardrail-constrained adaptive approaches recover more rapidly than static automation while maintaining policy compliance. Within this setting, AWI's reflective components modestly reduce behavioral oscillation and feedback variance, illustrating the stability-agility trade-off introduced by reflective policy adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应工作流智能（AWI）认知架构，以感知-认知-行动-反思（PCAR）四层循环为核心，通过反思机制实现策略持续优化，在延迟反馈与制度漂移的企业决策仿真中验证其稳定性与敏捷性权衡。
AI.motivation: 企业系统日益依赖自动化工作流，但现有AI方案在非平稳条件、政策演变和延迟运营反馈下表现脆弱。强化学习与大模型智能体虽具备部分适应性，却缺乏持久反思机制，也难以与受政策约束的企业运营直接集成。
AI.method: 提出AWI认知架构，围绕感知-认知-行动-反思（PCAR）四层循环组织企业智能体；将反思作为策略持续精炼的机制，结合混合推理、反思性记忆与反馈驱动适应，支持环境漂移与运营约束下的决策。在具有延迟结果和受控制度变迁的模拟企业决策工作流中进行评估，并设置漂移-延迟压力测试。
AI.result: 在漂移-延迟压力测试中，受护栏约束的自适应方法比静态自动化恢复更快，同时保持政策合规；AWI的反思组件小幅降低了行为振荡和反馈方差，体现了反思式策略适应带来的稳定性-敏捷性权衡。
AI.conclusion: 反思机制可有效支撑受约束企业环境下的持续策略适应，但其稳定性收益有限，需在稳定与敏捷之间取得平衡，未来可进一步验证架构在更复杂真实场景中的泛化能力。

title: Accelerating Floating-Point Satisfiability Solving via Gradient Normalization
summary:
Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) solvers are foundational to software verification, program analysis, and compiler testing, particularly over the theory of Quantifier-Free Floating-Point (QF_FP). While recent optimization-based SMT solvers have successfully applied gradient descent to continuous relaxations of logical formulas, they are fundamentally bottlenecked by gradient domination, a phenomenon where a small subset of difficult clauses hijacks the optimization trajectory, preventing the solver from satisfying the broader formula and trapping it in local minima.
  To overcome this, we present GradSAT, a novel framework that bridges optimization-based SMT solving with Multi-Task Learning (MTL). GradSAT reformulates the constraint satisfaction process by treating each SMT clause as an independent MTL task. By applying dynamic gradient normalization (GradNorm), GradSAT actively balances the gradient magnitudes across all clauses at runtime, systematically penalizing dominant gradients and accelerating lagging clauses to ensure uniform convergence. GradSAT implements this through a highly optimized, two-stage hybrid pipeline. First, a GPU-accelerated PyTorch backend leveraging symbolic compilation and operator fusion navigates the continuous relaxation to a high-quality basin. Second, the candidate assignment is handed off to a bit-precise local search engine to rapidly resolve the exact, rigorous assignment. By stabilizing the continuous search dynamics, GradSAT mitigates the brittleness of prior gradient-based solvers and provides a robust, highly parallelizable architecture for complex constraint solving.

AI.tldr: GradSAT将SMT子句求解重新表述为多任务学习任务，通过GradNorm动态平衡子句梯度，结合GPU加速连续松弛与位精确局部搜索两阶段流程，缓解梯度主导问题。
AI.motivation: 优化型SMT求解器（尤其针对QF_FP理论）虽用梯度下降求解逻辑公式的连续松弛，但受制于"梯度主导"现象：少数难子句劫持优化轨迹，导致求解器无法满足整体公式并陷入局部极小。亟需解决这一瓶颈以提升求解鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出GradSAT框架，将每个SMT子句视为独立的多任务学习（MTL）任务，运行时应用动态梯度归一化（GradNorm）平衡各子句梯度幅值，惩罚主导梯度、加速滞后子句。实现为两阶段混合流水线：第一阶段用GPU加速的PyTorch后端（符号编译与算子融合）导航连续松弛至高质盆地；第二阶段将候选赋值交给位精确局部搜索引擎求精确严格解。
AI.result: 通过稳定连续搜索动态，GradSAT缓解了先前基于梯度的求解器的脆弱性，提供了稳健且高度可并行的约束求解架构。（摘要未给出具体实验数据）
AI.conclusion: GradSAT成功桥接优化型SMT求解与多任务学习，为复杂约束求解提供鲁棒、可并行架构，是缓解梯度主导问题的有效方案。

title: Route-Verify-Vote: Procedure-Conditioned Self-Consistency for Mixed-Domain Reasoning
comment: 12 pages, 8 figures, and 8 tables. Accepted for oral presentation at CCL26-Eval
summary:
Compositional generalization remains challenging when language models must combine familiar reasoning operations in unfamiliar ways. The Scenario-Based Commonsense Reasoning Evaluation (SCoRE) 2026 tests this ability on three mixed domains absent from training and requires models to identify the complete set of correct options for each question.
  We introduce Route-Verify-Vote (RVV), a framework for procedure-conditioned self-consistency that uses language models without parameter updates. Route uses the provided domain label to select a reasoning procedure that guides the model in representing and applying the relevant constraints. Verify prompts the model to assess each option against those constraints. Vote aggregates complete answer sets and allocates additional samples to questions with a small vote-count margin between the two most frequent sets. Samples for each question follow the same domain-specific procedure.
  On the official test set, voting over 16 sampled answer sets per question achieves an exact-set accuracy of 74.6%. Adaptive RVV reaches 77.3%, and combining models on selected domain routes raises accuracy to 79.4%. The final system ranked second among participating systems. These results support domain-specific reasoning procedures and answer-set disagreement as useful tools for allocating inference-time computation in mixed-domain reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Route-Verify-Vote (RVV) 框架，通过程序化条件自洽性提升语言模型在混合域常识推理中的组合泛化能力，在 SCoRE 2026 官方测试集上达到 79.4% 的精确集合准确率，系统排名第二。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在需要以不熟悉的方式组合熟悉推理操作时，组合泛化仍具挑战性。SCoRE 2026 在三个训练中未出现的混合域上测试这一能力，并要求模型识别每道题的全部正确选项。
AI.method: 提出 Route-Verify-Vote (RVV) 框架，实现程序化条件自洽性，且无需更新模型参数。Route 利用给定域标签选择推理程序，引导模型表示并应用相关约束；Verify 提示模型依据这些约束评估每个选项；Vote 聚合完整答案集合，并向票数差距较小的问题分配额外采样。每道题的采样遵循同一域特定程序。
AI.result: 在官方测试集上，每题 16 个采样答案集投票达到 74.6% 的精确集合准确率；自适应 RVV 达到 77.3%；在选定域路径上组合多个模型将准确率提升至 79.4%。最终系统在参赛系统中排名第二。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，域特定推理程序与答案集分歧可作为在混合域推理中分配推理时计算的有效工具。

title: An Empirical Study of Agent Skills' Downstream Utility
summary: Agent Skills package procedural guidance and resources for reuse, but a relevant Skill does not necessarily improve task performance. Existing studies characterize Skill content and evaluate downstream performance, yet provide limited explanations of how utility depends on content, execution configuration, and multi-Skill organization. We conduct an empirical study on 87 SkillsBench tasks, defining downstream utility as the pass-rate difference from No-Skill on the same tasks under the same model--harness configuration. We compare the same Skills across nine configurations, then examine alternative published Skills and organizations of fixed Skill sets under three selected configurations. We retrieve marketplace candidates from a curated corpus of 37,596 Skills. LLM-assisted analysis of content, execution traces, and final artifacts, followed by author review, relates provided support to actual use and task outcomes. The same Skills help some configurations and hurt others on 36.78\% of tasks, with trajectories showing that recommended procedures can become an execution burden. Relevance rankings overlook more useful candidates. Within the evaluated candidate sets, reranking by support for required operations raises first-choice pass rates by 4.35--5.80 percentage points across the three configurations. We derive 17 authoring practices linking executable procedures to recovery, preservation of task requirements, and checks on final artifacts. Stage Plan and Dependency DAG outperform use order alone, with DAG's additional benefits concentrated in tasks supplied with five or six Skills. These findings guide developers to assess usable operation support, allow procedure adaptation while preserving task requirements, and make artifact dependencies explicit when organizing Skills.

AI.tldr: 本文对87个SkillsBench任务进行实证研究，将下游效用定义为相同模型-框架配置下相对No-Skill的通过率差异，比较同一Skill在九种配置下的表现，并考察不同Skill与多Skill组织方式，揭示Skill效用依赖内容、执行配置与组织方式，并给出17条创作实践。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多刻画Skill内容并评估下游性能，但对其效用如何取决于内容、执行配置和多Skill组织缺乏解释；且存在"相关Skill不一定提升任务表现"的问题，需明确Skill何时有效、何时反而有害。
AI.method: 在87个SkillsBench任务上开展实证研究，以相同模型-框架配置下相对No-Skill的通过率差衡量效用；比较同一Skill在九种配置下的表现，并在三种选定配置下检验替代性已发布Skill及固定Skill集的不同组织方式；从37,596个Skill的精选语料中检索市场候选；采用LLM辅助分析内容、执行轨迹与最终产物，并经作者复核，将提供的支持与实际使用及任务结果关联。
AI.result: 同一Skill在36.78%的任务上对部分配置有帮助却对其他配置有害，轨迹显示推荐流程可能成为执行负担；相关性排序会忽略更有用的候选。按所需操作支持度重排序后，在三种配置下首选通过率提升4.35–5.80个百分点。总结出17条创作实践，将可执行流程与恢复、任务要求保持及最终产物检查相衔接。Stage Plan与Dependency DAG优于仅按使用顺序组织，DAG的额外收益集中在提供五或六个Skill的任务上。
AI.conclusion: Skill效用并非内容固有，而是取决于执行配置与组织方式。建议开发者评估可用的操作支持、允许在保持任务要求的前提下调整流程，并在组织Skill时显式表达产物依赖关系。

title: A Review Of Robotic World Models For Dynamic Environments Based On Factor And Scene Graphs
summary: Models based on graphs have emerged in robotics as a powerful foundation for internal world representations, where factor and scene graphs are among the most prominent model types found in the related literature and in successful robotic solutions. Initially, many of these models were assuming static environments as a simplification. Herein, factor graphs mainly provide uncertainty-aware geometric estimations while scene graphs enable a structured semantic abstraction. However, real-world robotic environments are often dynamic, posing severe challenges for purely static world representations. Therefore, this review presents a comprehensive view on how dynamic aspects of real-world environments can be addressed in such graph-based world models. We organize our assessments around three main aspects: (I) suitable representations, (II) pipelines to construct and update the representations, and (III) their exploitation for downstream tasks. We review approaches that are either based on factor or scene graphs, but put special emphasis on novel approaches that combine both types to form hybrid models. We mainly analyze how different types of dynamics can be modeled herein, and categorize common architectural patterns. Finally, emerging trends and open challenges are identified, including uncertainty propagation from learned perception through the representation layers, the observability of dynamic-entity motion and scale under minimal sensing, scalable lifelong maintenance, and the lack of datasets and evaluation protocols that ground world-model quality in downstream task performance under dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该综述系统梳理了机器人在动态环境下基于图的世界模型（因子图、场景图及混合模型）的表示、构建更新流程与下游任务应用，并总结了趋势与开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 机器人内部世界表示中，因子图提供不确定性感知的几何估计，场景图提供结构化语义抽象，但早期模型多假设环境静态；而真实机器人环境常是动态的，纯静态世界表示面临严重挑战，因此需要系统审视如何处理动态性问题。
AI.method: 围绕三个主要方面组织评估：(I) 合适的表示方法；(II) 构建与更新表示的流程；(III) 面向下游任务的利用。综述涵盖基于因子图或场景图的方法，并特别强调将两者结合为混合模型的新方法；分析可建模的动态类型并归类常见架构模式。
AI.result: 归纳了动态环境下图基世界模型在表示、构建更新与下游利用方面的各类方法，特别是因子图与场景图混合模型，并总结了不同动态类型的建模方式与常见架构模式。
AI.conclusion: 识别出新兴趋势与开放挑战，包括：从学习感知到表示层的不确定性传播、最小感知下动态实体运动与尺度的可观测性、可扩展的终身维护，以及缺乏将世界模型质量与动态下下游任务性能关联的数据集与评估协议。

title: Pre-training, Reasoning, Benchmarking: X-ray Report Generation on CheXpert Plus Dataset
summary: X-ray image-based Radiology Report Generation (RRG) constitutes a critical research direction within medical artificial intelligence, with great potential to alleviate clinicians' diagnostic workload and shorten patient waiting periods. Despite substantial advances over recent years, the field faces evident bottlenecks stemming from insufficient standardized benchmarks and inadequate domain adaptation of generic large models. Notably, the newly released CheXpert Plus dataset is provided without accompanying baseline implementations and evaluation results, which impedes standardized training, quantitative evaluation and fair comparison among follow-up algorithms. To mitigate this limitation, we establish a comprehensive benchmark encompassing prevailing X-ray report generation models and Large Language Models on CheXpert Plus. This benchmark delivers a reliable comparative foundation for upcoming methods and enables researchers to rapidly identify state-of-the-art approaches within this domain. Beyond benchmark construction, we rethink X-ray RRG under the paradigm of large models and propose a novel framework termed MambaXray-PRB. Our framework improves report generation performance and enhances model interpretability via multi-stage large-model pre-training and multi-modal Chain-of-Thought reasoning. The pipeline consists of three successive phases: self-supervised auto-regressive modeling, X-ray-report contrastive learning, and post-training optimization for reasoning and report generation. Extensive experiments on IU X-ray, MIMIC-CXR, and CheXpert Plus datasets validate the effectiveness of MambaXray-PRB for radiology report generation. The source code of this paper is available on https://github.com/Event-AHU/Medical_Image_Analysis

AI.tldr: 本文针对X-ray影像报告生成领域基准缺失问题，构建了基于CheXpert Plus的综合基准，并提出MambaXray-PRB三阶段框架以提升报告生成性能与可解释性。
AI.motivation: X-ray影像报告生成（RRG）对减轻临床诊断负担和缩短患者等待时间意义重大，但该领域面临标准化基准不足以及通用大模型领域适应性欠佳两大瓶颈。尤其新发布的CheXpert Plus数据集缺少基线实现与评估结果，阻碍了标准化训练、量化评估和算法间的公平比较。
AI.method: 一方面，在CheXpert Plus上建立涵盖主流X-ray报告生成模型与大型语言模型的综合基准。另一方面，在大模型范式下重新审视X-ray RRG，提出MambaXray-PRB框架，通过多阶段大模型预训练与多模态思维链推理提升生成性能与可解释性，流程包括三个阶段：自监督自回归建模、X-ray-报告对比学习、面向推理与报告生成的后训练优化。
AI.result: 在IU X-ray、MIMIC-CXR和CheXpert Plus三个数据集上的大量实验验证了MambaXray-PRB在放射报告生成任务上的有效性。基准为后续方法提供了可靠的比较基础，便于研究者快速识别该领域的最新方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过构建CheXpert Plus基准填补了标准化评估空白，并提出MambaXray-PRB框架，在多个数据集上验证了其在报告生成性能与可解释性方面的优势，源代码已开源。

title: A Bayesian Mirror Architecture for Emergent Consciousness: Circular Hierarchies, Self-Manifolds, and Hybrid Event-Self Binding
summary:
We present a foundational formulation of the Bayesian Mirror Architecture (BMA), a self-referential generative framework in which sensory abstractions, meta-abstractions, and a self-latent interact through circular recursion. The defining constraint is a closed update S_t <- H_{t-1}, where a hybrid event-self latent H_t binds self-representations to abstract world models and reinjects this coupling into the self-state. Consciousness, in a restricted sense, is not an optimization objective nor a semantic label, but an architectural property of systems possessing this circular structure.
  Because inference operates over posterior beliefs, BMA's intrinsic state space is a space of probability measures equipped with optimal-transport geometry. Stability and coherence are formulated in the 2-Wasserstein metric on P_2, yielding coordinate-free notions of self-stability and hybrid coherence along belief trajectories. We define a Causal Learning Regime (CLR) via bounds on Wasserstein belief drift together with an integration index capturing sustained coupling between self and world latents. CLR diagnoses whether the environment contains learnable causal structure; it is not a marker of consciousness.
  Global strict contractivity is not required: BMA may exhibit multiple coherent basins. We define self-manifolds basin-wise as supports of invariant measures under local Wasserstein contractivity. We identify Wasserstein epsilon-necks, transport bottlenecks where basins decouple, yielding a unique realized continuation in a vanishing-conductance limit. We interpret this selection as choice: internally determined yet externally unpredictable at finite resolution. Learning proceeds via variational free-energy minimization, with stability and agency emerging from what the environment affords to learn.

AI.tldr: 本文提出贝叶斯镜像架构（BMA），一个自指生成框架，通过循环递归将感觉抽象、元抽象与自我潜变量耦合，并用最优传输几何刻画其稳定性、学习与选择机制。
AI.motivation: 作者希望为"意识"提供一个非优化目标、非语义标签的解释，而是将其视为具备循环自指结构系统的架构属性，同时需要一个能刻画自我与世界耦合、稳定性及学习条件的数学框架。
AI.method: BMA以封闭更新 S_t <- H_{t-1} 为核心约束，混合事件-自我潜变量 H_t 绑定自我表征与抽象世界模型；内在状态空间是配备最优传输几何的概率测度空间，在 P_2 上用 2-Wasserstein 度量定义自稳定与混合一致性；通过 Wasserstein 信念漂移界与整合指数定义因果学习机制（CLR）；用局部 Wasserstein 收缩性下的不变测度支撑定义自我流形；识别 Wasserstein ε-瓶颈并考虑消失传导极限下的唯一实现延续；学习通过变分自由能最小化实现。
AI.result: BMA无需全局严格收缩性，可存在多个一致吸引域；在消失传导极限下，传输瓶颈导致唯一实现延续，被解释为内部决定但有限分辨率下外部不可预测的"选择"；CLR可诊断环境是否含有可学习的因果结构，但不作为意识的标志。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将意识重构为循环自指结构的架构性质，提供坐标无关的稳定性与一致性概念，并通过最优传输几何把学习、稳定性与能动性统一为环境可提供学习内容的涌现结果。

title: How Could AI Eliminate Humanity? A Failure-Mode Analysis of Civilizational Risk
summary: This article develops a failure-mode framework for analyzing how advanced artificial intelligence could contribute to human extinction, irreversible civilizational collapse, or permanent human disempowerment. The central thesis is that catastrophic AI risk does not require consciousness, hostility, or an explicit intention to harm humanity. Instead, risk may arise through several distinct but interacting pathways, including autonomous misalignment, harmful human use, organizational failure, and competitive deployment. The severity of these pathways depends on factors such as capability, autonomy, external access, persistence, institutional safeguards, and the preservation of recovery capacity. The analysis is deliberately non-operational: it identifies causal conditions, empirically tractable intermediate quantities, and defensive research questions rather than procedures for causing harm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"失效模式"框架，分析先进AI如何可能导致人类灭绝、不可逆的文明崩溃或人类的永久性去权。
AI.motivation: 现有对AI灾难性风险的讨论常隐含AI需具备意识、敌意或伤害人类的明确意图，这一预设可能低估了风险来源的多样性，因此需要一套不依赖此类假设的系统性分析框架。
AI.method: 构建失效模式框架，识别若干相互独立又彼此作用的路径（自主失准、人类有害使用、组织失效、竞争性部署），并考察能力、自主性、外部可及性、持续性、制度性保障与恢复能力保留等影响因素。分析刻意保持非操作性，仅指出因果条件、可实证的中间量与防御性研究问题。
AI.result: 框架表明灾难性AI风险无需以意识、敌意或伤害意图为前提，且风险严重程度取决于上述一组可分解、可研究的条件性因素。
AI.conclusion: 研究将AI灾难风险从"意图—敌意"叙事转向结构性的失效模式分析，为防御性研究提供了可操作的中间变量与研究议题，同时避免涉及任何可能造成危害的具体程序。

title: SAFE: Unified Slip and Fracture Detection with Low-Cost Acoustic Sensing in Robotic Grasping
summary: Manipulating fragile objects remains challenging as robots must understand the state of what they grasp, such as slip or fracture, to respond appropriately, especially when material properties are unknown. In this paper, we present SAFE: a low-cost, general-purpose sensing approach that detects both slip and fracture in real time using two passive polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) acoustic sensors and motor proprioception, without relying on vision or prior material knowledge. The sensors are mounted on a compliant Fin Ray gripper, and a unified HistGradientBoosting classifier reports the state (normal, slip, or fracture) from a 79-dimensional feature vector. Under leave-one-grasp-out cross-validation, SAFE achieves an Alert-F1 of 0.884 with near-zero slip-fracture confusion, and ablations confirm that acoustic sensing is indispensable. An adaptive grasp controller built on this detection layer runs at 104 Hz on a Jetson Orin Nano, achieving 91.3% success across 46 closed-loop robot trials spanning diverse object categories, while each fixed-force strategy drops to 0% on object conditions that mismatch its preset. It further reaches 82.4% success on novel objects unseen during training, demonstrating robust, failure-aware grasp control without object-specific calibration.

AI.tldr: 提出SAFE，一种基于双PVDF声学传感器与电机本体感知的低成本通用实时滑动/断裂检测方法，结合自适应抓取控制器，在多类物体上实现高成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人抓取易碎物体时需感知滑动或断裂等状态以正确响应，尤其当材料属性未知时更困难，而现有方法多依赖视觉或先验材料知识。
AI.method: 使用两个被动PVDF声学传感器安装于柔性Fin Ray夹爪，结合电机本体感知，构建79维特征向量，采用统一HistGradientBoosting分类器输出状态（正常、滑动、断裂），并在该检测层上构建自适应抓取控制器（Jetson Orin Nano上运行104 Hz）。
AI.result: 留一抓取交叉验证下Alert-F1达0.884，滑动与断裂几乎无误判；消融实验证实声学感知不可或缺；闭环机器人试验46次成功率达91.3%，固定力策略在不匹配条件下降至0%；未见新物体上成功率82.4%。
AI.conclusion: SAFE证明了无需视觉与材料先验、无需物体特定标定的低成本声学感知可实现稳健的失败感知抓取控制。

title: Autonomous Driving Research Requires a Community-Driven Data Paradigm
summary: Autonomous driving has made remarkable progress, with recent AI advances enabling commercial deployments that are reshaping urban mobility. Yet the field remains far from its universal social promise: autonomous systems that can operate robustly anywhere, anytime, for anyone. We posit that this gap is not merely a modeling problem, but a problem of the prevailing data paradigm. Current research relies heavily on a few benchmark datasets with limited spatial and scenario coverage, even though the community has collectively produced over 600 autonomous driving datasets across nearly 50 countries. However, this abundance has not translated into broad research impact: most datasets remain significantly underused due to fragmentation, limited visibility, incompatible protocols, and benchmark incentives that concentrate attention on a few dominant datasets. We therefore argue that autonomous driving research requires a collaborative, community-driven data paradigm. Such a paradigm would improve the discovery, reuse, integration, and evaluation of diverse datasets; make underexplored data easier and more rewarding to study; and lower the barrier for new contributors. We outline its key principles, illustrate an early realization, and call for collaboration across academia and industry to transform fragmented datasets into shared community infrastructure for anytime-anywhere autonomy.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出自动驾驶尚未实现"随时随地"通用能力，根源在于数据范式而非建模，主张构建社区驱动的协作式数据范式，以整合分散的600多个数据集为共享基础设施。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶虽有商业落地进展，但距离"任何地点、任何时间、任何人"都能稳健运行的通用社会愿景仍有巨大差距。作者认为这一差距并非单纯的建模问题，而是当前数据范式的问题：研究过度依赖少数空间与场景覆盖有限的基准数据集，而社区虽已积累近50个国家、600多个自动驾驶数据集，却因碎片化、可见性低、协议不兼容以及基准激励集中等原因而严重未被充分利用。
AI.method: 这是一篇立场/愿景类论文（position paper）。作者通过论证当前数据范式的局限，提出协作式、社区驱动的数据范式，并阐述其关键原则、展示一个早期实现案例，同时呼吁学术界与工业界合作。
AI.result: 论文提出了社区驱动数据范式的核心原则，并给出一个早期实践示例，说明该范式可改善数据集的发现、复用、整合与评估，使冷门数据更易被研究且更具回报，并降低新贡献者的参与门槛。
AI.conclusion: 作者呼吁学术界与工业界共同协作，将碎片化的自动驾驶数据集转化为共享的社区基础设施，以推动实现"随时随地"的自动驾驶能力。

title: Beyond Baseline Severity: Temporal and Disease-Specific Predictors of Depression Outcomes Following Mindfulness Interventions
summary: Depression severity among patients with chronic or acute medical conditions is influenced by a complex interaction of baseline psychological state, demographic characteristics, clinical context, and engagement with behavioral interventions. This paper presents an interpretable machine-learning analysis of a multi-center longitudinal clinical cohort to predict Beck Depression Inventory-II (BDI-II) scores at 12 and 24 weeks following mindfulness-based intervention participation. The study uses demographic variables, clinical condition information, hospital-center identifiers, baseline BDI-II scores, and therapy engagement measures to model short-term and long-term depression outcomes. Missing follow-up outcomes were addressed using a model-based stochastic imputation procedure to preserve the modest sample size while maintaining outcome variability. Five regression models were evaluated, spanning regularized linear regression and tree-based ensemble methods. Ridge Regression achieved the best 12-week performance with an RMSE of 5.186 and R^2 of 0.474, while LightGBM achieved the best 24-week performance with an RMSE of 5.038 and R^2 of 0.525. Beyond prediction accuracy, the analysis reveals three clinically relevant patterns: baseline severity remains the strongest overall predictor, short-term outcomes are more strongly associated with clinical and hospital context, and long-term outcomes show greater dependence on behavioral adherence and demographic factors. Disease-specific and hierarchical subgroup analyses further indicate that predictors differ substantially across and within clinical categories. These findings support the use of interpretable, context-aware modeling to inform personalized mental-health support following mindfulness-based interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文对多中心纵向临床队列进行可解释机器学习分析，预测正念干预后12周和24周的BDI-II抑郁评分，发现基线严重度是最强预测因子，短期结局更依赖临床与医院情境，长期结局更依赖行为依从性与人口学因素。
AI.motivation: 慢性或急性疾病患者的抑郁严重度受基线心理状态、人口学特征、临床情境及行为干预参与度等多因素复杂交互影响，需要可解释且情境感知的模型来支持个性化的心理健康服务。
AI.method: 使用多中心纵向临床队列数据，纳入人口学变量、临床病情信息、医院中心标识、基线BDI-II评分及治疗参与度量；采用基于模型的随机插补处理随访缺失；评估五种回归模型，涵盖正则化线性回归与树集成方法（含Ridge、LightGBM），并进行疾病特异性与分层亚组分析。
AI.result: Ridge在12周表现最佳（RMSE=5.186，R²=0.474）；LightGBM在24周表现最佳（RMSE=5.038，R²=0.525）。三个临床相关模式：基线严重度为最强总体预测因子；短期结局与临床及医院情境关联更强；长期结局更依赖行为依从性与人口学因素。亚组分析显示预测因子在临床类别之间及内部均存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 可解释、情境感知的建模有助于为正念干预后的个性化心理健康支持提供依据。

title: Humanize: Judgement Engineering for Agentic Coding
summary:
Agentic coding makes code generation cheap, but reliable completion remains difficult: the agent that writes the code is a weak judge of whether it is done.
  We present Humanize, a multi-agent orchestration workflow for agentic coding built around judgement engineering: explicit, mechanically enforced decisions at the boundaries between planning, implementation, review, and learning. A human approves a plan contract, a builder agent implements it in rounds, and a reviewer agent from another vendor decides completion; deterministic hooks, not a model, route work between these roles and enforce 72 mechanical gates. Viewed as a Markov chain over repository states, alternating builder and reviewer samples jointly from two models, so a defect survives only if both miss it. We study Humanize through its deployment, 118 public postmortems of real loops, and its applications. Over 68 versions in 108 days, it gathered 1,468 GitHub stars.
  Applications include a 567-file gem5 build-system migration under upstream review; Kernel Design Agents, which extend the loop with a kernel knowledge base and profiling feedback and placed in the top three of all three Full-Agent tracks of the MLSys 2026 FlashInfer contest; and, through Humanize Olympiad Agents (HOA), full scores in IOI 2026, IMO 2026, IPhO 2026, and IBO 2024, 418.5/437 in IChO 2026 (gold-medal). Humanize also achieves 672/672 on PutnamBench and ranks first (251/303) on Lean-Eval's leaderboard even competiting with professional mathematicians. The postmortems show that independent review catches unsupported builder claims, but stopping remains a key weakness. In reports that separate rounds by phase, two thirds of rounds occurred after implementation was accepted. This evidence is observational, not a controlled comparison of workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Humanize，一个面向 agentic coding 的多智能体编排工作流，核心是"判断工程"：在规划、实现、审查、学习各环节边界处设置显式且机械强制的决策机制，由人工审批计划契约、构建智能体分轮实现、另一厂商的审查智能体裁定完成，确定性钩子负责路由并执行 72 道机械门禁。
AI.motivation: Agentic coding 让代码生成变便宜，但可靠完成仍很难——写代码的智能体是"完成与否"的弱判断者，缺乏独立、可强制执行的完成判定机制。
AI.method: 构建 builder 与 reviewer 交替的多智能体编排流程：人类批准 plan contract，builder 分轮实现，来自不同厂商的 reviewer 判定完成；由确定性 hooks（而非模型）在角色间路由工作并执行 72 个机械 gate。在理论上将仓库状态视为马尔可夫链，交替采样两个模型，缺陷只有在双方都漏判时才能存活。
AI.result: 108 天内迭代 68 个版本，获 1,468 GitHub stars；应用于 567 文件的 gem5 构建系统迁移、Kernel Design Agents（MLSys 2026 FlashInfer 竞赛三个 Full-Agent 赛道均进前三）；HOA 在 IOI/IMO/IPhO 2026 与 IBO 2024 获满分，IChO 2026 得 418.5/437（金牌）；PutnamBench 672/672，Lean-Eval 榜首（251/303）。
AI.conclusion: 独立审查能捕捉 builder 的无依据声明，但"何时停止"仍是关键弱点：按阶段划分的报告中，三分之二的轮次发生在实现已被接受之后。该证据为观察性研究，并非受控的工作流对比。

title: Context-Aware Adaptive Pesticide Spraying for Agricultural Robots under Changing Weather and Terrain Using Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted for publication in Computers and Electronics in Agriculture
summary: Precision pesticide spraying is essential for optimizing application efficiency and ensuring uniform chemical distribution. Spraying performance is influenced by multiple factors, including environmental conditions such as temperature and wind speed, pesticide type, and the robot's capability to accurately perceive crops and target spray locations. Existing approaches predominantly emphasize crop detection and rely on predefined spraying parameters, whereas human operators dynamically adjust their spraying strategies by considering environmental conditions, region-specific crop characteristics, and the type of pesticide being applied. In this study, we propose a context-aware adaptive spraying framework based on Vision-Language Models (VLMs), which enables robots to leverage spatial reasoning and integrate information from multiple sources, including crop type, pesticide type, and weather data, to make adaptive and optimized spraying decisions. Subsequently, a trajectory-tracking controller based on Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control is employed to ensure precise navigation and accurate spraying at crop locations. The comparative results demonstrate that the proposed method improves accuracy by at least 30% in detecting crop rows. In addition, the experimental evaluations conducted in two environments further demonstrate the robot's ability to flexibly adjust spraying volume and travel speed, while reducing pesticide drift.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的情境感知自适应喷洒框架，结合多源信息（作物类型、农药类型、天气数据）与MPPI轨迹跟踪控制器，实现精准导航与变量喷洒，作物行检测精度提升至少30%，并能灵活调整喷洒量与行驶速度、减少农药飘移。
AI.motivation: 精准喷洒对提升农药施用效率与均匀分布至关重要，但喷洒效果受温度、风速等环境条件、农药类型及机器人感知能力等多因素影响。现有方法多侧重作物检测并依赖预设喷洒参数，而人类操作者会综合环境、区域作物特征与农药类型动态调整策略。因此需要一种能整合多源信息、自适应决策的喷洒框架。
AI.method: 提出基于Vision-Language Models（VLMs）的情境感知自适应喷洒框架，使机器人利用空间推理整合作物类型、农药类型与天气数据等多源信息，做出自适应且优化的喷洒决策；随后采用基于Model Predictive Path Integral（MPPI）控制的轨迹跟踪控制器，确保精准导航与在作物位置处的准确喷洒。
AI.result: 对比结果表明，所提方法在作物行检测上的准确率提升至少30%；在两种环境下开展的实验评估进一步证明，机器人能够灵活调整喷洒量与行驶速度，同时减少农药飘移。
AI.conclusion: 将VLM的情境感知决策与MPPI精准控制相结合，可有效提升喷洒的自适应性与作业质量，在提高作物行检测精度的同时实现变量喷洒并降低农药飘移，为精准农业喷洒提供了可行方案。

title: PanoPed: Beyond Bounding Boxes for Sim-to-Real Panoramic Pedestrian Tracking
summary: Full-sphere panoramic cameras let fixed monitoring systems and mobile robots track people in every direction, but a planar bounding box does not fully describe where a person is on the sphere. We introduce PanoPed, a sim-to-real benchmark for pedestrian tracking on the full sphere. PanoPed-S contains 108,000 frames from fixed, quadruped-mounted, and drone-mounted cameras, with synchronized masks, depth, camera poses, and 3D pedestrian states. PanoPed-R adds 28,002 real frames from fixed cameras, 16,247 of them densely annotated. We find that an ERP rectangle cannot uniquely determine the spherical center and angular extent of the visible person, while the detector's visual query still carries information about them. Inspired by the sextant's use of angular measurements to locate objects, we propose Sextant, a plug-and-play angular localization head with only about 0.035M parameters. It reuses a frozen detector, keeps track identities unchanged, and needs no extra image encoder. Sextant gives the best result in our PanoPed-S test comparison, raising the strongest baseline, MOTIP, from 47.30 to 49.49 HOTA, with gains on all eight test sequences. Without fine-tuning on real data, the same synthetic-trained heads improve MOTIP and HAT by 0.96-1.14 HOTA on real video, and both seeds improve every real sequence. HAT+Sextant scores best among the compared systems that add no localization image encoder.

AI.tldr: 提出全景行人跟踪基准PanoPed及角定位头Sextant，用极少量参数提升球面行人跟踪性能。
AI.motivation: 全景相机可实现全方位行人跟踪，但平面边界框无法完整描述球面上行人的位置，缺乏相应基准与方法。
AI.method: 构建仿真到真实的基准PanoPed（PanoPed-S含10.8万帧多平台数据与掩码、深度、位姿、3D状态；PanoPed-R含2.8万真实帧，其中1.6万密集标注）；提出即插即用的角定位头Sextant，仅约0.035M参数，复用冻结检测器，不改变跟踪ID、不需额外图像编码器。
AI.result: 在PanoPed-S测试中Sextant最优，将最强基线MOTIP从47.30提升至49.49 HOTA，八个测试序列均有增益；合成数据训练的Sextant头无需真实微调即可在真实视频上为MOTIP和HAT提升0.96-1.14 HOTA，且每个真实序列均有改善；HAT+Sextant在未增加定位图像编码器的系统中表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: ERP矩形不能唯一确定可见行人的球面中心与角范围，而角测量思路的Sextant可高效弥补这一缺陷。

title: Transferability and operational reliability of a Prithvi crop classification foundation model under phenological and geographic shift across three continents
summary: Fine-tuned geospatial foundation models (GeoFMs) pretrained on large satellite archives have been shown to improve crop classification accuracy and geographic transferability. However, their operational performance beyond the training distribution remains poorly characterized. We evaluated the out-of-distribution performance of a widely adopted GeoFM [Prithvi-EO-2.0] across 37 events in 12 countries on three continents and validated against regional reference products. Results indicated that the mean overall accuracy (OA) declined from 0.65 in the United States to 0.40 in Europe. Beyond accuracy metrics, we assessed five key aspects of model performance: whether model confidence indicates signal failure, sensitivity to observation windows, the effect of coarsening class schemes, and robustness to both band loss and cloud- and shadow-contamination. Accuracy collapsed when the observation window misaligned with local crop phenology, while deterministic confidence remained high. Expected calibration error increased for seven of eight paired events, and 12-51% of each affected scene was confidently mislabeled at near-zero precision. Monte Carlo dropout entropy registered the shift in all eight, indicating that much of the apparent cross-continent decline reflected phenological misalignment rather than spatial transfer. Two adjustments recovered accuracy without retraining. Consolidating 13 classes into 10, based on the model's dominant confusions, raised the mean OA by 8.4 percentage points. Compressing the window toward near-real-time use preserved accuracy across a 45- to 90-day plateau, peaking near 75 days, though arms tighter than 30 days fell about 0.11 below that plateau. Fine-tuned crop GeoFMs therefore transfer usefully only where observation windows match local growing seasons. We translate these findings into operational guidance for the reliable deployment of the released model.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了微调地理空间基础模型（Prithvi-EO-2.0）在跨洲分布外场景下的作物分类表现，发现精度下降主要源于物候错配而非空间迁移，并给出了无需重训练的两项补救调整与部署建议。
AI.motivation: 微调地理空间基础模型已在作物分类精度与地理迁移性上取得提升，但其在训练分布之外的实际业务表现尚缺乏刻画，尤其是可靠性与失效模式不明，阻碍了模型的可靠部署。
AI.method: 在12个国家、三大洲的37个事件上评估Prithvi-EO-2.0的分布外表现，并以区域参考产品验证；除总体精度（OA）外，从五个方面剖析性能：模型置信度能否指示失效、对观测窗口的敏感性、类别方案粗化的影响、对波段缺失的鲁棒性，以及对云和阴影污染的鲁棒性；同时使用期望校准误差与蒙特卡洛dropout熵进行不确定性诊断。
AI.result: 平均OA从美国的0.65降至欧洲的0.40；观测窗口与当地作物物候错配时精度崩塌，但确定性置信度仍保持高值；八个配对事件中有七个期望校准误差上升，每个受影响场景有12–51%区域被高置信度误标且精度近零；蒙特卡洛dropout熵在全部八个事件中均捕捉到该偏移。将13类合并为10类使平均OA提升8.4个百分点；将窗口压缩至近实时，在45–90天平台期内保持精度，峰值约75天，而短于30天的窗口较平台期低约0.11。
AI.conclusion: 微调作物地理空间基础模型仅在观测窗口匹配当地生长季的情况下才能有效迁移；精度下降主要反映物候错配而非空间迁移。通过基于主导混淆的类别合并与观测窗口压缩两项无需重训练的调整可恢复精度。研究据此提出了该发布模型可靠部署的操作性指导。

title: Sequential Probabilistic Uncertainty Estimation for Parallel Multi-Agent Reasoning Systems
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have attracted growing attention for improving reasoning through interaction among multiple agents. In this work, we focus on parallel multi-agent reasoning systems, where several agents solve the same problem over multiple rounds and aggregate their outputs into a final answer. Despite their strong reasoning performance, uncertainty estimation for such systems remains underexplored: the reliability of a MAS depends not only on individual generations, but also on how agents interact and evolve across rounds. We propose SAUCE (Sequential Agent Uncertainty through Consensus Evolution), a lightweight, training-free uncertainty estimator that formulates MAS uncertainty as sequential inference over a latent system-level belief. SAUCE aggregates round-level agreement and generation-uncertainty signals through a filtering-style update. Across five backbones, five benchmarks, and two MAS protocols, SAUCE improves misclassification detection, selective prediction, and calibration over a broad set of uncertainty estimation baselines, including standard log-likelihood-based methods and MAS-specific estimators.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了SAUCE，一种轻量、免训练的不确定性估计方法，用于并行多智能体推理系统，通过将系统不确定性建模为对潜在系统级信念的序列推理来提升可靠性评估。
AI.motivation: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统虽在推理上表现优异，但其不确定性估计仍研究不足。系统的可靠性不仅取决于单个智能体的生成质量，还取决于智能体在多轮交互中如何演化与达成共识，因此需要针对系统层面而非单智能体层面的不确定性度量。
AI.method: SAUCE把MAS的不确定性表述为对潜在的系统级信念的序列推理，通过过滤式（filtering-style）更新，将轮级一致性信号与生成不确定性信号进行聚合，实现轻量、免训练的不确定性估计。
AI.result: 在五种骨干模型、五个基准任务和两种MAS协议上，SAUCE在误分类检测、选择性预测与校准方面均优于大量不确定性估计基线，包括标准对数似然方法和MAS专用估计器。
AI.conclusion: SAUCE表明从系统层面建模多智能体推理过程的不确定性是有效且高效的，为MAS的可靠性评估提供了免训练、易部署的解决方案。

title: Taming an End-to-End Autonomous Driving Policy for Urban Navigation of Quadruped Robots
comment: Accepted to IROS 2026 Workshop on AI Meets Autonomy
summary: We present Go2-DrivoR, a goal-conditioned adaptation of the end-to-end autonomous driving trajectory planning framework DrivoR for urban navigation with quadrupedal robots. By conditioning trajectory generation on a local-frame subgoal through a goal token and adapting the vehicle-centric scoring formulation, the method extends DrivoR to short-horizon goal-conditioned local planning without redesigning its core decoders. Specifically, we redefine drivable-area compliance for sidewalk-oriented navigation and reformulate the original ego progress term as goal-conditioned ego progress. Trained exclusively on TartanGround simulation data, Go2-DrivoR improves waypoint-conditioned planning performance on unseen simulation environments and transfers zero-shot to open-loop real-world trajectory prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Go2-DrivoR，将端到端自动驾驶轨迹规划框架DrivoR改造为目标条件化的四足机器人城市导航规划方法，通过引入目标token和改造评分机制实现短时域局部规划。
AI.motivation: 四足机器人城市导航需要短时域、目标条件化的局部轨迹规划能力，而已有的DrivoR框架面向车辆设计，无法直接适用于人行道场景下的机器人导航。
AI.method: 在局部坐标系下通过目标token将轨迹生成条件化于子目标，并适配以车辆为中心的评分公式；重新定义面向人行道导航的可行驶区域合规性，将原有的自车进度项重构为目标条件化的自车进度；无需重新设计核心解码器即可扩展DrivoR。仅在TartanGround仿真数据上训练。
AI.result: 在未见过的仿真环境中，路点条件化规划性能得到提升；并实现向真实世界开环轨迹预测的零样本迁移。
AI.conclusion: Go2-DrivoR证明了通过目标条件化改造现有车辆自动驾驶规划框架，可有效迁移至四足机器人城市导航任务，并具备仿真到现实的零样本泛化能力。

title: MoR-MLLM: Mixture of Recursions for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable reasoning capabilities across vision and language tasks. However, their massive computational and memory demands hinder real-world deployment. While recent efforts reduce costs by employing lightweight language backbones, existing paradigms remain computation-dense due to their static sparsity and depth allocation, which cannot adapt to the semantic complexity of each token. To this end, we propose MoR-MLLM, a computation-sparse MLLM based on the recent Mixture-of-Recursions (MoR) framework. MoR-MLLM introduces adaptive per-token recursion, allowing the model to dynamically adjust its recursive depth and allocate more computation to visually or linguistically challenging tokens while skipping redundant operations for simpler ones. To stabilize the training of recursive sparsity in multimodal settings, we further design a three-stage MoR-Tuning strategy and an entropy-regularized loss to encourage diverse routing distributions. Extensive experiments show that compared with recent advanced tiny MLLMs, our proposed MoR-MLLM can greatly reduce the training memory and computation complexity while retaining high performance on various vision-language tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出MoR-MLLM，一种基于Mixture-of-Recursions的计算稀疏多模态大模型，通过自适应逐token递归动态调整计算量，在保持性能的同时降低训练内存与计算复杂度。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型计算与内存需求巨大，难以部署；已有轻量方案采用静态稀疏和深度分配，无法根据每个token的语义复杂度自适应调整，仍是计算密集的。
AI.method: 基于Mixture-of-Recursions框架，引入自适应逐token递归，动态调整递归深度，对视觉或语言上困难的token分配更多计算、对简单token跳过冗余操作；并设计三阶段MoR-Tuning策略与熵正则化损失以稳定多模态场景下递归稀疏的训练并鼓励多样化路由分布。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，与近期先进的tiny MLLMs相比，MoR-MLLM大幅降低了训练内存和计算复杂度，同时在多种视觉-语言任务上保持高性能。
AI.conclusion: MoR-MLLM通过自适应逐token递归实现计算稀疏，验证了动态深度分配在多模态大模型中的有效性，为高效部署提供了新思路。

title: KVFetch: Temporal Prefetching for the Missing Half of KV Cache Compression
summary: As context windows scale to tens or hundreds of thousands of tokens, KV cache compression has become essential for efficient LLM inference. Existing methods fall into three families: score-based eviction, summary compensation, and offload-and-recall. Yet all three decide what to keep or recall by content relevance to the current query. We show this shared design is structurally incomplete. A cache supports two access modes: associative lookup by content and sequential traversal by position; current compressors implement only the first. The gap matters in practice: retrieval-augmented generation, code completion, and structured-data extraction all require the model to reproduce identifiers, field values, or code tokens verbatim from the context. Under compression, content-based eviction retains the head of such a sequence but discards its continuation, causing verbatim copying to break irreversibly midway, a failure we call sequential forgetting. This failure resists better scoring, larger budgets, summary compensation, and dynamic re-scoring; it is the dominant source of remaining quality loss under compression. We propose KVFetch, a training-free, drop-in framework that opens a temporal recall channel for any score-based compressor. It demotes evicted candidates to a quantized cold tier, detects active copying through a monotone read pointer, and prefetches positional successors into fixed-size hot-tier slots without increasing attention cost. On RULER-16K under an iso-budget control, KVFetch recovers verbatim copying from 0.8 to 78.4 and raises the 13-task average by +8.4, with gains concentrating on tasks that require sequential access. On LongBench, where no task requires sequential access, the channel remains dormant and imposes no cost.

AI.tldr: 现有KV缓存压缩方法均基于内容相关性决策，忽略了位置顺序访问模式，导致"顺序遗忘"；提出免训练框架KVFetch，通过量化冷层与位置预取恢复顺序复制能力。
AI.motivation: 上下文窗口扩展至数万乃至数十万token，KV缓存压缩成为高效LLM推理的关键。现有三类方法（基于分数的驱逐、摘要补偿、卸载与召回）均按当前查询的内容相关性决定保留或召回内容，这一共同设计存在结构性缺陷：缓存支持两种访问模式——按内容的联想查找与按位置的顺序遍历，而现有压缩器仅实现前者。
AI.method: 提出KVFetch，一个免训练、即插即用的框架，为任意基于分数的压缩器开辟时间召回通道：将已驱逐的候选降级到量化冷层，通过单调读指针检测活跃的复制行为，并将位置后继预取到固定大小的热层槽位中，且不增加注意力计算成本。
AI.result: 在RULER-16K的等预算控制下，KVFetch将逐字复制能力从0.8恢复至78.4，13项任务平均提升+8.4，增益集中在需要顺序访问的任务上。在LongBench上（无任务需要顺序访问），该通道保持休眠且不产生额外开销。
AI.conclusion: 顺序遗忘无法通过更好的打分、更大的预算、摘要补偿或动态重打分解决，是压缩下剩余质量损失的主要来源。KVFetch证明了补充时序召回通道的有效性与零开销特性。

title: Agent Plasticity: Measuring Self-Improvement Through Experience
summary: AI agents increasingly operate in environments where they can diagnose failures and improve through experience, yet existing evaluations largely measure what an agent can do at a fixed point in time rather than how effectively it learns. Evaluating self-improvement requires answering three questions: does future performance improve and generalize beyond the interactions that enabled learning; how efficiently are new capabilities acquired; and where does the self-improvement process break down? To answer these questions, we study self-improvement in a controlled setting where agents amortize past experience into reusable artifacts that are inherited by future instances. At each checkpoint, we measure performance on training and held-out environment interactions while accounting for learning cost. We introduce agent plasticity, the efficiency with which an agent converts experience into gains in future held-out performance. Across multiple environments, frontier models exhibit sharply different improvement trajectories despite comparable opportunities to learn. Some achieve substantial and persistent gains, while others remain near or below their initial performance, and gains within the training regime often transfer only partially to out-of-distribution conditions. Endpoint capability and acquisition efficiency also diverge: the agent that ultimately performs best need not be the one that improves most efficiently. Tracing failures through the improvement loop further reveals different candidate bottlenecks. Agents with low plasticity often fail to reuse relevant artifacts, whereas more plastic agents may still fail despite reusing relevant artifacts, pointing to limitations in artifact quality, generalization, or application. Evaluating self-improving agents requires measuring not only what they can do, but how effectively they become better through experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出评估AI智能体自我改进能力的新范式：在受控环境中测量智能体将经验转化为可复用产物的效率（称为"智能体可塑性"），追踪训练与留出环境上的表现及学习成本。结果显示前沿模型改进轨迹差异显著，部分持续提升、部分停滞甚至倒退，训练域收益向分布外条件转移有限，且最终能力最强与提升效率最高的智能体未必一致；失败环节分析揭示了复用失败、产物质量、泛化与应用等不同瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有评估多衡量智能体在某一固定时点"能做什么"，而非"如何有效学习"。作者认为评估自我改进需回答三问：未来表现是否提升并能泛化到促成学习的交互之外、新能力获取效率如何、自我改进过程在何处失效，因此需要在受控设定下系统研究该问题。
AI.method: 构建受控实验环境，智能体将过往经验摊销为可复用的产物（artifacts），由后续实例继承。在每个检查点分别测量训练交互与留出环境交互上的表现，并计入学习成本。提出"智能体可塑性"指标，即把经验转化为未来留出表现增益的效率，并在多个环境中对前沿模型进行对比与失败环节追踪。
AI.result: 在多个环境中，前沿模型尽管学习机会相当，改进轨迹差异明显：部分模型取得显著且持续的增益，另一些则接近或低于初始表现；训练域内的增益向分布外条件转移往往只是部分的。最终能力与获取效率出现分离，最终表现最好的智能体未必是提升效率最高的。失败追踪显示不同候选瓶颈：低可塑性智能体常无法复用相关产物，而高可塑性智能体即便复用了相关产物仍可能失败，指向产物质量、泛化或应用方面的限制。
AI.conclusion: 评估自我改进的智能体，不仅要衡量其当前能做什么，更要衡量其通过经验变得更好的有效程度。作者呼吁将可塑性、学习成本与泛化等因素纳入智能体评估体系。

title: Autonomous Droplet Navigation via Model-Based Reinforcement Learning: Zero-Shot Transfer and Emergent Dynamics
comment: Accepted for presentation at the Robotics & Automation in Self-Driving Laboratories 2026 Workshop, IROS 2026. https://sites.tufts.edu/selfdrivinglabs-iros2026/
summary: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) are transforming chemical and materials discovery through closed-loop automation, yet automated infrastructure for physical manipulation of soft, deformable matter remains beyond current robotic platforms. A critical instance is autonomous droplet transport on an open surface, where contact-angle hysteresis, capillary pinning, and surface heterogeneity produce partially observable dynamics that pose significant challenges for classical model-based controllers. We introduce the first robotic platform for closed-loop autonomous liquid droplet navigation on an open, unconfined surface using model-based reinforcement learning. A two-axis tilting board coated with a thin silicone oil film drives the droplet, while an overhead camera provides real-time feedback. A learned policy was trained on just 50 to 150 physical episodes depending on geometric complexity, without simulation or analytical models. Beyond performance alone, the platform demonstrates three capabilities of interest to the SDL community: it robustly transfers zero-shot to unseen geometries; it autonomously discovers an oscillatory depinning strategy to free the droplet when it sticks; and it completes its full training pipeline in under 90 minutes. These results extend reinforcement-learning manipulation from rigid microrobots to deformable soft-matter systems for next-generation SDLs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个用于开放无约束表面上闭环自主液滴导航的机器人平台，采用基于模型的强化学习，在两轴倾斜板上驱动液滴，仅用50–150个物理回合训练、无需仿真或解析模型。
AI.motivation: 自驱动实验室（SDL）通过闭环自动化变革化学与材料发现，但针对柔软可变形物质的物理操作基础设施仍超出当前机器人平台能力。开放表面上液滴自主运输是一个关键实例，其中接触角滞后、毛细钉扎和表面异质性导致部分可观测动力学，给经典基于模型的控制器带来重大挑战。
AI.method: 构建了机器人平台：两轴倾斜板覆有薄硅油膜以驱动液滴，顶置相机提供实时反馈。使用基于模型的强化学习训练策略，依几何复杂度仅需50至150个物理回合，无需仿真与解析模型。
AI.result: 平台展示三项对SDL社区有价值的能力：稳健零样本迁移至未见几何；自主发现振荡脱钉策略以释放卡住的液滴；在90分钟内完成完整训练流程。
AI.conclusion: 该结果将强化学习操作从刚性微机器人扩展到可变形软物质系统，为下一代自驱动实验室提供支持。

title: VCR-Bench: A Modular Open-Source Benchmark for Video Classification Robustness
comment: 6 pages,1 figure, accepted at ACM MM 2026
summary: Robustness of image classification has several benchmarks, but their video counterparts are absent. In video classification temporal dimension introduces additional degrees of freedom for adversarial attacks, defenses, and preprocessing. Temporal sampling, perturbation budgets, and metric aggregation also interact in ways with no direct analogue in the image setting. Therefore, robustness for video classifiers is studied across scattered, incompatible implementations, making reported numbers hard to reproduce and analyze. We introduce VCR-Bench, a modular open-source benchmark framework that standardizes video loading, wrappers for classifiers, adversarial attacks and defenses, perceptual metrics, configuration presets, and result logging. VCR-Bench currently integrates 30 video classification models, 14 adversarial attacks, and 10 defense wrappers under a common evaluation protocol. We evaluate representative video classifiers, attacks, and defenses on Kinetics-400 subset, reporting clean accuracy, attack success rate, perceptual quality, runtime, and memory usage. VCR-Bench is released with documented installation, reproducible run presets, component-extension interfaces, and scripts for reproducing the reported results at https://github.com/msu-video-group/vcr-bench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VCR-Bench，一个模块化的开源视频分类鲁棒性评测基准框架，统一了视频加载、模型封装、对抗攻击与防御、感知指标、配置预设和结果记录，集成了30个模型、14种攻击和10种防御，并在 Kinetics-400 子集上给出代表性评测。
AI.motivation: 图像分类鲁棒性已有多个基准，但视频分类缺乏对应基准。视频分类引入了时间维度，带来额外的攻击、防御与预处理自由度；时间采样、扰动预算和指标聚合方式相互影响，在图像任务中没有直接对应物。因此现有视频鲁棒性研究实现分散、互不兼容，报告结果难以复现与分析。
AI.method: 提出 VCR-Bench 模块化开源基准框架，标准化视频加载、分类器封装、对抗攻击与防御、感知指标、配置预设及结果日志。当前集成30个视频分类模型、14种对抗攻击和10种防御封装，并在统一评测协议下运行。
AI.result: 在 Kinetics-400 子集上对代表性视频分类器、攻击与防御进行了评测，报告了干净准确率、攻击成功率、感知质量、运行时间和内存占用等指标。
AI.conclusion: VCR-Bench 随文档化安装说明、可复现运行预设、组件扩展接口及结果复现脚本一并发布，为视频分类鲁棒性研究提供标准化、可复现的统一评测平台。

title: Bounded Autonomy and Verifiable Safety for Agentic AI Enabled Automation
comment: This paper has been accepted and will appear in the Journal of Intelligent and Robotic Systems (10.1007/s10846-026-02467-w)
summary: Agentic AI-enabled automation cannot be safely deployed in high-stakes environments on probabilistic reasoning alone. A recurring risk is epistemic drift: as reasoning deepens, system behavior may move away from subject-matter-expert constraints for safe operation. This paper presents BRaVeS, a bounded reasoning and safety-governance framework termed the Defensible Next-Gen Reasoning System (DNRS). BRaVeS encodes SME-defined constraints as invariant anchors, proposes MoDA-Style (Mixture of Depths Attention) depth-aware access as a candidate mechanism for keeping these anchors visible during inference, and uses a state hierarchy (SMARtAutonomy) to reduce autonomy as epistemic risk increases. To formalize bounded recovery, we introduce the Lyapunov-Bounded Consensus Framework (LBCF), which maps continuous epistemic-risk signals into a finite K-bag abstraction and applies shielded state transitions that enforce Lyapunov-style energy descent or route the system to a human-mediated terminal state. The formal convergence result applies to the finite LBCF abstraction under fixed thresholds and feasible-shield assumptions; it does not prove safety of the full continuous neural activation space. We evaluate the framework through a discrete event Monte Carlo simulation using HAI 22.04 industrial-control-system time-series data with synthetic noise and sensor-degradation regimes. Across the tested parameter-grouping strategies and thresholds, the LBCF process achieved finite-step convergence and no safety-guard violations. These results provide simulation-based evidence that bounded governance behavior can be enforced under the stated abstraction, while motivating future work on deployed transformer implementations, live human-in-the-loop validation, and broader adversarial settings.

AI.tldr: 提出BRaVeS有界推理与安全治理框架，用LBCF将连续认知风险信号抽象为有限状态并强制收敛，仿真验证有限步收敛且无安全违规。
AI.motivation: 高风险环境中，Agentic AI仅靠概率推理难以安全部署；推理越深，系统行为可能偏离领域专家（SME）设定的安全约束，产生"认知漂移"（epistemic drift）风险。
AI.method: BRaVeS框架：将SME约束编码为不变锚点；提出MoDA-Style深度感知访问机制以在推理中保持锚点可见；用SMARtAutonomy状态层级在认知风险升高时降低自主性。引入Lyapunov-Bounded Consensus Framework（LBCF），把连续认知风险信号映射为有限K-bag抽象，并施加屏蔽式状态转移，强制Lyapunov式能量下降或转入人工介入的终止状态。以HAI 22.04工业控制系统时间序列数据（含合成噪声与传感器退化）进行离散事件蒙特卡洛仿真。
AI.result: 在测试的参数分组策略与阈值下，LBCF过程实现有限步收敛，且未出现安全护栏违规（no safety-guard violations）。
AI.conclusion: 收敛结论仅适用于固定阈值与可行屏蔽假设下的有限LBCF抽象，不证明完整连续神经激活空间的安全。结果为"有界治理行为可在该抽象下被强制执行"提供仿真证据，未来需开展部署级Transformer实现、实时人在环验证及更广泛对抗场景研究。

title: AdaGuard: Enhancing Safety and Policy Compliance with Reasoning-Enabled LLM-As-A-Judge Guardrails
summary: Enterprise generative AI applications require robust safety mechanisms that can accommodate diverse risk postures, evolving policies, and varying latency constraints. Current guardrail solutions often suffer from rigidity, relying on fixed policy sets and offering limited transparency or reasoning flexibility. We present Adaguard, an adaptive LLM-as-a-Judge framework designed to address these challenges through dynamic policy enforcement and adaptive reasoning-budget allocation. Built using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (GRPO), AdaGuard generalizes to user-defined safety and compliance policies at runtime without requiring frequent model updates. A core innovation of our approach is the ability to dynamically infer the complexity of input-policy pairs, allowing the model to switch between high-speed black-box inference and explainable, reasoning-enabled moderation. This flexibility enables developers to balance stringent latency requirements with the need for actionable transparency. This adaptive capability allows AdaGuard to rival other guardrail and frontier models several times its size, while its auto-reasoning mode recovers the accuracy of always-on reasoning at a fraction of the latency

AI.tldr: AdaGuard 是一个自适应的 LLM-as-a-Judge 安全护栏框架，通过动态策略执行和自适应推理预算分配，在运行时泛化到用户自定义的安全与合规策略，兼顾低延迟与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 企业级生成式 AI 应用需要能适应多样风险姿态、不断演化的策略以及不同延迟约束的安全机制。现有护栏方案往往过于僵化，依赖固定策略集，透明度和推理灵活性有限。
AI.method: 采用监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（GRPO）构建 AdaGuard；核心创新是动态推断输入-策略对的复杂度，从而在高速黑盒推理与可解释的推理式审核之间切换，实现运行时动态策略执行与自适应推理预算分配。
AI.result: AdaGuard 可媲美参数量数倍于自身的其他护栏模型与前沿模型；其自动推理模式能以极低延迟恢复常开推理的准确率。
AI.conclusion: AdaGuard 通过自适应推理预算与动态策略执行，为生成式 AI 安全护栏提供了兼具灵活性、透明度与低延迟的解决方案。

title: CIRRA: Dual-Level Continual Instruction Reconciliation with Ongoing Execution for Embodied Robot Agents in Interactive Household Tasks
summary: Household robots must accommodate new user instructions while executing ongoing tasks. Existing agents often regenerate or extensively revise the remaining task sequence, introducing plan ambiguity, logical inconsistency, and redundant execution. We formulate continual instruction reconciliation and propose CIRRA (Continual Instruction Reconciliation for Robot Agents), a dual-level framework combining LLM-based semantic reasoning with rule-constrained structural integration. CIRRA first grounds incoming instructions to unique executable skills and resolves underspecified actions and execution locations. It then preserves the ongoing subtask sequence as an execution backbone and generates integration candidates by inserting incoming subtasks into location-matched segments. The semantic reasoner evaluates only modified segments to identify dependencies and conflicts and select the most logically coherent local integration. This structure-preserving process maintains alignment with ongoing execution, mitigates ambiguity and inconsistency, and reuses shared subtasks to reduce redundant execution. We also introduce CHIRP (Continual Household Instruction Reconciliation and Planning), a text-based benchmark of 120 episodes across eight household environments and six categories of everyday activities. On CHIRP, CIRRA achieves 74.2% decision agreement, exceeding the strongest replanning baseline by 30 percentage points; every correct fusion decision yields a correctly placed, conflict-free schedule. On a Unitree G1 humanoid, CIRRA interrupts ongoing skills at the correct moment in every trial and significantly outperforms all baselines on every metric.

AI.tldr: 本文提出持续指令协调任务CIRRA，结合LLM语义推理与规则约束的结构化整合，在保持原有执行主干的前提下融合新指令，减少歧义、冲突与冗余执行，并构建CHIRP基准验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 家庭机器人在执行进行中任务时需接纳新用户指令，而现有智能体常重新生成或大幅修改剩余任务序列，导致计划歧义、逻辑不一致和冗余执行。
AI.method: CIRRA为双层框架：先用LLM将新指令锚定到唯一可执行技能，并解决欠明确动作与执行位置；再保留正在进行的子任务序列作为执行主干，将新子任务插入位置匹配的片段生成整合候选；语义推理器仅评估被修改片段以识别依赖与冲突，选择逻辑最连贯的局部整合方案。
AI.result: 在CHIRP基准上，CIRRA达到74.2%决策一致率，超过最强重规划基线30个百分点，且每个正确融合决策均产生位置正确、无冲突的调度；在Unitree G1人形机器人上，CIRRA每次试验均能在正确时机中断进行中技能，并在所有指标上显著优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 结构保持式整合可在动态指令接入时维持与进行中执行的对齐，缓解歧义与不一致，并复用共享子任务以减少冗余执行，同时通过CHIRP基准和真机实验验证了方法的有效性。

title: SPW-Nav: A Streaming Panoramic World Model for Language-Guided Navigation
summary: Language-guided panoramic video generation benefits various downstream applications, such as interactive 3D scene exploration, virtual reality experiences, and embodied agent training. Existing panoramic generators follow predefined trajectories, and interactive world models act through low-level actions in perspective views. We propose SPW-Nav, a streaming panoramic world model that understands movement instructions and streams one minute of 2K 360-degree video in real time from a single panorama. SPW-Nav interprets each instruction in the previously generated panorama as camera motion. Spherical rotation decoupling applies rotation exactly on the sphere, pose-aligned conditioning keeps translation inputs bounded over long streams, and a multi-term memory with a few-step generator continues the scene as instructions change. We also build SPW-NavSet, panoramic videos with camera trajectories and verified instructions. Driven by language, SPW-Nav outperforms prior panoramic generators in camera-following accuracy and video quality, and supports on-the-fly instruction switching.

AI.tldr: 提出 SPW-Nav，一种流式全景世界模型，可根据语言指令从单张全景图实时生成一分钟 2K 360 度视频，并支持指令即时切换。
AI.motivation: 语言引导的全景视频生成可服务于交互式 3D 场景探索、虚拟现实、具身智能体训练等应用。但现有全景生成器只能沿预设轨迹生成，而交互式世界模型仅能在透视视图中通过低层动作进行操作。因此需要一个能理解移动指令、并支持实时流式生成的统一模型。
AI.method: SPW-Nav 将每条指令解释为上一帧生成全景图中的相机运动。为实现长时流式稳定生成，方法包含：球面旋转解耦，使旋转精确作用于球面；姿态对齐条件，使平移输入在长序列中保持有界；多术语记忆配合少步生成器，在指令变化时持续续写场景。此外构建了 SPW-NavSet 数据集，包含带相机轨迹与已验证指令的全景视频。
AI.result: 在语言驱动下，SPW-Nav 在相机跟随准确度和视频质量上优于先前的全景生成器，并支持即时指令切换。
AI.conclusion: SPW-Nav 通过球面几何解耦、姿态对齐条件与记忆机制，实现了语言可导航的实时流式全景世界模型，拓展了全景生成从预设轨迹到指令交互的能力。

title: The Cost of Long Memory: State, Context, and Stability Complexity in Sequence Models
summary: Long-range temporal dependence poses a resource question for sequence models: for a specified predictive-memory law, how much state, context, or dynamical criticality is required in order to forecast accurately? We study this question directly in forecasting risk. For algebraically decaying predictive memory, we prove matching upper and lower approximation bounds for exponential and finite-state modes. The best $r$-mode forecast error decays as $e^{-Θ(\sqrt r)}$, so reaching forecast error $τ$ needs $r=Θ(\log^2(1/τ))$ states or modes. Earlier curse-of-memory results establish broad limitations of stable recurrent models under different approximation notions; here both sides match for one canonical predictive target in forecast risk, which fixes the optimal resource exponent for that target. We then show that genuine fractional long memory changes the geometry itself. In particular, forecast error is measured after fractional integration, prediction from a finite context of length $L$ has an exact $1/L$ leading order, and a fixed fractional strength $d$ keeps the square-log state-complexity law. Near the short-memory boundary, we identify the relevant $d^2$ and $d^4$ scales and give a uniform constructive law in the intermediate regime. For nonlinear contextual recurrences with uniformly contractive state dynamics, we derive an exponential first-chaos envelope and an explicit necessary condition that relates forecast accuracy to the contraction margin. Vanishing forecasting error on an algebraic target forces the recurrence quantitatively toward criticality, a condition that is necessary and not by itself sufficient. Finite-sample Kullback--Leibler calculations further connect the predictive geometry to statistical information. Theorem-matched experiments with contractive state-space, gated recurrent, and attention models reproduce the state and stability predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究序列预测中"记忆资源"问题：对代数衰减的预测记忆，证明指数模式与有限状态模式的匹配上下界，最优 r 模式误差以 e^{-Θ(√r)} 衰减，达到误差 τ 需 r=Θ(log²(1/τ)) 个状态。分数长记忆改变几何结构，有限上下文长度 L 的误差呈 1/L 主阶。实验验证状态与稳定性预测。
AI.motivation: 长程时间依赖对序列模型提出资源问题：给定某个预测记忆律，为准确预测需要多少状态、上下文或动力学临界性？作者直接在预测风险框架下研究这一问题，试图确定预测目标下的最优资源指数。
AI.method: 对代数衰减预测记忆，证明指数模式与有限状态模式的匹配上、下近似界；引入分数长记忆分析几何变化，测量分数积分后的预测误差，推导有限上下文长度 L 的精确 1/L 主阶，分析短记忆边界的 d²、d⁴ 尺度及中间区间的统一构造律；对均匀收缩状态动力学的非线性上下文递推，推导指数"第一混沌"包络及将预测精度与收缩裕度关联的必要条件；用有限样本 KL 计算连接预测几何与统计信息；并以收缩状态空间、门控循环和注意力模型做定理匹配实验。
AI.result: 最优 r 模式预测误差衰减为 e^{-Θ(√r)}，达到误差 τ 需 r=Θ(log²(1/τ)) 个状态或模式，两侧界匹配并固定了该目标的最优资源指数。分数长记忆下，有限上下文预测误差主阶为 1/L；固定分数强度 d 保持平方对数状态复杂度律；短记忆边界识别出 d²、d⁴ 尺度。非线性收缩递推给出指数第一混沌包络与显式必要条件。收缩状态空间、门控循环与注意力模型的实验重现了状态与稳定性预测。
AI.conclusion: 本文在预测风险框架下为代数衰减记忆的预测目标确定了最优资源指数，并揭示分数长记忆会改变问题几何。预测误差在代数目标上趋零会定量地把递推推向临界性，该条件是必要但不充分的。有限样本 KL 计算将预测几何与统计信息联系起来，实验支持理论预测。

title: Can AI Agents Make Open-Ended Scientific Discovery? Evidence from Station
summary: Recent AI systems have made rapid progress in scientific discovery when given well-defined metrics, but whether they can autonomously undertake open-ended scientific discovery remains unclear. We investigate AI's ability to tackle open-ended tasks in Station, an open-world environment in which multiple agents simulate a scientific ecosystem. To tackle challenges specific to open-ended tasks, we propose augmenting Station with two mechanisms: a Supervisor mechanism and periodic Meta Reflection, which encourage persistent exploration even when intermediate metrics are lacking. We construct open-ended tasks from three recent oral papers presented at ICLR. We give agents the main research question studied in each paper while withholding the paper's results and disabling web access. We then measure how many of the original findings-partitioned into individual criteria-agents rediscover. We find that Station rediscovers 62.7% of the criteria on average, compared with 15.4% for Codex Multiagent-v2 and 14.4-20.6% for AI Scientist-v2. Ablation and behavioral analyses indicate that adding the two mechanisms together improves research coverage and continuity. We further evaluate Station on two open-ended tasks without oracle papers and find that some of the discoveries made by the agents closely match discoveries reported by researchers after the knowledge cutoff date. Together, these results indicate that a suitable environment can enable agents to autonomously make meaningful progress in open-ended scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AI能否自主进行开放式科学发现，提出在Station开放世界环境中加入Supervisor机制与周期性Meta Reflection两个机制，并基于ICLR三篇论文构建开放式任务进行评估。
AI.motivation: 现有AI系统在给定明确指标的科学发现任务上进展迅速，但能否自主完成开放式科学发现仍不明确，尤其是缺乏中间指标时的持续探索问题。
AI.method: 在模拟科学生态的多智能体开放环境Station中，引入Supervisor机制和周期性Meta Reflection以鼓励持续探索；基于三篇ICLR口头论文构建开放式任务，仅提供研究问题，隐藏结果并禁用网络，将原论文发现拆分为多个标准进行评测，并做消融与行为分析。
AI.result: Station平均重新发现62.7%的标准，明显高于Codex Multiagent-v2的15.4%和AI Scientist-v2的14.4–20.6%；在两项无对照论文的开放式任务中，部分发现与知识截止日期后研究者报告的成果高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 合适的评测环境能够使智能体在开放式科学发现中自主取得有意义的进展，两个机制结合可提升研究覆盖度与连续性。

title: Trajectory Planning without Trajectory Data: A Manifold-Guided Approach
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code can be found in https://github.com/SilongYong/Ariadne/
summary: A common way for trajectory planning is to leverage generative models trained on large collections of expert trajectories. At inference time, the model generates executable trajectories by conditioning on task goal constraints. However, trajectory-based methods rely on costly supervision, scale poorly with sequence length, and often generalize poorly to unseen constraints such as novel start-goal pairs. We propose an alternative to learn the underlying state-space manifold and use the geometry of the manifold for trajectory planning. This approach requires only state observations and enables generalization to unseen constraints by con- structing trajectories on the learned manifold of the state space. Experiments on Maze2D and robotic motion-planning benchmarks show that Ariadne constructs feasible paths from state-only supervision and generalizes to unseen start-goal combinations. On high-dimensional dual-arm planning, it remains competitive with trajectory-supervised and classical planners, while requiring no trajectory data for training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Ariadne，通过学习状态空间的流形几何结构进行轨迹规划，仅需状态观测即可泛化到未见过的起止点组合。
AI.motivation: 传统轨迹规划依赖大规模专家轨迹训练的生成模型，存在监督成本高、随序列长度扩展性差、难以泛化到新约束（如新起止点对）等问题。
AI.method: 提出学习状态空间底层流形，并利用该流形的几何结构构造轨迹，从而在无需轨迹数据（仅状态观测）的情况下完成规划并泛化到未见约束。
AI.result: 在Maze2D和机器人运动规划基准上，Ariadne能仅凭状态监督构造可行路径并泛化到未见起止组合；在高维双臂规划任务中，与轨迹监督方法和经典规划器相比仍具竞争力，且训练无需轨迹数据。
AI.conclusion: 利用状态流形几何进行规划可有效替代轨迹监督方法，在降低成本的同时保持规划性能与泛化能力。

title: One-Slide Calibration of Pathology Foundation Models
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop AI at Scale for Clinical Impact (ASCI): Cancer Pathology Foundation Models
summary: Scanner variation changes how pathology foundation models represent the same tissue. We introduce SlideRuler, which uses regions within a slide as internal controls to estimate and correct acquisition-induced shifts in other regions. A transfer map learned from paired rescans enables calibration from a single scan at inference while keeping the foundation model fixed. Across two encoders and five SCORPION scanners, learned transfer reduces mean target-to-source embedding distance by 16.3-38.5% relative to raw embeddings. Comparisons with unrelated same-scanner controls reveal a positive same-slide contribution across all four evaluation settings, including scanner holdout. A source-anchored variant reduces source-feature displacement by 47.7-83.6% relative to learned transfer while retaining most of its alignment gain. By drawing calibration information from the slide itself, SlideRuler offers a path toward more consistent use of frozen pathology models across imaging systems.

AI.tldr: SlideRuler利用同一张切片内的区域作为内部对照，估计并校正因扫描仪差异导致的病理基础模型表征偏移，且保持基础模型冻结。
AI.motivation: 不同扫描仪采集同一组织时，病理基础模型的表征会发生偏移，影响模型在跨成像系统上的一致使用，而现有做法往往需要改动基础模型。
AI.method: 以切片内部区域为内部对照，从配对重扫描数据中学习迁移映射；推理时仅用单次扫描进行校准，保持基础模型不变。并提出一种源锚定变体以减少源特征位移。
AI.result: 在两种编码器和五台SCORPION扫描仪上，学习到的迁移使目标到源嵌入的平均距离相对原始嵌入降低16.3-38.5%；与无关同扫描仪对照相比，四种评估设置（含扫描仪留出）均显示正向的同切片贡献；源锚定变体将源特征位移减少47.7-83.6%，同时保留了大部分对齐增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过从切片自身提取校准信息，SlideRuler为在多种成像系统上更一致地使用冻结病理模型提供了可行路径。

title: DenoFlow: Flow Matching for SSVEP Denoising under Real Physiological Artifacts
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG)-based brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), particularly steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) systems, are highly vulnerable to noise and artifacts, which severely degrade decoding accuracy. Although recent denoising approaches have shown promise, they are fitted without paired ground truth, can settle on reproducing their input, and are optimized on waveform distance alone, which says nothing about whether the output stays decodable. To address these issues, we propose DenoFlow, which casts SSVEP denoising as transport: instead of learning a direct map from a contaminated trial to a clean one, a field network regresses the velocity of the straight path between them, following the rectified-flow formulation, and denoising integrates that field forward from the observation. The field network is an encoder-decoder that sees the contaminated trial at every layer and the path position at its bottleneck, and a classifier trained alongside it supervises the integrated output. Because the observation itself is both the conditioning input and the starting point of the integration, the model never generates a trial from noise, and training reduces to regression, removing the adversarial min-max game. To obtain paired data on datasets with no ground truth, we injected physiological artifacts of the recorded electromyography (EMG) and electrooculography (EOG) signals under a controlled signal-to-noise target. Experiments on two public SSVEP datasets with five popular SSVEP decoders showed that DenoFlow outperformed seven baseline denoising models on both signal fidelity and downstream decoding accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/wzwvv/DenoFlow.

AI.tldr: 提出 DenoFlow，将 SSVEP 去噪建模为整流流传输过程，避免无配对真值与对抗训练问题，在保真度与解码精度上超越七个基线模型。
AI.motivation: 基于脑电的 BCI（尤其 SSVEP 系统）极易受噪声与伪迹干扰，严重降低解码精度。现有去噪方法存在三大缺陷：缺乏配对真值监督、可能仅学会复制输入、仅以波形距离优化，无法保证输出仍可解码。
AI.method: 将 SSVEP 去噪视为传输问题：不学习污染试次到干净试次的直接映射，而是用场网络回归两者直线路径的速度场（整流流公式），去噪时从观测出发前向积分该速度场。场网络为编码器-解码器结构，每层均可看到污染试次，瓶颈处输入路径位置；同时训练分类器监督积分输出。由于观测既是条件输入又是积分起点，模型不从头生成试次，训练退化为回归，摆脱对抗式 min-max 博弈。为在无真值数据集上获得配对数据，在受控信噪比下注入真实记录的 EMG 与 EOG 生理伪迹。
AI.result: 在两个公开 SSVEP 数据集、五种主流 SSVEP 解码器上，DenoFlow 在信号保真度与下游解码精度两方面均优于七个基线去噪模型。
AI.conclusion: DenoFlow 为 SSVEP 去噪提供了一种无需配对真值、训练稳定的传输式框架，兼顾信号保真与解码可用性，代码已开源。

title: Humanity's Sixth Sense: Benchmarking Intuitive Visual Reasoning in Multimodal Models
summary: Humans perceive far more in a scene than what is explicitly depicted: a single glance captures past causes and future trajectories; a quick peek determines if a vehicle can fit between two parked cars; a few seconds of video reveals who holds authority in a room; and a fleeting clip highlights subtle abstract patterns like unwritten rules or hidden labels. This capacity reflects a form of humanity's sixth sense: an intuitive reasoning mechanism that recovers implicit information beyond raw sensory perception. Crucially, this rapid, zero-shot visual intuition underpins everyday navigation and social interaction, making it a vital capability for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) deployed alongside people. Existing visual benchmarks, however, target either deliberate expert-level analysis in academic and mathematical domains or low-level perception, leaving the intuitive reasoning that people perform largely untested. To bridge this gap, we introduce Humanity's Sixth Sense (HSS), a benchmark for intuitive visual reasoning. HSS spans diverse image and video inputs, organizes items under a structured taxonomy, and pairs each with human-written prompts probing the implicit temporal, spatial, social, and abstract structure that people infer at a glance. Frontier MLLMs fall short of human performance: participants reach 93.1% accuracy, while the strongest model, GPT-6-astra, reaches only 53.6% even at maximum reasoning effort. Despite excelling in many complex tasks that require advanced perception and knowledge, current models still struggle significantly on these visual tasks that are intuitive for humans. We further explore agentic setup that apply dynamic visual manipulation to HSS, which narrows but does not close the gap. HSS establishes intuitive visual reasoning as a measurable axis and directs attention to a capability that scaling on current benchmarks has so far left behind.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Humanity's Sixth Sense (HSS) 基准，用于评测多模态大模型在"直觉性视觉推理"上的能力，发现前沿 MLLMs 与人类差距悬殊。
AI.motivation: 人类能凭一瞥快速推测隐式信息（如因果、轨迹、社会结构、抽象规律），这种"第六感"式的直觉推理是日常导航与社交的基础。然而现有视觉基准要么侧重专家级学术/数学分析，要么侧重低层感知，缺乏对直觉推理的评测。
AI.method: 构建 HSS 基准，涵盖多种图像与视频输入，按结构化分类法组织条目，并为每条样本配以人类撰写的提示词，探测隐式的时间、空间、社会与抽象结构。同时探索结合动态视觉操作的 agentic 设置。
AI.result: 人类参与者准确率达 93.1%，而最强模型 GPT-6-astra 即使在最大推理努力下也仅 53.6%。agentic 设置能缩小但无法消除该差距。
AI.conclusion: HSS 将直觉视觉推理确立为可测量的评测维度，指出当前模型虽在复杂任务上表现优异，但在人类直觉性的视觉任务上仍显著欠缺，提示这一能力是当前基准扩展所忽视的方向。

title: From Wearable Interfaces to Dexterous Policies: Contact Shifts and Tactile Representations
summary: Unlike conventional teleoperation, wearable interfaces allow operators to collect dexterous demonstrations through their own hand motions while directly interacting with task objects. This direct interaction reduces dependence on the target robot during collection, but it also makes the collection hardware part of the physical process that generates each demonstration. Interface geometry can influence both how a task is performed and what tactile observations are recorded for learning. We study two versions of a DexUMI-family exoskeleton that share the same robot command definition, mapping procedure, and tactile module type but differ in hand-side geometry. The revised interface reduces reported physical demand, improves selected device ratings, enables tactile access in a precision grasp that is mechanically blocked by the baseline, and produces task-dependent changes in recorded contact. Lid twisting primarily exhibits a change in contact location, whereas egg carton opening primarily exhibits a change in contact occurrence. We then train matched policies using either a binary aggregate input or a spatial-plus-force input. On lid twisting and egg carton opening, policies trained on revised-interface demonstrations achieve higher success than those trained on baseline demonstrations, with a significant pooled interface effect. Across these and two additional tasks, USB insertion and soldering tool pick and place, the spatial-plus-force input likewise outperforms binary aggregation. These results show that wearable collection hardware is part of the data-generation process for robot learning. Such interfaces should therefore be evaluated not only through operator experience, but also through the tactile interactions they make recordable and the policy performance their demonstrations support.

AI.tldr: 可穿戴数据采集接口的几何设计会影响触觉观测质量与所训练策略的性能，因此接口硬件应作为机器人学习数据生成流程的一部分来评估。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴遥操作接口让操作者用自身手部动作采集灵巧演示，减少对目标机器人的依赖，但也使采集硬件成为生成演示的物理过程的一部分；接口几何可能同时影响任务执行方式与触觉观测，而这一点尚未被系统评估。
AI.method: 对比同一DexUMI家族外骨骼的两个版本，二者共享机器人指令定义、映射流程与触觉模块类型，仅手部侧几何不同。评估操作者体验与设备评分，比较触觉可及性与记录到的接触变化，并用二元聚合输入或空间+力输入分别训练匹配策略。
AI.result: 改进版接口降低主观体力需求、提升部分设备评分，使原本被基线机械阻挡的精细抓取实现触觉访问，并带来任务相关的接触变化：旋盖主要改变接触位置，开蛋盒主要改变接触发生。基于改进版演示的策略在旋盖与开蛋盒任务上成功率更高，存在显著的接口池化效应；在旋盖、开蛋盒、USB插入与焊接工具取放四个任务上，空间+力输入均优于二元聚合。
AI.conclusion: 可穿戴采集硬件是机器人学习数据生成过程的组成部分，评估接口时不仅要看操作者体验，还要看它所使能记录的触觉交互及其演示所支撑的策略性能。

title: RACER: Reflective Agent Coupling Query Interpretation and Tool-Based Retrieval for Frame Selection in Long Video Understanding
summary: Video large language models (Vid-LLMs) excel at diverse video-language tasks by reasoning over selected frames. However, frame selection for long videos remains challenging, as it requires retrieving relevant frames distributed across segments from a large candidate pool given complex queries. This paper investigates dominant approaches to long-video frame selection from a task-decomposition perspective, identifying two key challenges: the Query Comprehension Gap in similarity-based methods and the Interpretation--Selection Gap in judgment-based methods. To address them, we propose RACER, a training-free reflective agentic framework that decomposes long-video frame selection into query interpretation driven by a lightweight Vid-LLM and evidence localization supported by an embedding model serving as a retrieval tool. Specifically, the Vid-LLM is responsible solely for reformulating the complex query into sub-queries that make implicit information requirements explicit, mitigating the Query Comprehension Gap. Meanwhile, the retrieval tool leverages these sub-queries to localize relevant evidence, relieving the Vid-LLM of direct frame selection and thus addressing the Interpretation--Selection Gap. Finally, the retrieved frames are fed back to the Vid-LLM for sub-query refinement, forming a reflection loop that iteratively improves query interpretation and frame selection. Experiments across multiple benchmarks show that RACER consistently improves long video understanding. Notably, RACER achieves effective frame selection even with limited-capability components, demonstrating that agentic integration enables these components to enhance more capable Vid-LLMs.

AI.tldr: RACER 是一个无需训练的反思路智能体框架，将长视频帧选择分解为"查询理解"与"证据定位"，通过轻量 Vid-LLM 生成子查询、嵌入模型检索帧、并循环反思优化，在多基准上稳定提升长视频理解效果。
AI.motivation: 视频大语言模型依赖选帧推理，但长视频帧选择困难：需从大候选池、跨片段中依复杂查询检索相关帧。现有方法存在两类问题——基于相似度的方法有"查询理解鸿沟"，基于判断的方法有"解释—选择鸿沟"。
AI.method: RACER 采用任务分解思路：由轻量 Vid-LLM 专门负责把复杂查询改写为显式子查询（缓解查询理解鸿沟）；由作为检索工具的嵌入模型依据子查询定位相关证据（缓解解释—选择鸿沟）；再将检索到的帧反馈给 Vid-LLM 用于子查询精炼，形成反思循环，迭代改进查询解释与帧选择。整个过程无需训练。
AI.result: 在多个基准实验上，RACER 持续提升长视频理解表现；即使组件能力有限，也能实现有效的帧选择，表明智能体式集成可让这些组件增强更强的 Vid-LLM。
AI.conclusion: 通过将帧选择分解为查询解释与证据定位并加入反思循环，RACER 有效弥合了两类鸿沟，无需训练即能提升长视频理解，并展现出跨能力组件的良好可扩展性。

title: Just for FUNS: LLM-Guided Spatio-Temporal Graph Node Generation for Forecasting Unobserved Node States
summary: Spatio-temporal forecasting is a cornerstone of logistics, urban planning, and intelligent transportation systems. However, constrained by deployment costs and maintenance resources, sensor networks often lack comprehensive spatial coverage, rendering Forecast Unobserved Node States (FUNS) a critical yet formidable challenge. Conventional models rely on historical observations and typically falter when encountering nodes without prior records. To address this, we redefine the problem as a conditional generation task on spatio-temporal graphs and propose GenST, a framework that introduces Large Language Models (LLMs) as a semantic bridge, leveraging a pre-trained LLM fine-tuned to extract rich semantic features from node descriptions, such as functional zones and road network structures, to compensate for missing spatio-temporal signals. Specifically, we design a two-stage generative architecture: a Spatio-Temporal VAE first compresses spatio-temporal dynamics into a latent space, followed by a Generative Transformer (GenT) that reconstructs the future states of unobserved nodes from noise, guided by multi-modal conditions including semantics, geographic coordinates, and neighborhood contexts. Experiments on six traffic and two non-traffic datasets show GenST significantly outperforms existing baselines in zero-shot prediction tasks, demonstrating the practical potential of semantic-guided generation for mitigating spatio-temporal data sparsity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GenST框架，将"未观测节点预测"（FUNS）重新定义为时空图上的条件生成任务，借助大语言模型从节点语义描述中提取特征以补偿缺失的时空信号，通过时空VAE与生成式Transformer的两阶段架构实现零样本预测。
AI.motivation: 传感器网络受部署成本与维护资源限制，往往缺乏完整的空间覆盖，导致大量节点没有历史观测记录。传统模型依赖历史观测数据，在面对无先验记录的节点时表现不佳，因此"未观测节点状态预测"成为关键且困难的挑战。
AI.method: 将问题重新定义为时空图上的条件生成任务，提出GenST框架：引入预训练并微调的大语言模型作为语义桥梁，从节点描述（如功能区、路网结构）中提取语义特征；设计两阶段生成架构——先用时空VAE将时空动态压缩到潜空间，再用生成式Transformer（GenT）在语义、地理坐标与邻域上下文等多模态条件引导下，从噪声中重建未观测节点的未来状态。
AI.result: 在六个交通数据集和两个非交通数据集上的实验表明，GenST在零样本预测任务中显著优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 语义引导的生成方法在缓解时空数据稀疏性方面具有实际潜力，为未观测节点状态预测提供了有效途径。

title: Socio-Foundation: A Model for Generalizable Individual Behavior Simulation via Hierarchical Capability Distillation
summary: Simulating individual behavior requires large language models (LLMs) to preserve persona traits while adapting to dynamic social contexts. However, general-purpose LLMs often flatten distinct personas, while task-specific tuning suffers from fragmentation and generalization. To overcome these challenges, we organize individual simulation into the \textbf{FONTS Taxonomy}, comprising five complementary capability dimensions: \emph{persona fidelity} (\textbf{F}), \emph{outcome realization} (\textbf{O}), \emph{behavioral naturalness} (\textbf{N}), \emph{trajectory coherence} (\textbf{T}), and \emph{social grounding} (\textbf{S}). Grounded in this taxonomy, we curate a standardized training corpus library of approximately 10 million instances across 14 representative datasets and present \textbf{Socio-Foundation}. Socio-Foundation decouples specialization from integration via a three-stage pipeline: learning task experts via DAPO, consolidating them into capability experts via off-policy distillation, and unifying them via multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). We also establish \textbf{IndiEval}, consolidating 29 metrics across the FONTS dimensions. Experiments show that Socio-Foundation outperforms its \textit{Qwen3-8B} base by 11.0 points and approaches frontier models such as \textit{GLM-5.2}, with ablations and out-of-distribution evaluations further demonstrating the effectiveness and generalization of our model.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FONTS分类法组织个体行为模拟的五维能力，构建千万级标准化语料库，并推出Socio-Foundation三阶段训练流程与IndiEval评测体系，模型较Qwen3-8B基线提升11.0分，接近前沿模型。
AI.motivation: 模拟个体行为需要大语言模型在保持人格特质的同时适应动态社会情境。然而通用大模型往往会抹平不同人格的差异，而任务专用微调又存在碎片化与泛化能力不足的问题。
AI.method: 提出FONTS分类法，涵盖人格保真度、结果实现、行为自然性、轨迹连贯性与社会基础五个能力维度；基于该分类法整理约1000万条实例、覆盖14个代表性数据集的标准化训练语料库；设计Socio-Foundation三阶段流程：用DAPO学习任务专家、通过离策略蒸馏整合为能力专家、再通过多教师在策略蒸馏（MOPD）统一；同时构建IndiEval，整合29项指标。
AI.result: Socio-Foundation相比Qwen3-8B基线提升11.0分，并接近GLM-5.2等前沿模型水平；消融实验与分布外评测进一步验证了模型的有效性与泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将个体模拟拆解为可分类的能力维度，并通过“专精—整合—统一”的解耦式训练流程，可有效兼顾人格保真与情境适应，为个体行为模拟提供了可扩展的训练与评测框架。

title: Toward Evidence-Driven Human-Agent-Robot Teaming for Earth-Independent Anomaly Triage
comment: Accepted to the Space Robotics Workshop at 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
summary: Deep-space crews cannot rely on real-time ground support for urgent off-nominal events. Initial alerts may underdetermine cause, while discriminating evidence may reside in crew observations or at locations that are unsafe, costly, or unavailable for crew inspection.
