We present an evidence-driven architecture for human-agent-robot teaming in Earth-independent anomaly triage. Agentic AI is treated as a stateful coordinator over bounded, inspectable services rather than as a fully autonomous vehicle controller. A triage state manager maintains hypotheses, evidence provenance, uncertainty, operational context, and tool status; a crew-facing embodied agent elicits observations and explains assessment changes; and a mobile robot acquires targeted, localized evidence. Typed interfaces separate dialogue and orchestration from monitoring, robot command, context retrieval, and safety-critical control. Two scenarios illustrate the architecture: a crewed deep-space mission based on an actual ISS ammonia false alarm, where suspected contamination restricts crew access, and a power-interface anomaly at a crewed lunar base, where robotic inspection distinguishes a local connector fault from other causes ambiguous in remote telemetry. Our main contribution is an authority-bounded closed evidence-loop architecture, exercised in a hardware-in-the-loop integration prototype using Reachy Mini and an Innate MARS mobile robot.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种“证据驱动”的人-智能体-机器人团队协作架构，用于地球独立（无实时地面支持）的深空异常分诊，将智能体式AI定位为对可检查服务的有界状态协调器，而非全自主车辆控制器。
AI.motivation: 深空乘组无法依赖实时地面支持处理紧急异常。初始警报往往无法确定根本原因，而关键判别证据可能存在于乘组观察中，或位于不安全、成本高或乘组无法抵达的位置，因此需要一种能够在无地面支持下进行异常分诊的协作架构。
AI.method: 构建证据驱动的“人-智能体-机器人”团队架构：分诊状态管理器维护假设、证据溯源、不确定性、运行上下文与工具状态；面向乘组的具身智能体负责收集观察并解释评估变化；移动机器人获取定向、局部证据；通过类型化接口将对话与编排同监测、机器人指令、上下文检索及安全关键控制分离。并在硬件在环集成原型中使用Reachy Mini与Innate MARS移动机器人进行验证。
AI.result: 通过两个场景说明架构有效性：一是基于真实国际空间站氨气误报的载人深空任务场景，疑似污染限制乘组进入；二是载人月球基地的电源接口异常场景，机器人检查可区分局部连接器故障与远程遥测中含糊的其他原因。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是一种“权限受限的闭环证据回路”架构，并在硬件在环集成原型中进行了实际演练。

title: S2Tok: Streaming 3D Gaussian Reconstruction with Persistent Spatial Tokens
summary: Streaming 3D reconstruction requires more than a sequence of geometric predictions: it requires a persistent scene state that can incorporate new evidence and remain renderable as observations arrive. Latent spatial tokens offer a promising representation for this purpose, but constructing them from an image collection leaves open how to maintain them online, where each observation may both revisit known regions and reveal new content. We introduce S2Tok, a feed-forward framework that maintains a size-adaptive, persistent scene state from uncalibrated image streams. Its central idea is to distinguish updates to the existing representation from selective expansion. A spatially informed transformer integrates each incoming observation with the persistent scene tokens, while a learned admission module selectively expands the representation to limit redundant storage. A hierarchical decoder and Gaussian head convert the evolving state into non-pixel-aligned 3D Gaussians, enabling novel-view rendering without caching previous frames. Experiments across four benchmarks demonstrate competitive streaming rendering quality with compact Gaussian representations. These results support latent spatial tokens as a persistent computational state for online 3D reconstruction, combining learned scene updates with explicit Gaussian rendering.

AI.tldr: 提出 S2Tok，一种前馈框架，从无标定图像流中维护尺寸自适应、持久的场景状态，通过区分"更新已有表示"与"选择性扩展"实现流式三维重建与渲染。
AI.motivation: 流式三维重建不仅需要几何预测序列，还需要一个能持续吸收新证据、并始终保持可渲染的持久场景状态。潜空间 token 是有前景的表示形式，但如何在观测不断到来（既可能重访已知区域又可能揭示新内容）的情况下在线维护这些 token，仍是一个未解决的问题。
AI.method: 核心思想是区分对已有表示的更新与选择性扩展。使用空间感知的 Transformer 将每个新观测与持久场景 token 融合；引入可学习的准入模块（admission module）选择性地扩展表示以抑制冗余存储；再通过分层解码器与高斯头将演化中的状态转换为非像素对齐的三维高斯，从而无需缓存历史帧即可实现新视角渲染。
AI.result: 在四个基准上取得具有竞争力的流式渲染质量，同时保持紧凑的高斯表示。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明潜空间 token 可作为在线三维重建的持久计算状态，将可学习的场景更新与显式高斯渲染相结合。

title: HydroSphere: A Framework for Governed, Self-Healing Wastewater Infrastructure
comment: 16 pages, 5 tables and 9 figures - article to be submitted to a Journal / Conference
summary: Rapid industrialization and urban growth are increasing pressure on water quality and wastewater treatment systems, while conventional treatment plants often rely on static monitoring and control strategies that cannot easily adapt to changing pollutant conditions. This paper presents HydroSphere, a governed, data-driven framework for real-time water quality monitoring, forecasting, treatment optimization, and fault recovery. HydroSphere is evaluated using 2.82 million water-quality measurements collected between 1940 and 2023. The framework integrates three main components. First, a hybrid TCN-LSTM model performs multi-step forecasting across seven water-quality parameters, achieving an RMSE of 0.1417, MAE of 0.1047, and R2 of 0.3596. Second, the Adaptive Dosage Optimization Module uses PPO reinforcement learning to adjust chemical dosing, achieving a mean step reward of 1.059 compared with 1.017 for a fixed-dose baseline. The results also show that unconstrained reward optimization can lead to excessive dosing, demonstrating the need for explicit operational safeguards. Third, the SHADE anomaly detection module uses a deep autoencoder to identify sensor and process anomalies, achieving an F1 score of 0.651 under controlled fault injection. HydroSphere combines these capabilities with tiered governance, deterministic safety bounds, and human oversight to support safer and more adaptive water infrastructure. The framework provides a scalable foundation for intelligent wastewater management and supports the objectives of UN Sustainable Development Goals 6 and 13.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HydroSphere框架，一个受治理约束的数据驱动系统，用于实时水质监测、预测、处理优化与故障恢复，基于282万条水质数据评估。
AI.motivation: 快速工业化与城市增长对水质和污水处理系统施压，而传统处理厂依赖静态监测与控制策略，难以适应变化的污染物状况。
AI.method: 框架包含三部分：混合TCN-LSTM模型对七个水质参数进行多步预测；自适应投药优化模块采用PPO强化学习调整化学投药；SHADE异常检测模块使用深度自编码器识别传感器与过程异常。整体结合分层治理、确定性安全边界与人工监督。
AI.result: 预测RMSE 0.1417、MAE 0.1047、R2 0.3596；PPO投药平均步奖励1.059，高于固定投药基线1.017，且无约束奖励优化会导致过量投药；异常检测F1为0.651（受控故障注入下）。
AI.conclusion: HydroSphere支持更安全、更自适应的水务基础设施，为智能污水管理提供可扩展基础，并助力联合国可持续发展目标6和13。

title: Verify Less, Evolve More: Training Idea-Level Critics for Verification-Efficient ML Evolving Agents
summary: As large language models become more powerful, self-evolving agents are able to tackle challenging tasks including AI for machine learning (AI4ML). In AI4ML, while empirical verification is available, it often requires computationally costly model training and evaluation, limiting the speed and scale of agent evolution. Yet verification efficiency remains under-explored, and frontier models provide only limited gains when used directly as idea selectors. We address this gap with specialized idea-level critic models that predict whether a proposed ML modification will improve upon the current solution, allowing agents to screen ideas and concentrate verification resources on the most promising candidates. We train the critic models through supervised fine-tuning on high-quality critiques synthesized by Gemini-3.1-Pro, followed by GRPO to further improve their predictive accuracy. Empirically, our critic models outperform Gemini-3.1-Pro in static idea evaluation, and these gains extend to agent inference, continual learning, and policy training. During inference-time evolution, they improve final solution quality under the same verification budget by selecting more promising ideas, with further gains from continual learning. During policy training, they serve as learned reward models, reserving empirical verification for uncertain cases and enabling substantially more policy updates with the same verification resources. Together, these results show that idea-level critic models help ML agents discover better solutions and learn stronger proposal policies under limited verification budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出专门的"想法级"评论家模型（critic models），用于预测某个机器学习修改方案是否能改进当前解，从而帮助AI4ML智能体在有限验证预算下筛选高质量想法、提升进化效率。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型能力增强，自进化智能体可应对AI4ML等挑战性任务。但在AI4ML中，经验验证通常需要昂贵的模型训练与评估，限制了智能体进化的速度与规模。验证效率问题尚未被充分研究，而直接使用前沿模型作为想法筛选器收益有限。
AI.method: 训练专门的评论家模型：先用Gemini-3.1-Pro合成的高质量评论进行监督微调，再通过GRPO进一步提升预测准确率。这些模型用于预测所提ML修改是否能改进当前解，使智能体能够筛选想法并将验证资源集中于最有前景的候选。
AI.result: 在静态想法评估中，评论家模型优于Gemini-3.1-Pro，且这一优势可扩展至智能体推理、持续学习与策略训练。在推理时进化中，相同验证预算下通过筛选更优想法提升最终解质量，并可从持续学习中获得进一步增益；在策略训练中，它们作为学习到的奖励模型，将经验验证保留给不确定情况，从而在相同验证资源下实现显著更多的策略更新。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，想法级评论家模型能够帮助ML智能体在有限验证预算下发现更好的解并学习更强的提议策略。

title: HULK: Learning Whole-Body Forceful Loco-Manipulation for Humanoids
comment: 16 pages, 7 figures, IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation 2027
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation of large, heavy objects demands forceful interaction across the entire body. However, such payloads shift a humanoid's center of mass and impose sustained loads across the upper body, challenging balance and command tracking. We present HULK, a whole-body control framework for forceful loco-manipulation. Using model predictive control (MPC) to guide reinforcement learning with predictions of the loaded dynamics, we train two teachers: one tracks arm motions under wrist forces, and the other locomotes while holding large objects against the body. A capture-point control barrier function augments the wrist-force teacher during training to improve balance under load. We distill both teachers into a single policy. Evaluation spans simulation and the Unitree G1. In simulation, the teacher with the barrier function achieves the lowest forward and lateral velocity tracking errors at 10 kg per arm among evaluated controllers and reduces aggregate divergent component of motion (DCM) excursion magnitude by 35.7% relative to MPC-guided reinforcement learning alone. Our wrist-force teacher withstands torso push disturbances of up to 130 N.

AI.tldr: HULK 是一个面向人形机器人全身强力 loco-manipulation 的控制框架，结合 MPC 引导强化学习、双教师蒸馏与 capture-point 控制障碍函数，实现对大型重载物体的稳定平衡与运动。在仿真与 Unitree G1 上验证，手臂负载 10 kg 时跟踪误差最低，DCM 偏移幅度降低 35.7%，并可承受 130 N 躯干推力干扰。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人搬运大型重型物体需要全身强力交互，但负载会改变质心并对上肢施加持续载荷，严重挑战平衡与指令跟踪能力，现有方法难以兼顾强力操作与稳定运动。
AI.method: 提出 HULK 全身控制框架：用模型预测控制（MPC）预测负载动力学以引导强化学习；训练两个教师策略，分别负责腕部受力下的手臂运动跟踪与抱持大型物体时的行走；在腕力教师训练中引入 capture-point 控制障碍函数以增强负载下的平衡；最后将两个教师蒸馏为单一策略。
AI.result: 在仿真与 Unitree G1 上评估。仿真中，含障碍函数的教师在双臂各 10 kg 负载下取得最低的前向与侧向速度跟踪误差，相较仅用 MPC 引导强化学习的方法，聚合 DCM 偏移幅度降低 35.7%；腕力教师可承受高达 130 N 的躯干推力干扰。
AI.conclusion: HULK 通过 MPC 引导的多教师强化学习与蒸馏、结合控制障碍函数，有效提升了人形机器人在重载全身操作中的平衡与指令跟踪能力，并在实体机器人上得到验证。

title: Zero-Shot Brain MRI Inpainting with 2.5D Unconditional Flow Priors
summary: Generative inpainting of brain MRI volumes is essential for synthesizing healthy tissue in pathological regions, improving the accuracy and reliability of automated downstream brain analysis applications such as image registration, brain extraction, and segmentation. However, standard 3D approaches are computationally prohibitive, while efficient 2D slice-wise methods suffer from severe inter-slice discontinuities. Furthermore, traditional models rely on conditional training, requiring task-specific learning of masked inputs. We propose a zero-shot brain MRI inpainting framework utilizing 2.5D unconditional flow priors to capture spatial context along the superior-inferior axis without the overhead of full 3D convolutions. During training, our flow matching model learns the joint distribution of adjacent axial slice triplets, modeling the manifold of healthy brain anatomy while explicitly excluding pathological regions from the loss function. At inference, the model processes the input triplets autoregressively along the depth axis. We employ the Restora-Flow solver to constrain the unconditional prior using the input mask, achieving accurate zero-shot inpainting. Evaluations show our 2.5D strategy resolves the structural discontinuities of 2D baselines, synthesizing plausible healthy tissue while maintaining volumetric consistency across the axial, sagittal, and coronal planes. As a final step, we generate and average an ensemble of multiple stochastic reconstructions to form the final prediction. Quantitative results benchmarked on the official BraTS 2026 Inpainting Challenge validation set demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed approach, yielding an SSIM of 0.816 $\pm$ 0.112, MSE of 0.007 $\pm$ 0.005, and PSNR of 22.923 $\pm$ 4.343. Code is available at https://github.com/imigraz/brats2026-inpainting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种零样本脑部MRI修复框架，利用2.5D无条件流匹配先验沿上下轴捕捉空间上下文，在推理时自回归处理相邻轴位三切片，并用Restora-Flow求解器结合输入掩膜约束，从而实现无需条件训练的准确修复。
AI.motivation: 脑部MRI体积的生成式修复对合成病理区域的健康组织至关重要，可提升配准、脑提取和分割等下游任务的准确性。但现有方法存在不足：标准3D方法计算开销过大，高效的2D逐切片方法存在严重的层间不连续，且传统模型依赖条件训练，需要针对特定任务学习掩膜输入。
AI.method: 提出基于2.5D无条件流先验的零样本修复框架。训练时，流匹配模型学习相邻轴位三切片的联合分布，建模健康脑解剖流形，并在损失函数中显式排除病理区域。推理时沿深度轴自回归处理输入三切片，采用Restora-Flow求解器利用输入掩膜约束无条件先验，实现准确的零样本修复。最后生成并平均多个随机重建的集成作为最终预测。
AI.result: 在官方BraTS 2026修复挑战赛验证集上的定量评测表明方法有效：SSIM为0.816±0.112，MSE为0.007±0.005，PSNR为22.923±4.343。
AI.conclusion: 2.5D策略解决了2D基线的结构不连续问题，能合成合理的健康组织，并在轴位、矢状位和冠状位保持体积一致性。

title: Task-Oriented Key-Layer KV Communication for Efficient Latent Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: Large language model-based multi-agent systems improve complex problem solving through collaboration, while latent communication directly transmits model internal states to avoid the high inference costs of natural language. However, existing KV-based latent communication methods prioritize sender-side state fidelity, leading to substantial communication and computation overhead and potentially introducing redundant information. To address these limitations, we revisit latent communication from a task-oriented perspective, shifting its objective from sender-side state fidelity to receiver-side task sufficiency. Under this formulation, we propose KITE, a training-free framework for task-oriented key-layer KV communication. KITE identifies a task-effective key layer using a receiver trajectory distortion criterion, transmits only the latent working memory associated with the key layer, and further uses the same layer as the entry point for autoregressive latent reasoning. Experiments on seven benchmarks across two model families and three model scales show that, compared with full-layer KV communication, KITE reduces communication volume by 28-36$\times$, achieves up to 3$\times$ end-to-end inference speedup, and improves accuracy by up to 23.3 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KITE，一种面向任务的免训练关键层KV隐式通信框架，将隐式通信目标从发送端状态保真转向接收端任务充分性，大幅降低通信与计算开销并提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统通过协作提升复杂问题求解能力，隐式通信直接传输模型内部状态以避免自然语言推理的高昂成本。然而现有基于KV的隐式通信方法以发送端状态保真为目标，导致通信和计算开销巨大，并可能引入冗余信息。
AI.method: 作者从任务导向视角重新审视隐式通信，将目标从发送端状态保真转为接收端任务充分性。据此提出KITE，一个免训练的任务导向关键层KV通信框架：利用接收端轨迹失真准则识别任务有效关键层，仅传输与该关键层相关的隐式工作记忆，并以同一层作为自回归隐式推理的入口。
AI.result: 在两个模型家族、三种模型规模的七个基准上，与全层KV通信相比，KITE将通信量减少28-36倍，实现最高3倍的端到端推理加速，并将准确率提升最高23.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: KITE通过面向任务的隐式通信范式，在显著降低通信与计算开销的同时提升任务性能，验证了接收端任务充分性作为隐式通信优化目标的有效性。

title: How Fragile Is On-Device Language Model Safety? Localizing Safety-Critical Parameters for Sparse Fault Analysis
summary: As small language models (SLMs) are increasingly deployed on resource-constrained and on-device platforms, including as components of agentic systems, the integrity of locally stored model parameters becomes an important safety concern. We investigate whether safety-sensitive behavior in LLaMA-2-7B-Chat is concentrated within a sparse subset of parameters, creating a reduced fault surface for targeted analysis. We study two complementary localization methods: low-rank safety-associated subspace analysis and parameter-level safety--utility importance filtering. Both approaches reveal highly non-uniform safety sensitivity across the network, with the MLP down_proj consistently emerging as a prominent safety-sensitive component and o_proj providing a smaller contribution. Using parameter-level localization, modifying only 0.19% of model weights in down_proj yields 53% Basic ASR and 56% GCG ASR, while tinyBenchmarks accuracy remains at 51.6% compared with a 52.2% unmodified baseline. These results motivate targeted fault analysis and selective integrity protection for language models deployed in resource-constrained, on-device, and agentic settings.

AI.tldr: 研究LLaMA-2-7B-Chat中安全敏感行为是否集中于稀疏参数子集，发现仅修改down_proj中0.19%权重即可显著提升攻击成功率，同时几乎不影响基准准确率。
AI.motivation: 小型语言模型日益部署于资源受限和端侧平台，甚至作为智能体系统组件，本地存储的模型参数完整性成为重要安全隐患。作者希望探究安全敏感行为是否集中于稀疏参数子集，从而形成可利用的"缩减故障面"。
AI.method: 采用两种互补的定位方法：(1) 低秩安全关联子空间分析；(2) 参数级安全—效用重要性过滤。在LLaMA-2-7B-Chat上分析安全敏感性的非均匀分布，定位关键组件。
AI.result: 两种方法均显示网络安全性敏感度高度非均匀，MLP的down_proj始终是最突出的安全敏感组件，o_proj贡献较小。参数级定位中，仅修改down_proj中0.19%的权重即达到53% Basic ASR和56% GCG ASR，而tinyBenchmarks准确率保持51.6%（未修改基线为52.2%）。
AI.conclusion: 安全敏感行为确实集中在稀疏参数子集中，为资源受限、端侧及智能体场景下部署的语言模型提供靶向故障分析与选择性完整性保护的依据。

title: PhysEvo: Astra Can Act, Let It
summary: Astra can act, yet reliable manipulation depends on the system through which it observes and controls the world. We introduce PhysEvo, a framework for physical recursive self-improvement (RSI) around a single frozen model. A task agent executes robot tasks; a meta-agent uses the resulting trajectories to diagnose failures, revise tools and skills, and test corrections. The meta-agent can also improve its own diagnostic tools, so retained revisions support both later action and later self-improvement. This process develops joint-level control, evidence-seeking observation, and reusable manipulation skills without model-weight updates or a separately trained action policy. Across 42 RoboDojo tasks, held-out-layout evaluation of retained task-specific deployment versions yields a five-dimension average score of 68.14/100 and 62.00% success, compared with 47.17% for RoboDawn's one-shot Astra agent, the strongest published reference in our comparison. On eight manipulation tasks challenging direct Astra, PhysEvo achieves 55.00% success, compared with 1.25% for the direct-Astra reference. Deploying the simulation-evolved harness on AgileX PiPER and continuing skill revision yields 90.60/100 average score and 84.00% success across 25 trials on five real-world tasks. PhysEvo turns the consequences of action into persistent, testable changes to how a frozen model acts and improves.

AI.tldr: PhysEvo提出围绕单一冻结模型的物理递归自我改进框架，通过任务智能体与元智能体的协作，在不更新模型权重的情况下实现机器人操作能力的持续进化。
AI.motivation: Astra虽能行动，但可靠的操作依赖其观察与控制世界的系统。作者希望在不更新模型权重、也不单独训练动作策略的前提下，让冻结模型通过递归自我改进获得操作能力提升。
AI.method: 框架包含两部分：任务智能体执行机器人任务；元智能体利用产生的轨迹诊断失败、修订工具与技能并测试修正。元智能体还能改进自身诊断工具，使保留的修订同时支持后续行动与后续自我改进，从而发展关节级控制、求证据式观察和可复用操作技能。
AI.result: 在42个RoboDojo任务上，保留的任务特定部署版本在留出布局评估中五维平均分为68.14/100、成功率62.00%，对比RoboDawn一次性Astra智能体（最强公开参照）的47.17%。在8个挑战直接Astra的操作任务上，PhysEvo成功率达55.00%，直接Astra参照仅1.25%。将仿真进化框架部署到AgileX PiPER并继续技能修订，在5个真实任务25次试验中取得90.60/100平均分和84.00%成功率。
AI.conclusion: PhysEvo将行动的后果转化为对冻结模型如何行动与改进的持久、可测试的改变，实现无需权重更新的物理递归自我改进。

title: Personalize at Test Time: Learning User Preferences for Image Generation
summary: Diffusion models can generate high-quality images, yet aligning their outputs with individual user preferences remains challenging. A key bottleneck is accurately modeling diverse user preferences from limited feedback. Existing approaches often rely on labor-intensive manual preference annotations or vision-language models (VLM) to extract preference information from user interaction histories, introducing substantial annotation or computational costs that limit scalability. We propose an approach that learns personalized reward models directly from users' historical image preference pairs. First, we use an autoencoder to compress hundreds of visual attributes into 50 attribute-anchored preference dimensions and train an evaluator to score images along these dimensions. We then represent each user's preferences as a linear combination of the shared dimension scores, estimating the user-specific weights by maximizing the likelihood of their observed pairwise preferences under the Bradley-Terry model. This formulation reduces per-user adaptation to optimizing a low-dimensional weight vector, simplifying optimization and enabling data-efficient personalization from sparse feedback. The learned personalized rewards guide image generation at inference time while keeping the diffusion model frozen. Experiments on real-user preference data show that our approach achieves approximately 77% held-out pairwise preference prediction accuracy and improves the alignment of generated images with individual user preferences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种从用户历史图像偏好对中直接学习个性化奖励模型的方法，通过自编码器压缩视觉属性为50个偏好维度，再用Bradley-Terry模型估计用户权重，实现数据高效的用户个性化图像生成对齐。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型能生成高质量图像，但难以对齐个体用户偏好。关键瓶颈在于从有限反馈中准确建模多样的用户偏好。现有方法依赖人工标注或视觉语言模型（VLM）提取偏好信息，带来高昂的标注或计算成本，限制了可扩展性。
AI.method: 1) 使用自编码器将数百个视觉属性压缩为50个属性锚定的偏好维度，并训练评估器沿这些维度打分；2) 将每个用户的偏好表示为共享维度分数的线性组合，在Bradley-Terry模型下通过最大化观测成对偏好的似然估计用户特定权重；3) 该形式将每用户适配简化为优化低维权重向量，实现从稀疏反馈中数据高效地个性化；4) 学到的个性化奖励在推理时引导图像生成，同时保持扩散模型冻结。
AI.result: 在真实用户偏好数据上的实验显示，该方法达到约77%的留出成对偏好预测准确率，并提升了生成图像与个体用户偏好的对齐度。
AI.conclusion: 该方法无需人工标注或VLM，直接从历史偏好对中学习个性化奖励，计算高效且可扩展，能有效将扩散模型输出对齐到个体用户偏好。

title: A Vehicle-Integrated Approach to Digital Twin Deployment for Bridges Through Drive-By Sensing
comment: Extended abstract for 2nd International Conference on Engineering Structures (ICES2026)
summary: Ageing bridge infrastructure is a growing global concern, yet conventional Structural Health Monitoring (SHM) systems are costly and difficult to scale, and routine visual inspections remain subjective. Drive-by, or indirect, bridge inspection, in which a sensorised vehicle recovers structural information from vehicle-bridge interaction (VBI) and vehicle-road interaction (VRI) responses, offers a scalable alternative. However, key challenges remain unresolved, including separating bridge responses from road roughness, detecting damage under normal traffic, and generalising across diverse bridge types. This paper presents a vehicle-integrated digital twin framework that unifies physics-based modelling and machine learning for continuous monitoring of bridge and road conditions. The framework comprises three pillars. First, surrogate models of VBI and VRI are constructed using a Fourier Neural Operator that learns function-to-function mappings from operating conditions to vehicle responses. Trained on both simulated and field data, these surrogates deliver millisecond-scale inference, replacing computationally intensive full-order analyses. Second, the design of a custom electric inspection vehicle, its sensor layout, and signal processing chain are optimised through Bayesian optimisation to maximise bridge information yield while suppressing road and vehicle noise. Unsupervised damage-assessment pipelines based on adversarial autoencoders, matrix profiles, and transformer architectures have been developed and validated to process the resulting vehicle data. Third, the complete workflow is validated through coordinated multi-site field trials in Australia and Japan, covering a range of bridge types, traffic conditions, and environmental settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个车辆集成数字孪生框架，融合物理建模与机器学习，用于桥梁与道路状态的连续监测，并通过在澳大利亚和日本的多场地实测验证。
AI.motivation: 全球桥梁老化问题日益突出，而传统结构健康监测系统成本高、难以规模化，常规目视检测又存在主观性。驱动式（间接）桥梁检测利用传感车辆从车-桥与车-路相互作用响应中提取结构信息，具备可扩展性，但仍有若干关键难题待解决：如何将桥梁响应与路面粗糙度分离、如何在正常交通下检测损伤、如何泛化到不同类型的桥梁。
AI.method: 框架由三大支柱构成：其一，用傅里叶神经算子（FNO）构建车-桥相互作用与车-路相互作用的代理模型，学习从运营条件到车辆响应的函数到函数映射，基于仿真与实测数据训练，实现毫秒级推理以替代高成本的全阶分析；其二，通过贝叶斯优化设计定制电动检测车辆、传感器布局与信号处理链路，在最大化桥梁信息产出的同时抑制路面与车辆噪声，并开发基于对抗自编码器、矩阵剖面和Transformer架构的无监督损伤评估流程；其三，在澳大利亚与日本开展协调多场地实测，覆盖多种桥型、交通与环境条件，验证完整工作流。
AI.result: 代理模型实现毫秒级推理；经贝叶斯优化得到的车辆与传感配置提升了桥梁信息产出并抑制了噪声；无监督损伤评估流程在实测车辆数据上得到验证；完整工作流在澳、日多场地实测中通过验证，覆盖多种桥型、交通与环境条件。
AI.conclusion: 该车辆集成数字孪生框架将物理建模与机器学习统一起来，为桥梁与道路状态的连续、可扩展监测提供了一条可行路径，并通过跨国多场地实测证明了其适用性与可推广性。

title: Learning to Report Unsafe Tasks in a Multi-Agent Game
summary: When agents share a reward for completed tasks, reporting unsafe work can reduce the reporter's reward by stopping a task. Audits can make reporting optimal without ensuring that further training teaches a silent team to report. We study this learning problem in a game where any witness can stop a task by reporting. With $k$ witnesses per task sharing a policy and drawing independently, the expected-reward derivative with respect to their shared silence probability counts each task's benefit $k$ times at universal silence. The comparison with universal reporting counts it once. For arbitrary policy groups, we give an audit condition sufficient for exact policy-gradient updates to reach universal reporting and, apart from boundary cases, necessary near universal silence. In a balanced family, the cheapest audits meeting the condition with prescribed positive margins cost exactly $k$ times as much for full sharing as for one policy per role. We train PPO policies on 24 witness graphs from learned silence. Separating co-witnesses reduces unsafe completion by 33.59 percentage points compared with shuffled groups of the same sizes under the same audits (95% graph-bootstrap interval: 21.03-45.13). Only 9 of 48 witness-group runs achieve below 1% unsafe completion while retaining at least 90% legitimate completion. At the same audit budget, a fully shared network meets both thresholds in none of 48 runs with independent action draws and all 48 with a common draw.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多见证人共享奖励时"报告不安全行为"这一合作行为的学习问题：共享策略会导致梯度把任务收益重复计入（k重），使普遍沉默成为吸引子；作者给出审计条件以保证策略梯度收敛到普遍报告，并在PPO实验中验证分离共同见证人可显著降低不安全完成率。
AI.motivation: 当多个智能体共享完成任务所获得的奖励时，报告不安全行为会因为中止任务而减少报告者自身的收益，从而抑制报告动机。审计可以改变激励，但即便在审计下报告成为最优选择，进一步的训练也未必能让原本沉默的团队学会报告。因此需要从学习动力学而非仅从激励设计角度，研究团队能否学会报告。
AI.method: 构建一个博弈：任何见证人都可通过报告中止任务。设每个任务有 k 个见证人，共享同一策略且独立采样，分析期望奖励对共享沉默概率的导数——在普遍沉默处，每个任务的收益被计算 k 次；而普遍报告处只计一次。针对任意策略分组，给出使精确策略梯度更新能到达普遍报告的审计充分条件，并证明除边界情形外该条件在普遍沉默附近也是必要的。进一步在"平衡族"中比较完全共享与每个角色一个策略的审计成本。最后用 PPO 在 24 个见证人图上从已学会的沉默状态开始训练。
AI.result: 理论上，平衡族中满足给定正边际条件的最便宜审计，其成本在完全共享情形下恰好是每角色一个策略情形的 k 倍。实验上，在相同审计下，将共同见证人分离相比同规模随机打乱的组，不安全完成率降低 33.59 个百分点（95% 图自助区间 21.03–45.13）。48 次见证组运行中仅 9 次在保持至少 90% 合法完成的同时将不安全完成率降到 1% 以下。同一审计预算下，完全共享网络在独立动作采样时 48 次运行无一满足双阈值，而在共同采样时 48 次全部满足。
AI.conclusion: 审计虽能使报告在激励上最优，但不足以保证学习动力学收敛到普遍报告；梯度中的重复计数使完全共享策略更易陷入沉默，需要更强或更昂贵的审计。分离共同见证人、以及在完全共享时使用共同采样，可显著提升团队学会报告的能力并减少不安全任务完成。

title: MimicX: Policy-in-the-Loop Supervision Refinement for Video-Driven Humanoid Motion Tracking
comment: 33 pages, 26 figures, 19 tables, including references and appendices. Project website: https://nebulis-lab.com/MimicX
summary: Human videos provide rich motion targets for humanoid learning, yet visually plausible references can still produce persistent failures under physics-based execution. These failures reveal where training supervision should change. We present MimicX, a policy-in-the-loop framework that uses execution feedback to refine video-driven humanoid motion tracking. Starting from reconstructed and retargeted motion, MimicX localizes difficult transitions and affected body regions, then jointly adapts tracking objectives and the reset curriculum for policy continuation. Repeated rollout verification selects execution-priority improvements subject to tracking guards. Across four core video tasks, MimicX consistently improves tracking accuracy and Robust Execution Horizon relative to the Fixed Reference baseline. Task-averaged results show a 25.7% reduction in body-tracking error and a 255.6% increase in execution horizon. Additional video, motion-reference, and collision-scene studies evaluate the method beyond the core tasks, while MimicX-HLoop accelerates feedback through heterogeneous execution. Overall, MimicX turns policy failure into actionable supervision for deciding what to refine and which refinement to retain.

AI.tldr: MimicX是一个策略在环框架，利用执行反馈来细化视频驱动的人形运动跟踪，通过定位困难过渡并联合调整跟踪目标与重置课程，显著提升跟踪精度和可执行时长。
AI.motivation: 人类视频为人形学习提供了丰富的运动目标，但视觉上合理的参考在基于物理的执行中仍会产生持续失败。这些失败揭示了训练监督应改变的环节，因此需要一个能利用执行反馈来改进训练的方法。
AI.method: MimicX从重建和重定向后的运动出发，定位困难过渡和受影响的身体区域，然后联合调整跟踪目标与重置课程以支持策略延续。通过重复的rollout验证，在跟踪约束下选择以执行为优先的改进。此外，MimicX-HLoop通过异构执行加速反馈循环。
AI.result: 在四个核心视频任务上，MimicX相对固定参考基线持续提升跟踪精度和鲁棒执行时域。任务平均结果显示身体跟踪误差降低25.7%，执行时域增加255.6%。额外的视频、运动参考和碰撞场景研究进一步评估了该方法。
AI.conclusion: MimicX将策略失败转化为可操作的监督信号，用于决定细化什么内容以及保留哪种细化方案，从而有效衔接视频驱动参考与基于物理的执行。

title: Beyond Explanation: Debugging Medical Imaging Models via Concept Intervention
comment: Accepted at the 5th Workshop on Applications of Medical AI (AMAI), MICCAI 2026
summary: Medical imaging models often operate as black boxes, limiting interpretability and systematic debugging. We introduce an easy-to-use, plug-and-play framework for concept-based interpretation and model refinement. By aligning a single-modality encoder to BioMedCLIP, we construct a Concept Bottleneck Model (CBM) that enables concept-level interventions. These interventions allow us to isolate causal versus spuriously correlated concepts, validate insights with domain experts, and generate counterfactual samples for targeted fine-tuning. We evaluate our framework on a Mayo Clinic ultrasound dataset and the CheXpert 5x200 chest X-ray dataset. Results demonstrate that concept intervention enables reliable model diagnosis while maintaining, and occasionally improving predictive performance via guided fine-tuning. Our findings highlight the practical value of this framework for controlled, interpretable refinement of clinical deep learning models.

AI.tldr: 提出一种即插即用的概念瓶颈框架，用于医学影像模型的可解释性分析与模型改进。
AI.motivation: 医学影像模型常为黑箱，限制可解释性与系统性调试。
AI.method: 将单模态编码器对齐到BioMedCLIP，构建概念瓶颈模型（CBM），实现概念级干预，用于区分因果与虚假相关概念、专家验证及生成反事实样本进行定向微调。
AI.result: 在Mayo Clinic超声数据集和CheXpert 5x200胸片数据集上评估，概念干预可可靠诊断模型，并通过引导微调维持甚至提升预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架对临床深度学习模型的可控、可解释改进具有实用价值。

title: HCPN-GCN: Scaling Hierarchical Prototype Networks with Cone Geometry for Continual Graph Learning
summary: Continual Graph Learning (CGL) aims to incrementally learn from graph-structured data while preserving knowledge acquired from previous tasks. A major challenge in this setting is catastrophic forgetting, where learning new tasks degrades performance on previously learned ones. Hierarchical Prototype Networks (HPNs) address this problem through a prototype-based memory mechanism that avoids storing historical data, but their reliance on linear feature extractors limits their ability to exploit graph topology, while point-based prototypes often lead to inefficient prototype growth on structurally diverse graphs. In this work, we propose HCPN-GCN, a graph-aware extension of HPN that replaces the original linear feature extractors with Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) and introduces cone-based prototypes with a diversity regularization objective. The proposed design produces richer graph-aware representations while compactly modeling the embedding space, reducing prototype proliferation without sacrificing discriminability. Experimental results on six continual graph learning benchmarks demonstrate that HCPN-GCN consistently improves average classification accuracy over the original HPN and representative continual learning baselines while maintaining near-zero forgetting. Furthermore, our analysis shows that the proposed model learns substantially richer class-level prototype hierarchies using approximately $30\times$ fewer atomic prototypes than the original HPN, providing a more compact and effective memory representation for continual graph learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HCPN-GCN，用图卷积网络替换HPN中的线性特征提取器，并引入锥形原型与多样性正则，从而在持续图学习中以更紧凑的记忆实现更低遗忘与更高准确率。
AI.motivation: 持续图学习需增量学习图结构数据并保留旧任务知识，核心难题是灾难性遗忘。层次原型网络（HPN）通过基于原型的记忆机制避免存储历史数据，但其线性特征提取器无法充分利用图拓扑，且点式原型在结构多样的图上易导致原型数量膨胀。
AI.method: 提出HCPN-GCN：将HPN原有的线性特征提取器替换为图卷积网络（GCN），获得更具图感知能力的表示；同时引入锥形原型（cone-based prototypes）并搭配多样性正则化目标，以更紧凑地建模嵌入空间，在保持判别力的同时抑制原型增长。
AI.result: 在六个持续图学习基准上，HCPN-GCN相较原始HPN及代表性持续学习基线，持续提升平均分类准确率，并保持接近零的遗忘率；分析表明其以约30倍更少的原子原型学习到更丰富的类别级原型层次。
AI.conclusion: HCPN-GCN为持续图学习提供了一种更紧凑且有效的记忆表示，兼顾了图拓扑感知、低遗忘与高准确率。

title: Sigma-Hunter: A Domain-Specific Language Model for Threat Hunting and Detection Engineering
summary: Detection engineers must translate threat reports, forensic observations, and hunt hypotheses into precise, testable rules. General-purpose large language models (LLMs) can draft such rules, but often produce invalid YAML, incorrect log sources, unsupported fields, or overly broad detection logic. This paper presents \emph{Sigma-Hunter}, a domain-adapted LLM for analyst-assistive Sigma rule generation and threat hunting. We build an instruction-tuning dataset from 3,635 validated open-source Sigma rules, expanded into 7,663 question-answer and analyst-reasoning examples. Each source rule is assigned to a single train, validation, or test partition before this expansion, so no rule leaks across splits. We fine-tune a 7B Mistral model and a Phi-4 model with LoRA and score held-out rule generations on syntax, approximate field consistency, and a semantic judgment of detection logic, completeness, selectivity, and log-source alignment. Sigma-Hunter-Mistral scores 8.17 overall, against 7.88 for the strongest general-purpose baseline and 4.61 for untuned Mistral. Two findings stand out: domain adaptation enables a compact 7B model to perform competitively with larger general-purpose models on this structured task, and syntactic validity is a weak proxy for semantic rule quality, as several baselines emit well-formed YAML carrying weak detection logic. The adapted models run locally, which suits detection engineering in disconnected environments where analysts cannot reach hosted model services.

AI.tldr: Sigma-Hunter 是一个面向检测工程领域的适配型大语言模型，用于辅助分析师生成 Sigma 规则和威胁狩猎，在 7B 规模下性能可媲美更大的通用模型。
AI.motivation: 检测工程师需将威胁报告、取证观察和狩猎假设转化为精确可测试的规则。通用 LLM 虽能起草规则，但常产生无效 YAML、错误日志源、不支持字段或过宽的检测逻辑，因此需要领域适配的模型。
AI.method: 基于 3,635 条经过验证的开源 Sigma 规则构建指令微调数据集，扩展为 7,663 个问答与分析师推理示例；每条源规则在扩展前先划分到训练/验证/测试集以避免泄漏。使用 LoRA 微调 7B Mistral 和 Phi-4 模型，并从语法、近似字段一致性及对检测逻辑、完整性、选择性和日志源对齐的语义判断等维度对留出集生成结果进行评分。
AI.result: Sigma-Hunter-Mistral 总体得分为 8.17，最强通用基线为 7.88，未微调 Mistral 为 4.61。发现领域适配使紧凑的 7B 模型在此结构化任务上可与更大的通用模型竞争；同时语法有效性是语义规则质量的弱代理，多个基线输出了格式正确但检测逻辑薄弱的 YAML。
AI.conclusion: 领域适配的小模型在 Sigma 规则生成上具有竞争力，且语法正确不等于语义质量高。适配模型可本地运行，适合无法访问托管模型服务的离线环境中的检测工程工作。

title: Workhorse: Learning Robust Whole-Body Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Human Data
comment: 9 pages, 8 figures, 2 tables. Project page: https://hsb0508.github.io/workhorse/
summary: Humanoid robots still struggle to plan contact-rich whole-body manipulation from egocentric RGB and proprioception. Workhorse learns such manipulation from robot-free human demonstrations. A visual planner predicts five-link targets: the poses of the torso, both wrists, and both feet. A reinforcement-learning whole-body tracker follows them on the robot. Both policies train separately on the same recorded human poses, without retargeting. We augment the training data of each policy to imitate the errors that the other makes at deployment. On a real Unitree G1, Workhorse sorts boxes with its hands and a kick, catches a thrown box, and topples and climbs a suitcase. During box sorting, we show recoveries after a person pushes the robot or takes the box away. In a simulated copy of the demonstration room, the system completes box sorting in 77% of episodes, and in 64% under 40 N.s pushes. With both policies retrained from the same demonstrations, a simulated second humanoid completes box sorting in 83% of episodes without pushes.

AI.tldr: Workhorse 通过无机器人人类演示学习接触丰富的全身操作：视觉规划器预测躯干、双腕和双足的五连杆目标，强化学习全身跟踪器在真机上执行，两策略独立训练并通过互相模仿对方部署误差增强鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 仿人机器人从自我中心 RGB 和本体感受进行接触丰富的全身操作规划仍然困难，且依赖机器人数据采集代价高，需要一种无需机器人、直接从人类演示学习的方法。
AI.method: 采用无重定向的两阶段框架：视觉规划器从自我中心 RGB 预测五个连杆（躯干、双腕、双足）位姿目标；强化学习全身跟踪器在机器人上跟随这些目标。两策略在相同人类姿态记录上分别训练，并相互用对方在部署时的误差增强各自训练数据。
AI.result: 在真实 Unitree G1 上完成用双手和踢腿整理箱子、接住抛来的箱子、推倒并爬上行李箱；整理箱子时可从被人推或拿走箱子后恢复。在模拟演示房间中，整理箱子成功率 77%，在 40 N·s 推力下为 64%；将两策略在同一演示上重训后，模拟第二台人形无推力下整理箱子成功率达 83%。
AI.conclusion: 该系统证明无机器人人类演示结合视觉规划与全身跟踪、并通过跨策略误差增强，可让不同人形机器人实现接触丰富的全身操作与扰动恢复。

title: Shape-Bayes: Bayesian Inference of Structured Shapes under Visual Ambiguity
summary: Perceiving structured shapes, such as human faces, from pixels is an inherently ambiguous task in real-world conditions. Yet, shape inference is largely posed as a deterministic regression task predicting fixed spatial coordinates. We find that deterministic regression is brittle when visual evidence is ambiguous or incomplete; under severe occlusions deterministic models exhibit structural collapse, predicting incoherent shapes or reverting to generic averages. To address this, we introduce Shape-Bayes, a probabilistic framework that couples uncertainty-aware visual perception with Bayesian shape reasoning. Rather than forcing point estimates, Shape-Bayes dynamically weights visual evidence against geometric priors to infer a structurally valid shape posterior. Demonstrated on human face shape regression, a rigorous testbed featuring complex non-rigid deformations and strict anatomical constraints, Shape-Bayes comprises: (1) a base model predicting noisy landmarks alongside distilled aleatoric uncertainties; (2) a lightweight Transformer encoding these observations into an adaptive prior over a PCA shape manifold; and (3) a differentiable Bayesian solver computing closed-form posteriors by balancing the noisy predictions against this prior. By guaranteeing complete structural integrity, Shape-Bayes achieves an absolute improvement of up to ~34% IDR over state-of-the-art deterministic models. Simultaneously, it yields highly calibrated uncertainty bounds and reduces relative error by up to 12.5%, establishing a new state-of-the-art for robust 2D face shape regression under severe occlusion. The project page is at https://shape-bayes.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出概率框架 Shape-Bayes，将不确定性感知视觉感知与贝叶斯形状推理耦合，实现严重遮挡下鲁棒的 2D 人脸形状回归。
AI.motivation: 从像素感知人脸等结构化形状本质上是模糊的任务，但现有方法多将形状推理建模为确定性的坐标回归，忽略视觉证据的不确定性。作者发现确定性回归在视觉证据模糊或不完整时非常脆弱：严重遮挡下模型出现结构性崩溃，预测出不连贯形状或退化为通用平均形状。
AI.method: Shape-Bayes 不强行输出点估计，而是动态权衡视觉证据与几何先验，推断结构有效的形状后验。其包含三部分：(1) 基模型预测含噪关键点及蒸馏的偶然不确定性；(2) 轻量 Transformer 将这些观测编码为 PCA 形状流形上的自适应先验；(3) 可微贝叶斯求解器，通过平衡含噪预测与先验计算闭式后验。以人脸形状回归为验证平台。
AI.result: 在保证完整结构有效性的前提下，相比最先进的确定性模型，IDR 绝对提升最高约 34%；同时给出高度校准的不确定性边界，相对误差最多降低 12.5%，在严重遮挡下树立新的 2D 人脸形状回归最优结果。
AI.conclusion: 将形状推理从确定性回归转向概率贝叶斯建模范式，可显著提升遮挡等困难条件下的结构完整性与鲁棒性，同时提供良好校准的不确定性估计，为人脸形状回归建立新 SOTA。

title: FinVector-Market-4B: A Controlled Study of LoRA Adaptation for Structured Financial Tasks
summary: FinVector-Market-4B adapts Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B with rank-16 LoRA on a 22,000-example corpus for structured financial tasks. We evaluate the base and adapted models on the same 600-example benchmark under implicit and explicit JSON-schema contracts. Supplying the schema alone raises base-model JSON validity from 0% to 91.3%. Under matched explicit prompting, the frozen scores improve from 14.7% to 40.0% for FinQA answer exact match, from 48.0% to 82.7% for calculator-expression correctness, from 20.1% to 89.5% for scenario branch-label agreement, and from 52.4% to 87.2% for implication-direction agreement. A post-hoc policy-scoring audit shows that the reported macro-F1 decline reflects a changing label set; using the same three target classes gives 77.4% for the base and 83.1% for the adapter. Filing overlap and calculator-target inconsistencies qualify the benchmark's generalization claims. The results show that compact financial domain adaptation can produce substantial task-specific gains beyond output-format learning under matched prompting, with gains bounded by the evaluated task distribution and prompt contract.

AI.tldr: 将Qwen3.5-4B以rank-16 LoRA在2.2万条金融语料上适配为FinVector-Market-4B，在600例基准上对比发现：显式schema提示本身即可显著提升JSON合法性，且在匹配提示条件下适配模型在多项金融任务上大幅超越基座模型。
AI.motivation: 检验紧凑型金融领域适配能否在输出格式学习之外带来实质的任务性能提升，并厘清提示契约（隐式/显式JSON schema）对评估结果的影响。
AI.method: 用rank-16 LoRA对Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B在22,000条结构化金融任务语料上进行适配；在同一600例基准上，以隐式与显式JSON-schema契约评测基座与适配模型；并做事后策略评分审计以核查macro-F1变化的来源。
AI.result: 仅提供schema即使基座模型JSON合法性从0%升至91.3%；匹配显式提示下，基座→适配模型分别为FinQA答案精确匹配14.7%→40.0%、计算器表达式正确率48.0%→82.7%、情景分支标签一致20.1%→89.5%、蕴含方向一致52.4%→87.2%；同一三类别下macro-F1为77.4%→83.1%。文件重叠与计算器目标不一致对泛化结论构成限制。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑型金融领域适配在匹配提示下可带来超出格式学习的显著任务增益，但增益受评测任务分布与提示契约约束。

title: Whose Memory Is It? Scope-Aware Commit Rules for Long-Term LLM Memory
summary: Persistent memory allows an LLM agent to carry experience across conversations, but it also turns a local reasoning mistake into a durable one. During deliberation, an agent may consider a plan, simulate a tool result, report another speaker's belief, and then reject all of them. If memory retains only the resulting sentences, those once-useful possibilities can later return as facts. The record is neither fabricated nor irrelevant; it has simply been detached from the context in which it was valid. We identify this missing context as \emph{discourse ownership}: the world, branch, or speaker that licenses a proposition. Our first finding is counterintuitive. Language models already carry a causally active signal for ownership, yet conventional memory interfaces discard it when they convert reasoning into records. We introduce CASK (Causally Anchored Scoping Keys), a commit rule that preserves this signal so that shared-world facts enter durable memory while provisional content remains available only within its original scope. Our second finding is that the most obvious way to preserve the signal---storing the discovered internal coordinates---is unreliable because equivalent representations need not keep the same coordinates. CASK instead preserves the stable relations that express ownership. Controlled long-conversation conflicts and tool-agent traces show that this design improves memory admission and prevents provisional content from contaminating later answers while complementing runtime provenance. The resulting commit boundary lets agents explore more possibilities without granting every intermediate sentence authority over future behavior.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"话语归属"(discourse ownership)概念，指一个命题成立的授权来源（世界、分支或说话者），并指出持久记忆会把局部推理错误固化为事实，因为传统记忆接口在将推理转成记录时丢弃了归属信号。作者提出 CASK 提交规则，保留表达归属的稳定关系而非内部坐标，使共享事实进入持久记忆、临时内容仅在原作用域可用。实验表明该方法改善记忆准入并防止临时内容污染后续回答。
AI.motivation: 持久记忆让 LLM 智能体跨对话携带经验，但也把局部推理错误变成持久错误：智能体在思考中可能设想计划、模拟工具结果、转述他人信念，然后又全部否定它们；若记忆只保留结果句子，这些曾经有用但未成立的"可能性"随后会被当作事实返回。这些记录既非捏造也非无关，只是脱离了其成立时所需的语境。
AI.method: 作者将缺失的语境定义为"话语归属"(discourse ownership)，即授权某命题成立的世界、分支或说话者。第一个发现是语言模型本身已携带因果活跃的归属信号，但常规记忆接口在把推理转为记录时丢弃了它。第二个发现是直接存储内部坐标来保留信号并不可靠，因为等价表示未必保持相同坐标。据此提出 CASK（Causally Anchored Scoping Keys）提交规则，保留表达归属的稳定关系：共享世界事实进入持久记忆，临时内容仅在其原始作用域内可用。
AI.result: 在受控的长对话冲突与工具智能体轨迹实验中，CASK 改善了记忆准入，防止临时内容污染后续回答，并与运行时溯源机制互补。所得提交边界让智能体能够探索更多可能性，而无需把每条中间句子都赋予对未来行为的权威性。
AI.conclusion: 持久记忆需要区分共享世界事实与临时/分支/他人视角的命题；通过保留归属关系而非内部坐标的提交规则，可在不损害探索能力的前提下避免临时内容污染持久记忆，为智能体记忆设计提供了新的归属边界视角。

title: FlashNeRD: Performance-First Contact-Rich Neural Robot Dynamics
summary: Compared with analytical physics, learned dynamics models promise robot simulation that is faster, inherently differentiable, and easily adaptable to real data. Neural Robot Dynamics (NeRD) pursues this by keeping collision detection analytical and replacing a simulator's numerical dynamics for the robot with a learned model. Three limitations remain. NeRD offers little speedup over the simulator it learned from, accepts contact only at predefined points, and has no two-way coupling with objects it manipulates. FlashNeRD removes all three with a parallel streaming architecture that makes each prediction faster and more accurate, an encoder that accepts contacts wherever they occur, and two-way coupling with objects simulated by analytical solvers. Experiments across five robots show faster and more accurate dynamics, faster policy learning, and faster inference-time planning. Across three robots, FlashNeRD's dynamics model is up to $55\times$ faster than an optimized NeRD and more accurate over long rollouts. This speedup extends to policy learning, where PPO trains an ANYmal locomotion policy in 34 seconds, $3.8\times$ faster than the analytical simulator and $2.7\times$ faster than an optimized NeRD. With DIAL-MPC, a sampling-based MPC method, the robot climbs all six test platforms where fixed-contact NeRD manages one, at approximately half the analytical simulator's planning time. Cube-reorientation policies trained with FlashNeRD complete within 2% of the simulator-trained policy's target count.

AI.tldr: FlashNeRD 提出并行流式架构，将碰撞检测保持解析、动力学学习化，实现更快更准的预测、任意接触点编码与双向耦合，在多个机器人任务上显著加速并提升精度。
AI.motivation: NeRD 将机器人动力学替换为学习模型并保留解析碰撞检测，但存在三个局限：相比原模拟器加速有限、仅支持预定义接触点、与被操作物体缺乏双向耦合。论文旨在同时解决这三个问题。
AI.method: FlashNeRD 采用并行流式架构使每次预测更快更准确；引入可接受任意接触位置的编码器；并与解析求解器模拟的物体实现双向耦合。
AI.result: 在五种机器人上实现更快更准的动力学、更快策略学习与更快推理时规划。在三种机器人上，其动力学模型比优化的 NeRD 快达 55 倍且长时 rollout 更准。PPO 用 34 秒训练出 ANYmal 运动策略，比解析模拟器快 3.8 倍、比优化 NeRD 快 2.7 倍。结合 DIAL-MPC，机器人爬完六个测试平台（固定接触 NeRD 仅完成一个），规划时间约为解析模拟器的一半。用 FlashNeRD 训练的方块重定向策略达到模拟器训练策略目标数的 98% 以内。
AI.conclusion: 通过并行流式架构、任意接触编码与双向耦合，FlashNeRD 在速度、精度与任务表现上全面超越 NeRD 与解析模拟器，验证了学习动力学在机器人仿真与规划中的实用价值。

title: GUARD: Geometric Uncertainty-Aware Point Cloud Denoising and Segmentation for Robotic Hard Disk Drive Disassembly
summary: Reliable robotic disassembly requires part-level representations that distinguish genuine component geometry from scanning and reconstruction artifacts. In point clouds of hard disk drives (HDDs), structured ghost artifacts can resemble valid components locally while remaining inconsistent with the overall geometry, allowing erroneous measurements to receive plausible semantic labels. This creates an engineering information problem: semantic prediction confidence alone does not establish whether the underlying geometry is reliable. We propose \textbf{GUARD}, a geometric uncertainty-aware framework that performs point filtering and segmentation within a single forward pass by modeling the reliability of learned geometric representations. GUARD combines a multi-scale geometric transformer with a multi-bandwidth random Fourier feature Gaussian Process to estimate per-point geometric uncertainty, complemented by predictive entropy to suppress unreliable measurements while preserving informative structures. Evaluation on 2,745 real HDD point clouds shows that GUARD improves PointNet++ segmentation mean intersection over union from 0.7739 to 0.8318. Additional experiments on ShapeNetPart and ScanNet examine robustness across corruption types, point-cloud domains, and segmentation backbones. On manually annotated ScanNet samples, geometric uncertainty achieves a corrupted-point detection F1 score of 0.7931, compared with 0.2212 for predictive entropy. The results demonstrate the value of distinguishing geometric reliability from semantic confidence and reveal a tradeoff between artifact suppression and preservation of informative structures. GUARD contributes a reliability-aware approach to interpreting imperfect 3D measurements for component identification and subsequent robotic handling. Project website: https://001-wang.github.io/GUARD_Point_denoiser/.

AI.tldr: 提出GUARD框架，通过建模几何不确定性，在单次前向传播中同时完成点云滤波与分割，提升机器人拆解中部件识别的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 机器人拆解需要区分真实部件几何与扫描/重建伪影。在HDD点云中，结构化幽灵伪影局部看似有效组件，却与整体几何不一致，可能获得貌似合理的语义标签。仅靠语义预测置信度无法判断底层几何是否可靠，这构成工程信息问题。
AI.method: GUARD结合多尺度几何Transformer与多带宽随机傅里叶特征高斯过程，估计逐点几何不确定性，并辅以预测熵，在抑制不可靠测量的同时保留有信息量的结构；在单次前向传播内完成点滤波与分割。
AI.result: 在2,745个真实HDD点云上，GUARD将PointNet++分割mIoU从0.7739提升至0.8318。在ShapeNetPart和ScanNet上验证了跨腐蚀类型、点云域和分割骨干的鲁棒性。在人工标注的ScanNet样本上，几何不确定性对损坏点的检测F1为0.7931，而预测熵仅为0.2212。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明区分几何可靠性与语义置信度的价值，并揭示伪影抑制与有信息结构保留之间的权衡。GUARD为不完美3D测量的可靠性感知解读提供了方法，服务于部件识别及后续机器人操作。

title: GraphOPD: Graph-Augmented On-Policy Distillation for LLM Agents
summary: On-policy distillation post-trains large language model agents by supplying dense, step-level guidance from a teacher policy when the reinforcement-learning reward is sparse and arrives only once per trajectory. Existing instantiations allocate this guidance by the size of the teacher-student divergence at each step, on the single-turn intuition that a large disagreement marks a mistake worth correcting. Once decisions chain over many turns, that rule misfires, since an early drift enters every later context both policies condition on, leaving the teacher consistent with the drifted trajectory instead of flagging its cause, while interchangeable steps register large but outcome-irrelevant divergences. We demonstrate this on an agentic benchmark, where distilling the highest-divergence steps brings no consistent benefit over random selection. To this end, we introduce GraphOPD, the first method to bring graph-based structural augmentation into on-policy distillation for agent capabilities. It reads which steps enabled which later ones from the environment's own record of state changes, immune to the drift that corrupts the teacher-student gap, organizes them into a dependency graph, scores each step by a random-walk stationary distribution over it, and fuses that structural credit with the divergence signal into a trajectory-relative mask concentrating supervision on each rollout's highest-aptitude steps. Across three model scales and eleven baselines on ALFWorld, WebShop, and SearchQA, GraphOPD shows competitive performance throughout, improving over the strongest baseline by up to +5.8 pp. An executed-replay audit further shows that this structural credit score tracks true causal impact far above chance, that both fused signals are independently necessary, and that the same signal transfers to out-of-domain tool-integrated reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GraphOPD，首个将图结构增强引入 on-policy distillation 的方法，用环境状态变化记录构建步骤依赖图并以随机游走平稳分布打分，与散度信号融合生成轨迹相对掩码，在 ALFWorld、WebShop、SearchQA 上超越最强基线最多 +5.8 pp。
AI.motivation: 现有多轮 agent 的 on-policy distillation 按每步师生散度大小分配监督，基于单轮直觉认为大分歧即值得纠正的错误。但在多轮决策链中，早期漂移会进入后续所有上下文，使教师与已漂移轨迹一致而非标记其成因；同时可互换步骤会产生大但与结果无关的散度。实验显示，蒸馏最高散度步骤相对随机选择并无稳定收益。
AI.method: GraphOPD 从环境自身的状态变化记录中读取哪些步骤使能了哪些后续步骤，该信号不受污染师生差距的漂移影响；将这些依赖组织为依赖图，用随机游走平稳分布为每步打分；再把结构信用与散度信号融合为轨迹相对掩码，将监督集中于每条 rollout 中最高“适配度”的步骤。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop、SearchQA 三个基准、三种模型规模和十一个基线上，GraphOPD 全程表现有竞争力，相对最强基线最高提升 +5.8 pp。执行重放审计显示，结构信用分对真实因果影响的追踪远超随机水平，两个融合信号各自独立必要，同一信号可迁移到域外工具集成推理。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的步骤信用分配可有效纠正散度导向的 on-policy distillation 在多轮 agent 中的误配问题，兼具性能增益、因果有效性与跨域可迁移性。

title: Enabling Dynamic Computation in Looped LMs
summary: Looped LMs are parameter efficient and promise dynamic computation (saving memory and FLOPs on easy tokens). However, state-of-the-art open Looped LMs trained with this dynamic computation capability (Ouro models) do not realize it in practice as each loop iteration (depth) requires its own level of KV-cache, necessitating all loop computations. Moreover, Ouro's early-exit prior is enforced on each token equally, which results in static lower-depth like processing of all tokens regardless of difficulty. In this work, we propose a simple "best-available" KV caching strategy that works out-of-the-box, creating a new frontier in the performance vs depth space. Our approach enables up to 30% reduction in FLOPs and KV memory while retaining full-depth performance, showing the true flexibility of Looped LMs. Furthermore, training looped LMs with awareness about this KV caching strategy improves performance and efficiency. Finally, we apply a small but effective fix to the early-exit prior enforcement objective that makes tokens exit at truly heterogeneous depths based on effort. Our findings are validated on Ouro models as well as smaller looped LMs pre-trained from scratch.

AI.tldr: 本文针对循环语言模型（Looped LMs）动态计算能力无法落地的问题，提出"best-available"KV缓存策略与早退先验修正，实现FLOPs和KV内存最多降低30%且保持全深度性能。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型参数高效且理论上支持动态计算（在简单token上节省内存和FLOPs），但现有SOTA开源模型（Ouro）在实践中无法实现这一能力：每个循环迭代（深度）都需要自己的KV缓存层级，导致所有循环计算都必须执行；同时Ouro的早退先验对所有token一视同仁，使得所有token无论难易都按较低的固定深度处理，缺乏真正的动态性。
AI.method: 1) 提出简单的"best-available"KV缓存策略，可开箱即用，在性能与深度空间上开辟新前沿；2) 在训练循环LM时引入对该KV缓存策略的感知；3) 对早退先验的施加目标做一个小而有效的修正，使token根据实际计算量在真正异构的深度上退出。
AI.result: 该方法在保持全深度性能的同时，FLOPs和KV内存最多减少30%；将KV缓存策略感知纳入训练可进一步提升性能与效率；早退先验修正使token在真正异构的深度退出。结论在Ouro模型及从零预训练的较小循环LM上均得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 通过"best-available"KV缓存策略和早退先验修正，真正释放了循环语言模型的动态计算灵活性，在保持性能的同时显著降低计算与内存开销，并证明训练时具备该策略感知能带来进一步的性能与效率提升。

title: World Models Dream of Success: Diagnosing and Repairing Failure Insensitivity in Robot World Models
summary: Robot world models support policy evaluation, planning, and synthetic data generation, but these applications require predictions that distinguish successful actions from failures. Across four released checkpoints from two architecture families, we observe weak sensitivity to action changes and success-like predictions on verified failures. Although recent work incorporates failures into model training, which data can repair released checkpoints without changing their architecture or training objective still remains underexplored. To this end, we introduce CureWM, which constructs alternative actions from successful demonstrations across a severity grid, verifies their outcomes through execution in simulation or on hardware, and fine-tunes released models on the resulting failures and surviving successes alongside nominal demonstrations. This construction provides controlled action contrasts from shared starting contexts. On 484 held-out LIBERO failure counterfactuals, optimism falls from 80\% after fine-tuning on the official data to 30--43\% across four independently fine-tuned CureWM models (38\% mean). In two separate evaluations on a physical robot arm, failure predictions scored as success-like by a latent-distance diagnostic decrease from 90\% after fine-tuning on successful demonstrations alone to 33\% with CureWM. With failure counts per task, successful replay data, and training budget matched, counterfactual failures yield a success--failure value gap of 0.124, compared with 0.014 for freshly collected on-policy failures. These findings support execution-verified counterfactual replay for post-hoc repair and show why reduced optimism must be evaluated alongside success--failure discrimination. Code is available at https://github.com/jiuyixu25/CureWM.

AI.tldr: CureWM通过执行验证的反事实失败数据微调已发布机器人世界模型，在不改变架构和目标的前提下显著降低乐观预测，提升成功-失败区分能力。
AI.motivation: 机器人世界模型在策略评估、规划和合成数据生成中需要区分成功与失败动作，但现有已发布模型对动作变化敏感度弱，且会对已验证的失败产生"成功式"预测。虽已有工作将失败纳入训练，但"用哪些数据修复已发布检查点"仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出CureWM：从成功演示出发，在严重度网格上构造替代动作，通过仿真或硬件执行验证其真实结果，再在由此得到的失败样本、存活成功样本及原始演示数据上微调已发布模型。该构造从相同起始上下文提供受控的动作对比。
AI.result: 在484个LIBERO留出失败反事实上，乐观率从官方数据微调后的80%降至4个独立微调模型的30–43%（均值38%）；物理机械臂两次评估中，被潜在距离诊断判为"成功式"的失败预测从仅用成功演示微调的90%降至33%；在失败数量、成功回放数据和训练预算匹配下，反事实失败的成败价值差为0.124，而新采集的在线策略失败仅0.014。
AI.conclusion: 执行验证的反事实回放可用于事后修复世界模型，并表明评估降低乐观性时必须与成败区分能力一并考量。

title: OverLay++: Dense-Overlap Layout-to-Image Generation Dataset
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track. Project website: https://mlpc-ucsd.github.io/OverLayPP . Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mlpcucsd/OverLayPP
summary: Layout-to-Image generation has made substantial progress in spatial and object-level control. However, existing methods still struggle with complex scenes containing many overlapping and interacting objects. We argue that training data is a particular bottleneck: existing datasets lack examples with dense, complex object interactions. To address this gap, we introduce OverLay++, a large-scale Layout-to-Image dataset with structurally complex scenes. OverLay++ contains approximately 500K images with an average of 6.6 objects per image, exceeding existing datasets by 1.67 times in annotation density. Beyond annotation density, OverLay++ provides rich semantic detail with object captions over six times longer than in current datasets. Our dataset generation pipeline is simple and produces dense, overlapping object annotations with rich per-object captions. Across multiple benchmarks, state-of-the-art Layout-to-Image methods trained on the OverLay++ dataset show consistent improvement and faster convergence, demonstrating the importance of dense, overlap-aware, and caption-rich supervision for controllable image generation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 OverLay++，一个大规模、结构复杂的 Layout-to-Image 数据集，包含约 50 万张图像，平均每图 6.6 个物体，标注密度和物体描述长度均远超现有数据集，可显著提升布局到图像生成模型的性能和收敛速度。
AI.motivation: 现有 Layout-to-Image 生成方法在空间与物体级控制上已有进展，但在包含大量重叠与交互物体的复杂场景中仍表现不佳。作者认为训练数据是关键瓶颈：现有数据集缺乏密集、复杂物体交互的样本。
AI.method: 构建 OverLay++ 数据集，其生成流程简单，可产生密集、重叠的物体标注及丰富的逐物体描述。数据集包含约 50 万张图像，平均每图 6.6 个物体，标注密度为现有数据集的 1.67 倍，物体描述长度超过现有数据集六倍。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，使用 OverLay++ 训练的先进 Layout-to-Image 方法均取得一致性提升，并实现更快的收敛。
AI.conclusion: 密集、感知重叠且描述丰富的监督信号对可控图像生成至关重要，OverLay++ 为复杂场景的 Layout-to-Image 生成提供了有效的数据支撑。

title: Directed Temporal Representations for Offline Visual Control
summary: Predictive world models provide compact visual representations for control. Control requires a latent geometry aligned with temporal reachability rather than predictive similarity alone. We introduce Directed Temporal Representations for Control (DTRC), which learns such a geometry from offline visual trajectories on top of frozen LeWorldModel (LeWM) features. DTRC constructs a directed temporal quasimetric over the learned control representation. Short-range temporal offsets calibrate the distance scale. Bootstrapped targets extend temporal reachability across longer horizons. Action-conditioned consistency aligns the representation with local transition dynamics. The resulting distance estimates temporal reaching cost, and its change across a transition defines goal-relative temporal progress. We use this progress signal as a temporal critic for direct goal-conditioned policy learning. Model-assisted targets provide an additional training-time refinement under behavior-support and dynamics-agreement constraints. Across ten visual control tasks, DTRC achieves strong goal-conditioned control performance relative to planning and direct-policy baselines. Held-out diagnostics on the four LeWM tasks show consistent short-range temporal calibration, task-dependent long-range and directional structure, and positive transition-level progress. Temporal supervision improves the same flow-policy parameterization across all four LeWM tasks, while the resulting policy acts directly without iterative trajectory search at test time.

AI.tldr: 提出 DTRC，在冻结的 LeWM 视觉特征上学习“有向时间准度量”的表征几何，用其时间到达代价与进度信号作为评论器，直接训练目标条件策略，在十个视觉控制任务上取得优于规划与直接策略基线的表现。
AI.motivation: 预测式世界模型虽能提供紧凑的视觉表征，但控制所需的潜空间几何应对齐“时间可达性”，而非仅仅对齐预测相似性。因此需要一个显式编码时间方向与到达成本的表征结构来支撑目标条件控制。
AI.method: DTRC 在冻结的 LeWM 特征之上，从离线视觉轨迹中构建有向时间准度量。具体包括：用短程时间偏移标定距离尺度；用自举目标把时间可达性扩展到更长视野；用动作条件一致性让表征对齐局部转移动态。由此得到的距离估计“时间到达代价”，其跨转移的变化定义目标相对的时间进度，并作为时间评论器驱动直接目标条件策略学习；此外用模型辅助目标在行为支撑与动态一致约束下进行训练期精炼。
AI.result: 在十个视觉控制任务上，DTRC 的目标条件控制性能优于规划式与直接策略基线。在四个 LeWM 任务上的留出诊断显示：短程时间标定一致、长程与方向结构依赖任务、转移级进度为正；时间监督在四个 LeWM 任务上均改善了同一 flow-policy 参数化，且测试时策略直接行动，无需迭代轨迹搜索。
AI.conclusion: 以有向时间准度量为核心的时间表征监督，能够把世界模型特征转化为面向控制的可达性几何，并作为有效的时间评论器支持无测试时搜索的直接目标条件策略。

title: PAIR: Bridging Perception and Action in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models map visual observations and language instructions to continuous robot actions. This task requires a transition from representations that describe the scene and instruction to representations that support action generation. Many continuous-action VLAs leave this transition implicit and supervise it mainly through the final action-prediction loss. We introduce PAIR, a framework that learns a shared perception-action representation between these two spaces. During training, a Masked Action Autoencoder encodes expert action chunks into horizon-aligned Action Latent Tokens. A Bridge Module extracts task-relevant features from the current visual-language representations. PAIR aligns these features with the Action Latent Tokens to form Bridge Tokens that preserve task information and capture the structure of expert actions. The Bridge Tokens are then projected into the action-token space and injected into the initial Action Tokens, providing an action-ready starting point for Action Expert refinement. At inference, the autoencoder is removed, and the Bridge Tokens are generated only from the current observation and instruction. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and CALVIN ABC-D show gains for the evaluated OpenVLA-OFT and VLA-Adapter models. On LIBERO-Plus, PAIR raises VLA-Adapter's success rate from 59.1% to 64.2%. On CALVIN, it increases VLA-Adapter's average completed sequence length from 4.42 to 4.53. Across seven real-world tasks, PAIR raises OpenVLA-OFT's success rate from 51.4% to 65.0%. Representation analyses show that Bridge Tokens retain task information while making continuous-action information accessible before Action Expert refinement. These results support a shared intermediate representation as a useful interface between perception and action in continuous-action VLAs.

AI.tldr: PAIR 提出一种共享感知-动作表示框架，通过 Bridge Tokens 在视觉语言表示与连续动作空间之间建立显式接口，在多个仿真与真实任务上提升 VLA 模型表现。
AI.motivation: 连续动作 VLA 模型需要从"描述场景与指令"的表示过渡到"支持动作生成"的表示，但多数方法将这一过渡隐含处理，仅依赖最终动作预测损失进行监督，缺乏对中间表示的显式约束。论文希望显式学习一个连接感知与动作空间的共享表示。
AI.method: 训练阶段：Masked Action Autoencoder 将专家动作块编码为与时间跨度对齐的 Action Latent Tokens；Bridge Module 从当前视觉-语言表示中提取任务相关特征，并将其与 Action Latent Tokens 对齐形成 Bridge Tokens；Bridge Tokens 被投影到动作 token 空间并注入初始 Action Tokens，为 Action Expert 提供可动作化的起点。推理阶段移除自编码器，仅由当前观测与指令生成 Bridge Tokens。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 与 CALVIN ABC-D 上，OpenVLA-OFT 与 VLA-Adapter 均有提升：LIBERO-Plus 上 VLA-Adapter 成功率从 59.1% 提升至 64.2%；CALVIN 上平均完成序列长度从 4.42 提升至 4.53；七个真实世界任务中 OpenVLA-OFT 成功率从 51.4% 提升至 65.0%。表示分析显示 Bridge Tokens 保留任务信息，并在 Action Expert 细化前使连续动作信息可被访问。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，共享中间表示可作为连续动作 VLA 中感知与动作之间的有效接口，显式对齐感知-动作表示空间有助于提升动作生成性能。

title: A Unified Kinematic Representation Enables Reusable Biological Joint Moment Estimation
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Objective: Data-driven models that estimate physiological states, particularly biological joint moments, are widely used in exoskeleton control. However, these estimators are often coupled to device-specific sensor configurations, limiting controller transfer and the use of open-source biomechanics datasets. Methods: We proposed joint kinematics as an intermediate representation that decouples hardware-specific sensing from downstream biological joint moment estimation. A joint-moment estimator using joint angles and angular velocities was trained exclusively on open-source biomechanics data and evaluated using kinematics from a hip exoskeleton, knee exoskeleton, and inertial measurement unit (IMU) sensor suite during level-ground, ramp-ascent, and ramp-descent walking. Results: The estimator achieved an root mean square error (RMSE) of 0.17 Nm/kg and coefficient of determination (R2) of 0.79 using hip exoskeleton kinematics, 0.19 Nm/kg and 0.62 using knee exoskeleton kinematics, and 0.15 Nm/kg and 0.85 using kinematics derived from IMUs across bilateral hip, knee, and ankle joints. Conclusion: Joint kinematics enabled an estimator trained only on open-source data to operate across distinct wearable platforms. Significance: This framework may reduce target-device data collection and support transferable biological joint moment estimation for exoskeleton control and wearable biomechanics.

AI.tldr: 提出以关节运动学作为中间表示，解耦硬件传感器配置与生物关节力矩估计，实现跨设备迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动力矩估计器与特定设备的传感器配置耦合，限制了控制器的迁移能力及开源生物力学数据集的使用。
AI.method: 以关节角度和角速度为输入的关节力矩估计器，仅用开源生物力学数据训练，并在髋外骨骼、膝外骨骼及IMU传感器套件的运动学数据上评估（平地、上坡、下坡行走）。
AI.result: 髋外骨骼运动学：RMSE 0.17 Nm/kg，R² 0.79；膝外骨骼：0.19 Nm/kg，R² 0.62；IMU：0.15 Nm/kg，R² 0.85（双侧髋、膝、踝）。
AI.conclusion: 关节运动学使仅在开源数据上训练的估计器可跨不同可穿戴平台运行，有望减少目标设备数据采集，支持可迁移的关节力矩估计。

title: DISRQAD: Diffusion Image Super-Resolution Quality Assessment Dataset and Benchmark
summary: Diffusion-based image super-resolution (SR) can create visually plausible detail that is not supported by the low-resolution input. We introduce DISRQAD, a subjective-quality dataset and diagnostic benchmark for this setting. It contains mean opinion scores (MOS) for 14,000 SR outputs from ten diffusion and four non-diffusion methods, spanning four low-resolution degradation conditions and x2/x4 upscaling. We evaluate 51 standard full-reference and no-reference metric configurations and 11 adapted variants. Agreement with MOS is substantially weaker on diffusion outputs: the strongest standard no-reference baseline reaches 0.431 SRCC on diffusion SR versus 0.813 on non-diffusion SR. As a case study in benchmark use, a pruned and distilled Q-ReAlign-mini student reaches 0.496 SRCC on diffusion SR. DISRQAD measures perceived output quality, not faithfulness to the input; it enables analysis of metric behavior across generator families and input conditions. Our findings reveal a substantial gap in the assessment of diffusion-based SR and provide a basis for developing quality models sensitive to diffusion-specific artifacts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DISRQAD——一个面向扩散模型图像超分辨率的">主观质量数据集与诊断基准"，包含14,000个SR输出的MOS评分，覆盖10种扩散与4种非扩散方法、4种退化条件和x2/x4放大。评估51种标准指标和11种变体后发现：扩散输出上指标与MOS一致性显著更弱（最强无参考基线SRCC仅0.431 vs 非扩散0.813），并给出Q-ReAlign-mini学生模型案例（扩散SR上0.496 SRCC）。
AI.motivation: 扩散式图像超分辨率能生成低分辨率输入所不支持的视觉逼真细节，使得输出质量评估变得困难；然而现有质量指标在此类扩散输出上的行为尚未被系统研究，缺少专门的基准与诊断分析。
AI.method: 构建DISRQAD数据集，采集14,000个SR输出的平均Opinion评分（MOS），涵盖10种扩散方法和4种非扩散方法、4种低分辨率退化条件及x2/x4放大倍数；评估51种标准全参考与无参考指标配置及11种适配变体；并以剪枝蒸馏的Q-ReAlign-mini学生模型作为基准使用案例。
AI.result: 在扩散输出上指标与MOS的一致性明显更弱：最强的标准无参考基线在扩散SR上SRCC为0.431，而在非扩散SR上达0.813；Q-ReAlign-mini学生在扩散SR上取得0.496 SRCC。
AI.conclusion: DISRQAD衡量的是感知输出质量而非对输入的忠实度，支持跨生成器家族与输入条件的指标行为分析，揭示了扩散式SR质量评估的显著空白，为开发对扩散特有伪影敏感的质量模型提供了基础。

title: On KL-Regularized Policy Optimization
summary: Asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) for large language model (LLM) agents trains one policy on trajectories generated by another: rollouts come from stale checkpoints, and the inference engine's probabilities differ from the trainer's even at identical parameters. Standard remedies either clip importance ratios, which biases the update, or, as in GRPO, sample a group of responses per prompt, which is costly when episodes are long. We propose KL-Regularized Policy Optimization (KLPO), a framework that anchors the KL regularizer at the sampler. The regularized improvement step then has a closed-form Gibbs solution, and KLPO fits its log-ratio optimality condition by least squares on the sampler's own trajectories, so the sampler probability enters through a log-ratio and no importance weights are needed. Profiling out the regression intercept replaces the intractable log-partition function with the signal's sampler mean plus a sampler-to-trainer KL divergence. For token-level policy mirror descent targets, we show that the resulting gradient can be computed from terminal returns without a critic, via sampler-centered scores or a single trajectory residual, even under stochastic tool outputs. We further prove that independent Monte Carlo estimates of the KL term keep these gradients unbiased, derive the exact KL gap of cheaper top-$K$ and binary approximations, and show that SPPO, GPO, REBEL, and BPO arise as special cases of KLPO. The result is a critic-free update that uses one rollout per prompt and requires neither a learned normalizer nor a group of responses.

AI.tldr: 提出KLPO框架，将KL正则锚定在采样器上，得到闭式Gibbs解，用最小二乘拟合对数比最优性条件，无需重要性权重，实现无critic、每个prompt仅需一次rollout的更新。
AI.motivation: 异步RL训练LLM智能体时，rollout来自过期checkpoint，且推理引擎与训练器在相同参数下概率也不一致。现有方法要么裁剪重要性比率导致更新有偏，要么如GRPO需对每个prompt采样一组回复，在长episode时代价高昂。
AI.method: KLPO将KL正则器锚定在采样器处，使正则化改进步有闭式Gibbs解；在采样器自身轨迹上用最小二乘拟合对数比最优性条件，使采样器概率通过对数比进入且无需重要性权重。消去回归截距后，用信号的采样器均值加上采样器到训练器的KL散度替代不可解的log-partition函数。对token级策略镜像下降目标，证明梯度可由终端回报计算而无需critic，通过采样器中心化得分或单条轨迹残差实现，即使工具输出随机也成立。进一步证明KL项的独立蒙特卡洛估计保持梯度无偏，推导出更廉价的top-K与二值近似的精确KL差距，并表明SPPO、GPO、REBEL、BPO均为KLPO的特例。
AI.result: KLPO给出无critic的更新，每个prompt仅用一次rollout，既不需要学习归一化器，也不需要一组回复；同时统一了SPPO、GPO、REBEL、BPO等现有方法为特例，并给出top-K与二值近似KL差距的精确刻画。
AI.conclusion: KLPO通过将KL正则锚定在采样器并以最小二乘拟合对数比条件，避免了重要性加权与分组采样，在异步RL设定下提供了高效、无偏、无critic的LLM智能体训练框架。

title: Not Every Call Needs a Frontier Model: Per-Call-Site Evaluation of Small Language Models in a Deployed Agentic Home-Automation System
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, accepted in NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on SLMs for Agentic Systems, Paris,
summary: An agentic system issues several structurally different kinds of LLM calls. It routes intent, classifies actions, grounds language in a device registry, plans multi-agent pipelines and writes the Python code those pipelines run. The difficulty of these call sites varies by an order of magnitude, yet in practice a single model, chosen for the hardest site, serves all of them. In this work, we evaluate 9 models from 0.8B to a frontier hosted model across the five call sites of a deployed open-source home-automation framework (Wactorz), using its unmodified production prompts and two real Home Assistant installations (280 cases, 2520 scored calls). We find that capability is not ordered the same way at every site, and that larger models are not uniformly better: one 4B model is worse than its 2B sibling at grounded actuation. Paired testing shows the best local model to be statistically indistinguishable from both hosted models at four of five sites. Only code generation separates them, against a small hosted model (p = 0.039) as well as a frontier one (p = 0.002). Aggregate accuracy also hides a safety failure specific to actuation, where small models resolve the accuracy/refusal trade-off in degenerate ways: one model (Gemma4 E2B) actuates on 87.2% of requests for devices the site does not own, while another refuses every request it receives. Routing each site to its best local model reaches 91.8% against 95.4% at no per-call cost. In a live deployment judged by a user, hosting only the two generative sites matches hosting everything (39/43 against 39/43) for 28% of the spend, and the actuation gap the benchmark predicted appears as exactly one case in twenty-six. Benchmark, harness and all records are released at https://github.com/waldiez/slm-callsite-eval.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估了某开源家庭自动化框架（Wactorz）五个不同调用点上的9个模型（0.8B到前沿托管模型），发现能力在不同调用点上的排序不一致，大模型并非总是更好，本地最佳模型在五个调用点中的四个与托管模型无统计差异，只有在代码生成上有差距；按调用点路由最佳本地模型可达到91.8%（对比95.4%）；在真实部署中只托管两个生成类调用点即可匹配全托管效果，成本仅为28%。
AI.motivation: 代理系统在多个结构不同的调用点上使用LLM（意图路由、动作分类、设备注册表接地、多智能体规划、代码生成），难度相差一个数量级，但实践中往往用一个为最难调用点选择的单一模型服务所有调用点。作者希望验证这种"一刀切"做法是否合理，并探究不同调用点上模型能力与规模的关系。
AI.method: 使用Wactorz框架未修改的生产提示词和两个真实Home Assistant安装环境，在五个调用点上评估9个模型（0.8B至前沿托管模型），共280个案例、2520次评分调用；采用配对检验比较本地最佳模型与托管模型的差异，并分析聚合准确率掩盖的接地特定安全失败问题。
AI.result: 能力在不同调用点上排序不同，大模型并非一致更优：某4B模型在接地执行上不如其2B同级模型。配对检验显示最佳本地模型在五个调用点中的四个与两个托管模型在统计上不可区分，仅代码生成有差距（对小托管模型p=0.039，对前沿模型p=0.002）。聚合准确率掩盖了接地特有的安全失败：Gemma4 E2B对87.2%的非自有设备请求执行动作，另一模型则拒绝所有请求。按调用点路由最佳本地模型达91.8%，全托管为95.4%，且无额外每次调用成本。在用户评判的实时部署中，仅托管两个生成类调用点即可匹配全托管（39/43对39/43），成本仅为28%；基准预测的接地差距在26个案例中仅出现1例。
AI.conclusion: 单一模型服务所有调用点并不最优；按调用点选择最佳本地模型可在几乎不损失准确率的情况下节省成本，且本地模型在多数调用点上已足够。聚合指标会掩盖特定的安全失败，需按调用点分别评估。基准、测试框架和所有记录已开源发布。

title: geodex: A Library for Motion Planning on Riemannian Manifolds
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. Code, documentation, and tutorials at https://geodex.readthedocs.io
summary: Planning motions that respect the intrinsic geometry of a robot's configuration space, including its curvature and a configuration-dependent notion of cost, yields shorter, lower-energy, and more natural trajectories than planning under the ambient flat metric. Existing libraries for optimization on manifolds provide rich geometric primitives but do not plan around obstacles. While general-purpose motion planning libraries support many state spaces and custom distance functions, they do not yet treat a configuration-dependent Riemannian metric as the geometry that drives distance, interpolation, and geodesics. We present geodex, an open-source C++20 library with Python bindings. The library exposes the manifold, its Riemannian metric, the retraction, and the sampler as independent, interchangeable components through a single sampling-based motion planning interface. The same planner runs unchanged on canonical spaces $\mathbb{R}^n$, $\mathbb{T}^n$, $\mathbb{S}^n$, matrix Lie groups such as $SO(2)$, $SE(2)$, $SO(3)$, and $SE(3)$, products of these spaces, and articulated-robot configuration spaces, each equipped with a user-defined Riemannian metric. We make geodex publicly available with documentation, tests, and a reproducible benchmark suite.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 geodex，一个开源 C++20 库（含 Python 绑定），将流形、黎曼度量、回缩映射与采样器解耦为可互换组件，通过统一的采样运动规划接口，在多种流形与自定义黎曼度量下规划出更短、更节能、更自然的轨迹。
AI.motivation: 在机器人构型空间中，考虑内在几何（曲率及构型相关代价）进行规划，比在欧氏平坦度量下能获得更短、更低能耗、更自然的轨迹。现有流形优化库几何工具丰富但不处理障碍物；通用运动规划库虽支持多状态空间与自定义距离，却未将构型相关黎曼度量作为驱动距离、插值与测地线的几何基础。
AI.method: 提出 geodex：开源 C++20 库并带 Python 绑定。把流形、黎曼度量、回缩（retraction）和采样器作为独立、可互换的组件，通过单一采样运动规划接口暴露。同一规划器无需修改即可运行在 R^n、T^n、S^n、SO(2)/SE(2)/SO(3)/SE(3) 等矩阵李群、其乘积空间及多关节机器人构型空间上，并各自配备用户自定义黎曼度量。
AI.result: 同一规划器可无缝运行于多类规范空间、矩阵李群、乘积空间与多关节机器人构型空间，且均支持用户自定义黎曼度量；库公开提供，并附带文档、测试与可复现基准套件。
AI.conclusion: geodex 以模块化设计把黎曼几何引入采样运动规划，填补了流形优化库不支持避障、通用规划库不支持构型相关黎曼度量的空白，为在非平坦几何下高效规划提供了开源工具与基准。

title: Anaximander: Interactively Running Geospatial Deep Learning Models on Any Compute Backend
comment: Accepted as a poster at the TerraBytes II workshop, ECCV 2026
summary: Applying deep learning models to satellite imagery from within geographic information systems (GIS) remains high-friction for remote sensing practitioners. Models arrive in incompatible formats and target different compute environments, from local workstations to serverless cloud services. As a result, every evaluation demands custom deployment, tiling, and georeferencing code before a single prediction reaches the analyst's map. This friction discourages systematic comparison in a domain where model choice directly affects operational outcomes such as field delineation, crop monitoring, and disaster response. We present Anaximander, an open-source system that unifies model source and compute location choice behind one interactive interface. The system's backend is an inference server that loads models from multiple commonly-used sources and serves them on any accessible compute backend. The server provides session management and model caching, and streams results back per tile. The backend is paired with a QGIS plugin that drives tiling, result reassembly, georeferencing, and real-time per-tile status visualization. An additional user-interface path injects layer legends as prompts into vision-language models. We demonstrate the system in a code-free side-by-side comparison of three heterogeneous models on an agricultural field delineation task: gpt-image-1 via a cloud API, Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) on a remote GPU, and DelineateAnything on a local CPU. The inference backend and protocol are open-source and available at https://github.com/microsoft/nxmndr.

AI.tldr: 本文提出开源系统Anaximander，将深度学习模型部署到GIS环境中的流程统一化，通过推理服务器与QGIS插件实现无需编程的卫星影像模型对比评估。
AI.motivation: 遥感实践者在GIS中使用深度学习模型时面临高摩擦：模型格式不兼容、目标计算环境各异，每次评估都需编写定制部署、切片和地理配准代码，阻碍了系统性的模型比较。
AI.method: 后端为推理服务器，支持从多种常用来源加载模型并在任意可访问计算后端上服务，提供会话管理与模型缓存，按瓦片流式返回结果；搭配QGIS插件驱动切片、结果重组、地理配准与实时瓦片状态可视化；另设界面路径将图层图例作为提示注入视觉语言模型。
AI.result: 在农田地块 delineation 任务上，对三种异构模型进行了无代码并排比较：云端API的gpt-image-1、远程GPU上的SAM3，以及本地CPU上的DelineateAnything。
AI.conclusion: Anaximander统一了模型来源与计算位置的选择，降低了GIS中深度学习模型评估的摩擦，其推理后端与协议已开源。

title: Work While They Sleep: Exploiting Evaluation Latency for Fully Bayesian Optimization
summary: Black-box optimization problems are ubiquitous across science and engineering, often dealing with expensive objective functions. This objective latency has two consequences during optimization: (i) the objective evaluation dominates execution time, and (ii) sample-efficient algorithms are crucial to accelerate development and avoid wasting resources. Bayesian optimization (BO) methods are the \textit{de facto} choice of planners for suggesting the next point to try. Standard BO fits the surrogate model's hyperparameters with a point estimate. Alternatively, a fully Bayesian approach uses model averaging to account for uncertainty over the hyperparameters, leading to better uncertainty estimates---useful in the low-data regime that is pervasive in BO. However, it is often prohibitively expensive and thus rarely used. In this work, we propose ELF-BO, an algorithm that uses the objective evaluation latency to headstart the computation of the next suggestion, allowing for fully Bayesian optimization without incurring substantial decision-time costs. This is done by sampling from the hyperparameter posterior \emph{while} the objective is being evaluated, only requiring reweighting of the samples once the objective value is observed. Across synthetic functions and real-world applications, we show that ELF-BO matches the performance of fully Bayesian methods while only incurring decision latency on par with or better than standard BO. Thus, ELF-BO makes fully Bayesian optimization practical in real-world use cases.

AI.tldr: 提出 ELF-BO 算法，利用目标函数评估的等待时间并行采样超参数后验，实现全贝叶斯优化且几乎不增加决策时间成本。
AI.motivation: 黑盒优化中目标函数评估耗时长，评估时间主导总执行时间，因此需要高样本效率算法。贝叶斯优化（BO）是主流选择，其中全贝叶斯方法通过模型平均考虑超参数不确定性，在低数据场景下能给出更好的不确定性估计，但计算成本过高而很少被采用。作者希望让全贝叶斯优化在现实中变得可行。
AI.method: ELF-BO 利用目标函数评估的延迟时间，提前开始下一步建议点的计算：在目标函数被评估的"同时"从超参数后验中采样，待观测到目标值后再对样本进行重新加权（reweighting），从而将原本昂贵的后验采样计算隐藏在评估延迟内。
AI.result: 在合成函数和真实世界应用上，ELF-BO 达到了与全贝叶斯方法相当的性能，而决策延迟仅与标准 BO 持平甚至更低。
AI.conclusion: ELF-BO 使全贝叶斯优化在实际应用场景中变得可行，兼顾了性能与决策时间成本。

title: BEACON-SP: Ontology-Grounded GraphRAG Framework for Clinical Suicide Risk Assessment
summary: We present BEACON-SP, an ontology-grounded Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) framework for clinician-facing decision support in behavioral health settings such as suicide prevention, where effective assessment requires integrating heterogeneous clinical, behavioral, social, and temporal evidence. BEACON-SP combines patient knowledge graphs with ontology-guided retrieval to support multi-hop reasoning across diagnoses, medications, risk and protective factors, life events, and temporal relationships. The framework is enabled by a comprehensive suicide prevention ontology that integrates the Three-Step Theory, the Integrated Motivational-Volitional Model, and the Suicide Social Determinants of Health Ontology into a unified representation of patient risk factors. We construct ontology-grounded patient knowledge graphs and evaluate BEACON-SP for clinician-facing question answering. Compared with a vector-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) baseline on a 1,500-query benchmark spanning 15 clinical categories and 100 patients, BEACON-SP improves completeness, clinical relevance, and evidence grounding under a corrected comparative evaluation protocol, with a small gain on factual accuracy. In paired criterion-level comparisons, GraphRAG is preferred in 76.4% of cases. These results demonstrate the potential of ontology-guided GraphRAG to provide structured, contextualized patient evidence for clinical decision support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BEACON-SP，一个基于本体（ontology）的图检索增强生成（GraphRAG）框架，用于行为健康领域的临床决策支持，尤其在自杀预防场景中整合临床、行为、社会与时间等多源异构证据。
AI.motivation: 行为健康（如自杀预防）的有效评估需要整合异质的临床、行为、社会和时间证据，传统向量RAG难以支持跨诊断、药物、风险与保护因素、生活事件及时间关系的多跳推理，因此需要结构化的本体引导方法。
AI.method: BEACON-SP将患者知识图谱与本体引导检索相结合：构建了一个综合自杀预防本体，融合三步理论（Three-Step Theory）、整合动机-意志模型（Integrated Motivational-Volitional Model）和自杀健康社会决定因素本体；并据此构建本体支撑的患者知识图谱，用于面向临床医生的问题回答。
AI.result: 在涵盖15个临床类别、100名患者的1500条查询基准上，与基于向量的RAG基线相比，BEACON-SP在修正后的比较评估协议下提升了完整性、临床相关性和证据支撑性，事实准确性略有提高；配对标准级比较中GraphRAG在76.4%的情况下更受偏好。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，本体引导的GraphRAG有潜力为临床决策支持提供结构化、情境化的患者证据。

title: Beyond Reconstruction: What Matters in Action Tokenization for Robot Policies?
summary: Autoregressive action-token policies such as vision-language-action models require action tokenizers to translate discrete token sequences into precise control actions in continuous space. Many action tokenizers learn the mapping between tokens and actions via a reconstruction objective. However, as we show through extensive analysis, sufficiently accurate action reconstruction is only one part of what makes a downstream robot policy successful. It is also critical that the policy is able to predict the right tokens for new observations, and that unseen policy token predictions still decode into reasonable actions. These properties are downstream of tokenizer training and are not directly incentivized by a reconstruction objective alone.
