Vision-language models (VLMs) describe a child's behavior from video well; the verdict drawn from the description is unstable: at temperature~0, across eight pipeline configurations on one backbone, 16--37\% of clips change their predicted label between repeated runs, and the cause lies in the serving stack. We keep the VLM frozen and move the decision out of the model. Under our grounded perception constraints the VLM writes an event table of timestamped, glossary-labeled events that names the eliciting press and logs counter-evidence; a text-only stage age-calibrates the confidence of each row; a deterministic weight-of-evidence scorer sums it into an evidence total and stratifies it into a risk category, so every decision decomposes into named per-feature contributions and can be re-scored from the saved table. On 43 caregiver-recorded, protocol-free home free-play clips of preschool children, the pipeline reaches AUC $0.851 \pm 0.012$, 86.0\% accuracy, and F$_1$ 71.8 over three runs. It labels 74.4\% of clips correctly in every run (60.5\% for the zero-shot baseline) and flags no typically developing clip in every run (9 of 31 at zero-shot). An ablation on the same backbone attributes the gain to the grounded perception constraints read through the deterministic scorer.

AI.tldr: 该论文将自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）的判定从视觉语言模型（VLM）内部移出，改用"有依据的感知约束"生成事件表，再由冻结的VLM与确定性证据加权评分器完成判定，从而提升稳定性与准确率。
AI.motivation: ASD诊断依赖专家观察儿童社交行为，专家资源成为早期识别的瓶颈。VLM虽能较好描述视频中的儿童行为，但其直接给出的判定极不稳定：在温度~0时，同一骨干网络的八种流水线配置下，有16–37%的视频片段在重复运行间改变预测标签，问题根源在于服务栈。因此需要把决策从模型中移出。
AI.method: 保持VLM冻结。在其上施加有依据的感知约束，使VLM输出带时间戳、词汇表标注的事件表，标注诱发刺激并记录反证；随后由纯文本阶段对各行置信度做年龄校准；最后由确定性的证据加权评分器累加为证据总分，并分层为风险类别，使每个决策可分解为具名的逐特征贡献，且可从保存的事件表重新评分。
AI.result: 在43段照护者录制、无协议约束的学龄前儿童家庭自由玩耍视频上，三次运行的AUC为0.851±0.012，准确率86.0%，F₁为71.8；74.4%的片段在每次运行中均被正确标注（零样本基线为60.5%），且在任何一次运行中都未误报典型发育儿童片段（零样本为31段中的9段）。同骨干网络的消融实验表明，增益来自经由确定性评分器读取的有依据感知约束。
AI.conclusion: 通过冻结VLM并将决策移出模型，结合有依据的感知约束、年龄校准的置信度与确定性证据加权评分，可在真实家庭自由玩耍视频上实现稳定、可分解、可复现的ASD风险分层，优于零样本基线，且不误报典型发育儿童。

title: Towards Financial World Modeling
summary: Building a world model requires a state representation useful for planning and decision-making---potentially over tasks unknown at training time. In the context of financial markets, planning and decision-making may require a model to reason about market-wide conditions, asset-specific expected returns, liquidity, volatility, and cross-asset relationships. Yet financial representation learning has largely been evaluated on individual predictive tasks, oftentimes on a single time period using comparatively narrow datasets. We address this through three primary contributions. First, we introduce Market-1T, a dataset containing nearly one trillion observations across U.S. equities from 2008 to 2025 at 1 Hz resolution. Second, we develop and implement a rigorous evaluation protocol. Third, we conduct a systematic large-scale study of financial representation learning, comparing 18 encoder-training strategies across nearly two decades of market regimes. We evaluate learned representations both by their predictive utility on common finance tasks and through probes of latent structure. We find that encoders with similar predictive performance can organize market state very differently. Collectively, we establish a foundation for training and evaluating financial market representations in support of world models such as DINO-WM, V-JEPA 2, and LeWM.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了名为 Market-1T 的大规模美股高频数据集（2008–2025年、1Hz、近万亿观测），提出严格的评估协议，并对18种编码器训练策略进行系统性大规模比较，发现预测性能相近的编码器在潜在空间组织方式上差异显著。
AI.motivation: 构建世界模型需要可用于规划与决策的状态表征，而在金融市场中，这要求模型能推理市场整体状况、资产预期收益、流动性、波动率及跨资产关系。然而现有金融表征学习多局限于单一预测任务、单一时段和较窄数据集，缺乏对表征质量的系统评估。
AI.method: 三项主要工作：一是构建 Market-1T 数据集，涵盖2008–2025年美国股票、1Hz分辨率、近万亿观测；二是设计并实施严格的评估协议；三是开展大规模系统性研究，在近二十年不同市场环境下比较18种编码器训练策略，既评估表征在常见金融任务上的预测效用，也通过探针分析其潜在结构。
AI.result: 预测性能相近的编码器可能以非常不同的方式组织市场状态（潜在结构差异显著）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为训练与评估金融市场表征、支撑 DINO-WM、V-JEPA 2、LeWM 等世界模型奠定了基础。

title: Which Buildings Are Artificial Intelligence-Ready? A Measurement-Based Assessment Framework for AI Question Answering and Actuation
comment: 47 pages, 11 figures, 23 tables. Code, results and data supplement: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23197610
summary: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems are becoming the interface to buildings, answering questions and controlling operations, but a building's readiness for them has not been systematically assessed. This study proposes a framework to quantify it. First, a building's knowledge graph sets two ceilings. The answerable-readiness ceiling is the share of operational questions its data could answer, and the actuation-readiness ceiling is the share of control actions it exposes. Second, a reference AI agent's accuracy on a fixed set of these questions shows how much of the ceilings is realized. On a simulated office, the agent realizes 0.62 of a 0.64 answerable ceiling, so missing data, not the AI, limit readiness, except in naming a fault's cause. Across 37 public real-building graphs, the median answerable ceiling is 0.16, and in 15 of 45, unlinked sensors lower it. The framework turns "is this building AI-ready?" into an auditable, ranked retrofit question.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个量化"建筑对智能体AI就绪度"的框架：用建筑知识图谱设定"可回答"与"可执行"两个上限，再用参考AI智能体的实际表现衡量这些上限的实现程度。
AI.motivation: 智能体AI正成为建筑交互与控制的操作界面，但建筑自身对这类AI的就绪程度尚缺乏系统性评估方法，需要将"这栋建筑是否AI就绪"转化为可审计、可排序的改造问题。
AI.method: 框架分两步：首先由建筑知识图谱设定两个上限——可回答就绪上限（数据能回答的运维问题比例）与可执行就绪上限（可暴露的控制动作比例）；其次用参考AI智能体在固定问题集上的准确率，衡量上限被实现的程度。
AI.result: 在模拟办公场景中，智能体在0.64的可回答上限上实现了0.62，说明限制就绪度的是数据缺失而非AI本身，唯一例外是"命名故障原因"；在37个公共真实建筑图谱中，可回答上限中位数为0.16，且45个案例中有15个因传感器未关联而进一步降低。
AI.conclusion: 该框架把笼统的"建筑是否AI就绪"问题转化为可审计、可排序的改造决策依据，揭示了数据连通性与覆盖度是当前建筑AI就绪度的主要瓶颈。

title: Adaptive Risk-Certified Event-Triggered Replanning for Dynamic Navigation
summary: Safe navigation in dynamic environments requires robots to plan under obstacle predictions whose errors are uncertain, non-stationary, and can induce rare but safety-critical failures. Existing control-barrier-function safety filters can reject immediately unsafe controls, but they provide little guidance on when the current finite-horizon planning mode itself is becoming unsafe as prediction uncertainty evolves. We propose Conformal Event-Triggered Risk-Certified Replanning (\emph{CERT-Replan}), a framework that uses calibrated barrier risk as an early-warning signal for replanning. CERT-Replan calibrates horizon-indexed obstacle-prediction residuals online and uses the resulting uncertainty radii to evaluate dynamic-obstacle safety margins. A one-step safety filter protects the next applied control, while a horizon-level risk monitor evaluates the upper-tail CVaR of predicted barrier-violation losses along the current MPC rollout. When this risk exceeds an allocated budget, CERT-Replan rejects the current planning mode and selects a lower-risk alternative, such as a different speed profile, corridor, or homotopy class, rather than repeatedly correcting the same nominal plan. In a non-stationary benchmark, CERT-Replan achieves an \(83.3\%\) collision reduction relative to the safety-filter-only baseline \textcolor{black}{and a \(77.8\%\) reduction relative to simple replanning triggers}, while reducing average safety-filter intervention by \(32.4\%\). \textcolor{black}{With Trajectron++, CERT-Replan achieves \(96\%\) collision-free operation. Hardware experiments and onboard runtime profiling demonstrate computational feasibility.}

AI.tldr: 提出CERT-Replan框架，用校准后的障碍预测风险作为重规划的早期预警信号，实现动态环境中安全导航。
AI.motivation: 动态环境下机器人导航需在障碍预测误差不确定、非平稳且可能引发罕见安全故障的条件下规划。现有控制屏障函数安全滤波器只能拒绝即时不安全控制，难以为"当前有限时域规划模式本身是否变得不安全"提供指导。
AI.method: 在线校准按时域索引的障碍预测残差，得到不确定半径以评估动态障碍安全裕度；一步安全滤波器保护下一个应用控制；时域级风险监控器评估当前MPC滚动轨迹上预测屏障违反损失的上尾CVaR。当风险超预算时拒绝当前规划模式，选择风险更低的替代方案（不同速度曲线、走廊或同伦类），而非反复修正同一标称计划。
AI.result: 在非平稳基准上，相比仅安全滤波基线碰撞减少83.3%，相比简单重规划触发减少77.8%，安全滤波干预平均减少32.4%；结合Trajectron++实现96%无碰撞运行；硬件实验与机载运行时剖析证明计算可行性。
AI.conclusion: CERT-Replan通过将校准屏障风险作为重规划预警信号，优于被动安全滤波与简单重规划触发，并在硬件上验证了实用性。

title: PVSync: A Unified Lip-Sync Expert for Timing and Articulation
summary: Lip movements can match the timing of speech without matching the spoken sounds. We introduce PVSync, a unified model for audio-visual offset estimation and phoneme-level articulation scoring. PVSync combines window-level contrastive learning for synchronisation with a phoneme-level articulation objective that aligns audio and video embeddings of the same viseme class across clips. Visemes group phonemes with similar visible articulation. Viseme labels are derived automatically from forced-aligned transcripts, without manual annotations. On offset-corrected videos from 13 talking-head video generation models, PVSync matches human rankings of lip-sync quality more closely than LSE-C, achieving a Spearman correlation of 0.83 versus 0.34. On an automatically constructed benchmark from held-out speech, PVSync distinguishes viseme-matched from mismatched audio-visual pairs with an ROC AUC of 0.91. PVSync also outperforms SyncNet and MTD-VocaLiST in temporal offset recovery on held-out in-the-wild clips. Code and benchmark data will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PVSync，一个统一的音视频偏移估计与音素级发音评分模型，结合窗口级对比学习与音素级发音目标，在唇形同步质量评估上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 唇部动作可能与语音时间对齐但并不匹配实际发音，现有唇形同步质量评估方法（如LSE-C）难以准确反映人类判断。作者希望提出一个能同时进行音视频偏移估计和音素级发音评分的统一模型，以更贴近人类对唇形同步质量的评价。
AI.method: PVSync采用统一建模：1）窗口级对比学习用于音视频同步；2）音素级发音目标，将同一viseme类别的音视频嵌入跨片段对齐。Viseme类别由强制对齐转录自动导出，无需人工标注。
AI.result: 在13个说话头视频生成模型生成的偏移校正视频上，PVSync与人类唇形同步质量排名的Spearman相关为0.83，优于LSE-C的0.34；在自动构建的基准上区分viseme匹配与不匹配音视频对的ROC AUC为0.91；在野外片段的时间偏移恢复上也优于SyncNet和MTD-VocaLiST。
AI.conclusion: PVSync能更准确评估唇形同步质量并估计音视频偏移，无需人工标注即可构建viseme标签，代码与基准数据将在录用后发布。

title: A Self-Pruning Transformer: Extreme KV-Cache Compression with Universal Attention
summary: The large KV-cache size of modern LLMs creates a barrier to efficient deployment. Recent work has explored replacing attention layers' RoPE positional embeddings with alternative decay-based mechanisms, which can then be used to prune KV-cache during inference. However, these decay functions have limited expressivity, and in practice devolve into sliding-window-like eviction patterns. In this work, we propose a unifying framework for complementary and novel decay mechanisms, capturing complex key statistics and interactions while preserving expressive RoPE embeddings and Softmax attention. The resulting Universal Attention is a highly expressive and end-to-end trainable architecture, whose composite decay mechanism acts as a natural, $\textit{adaptive}$ pruning criterion, removing tokens that contribute least to attention computation. Experimentally, Universal Attention achieves state-of-the-art $10\times$ compression on natural language and synthetic task data, while $\textit{improving}$ downstream performance compared to both state-of-the-art baselines and unpruned oracles. It further demonstrates superior long-context generalization with unprecedented $25\times$ compression at length 16k.

AI.tldr: 提出 Universal Attention 框架，用可学习的复合衰减机制替代单一衰减函数，实现自适应 KV-cache 剪枝，在自然语言与合成任务上达 10× 压缩并提升性能。
AI.motivation: 大模型 KV-cache 体积过大，阻碍高效部署。已有工作用基于衰减的机制替换 RoPE 位置编码以便推理时剪枝 KV-cache，但这些衰减函数表达能力有限，实践中退化为类似滑动窗口的淘汰模式。
AI.method: 提出统一框架，整合互补且新颖的衰减机制，在保留表达性 RoPE 和 Softmax 注意力的同时，捕获复杂的 key 统计与交互。由此得到的 Universal Attention 是高度表达、端到端可训练的结构，其复合衰减机制充当自然的自适应剪枝准则，剔除对注意力计算贡献最小的 token。
AI.result: 在自然语言和合成任务数据上实现 10× 压缩的 SOTA 效果，下游性能优于 SOTA 基线以及未剪枝的 oracle；在 16k 长度上展现更优的长上下文泛化能力，达到 25× 压缩。
AI.conclusion: Universal Attention 通过可端到端训练的复合衰减机制，将自适应剪枝与表达性注意力统一起来，在显著压缩 KV-cache 的同时不减反增性能，并具备出色的长上下文泛化能力。

title: CADFather: Autonomous CAD Reconstruction through Coordinated Tool Use
summary: Reconstructing an editable CAD model from a 3D shape remains a challenging engineering task. Existing methods can propose CAD operations, but no single source of proposals works equally well across different part geometries and stages of reconstruction. We introduce CADFather, an autonomous agentic system that coordinates complementary tools to recover parametric CAD programs from 3D meshes. A vision-language assistant inspects renders of the target and intermediate reconstructions, then decides which candidate CAD programs to extend, which tools to invoke, how many proposals to generate, and when to finish. Learned and algorithmic tools propose CAD operations, while numerical optimization refines the parameters of existing programs. Proposed or refined programs are executed and evaluated to provide feedback for subsequent decisions. The agent maintains alternative candidate programs for each target part and preserves the best valid result throughout reconstruction. CADFather uses pretrained generation and assistant models without additional training. We evaluate reconstruction quality and execution validity on the full DeepCAD, Fusion360, and MCB test sets, as well as on CADENA-Bench, CADBench, and BenchCAD. We additionally analyze computational cost and the trade-off between cost and reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: CADFather是一个自主智能体系统，通过协调互补工具，从3D网格重建可编辑的参数化CAD程序。
AI.motivation: 从3D形状重建可编辑CAD模型是难题；现有方法能提出CAD操作，但单一来源的提案在不同零件几何和重建阶段表现不一。
AI.method: 引入CADFather自主智能体系统：视觉语言助手检查目标与中间重建的渲染图，决定扩展哪些候选CAD程序、调用哪些工具、生成多少提案、何时结束；学习型与算法型工具提出CAD操作，数值优化精炼已有程序参数；执行并评估程序以提供反馈；为每个目标零件维护备选程序并保留最佳有效结果；使用预训练生成与助手模型，无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在DeepCAD、Fusion360、MCB完整测试集以及CADENA-Bench、CADBench、BenchCAD上评估重建质量与执行有效性，并分析计算成本及成本与重建质量的权衡。
AI.conclusion: CADFather通过智能体协调多工具与反馈机制，在不额外训练的情况下实现跨数据集的有效CAD重建。

title: Predicted Futures Are Not Enough: Learning Executable Goals for Robot Manipulation
comment: 9 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Project page: https://claire0730.github.io/executable-goals/ Code and models: https://github.com/Claire0730/executable-goals
summary: Generative world models provide rich predictions of how manipulation scenes may evolve toward task objectives, yet those futures do not directly expose the compact task variables required by control. When training supervises future prediction alone, terminal goal accuracy is not an explicit learning objective, even when geometric recovery is available. We present Entity-Level Goal Readout, a learned prediction-to-execution interface that makes the executable terminal goal an explicit output of a 3D trace world model. It combines object-centric pose prediction with translation grounded in observed depth to produce a compact goal in SE(3). A shared Pose-Native Executor consumes this fixed goal with online object-pose feedback for closed-loop control without rerunning the world model. Across five manipulation tasks, the pipeline achieves a mean success rate of 79.69%. Goal diagnostics directly measure terminal goal accuracy, while controlled translation perturbations characterize how execution degrades under goal error. Zero-shot deployment on a Franka arm achieves 73.33% success on nominal StackCube, 66.67% with distractors, and 75.00% on PickPlate with a target unseen during policy training. These results support treating the prediction-to-execution interface as an explicit learned component of world-model planning rather than incidental post-processing in the control pipeline itself. Project page: https://claire0730.github.io/executable-goals/

AI.tldr: 提出"实体级目标读出"接口，把3D世界模型的预测转化为可执行的SE(3)终端目标，实现闭环控制。
AI.motivation: 生成式世界模型能预测操作场景的未来演化，但这些未来不直接暴露控制所需的紧凑任务变量。仅用未来预测做监督时，终端目标精度并非显式学习目标，即使有几何恢复能力也不保证。作者认为预测到执行之间的接口应是显式学习的组件，而非控制流程中的附带后处理。
AI.method: 提出Entity-Level Goal Readout：结合物体中心位姿预测与基于观测深度的平移，输出SE(3)紧凑目标。共享的Pose-Native Executor以该固定目标为输入，配合在线物体位姿反馈进行闭环控制，无需重跑世界模型。
AI.result: 五项操作任务平均成功率79.69%。目标诊断直接测量终端目标精度，并通过受控平移扰动刻画目标误差下的执行退化。在Franka机械臂零样本部署：标称StackCube 73.33%，含干扰物66.67%，PickPlate（策略训练中未见目标）75.00%。
AI.conclusion: 将预测到执行的接口视为世界模型规划中显式学习的组件，而非控制流程的附带后处理，是可行且有效的方向。

title: Pooling Representation Autoencoders for Efficient Diffusion
summary: Representation Autoencoders (RAEs) generate images from pre-trained visual fea- tures, but their dense token grids make generative modeling expensive. Motivated by local feature correlations, we introduce PoolDINO, a learned affine pooling operator that merges neighboring tokens. Training the pooling operator jointly with the RGB decoder preserves the standard two-stage RAE procedure without a separate feature auto-encoder. On ImageNet-256, 4x token compression retains comparable generation quality under internal guidance, while 16x compression trades some quality for greater efficiency. At a fixed budget of 100 sampling steps, latent-sampling throughput increases by 3.7x and 9.0x, respectively, relative to the unpooled baseline. Classification and dense prediction evaluations show that comparable guided generation quality can coexist with weaker performance on other tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出PoolDINO，一种可学习的仿射池化算子，通过合并相邻token降低RAE生成建模成本，在保持生成质量的同时显著提升采样吞吐量。
AI.motivation: RAE（表示自编码器）从预训练视觉特征生成图像，但其密集的token网格使生成建模成本高昂。受局部特征相关性的启发，作者希望减少token数量以提升效率。
AI.method: 引入PoolDINO，一种可学习的仿射池化算子，用于合并相邻token。该池化算子与RGB解码器联合训练，从而保留标准的两阶段RAE流程，无需单独的特征自编码器。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-256上，4倍token压缩在内部引导下保持可比的生成质量；16倍压缩以一定质量换取更高效率。在固定100采样步预算下，潜变量采样吞吐量分别比未池化基线提升3.7倍和9.0倍。分类和密集预测评估显示，可比的引导生成质量可能与较弱的下游任务表现共存。
AI.conclusion: PoolDINO通过可学习池化有效压缩token网格，大幅提升RAE采样效率，同时在生成质量与下游任务性能之间存在权衡。

title: BeatFlow-ECG: Rectified Flow for ECG Reconstruction from Indirect Wearable Signals
summary: Continuous cardiac monitoring outside clinical settings requires signals that are both informative and practical to collect during daily life. Electrocardiography (ECG) provides rich information about cardiac rhythm and waveform morphology, while wearable photoplethysmography (PPG) is easier to acquire continuously but is only an indirect cardiovascular measurement and is highly sensitive to motion. We present BeatFlow-ECG, a conditional rectified-flow model for reconstructing single-channel ECG from synchronized PPG and inertial measurements. BeatFlow-ECG models reconstruction as conditional transport from noise to ECG using a convolutional encoder-decoder with a transformer bottleneck and explicit flow-time conditioning. Motion information is incorporated through IMU-derived conditioning features, motion-dependent loss weighting, and an easy-to-hard training curriculum. We evaluate the model under leave-one-subject-out protocols on PPG-DaLiA and WESAD. BeatFlow-ECG achieves the best results among the evaluated deterministic, adversarial, and diffusion-based baselines across all reported waveform and beat-timing metrics, with Pearson correlations of 0.983 and 0.986 and R-peak F1 scores of 0.946 and 0.955, respectively. Compared with Conditional DDPM-1D, L1 error decreases from 0.085 to 0.062 on PPG-DaLiA and from 0.074 to 0.055 on WESAD. Additional analyses on PPG-DaLiA show higher correlation in fixed R-peak-relative waveform regions and lower reconstruction error across low-, medium-, and high-motion subsets.

AI.tldr: 提出BeatFlow-ECG，一种条件整流流模型，从同步的PPG与惯性测量重建单通道ECG，在两个数据集上超越确定性、对抗和扩散基线。
AI.motivation: 临床外连续心脏监测需要兼具信息量与日常可采集性的信号。ECG信息丰富但难持续采集，PPG易采集但是间接测量且对运动敏感，因此需要从PPG等易得信号重建ECG。
AI.method: 将重建建模为从噪声到ECG的条件传输，采用卷积编解码器加Transformer瓶颈并显式条件化流时间；通过IMU衍生条件特征、运动相关损失加权及由易到难训练课程引入运动信息。
AI.result: 在PPG-DaLiA和WESAD上采用留一被试协议，所有波形与心搏时序指标均优于确定性、对抗及扩散基线；Pearson相关为0.983和0.986，R峰F1为0.946和0.955；相比Conditional DDPM-1D，L1误差由0.085降至0.062、由0.074降至0.055。
AI.conclusion: BeatFlow-ECG能有效从PPG和惯性信号重建高质量ECG；在固定R峰相对波形区域相关性更高，并在低、中、高运动子集上重建误差均更低。

title: Breaking the Space Barrier and its Application to Language Model Inference
summary: Language models are more and more often asked for structured output: JSON that follows a schema, or a tool call with typed arguments. A small machine, an automaton, enforces the format by forbidding the tokens that would break it. We observe that this machine has a rare property: from any of its states, each token leads along exactly one path. Graphs in which only a few paths join any two points are a classical object of complexity theory, and our theoretical result settles an open question about them: one can decide whether such a graph connects two points while verifying that it really has few paths, with very little memory. Precisely, the problem lies in the classes ReachUL, LOGDCFL, C=L and SC2, and needs only O(log2 n/ log log n) space, below the classical O(log2 n) of Savitch's theorem. The constructions behind the proofs become an inference engine: text the format forces is written without running the model, the mask is recomputed on the GPU without any table, recursive formats use a small stack, every output stays valid under a token limit, and independent fields are decoded in parallel and verified. On one 16 GB Apple M2 Pro with Qwen3.5-2B and 4B, against MLX with llguidance, the standard setup for this hardware, schema-constrained extraction finishes 1.2- 1.3x sooner with the same answers, a grammar costs 3 MB instead of up to 1.5 GB, one server holds sixteen grammars where tables run out of memory, and sixteen tool-calling agents finish 2.5x sooner.

AI.tldr: 论文研究结构化输出中格式约束自动机（每状态每token唯一路径的图）的复杂度，证明其可达性问题可在低于Savitch定理O(log²n)的空间内判定，并据此构建高效GPU推理引擎。
AI.motivation: 语言模型越来越多被要求生成结构化输出（符合schema的JSON或带类型参数的工具调用），通常由小型自动机禁止破坏格式的token来强制约束。但这类约束机制在实现上依赖庞大的查找表，内存开销大、解码慢、并行性差，亟需更好的理论与工程方案。
AI.method: 观察此类约束自动机具有稀有性质：从任一状态出发，每个token恰好沿唯一路径前进。将问题抽象为"任意两点间仅有少数路径"的图可达性判定，给出复杂度定位（ReachUL、LOGDCFL、C=L、SC²）并设计仅需O(log²n/log logn)空间的算法。基于证明构造出推理引擎：格式强制文本无需运行模型直接写入、GPU上无表重算掩码、递归格式用小型栈、token上限下保持输出合法、独立字段并行解码与验证。
AI.result: 在16GB Apple M2 Pro上以Qwen3.5-2B和4B对比MLX+llguidance标准方案：schema约束抽取快1.2–1.3倍且答案一致；语法内存从最多1.5GB降至3MB；单服务器可容纳16个语法（原方案因表耗尽内存）；16个工具调用智能体完成速度快2.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 该工作既解决了一个关于稀疏路径图的复杂度类归属的开放问题，又将理论构造落地为实用的约束解码引擎，在内存与速度上显著优于现有表格化方案。

title: ClimbLab: MATLAB Simulation Platform for Legged Climbing Robotics
comment: Author's version of a manuscript in the proceedings of CLAWAR 2021. The final published version is available at: https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-030-86294-7_20
summary: This paper presents an open-sourced MATLAB simulation and analysis platform dedicated to legged climbing robots. This simulator enables the design of any limbed robotic system as an articulated multi-body with a floating base and simulates it walking and climbing in an arbitrary environment. The main variable environmental parameters are inclination, gravity, and ground stiffness, and any point cloud can be installed as the terrain map. Furthermore, the simulator employs a rigid body dynamics engine. This paper first describes the simulator structure, and the computational flow and next presents the representative simulation examples where quadrupedal robots assumed gripping on the wall or climbing on the steep slope.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个开源的MATLAB仿真与分析平台，用于腿式攀爬机器人，支持任意多肢体机器人系统在可变环境中行走与攀爬的仿真。
AI.motivation: 腿式攀爬机器人的研究需要一个能够灵活配置机器人结构与环境参数的仿真工具，以便在真实实验前进行设计与验证。现有仿真平台在环境参数可调性与通用性方面存在不足。
AI.method: 构建开源MATLAB仿真与分析平台，将任意肢体机器人系统建模为带浮动基座的铰接多体系统；采用刚体动力学引擎；环境主要可变参数包括倾角、重力和地面刚度，并支持任意点云作为地形图。
AI.result: 给出了仿真器的结构、计算流程，并展示了代表性仿真示例：四足机器人抓附墙面或在陡坡上攀爬。
AI.conclusion: 该平台为腿式攀爬机器人的设计与分析提供了通用、可配置的开源仿真工具，能够支持多种机器人和环境条件下的行走与攀爬仿真。

title: Adaptive Visual Token Reduction for Accelerated Image Understanding
summary: Large Vision-Language Models achieve strong VQA performance, but processing high-resolution, information-rich images requires substantial computation, motivating visual token reduction. However, existing methods often prune individual tokens or rely on fixed-size cropping, limiting their ability to preserve spatially structured information such as horizontally or vertically elongated text. To address this limitation, we propose ReFIT, an instruction-guided visual token reduction framework for efficient LVLM inference. ReFIT consists of Relevance-Guided Window Reshaping (RWR) and Instruction-Guided Token Refinement (ITR), where RWR captures instruction-relevant regions by adapting to their spatial characteristics, while ITR further removes unnecessary visual tokens. Experiments on four VQA benchmarks demonstrate that ReFIT improves answer accuracy while reducing computational cost, and qualitative results demonstrate its effectiveness in localizing relevant regions and removing unnecessary visual information.

AI.tldr: 提出 ReFIT，一种指令引导的视觉 token 缩减框架，通过 Relevance-Guided Window Reshaping 与 Instruction-Guided Token Refinement 在降低计算成本的同时提升 VQA 准确率。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型虽在 VQA 上表现优异，但处理高分辨率、信息密集图像需大量计算，因此需要缩减视觉 token。然而现有方法多采用逐 token 剪枝或固定尺寸裁剪，难以保留如横向或纵向延伸文本这类具有空间结构的信息。
AI.method: ReFIT 框架包含两个模块：Relevance-Guided Window Reshaping（RWR）通过适应指令相关区域的空间特性来捕捉相关区域；Instruction-Guided Token Refinement（ITR）进一步去除多余视觉 token。
AI.result: 在四个 VQA 基准上的实验表明，ReFIT 在提升答案准确率的同时降低了计算成本；定性结果显示了其在定位相关区域与去除冗余视觉信息方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ReFIT 通过指令引导的窗口重塑与 token 精炼，克服了现有剪枝与固定裁剪方法在保留空间结构信息上的不足，实现了效率与精度的双重提升。

title: A Geometry-Based Capacity Theory for Finite-Feature Associative Memory
summary: We develop a geometry-based capacity theory for exact-key retrieval in compressed finite-feature Hebbian associative memory. For random or approximately isotropic values, retrieval interference separates into finite-feature noise, which decreases with feature dimension, and structural interference, which is determined by squared kernel overlap among stored keys and persists in the infinite-feature limit. This yields a fit-free prediction of retrieval quality, reveals a geometry-dependent capacity ceiling, and predicts the feature budget required for a target retrieval quality. When stored values are correlated, we show that retrieval depends jointly on the key kernel and value Gram matrix, and derive finite-feature approximations that account for this interaction. We validate the theory on synthetic, visual, and medical-image representations. Overall, the framework links representation geometry directly to memory capacity and distinguishes when performance can be improved by increasing the feature budget and when the representation itself must be changed. Across these settings, the predicted retrieval curves closely match empirical behavior and correctly identify changes in the preferred memory design.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于几何的容量理论，用于分析压缩有限特征Hebbian联想记忆中的精确键检索，将检索干扰分解为有限特征噪声与结构干扰，并给出无拟合的检索质量预测。
AI.motivation: 现有联想记忆研究缺乏一个能直接把表示几何与记忆容量联系起来的理论框架，尤其难以判断性能提升应通过增加特征预算还是改变表示本身来实现。
AI.method: 对随机或近似各向同性的值，把检索干扰分解为随特征维度下降的有限特征噪声和由存储键之间平方核重叠决定、在无限特征极限下仍存在的结构干扰；对相关值情形，结合键核与值Gram矩阵推导有限特征近似。
AI.result: 理论给出无拟合的检索质量预测，揭示了依赖几何的容量上限，并预测达到目标检索质量所需的特征预算；在合成、视觉和医学图像表示上验证，预测的检索曲线与实证行为高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将表示几何直接关联到记忆容量，能够区分何时通过增加特征预算提升性能、何时必须改变表示本身，并正确识别记忆设计偏好的变化。

title: Finding Blind Spots in AppWorld and WorkArena Task Verifiers
comment: 14 pages. Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 workshop "Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development". OpenReview paper and supplement: https://openreview.net/forum?id=uR6EWsGE48
summary:
Execution-based task verifiers decide whether an agent succeeded. We audit shipped AppWorld and WorkArena verifiers with source-informed mutation tests. The main audit never modifies a shipped checker.
  In AppWorld, duplicating a non-idempotent write creates an extra record while preserving every checked field value. The verifier accepts all three task variants from two of five eligible generators: 6/15 constructed effects. A cardinality patch applied to checker copies after the census makes all six cells fail while preserving valid controls.
  In WorkArena, we prospectively rerun 23 extra-field candidates selected for earlier checker-PASS outcomes. Independent Table API readback confirms nondefault persisted values in 21, while all 23 receive PASS. Two requested strings are aliases of stored defaults. The 21 confirmed wrong effects span three form templates. These selected cases confirm wrong effects under the audit's protocol; they do not estimate a population rate.
  No other construction produces an independently confirmed false accept. Other checker-PASS cases are effect-correct degeneracies. We report zero-PASS families separately because retained evidence differs. In fixed intent-swap grids, the checkers return no PASS on 2,689 off-diagonal executions. This is a rejection census: 57 WorkArena cells use session-scoped evidence; the other 2,632 lack classified rejection causes and independent target ground truth.
  Each increment is specified before its own cells are scored. A supplement accompanies the OpenReview submission with the construction grammar, evidence, content-bound stage lineage and count reproducer.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了 AppWorld 与 WorkArena 中已发布的任务执行验证器，通过源信息指导的变异测试发现：验证器会把带有未检查副作用（多余记录、非默认持久化字段）的执行错误判定为成功，即存在“假通过”。
AI.motivation: 基于执行的任务验证器决定智能体是否成功，其可靠性直接影响评测结论。作者希望在不修改已发布检查器的前提下，检验这些验证器是否能被“保持所有被检查字段、但引入额外副作用”的执行所欺骗，从而揭示其判定缺陷。
AI.method: 采用源信息指导的变异测试（mutation test）审计。主审计不修改已发布检查器：在 AppWorld 中通过复制非幂等写操作来注入多余记录；在 WorkArena 中前瞻性重跑 23 个此前检查器通过且带额外字段的候选案例，并用独立 Table API 回读确认持久化值。检查器的基数补丁仅施加于检查器副本，并保留有效对照；每个增量在评分前预先指定，并附带构造语法、证据与计数复现器。
AI.result: AppWorld：5 个合格生成器中有 2 个接受全部三种任务变体，共 6/15 构造效应被误接受；补丁后六格全部失败且对照仍有效。WorkArena：23 个候选全部 PASS，其中 21 个经独立回读确认为非默认持久化值（覆盖三种表单模板），另 2 个所请求字符串实为存储默认值的别名。未发现其他可独立确认的假通过，其余 PASS 案例为效应正确的退化情况。固定意图交换网格中 2,689 次非对角执行为零 PASS（拒绝普查），其中 57 个单元使用会话级证据，2,632 个缺少分类拒绝原因与独立目标真值。
AI.conclusion: 已发布验证器存在可独立确认的假通过，其根源是仅检查部分字段而忽略额外副作用；这些选定案例证实了协议下的错误接受，但不构成总体发生率估计。作者以拒绝普查和零通过家族分开报告，并强调证据保留方式差异，提示验证器设计与审计协议需同时改进。

title: MCFR: A Mask-Guided Coarse-to-Fine Regression Framework for Robust Multi-Variant Board-to-Board Connector Assembly
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, 1 table. Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026). Finalist for the IROS Best Paper Award for Industrial Robotics Research for Applications
summary: Automated insertion of board-to-board (BTB) connectors in 3C manufacturing requires both high visual accuracy and strong deployment robustness. This problem remains challenging because multi-variant connectors exhibit significant morphological and appearance variations, making stable cross-variant generalization difficult, while the mismatch between training and deployment under fixed-view inspection settings induces background spurious correlation and degrades real-world performance. To address these issues, this paper proposes MCFR, a Mask-Guided Coarse-to-Fine Regression framework for multi-variant BTB connector assembly. By introducing an object-aware mask prior and explicit photometric refinement, the proposed method suppresses background interference and improves alignment accuracy and robustness in practical deployment. Experiments on a self-constructed multi-variant dataset, a BTB batch insertion testbed, and a real smartphone assembly task show that MCFR consistently outperforms representative baselines and achieves an average real-world insertion success rate of 99.25%. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and practical potential of MCFR for automated assembly of multi-variant BTB connectors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MCFR框架，用于多型号板对板连接器的自动化插入，在真实装配任务中达到99.25%的平均插入成功率。
AI.motivation: 3C制造中板对板（BTB）连接器的自动化插入需要高视觉精度与强部署鲁棒性。难点在于：多型号连接器在形态与外观上差异显著，跨型号泛化困难；固定视角检测下训练与部署的不一致会引入背景虚假相关，降低实际性能。
AI.method: 提出MCFR——一种掩码引导的由粗到细回归框架，面向多型号BTB连接器装配。引入目标感知的掩码先验与显式的光度细化，抑制背景干扰并提升对齐精度与鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在自构建的多型号数据集、BTB批量插入测试平台以及真实智能手机装配任务上，MCFR持续优于代表性基线方法，真实场景平均插入成功率达99.25%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明MCFR对多型号BTB连接器的自动化装配具有有效性与实际应用潜力。

title: PhyDiCT: Plug-and-Play CT Reconstruction from Sparse X-Rays via Differentiable Rendering and Strong Priors
comment: Accepted at MICCAI 2026; to appear in LNCS 16888
summary: Reconstructing 3D Computed Tomography (CT) images from a few X-ray projections is a highly ill-posed inverse problem due to the loss of volumetric information. We propose PhyDiCT, a training-free framework that integrates a differentiable Physics-based forward model, grounded in the Beer-Lambert law, with a text-conditioned Diffusion as a strong prior to reconstruct 3D lung CT images. We refer to our approach as training-free since the prior model is used without fine-tuning, and our goal is to steer the denoising procedure to generate samples consistent with X-ray observations. We guide the diffusion generation using Split Gibbs sampling to jointly optimize for projection fidelity (reward) and consistency with prior knowledge. Also, we introduce a test-time refinement step that enhances image realism and anatomical coherence. We extensively evaluate our method on publicly available 3D CT datasets using both perceptual and semantic metrics, demonstrating that it surpasses existing plug-and-play diffusion and fully trained reconstruction approaches. Our findings highlight that combining a strong generative prior with the underlying physics of image formation substantially improves reconstruction quality, e.g., 7.5\% improvement on SSIM compared to full training methods. Code will be released at https://github.com/batmanlab/PhyDiCT.

AI.tldr: PhyDiCT：无需训练，结合可微物理前向模型与文本条件扩散先验，用Split Gibbs采样从少量X射线投影重建3D肺部CT，性能超过即插即用扩散与全训练方法。
AI.motivation: 从少量X射线投影重建3D CT是高度病态的逆问题，因体信息丢失严重。现有即插即用扩散方法与全训练重建方法在质量上仍有不足，需要更强先验与物理模型结合。
AI.method: 提出免训练框架PhyDiCT：1）基于Beer-Lambert定律的可微物理前向模型；2）以文本条件扩散模型作为强先验且不微调；3）用Split Gibbs采样引导去噪过程，联合优化投影保真度（reward）与先验一致性；4）引入测试时细化步骤提升图像真实感与解剖连贯性。
AI.result: 在公开3D CT数据集上，用感知与语义指标评估，方法超过现有即插即用扩散方法及全训练重建方法，SSIM相比全训练方法提升7.5%。
AI.conclusion: 将强生成先验与图像形成的底层物理相结合，可显著提升重建质量，验证了物理-生成联合框架在稀疏视图CT重建中的有效性。

title: Learning Cross-Model Activation Alignments with Explicit Many-to-Many Layer Maps
summary: LLMs are released at a rapid pace, raising a natural question: how do two independently trained models relate, both in which layers correspond and in how features transform between them? We study this by learning an activation alignment, a map from a source model's layerwise activations to a target's. Our method, MATCHA, factors this map into a layer map, whose output is an explicit target-by-source matrix that can be extracted and inspected, and a layer-shared feature map between hidden spaces. Most of prior work fixes the layer correspondence in advance, pairing layers at roughly the same relative depth; in contrast, we learn both factors jointly from prompts. Across 42 pairs of seven models spanning three different families, MATCHA reconstructs the target's activations more faithfully and improves retrieval-based metrics substantially, w.r.t. previous approaches. The recovered maps are broadly monotone in depth but, in contrast with most previous approaches, are consistently many-to-many: each target layer draws on a band of source layers. Our alignments also enable transfer of activation-space interventions, allowing steering vectors and probes developed for one model to transfer to another.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MATCHA方法，通过学习源模型层激活到目标模型激活的映射（激活对齐），将映射分解为可提取检查的层映射矩阵与层共享特征映射，在七个模型、42对模型上优于既有方法，并支持激活空间干预的跨模型迁移。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型发布迅速，一个自然的问题是两个独立训练的模型之间如何关联：哪些层相互对应，特征如何在它们之间变换。此前多数工作预先固定层对应关系，仅按大致相同相对深度配对层，缺乏从数据中学习对应关系的能力。
AI.method: MATCHA学习一个从源模型逐层激活到目标模型激活的激活对齐映射，并将其分解为两部分：(1) 层映射，其输出是一个显式的"目标层×源层"矩阵，可提取并检查；(2) 隐含空间之间的层共享特征映射。两个因子从提示（prompts）中联合学习，而非预先固定层对应。
AI.result: 在涵盖三个模型族、七个模型的42个模型对上进行实验，MATCHA在重建目标激活上更忠实，并在检索类指标上相较先前方法有显著提升。恢复出的映射在深度上大体单调，但与多数先前方法不同，呈一致的"多对多"结构：每个目标层都从源模型的一个层带中获取信息。对齐结果还支持激活空间干预的迁移，使为某模型开发的方向向量（steering vectors）和探针（probes）可以迁移到另一模型。
AI.conclusion: 跨独立训练模型的激活对齐可以被有效学习，且层对应关系本质上是多对多的层带结构而非简单的一一配对；该对齐不仅有重建与检索上的收益，还能实现激活空间干预与探针的跨模型迁移。

title: DIVA: Dual-Space Intent-Aware Visual Attenuation for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies typically feed dense visual patch tokens into a language-action backbone, preserving scene context but offering no explicit mechanism to regulate how strongly different visual tokens influence policy computation. We introduce DIVA, a Dual-Space Intent-Aware Visual Attenuation module with an anchor-then-attenuate design. DIVA combines high-level task intent with low-level visual evidence to estimate patch-wise relevance anchors, then applies them in two complementary spaces: it reweights projected visual tokens before backbone entry and persistently attenuates low-relevance visual states within the backbone. DIVA preserves the full visual token sequence and requires no external grounding supervision. On LIBERO, DIVA improves OpenVLA-OFT from 96.6% to 98.0% average success and raises its zero-shot LIBERO-Plus score from 69.6 to 72.6. Real-world experiments further show consistent gains under task-irrelevant visual perturbations, supporting the robustness of intent-aware visual attenuation beyond simulation.

AI.tldr: DIVA：一种双空间意图感知视觉衰减模块，通过"先锚定后衰减"设计提升VLA策略的鲁棒性与成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA策略通常将稠密视觉patch token输入语言-动作骨干网络，虽保留了场景上下文，但缺乏显式机制来调节不同视觉token对策略计算的影响强度。
AI.method: 提出DIVA（双空间意图感知视觉衰减模块），采用"先锚定后衰减"设计：结合高层任务意图与低层视觉证据估计逐patch的相关性锚点，并在两个互补空间应用——在进入骨干网络前对投影视觉token重新加权，以及在骨干网络内持续衰减低相关性视觉状态。方法保留完整视觉token序列，且无需外部grounding监督。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上，DIVA将OpenVLA-OFT的平均成功率从96.6%提升至98.0%，零样本LIBERO-Plus得分从69.6提升至72.6；真实世界实验在任务无关视觉扰动下也表现出一致增益。
AI.conclusion: DIVA通过意图感知的视觉衰减机制，在仿真与真实环境中均提升了VLA策略的性能与鲁棒性，验证了该方法的有效性。

title: Learning Unknown Constraints without Unsafe Data via Optimality and Counterfactual Regularization
summary: Learning from demonstrations (LfD) provides a framework for inferring unknown constraints from locally optimal, constraint-satisfying expert behavior. Existing approaches largely fall into two paradigms, constrained inverse optimal control (CIOC) and inverse constrained reinforcement learning (ICRL). CIOC exploits optimality conditions such as the Karush--Kuhn--Tucker (KKT) conditions but typically assumes known dynamics and structured constraint representations. Meanwhile, ICRL accommodates complex unknown constraints and unknown transition dynamics but often requires extensive online exploration, during which unsafe constraint violations may occur. In this work, we introduce Counterfactual KKT (CF-KKT), a constraint learning framework that leverages learned dynamics and locally optimal demonstrations to recover unknown constraints without requiring known dynamics or additional risky exploration, thereby combining the data efficiency and safety advantages of CIOC with the flexibility of ICRL. First, we use a locally learned differentiable dynamics model to impose KKT-inspired optimality conditions directly on the demonstrations. Second, we use the learned dynamics to generate reward-improving counterfactual behaviors near the demonstrations, revealing behaviors that would be preferable in the absence of the unknown constraint and thus providing synthetic infeasible data. When the constraint parameterization is known, the same learned-dynamics framework enables direct CIOC-based parameter recovery, and we characterize its sensitivity to dynamics misspecification. Across high-dimensional robotic control tasks, our approach learns neural constraint representations with improved safety and data efficiency relative to state-of-the-art offline ICRL baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出CF-KKT框架，利用学习到的动力学和局部最优演示恢复未知约束，兼具CIOC的数据效率/安全性优势与ICRL的灵活性，在机器人控制任务上优于离线ICRL基线。
AI.motivation: 从演示中学习约束存在两大范式：约束逆最优控制（CIOC）依赖最优性条件但假设动力学已知且约束表示结构化；逆约束强化学习（ICRL）能处理复杂未知约束和未知动力学，但需大量在线探索，可能发生不安全约束违反。作者希望结合二者优势，在未知动力学和无需额外风险探索的情况下恢复约束。
AI.method: 提出Counterfactual KKT（CF-KKT）。首先用局部学习的可微动力学模型，将KKT启发的,最优性条件直接施加于演示数据；其次利用学习动力学在演示附近生成奖励改进的反事实行为，揭示在无未知约束时更优的行为，从而得到合成的不可行数据。当约束参数化已知时，同一框架可直接用于基于CIOC的参数恢复，并分析其对动力学误设的敏感性。
AI.result: 在高维机器人控制任务上，该方法学习到神经约束表示，相比最先进的离线ICRL基线，在安全性和数据效率方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: CF-KKT通过结合学习动力学、KKT最优性条件与反事实生成，实现了无需已知动力学和额外风险探索的约束学习，融合了CIOC与ICRL的优点，在安全性和数据效率上表现更优。

title: Hardware-aware Calibrated Clustered Attention for Efficient Visual Geometric Transformers
summary: The Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT) marks a significant leap forward in 3D scene reconstruction, as it is the first model that directly infers all key 3D attributes (camera poses, depths, and dense geometry) jointly in one pass. However, this joint inference mechanism requires global attention layers with extremely long sequences that causes a significant latency bottleneck. In this paper, we propose blockwise clustered attention (BC attention) to accelerate the global attention layers in VGGT. By limiting the clustering within HW-friendly neighborhood blocks, BC attention reduces the computation overhead of query clustering as well as the costly data movement between on- and off-chip memory. This enables BC attention to scale to long sequences and deliver practical latency improvements on GPUs. Moreover, we introduce a hashing hyperplane calibration method and a threshold-based error compensation method to reduce clustering errors efficiently, which is a bottleneck in the current clustered attention mechanism. Overall, our experiments on GPU demonstrate that calibrated BC attention accelerates the global attention layers by 2.10-2.63$\times$ and the whole backbone by 1.77-2.35$\times$ with negligible loss (1%) for large scenes. With a small performance loss (< 5%), calibrated BC attention further achieves a 2.26-2.87$\times$ latency improvement on the global attention layers and a 1.90-2.55$\times$ improvement on the backbone.

AI.tldr: 提出块聚类注意力（BC attention）加速VGGT的全局注意力层，通过块内聚类、哈希超平面校准与阈值误差补偿，在GPU上实现显著加速且精度损失极小。
AI.motivation: VGGT首次实现一次前向推理中联合推断相机位姿、深度与稠密几何等3D属性，但其联合推理机制依赖超长序列的全局注意力层，造成严重的延迟瓶颈，亟需高效的注意力加速方案。
AI.method: 1) 提出块聚类注意力（BC attention），将聚类限制在HW友好的邻域块内，降低查询聚类计算开销及片上/片外内存间数据搬运，使其可扩展至长序列；2) 引入哈希超平面校准方法；3) 引入基于阈值的误差补偿方法，以高效降低当前聚类注意力机制的聚类误差瓶颈。
AI.result: GPU实验表明：校准后的BC attention使全局注意力层加速2.10-2.63倍，整个主干加速1.77-2.35倍，大场景精度损失可忽略（1%）；在较小性能损失（<5%）下，全局注意力层延迟改善2.26-2.87倍，主干改善1.90-2.55倍。
AI.conclusion: BC attention结合哈希超平面校准与阈值误差补偿，可有效缓解VGGT全局注意力的延迟瓶颈，在精度损失极小的情况下于GPU上实现大幅加速，具备实际应用价值。

title: EDiS: Edge Disjoint Subgraph Sparsification Framework for Graph Neural Networks
summary: Sparse GNN training reduces computation, but deciding which edges to keep can be costly. Reusing one sparse graph is cheap, but locks training to a fixed topology, while varying it across epochs can require repeated sampling or recomputation. We introduce EDiS (Edge-Disjoint Subgraph sparsification framework), which separates one-time structural extraction from per-epoch graph composition. EDiS decomposes the graph once into cacheable edge-disjoint subgraphs, then recombines them into graphs with edge-budget constraints across epochs and retention ratios without re-extracting structure. Our default construction uses feature-based scores and successive maximum score covering forests, while the same composition mechanism also supports alternative edge selection rules. We provide a combinatorial analysis of the per-epoch sampler, the composition step that draws a training graph from the cached decomposition. We show that, under the default covering-forest selector, the stored decomposition deterministically preserves high-score cut edges, and we derive a selector-agnostic conditional bound on high-score cut survival in composed training graphs. Across 19 homophilic, heterophilic, and large-scale node classification benchmarks against 17 baselines under the same edge budget, EDiS achieves the highest mean benchmark score (accuracy/ROC-AUC) and the lowest average rank and gap-to-best among ranked methods. Ablations show the clearest benefits of structural decomposition and epoch variation at tight edge budgets.

AI.tldr: EDiS 将稀疏图训练中的结构抽取与逐轮图组合解耦：一次性把图分解为可缓存的边不相交子图，之后在不重新抽取结构的情况下按边预算与保留率跨轮次重组成训练图。
AI.motivation: 稀疏 GNN 训练虽能降低计算量，但决定保留哪些边本身代价高昂。复用单一稀疏图成本低却将训练锁定在固定拓扑上；若逐轮改变拓扑，又需重复采样或重算，因而缺少一种既节省成本又能保持拓扑变化的方案。
AI.method: EDiS 框架把一次性的结构抽取与逐轮图组合分离。先将图一次性分解为可缓存的边不相交子图，再在多个轮次中按边预算约束和保留比重组成图，无需重新抽取结构。默认构造使用基于特征的分数与连续最大分数覆盖森林，同一组合机制也支持其他边选择规则。作者还对逐轮采样器（即从缓存分解中抽取训练图的组合步骤）进行了组合分析。
AI.result: 在默认覆盖森林选择器下，所存储的分解可确定性地保留高分割边；并推导出与选择器无关的、关于组合训练图中高分割边存活的条件界。在 19 个同配、异配及大规模节点分类基准上、相同边预算下与 17 个基线比较，EDiS 取得最高平均基准分数（准确率/ROC-AUC），并在排名方法中拥有最低平均排名与最小与最优差距。消融实验显示，结构分解与轮次变化在紧边预算下收益最明显。
AI.conclusion: EDiS 通过一次抽取、多次组合的设计，在保持逐轮拓扑可变的同时避免重复计算，并以理论分析与大规模实验验证其在紧边预算场景下的有效性，为高效稀疏 GNN 训练提供了可缓存、可选择器替换的结构分解框架。

title: Frozen Models, Evolving Expertise: Model-Agnostic Learning from Deployment Experience for Multimodal Medical AI
summary: Large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) are usually frozen after deployment, so they do not learn from the cases they solve. This is especially concerning in medicine, where new clinical evidence, updated guidelines, and new therapies can change established practice. Fine-tuning can update the model, but it requires access to model weights and additional training. Parameter-free methods avoid training, but they may overfit a fixed validation set, lack reliable domain knowledge, or lose visual details by saving experience only as text. To address these limitations, we present a model-agnostic framework that allows frozen LLMs and VLMs to learn from deployment experience through three forms of external expertise: a Skill that guides reasoning and tool use, a Knowledge Memory that stores reliable facts supported by earlier cases or trusted external evidence, and a Multimodal Knowledge Base that keeps visual examples and guides the model to relate each retrieved case to the current image. Instead of relying on a fixed validation set, a validation strategy keeps an update only if it helps on new cases without degrading performance on earlier ones. Across six benchmarks covering clinical diagnosis, clinical workflows, medical reasoning, and medical and non-medical visual reasoning, and with four open-weight and closed-source base models, our framework improves performance during online deployment by up to 34.2% over the base model on medical tasks, generalizes to unseen cases, transfers to other models without further optimization, and works in non-medical domains.

AI.tldr: 提出一种模型无关框架，让冻结的LLM/VLM通过三种外部专业知识形式从部署经验中持续学习，在六个基准上最高提升34.2%。
AI.motivation: LLM和VLM部署后通常被冻结，无法从所解决的案例中学习。这在医学领域尤为突出，因为新临床证据、更新指南和新疗法会改变既有实践。微调需要权重访问和额外训练；无参数方法可能过拟合固定验证集、缺乏可靠领域知识，或仅以文本保存经验而丢失视觉细节。
AI.method: 提出模型无关框架，使冻结的LLM和VLM通过三种外部专业知识形式从部署经验中学习：Skill（指导推理与工具使用）、Knowledge Memory（存储有先前案例或可信外部证据支持的事实）、Multimodal Knowledge Base（保留视觉示例并引导模型将每个检索案例与当前图像关联）。采用验证策略，仅在更新对新案例有益且不降低早期表现时才保留。
AI.result: 在涵盖临床诊断、临床工作流、医学推理及医学与非医学视觉推理的六个基准上，使用四种开源权重和闭源基座模型，在线部署期间医学任务表现较基座模型最高提升34.2%，可泛化到未见案例，无需额外优化即可迁移到其他模型，并在非医学领域有效。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为冻结LLM/VLM提供了一种无需训练、模型无关的持续学习方式，兼顾可靠知识与多模态细节，具备跨任务、跨模型和跨领域泛化能力。

title: COOL: Curiosity-Driven Object Ownership Learning for Personalized Robotic Assistance
summary: Robots are increasingly expected to provide personalized services in everyday environments. To do so, they must ground natural-language commands such as "Where is my backpack?" or "Find my bottle" and execute them by reasoning about object instances, people, locations, and ownership. This is challenging because ownership is rarely labeled explicitly and must be inferred from long-term, behavioral evidence of human-object interactions. To address this, we present COOL, a novel robotic framework for autonomously learning object ownership from everyday observations and maintaining a long-term spatial memory of its environment. To keep its memory current, COOL uses an agent-based curiosity-driven data collection strategy that guides the robot toward the most promising locations to gain information and refresh stale observations. Offline experiments, ablation studies, and real-world evaluations show that COOL can infer ownership relations from real-world interactions and use this knowledge for ownership-conditioned navigation and task execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出COOL，一个从日常观察中自主学习物品归属关系并维护长期空间记忆的机器人框架，通过好奇心驱动的数据收集策略提升记忆时效性。
AI.motivation: 机器人需在日常生活场景中提供个性化服务，必须理解如"我的背包在哪"这类涉及物品归属的自然语言指令。然而物品归属通常没有显式标注，只能从长期的人-物交互行为中推断，这是一大挑战。
AI.method: COOL框架让机器人自主从日常观察中学习物品归属关系，并维护环境的长期空间记忆。为保持记忆的时效性，采用基于智能体的好奇心驱动数据收集策略，引导机器人前往最有信息价值的地点以获取信息并更新过时观察。
AI.result: 离线实验、消融研究以及真实世界评估表明，COOL能从真实交互中推断归属关系，并利用该知识完成基于归属条件的导航与任务执行。
AI.conclusion: COOL验证了机器人可自主习得物品归属知识并用于个性化服务，为归属感知的长期机器人任务提供了可行方案。

title: EM-SNN: Efficiently Modulated Spiking Neural Network for Remote Sensing Image Dehazing
summary: Although spiking neural networks (SNNs) provide an energy-efficient alternative to artificial neural networks (ANNs), their application to remote sensing image dehazing remains limited. A key challenge arises from the coupling between haze-induced high-frequency attenuation and discrete spike thresholding. This interaction suppresses weak responses and fundamentally limits the recovery of edges, textures, and fine details in spiking dehazing models. To address this challenge, we propose the Efficiently Modulated Spiking Neural Network (EM-SNN), a dedicated spiking framework tailored to remote sensing image dehazing. EM-SNN integrates a statistics-driven Threshold-Modulated Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (TM-LIF) neuron to adaptively compensate for haze-induced contrast compression, together with a Spike Sobel Modulation (SSM) module that enhances structural cues and reduces depth-wise attenuation during spiking feature propagation. By jointly modulating activation scales and structural representations, EM-SNN improves dehazing performance while preserving the inherent event-driven sparsity of SNNs. Experiments on HRSD, RICE, RRSHID, and SateHaze1K demonstrate that EM-SNN achieves competitive dehazing performance while consuming only one quarter of the energy of the strong ANN baseline SFRDP-Net.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EM-SNN，一种面向遥感图像去雾的脉冲神经网络框架，通过TM-LIF神经元和SSM模块联合调制激活尺度与结构表示，在保持脉冲稀疏性的同时实现有竞争力的去雾性能，能耗仅为ANN基线的四分之一。
AI.motivation: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）相比人工神经网络（ANN）更节能，但其在遥感图像去雾中的应用仍然有限。核心挑战在于雾霾引起的高频衰减与离散脉冲阈值化之间的耦合：这种交互会抑制弱响应，从根本上限制了脉冲去雾模型对边缘、纹理和细节的恢复能力。
AI.method: 提出高效调制脉冲神经网络（EM-SNN）：1）集成统计驱动的阈值调制泄漏积分发放（TM-LIF）神经元，自适应补偿雾霾引起的对比度压缩；2）设计脉冲Sobel调制（SSM）模块，增强结构线索并减少脉冲特征传播过程中的深度衰减。二者联合调制激活尺度与结构表示。
AI.result: 在HRSD、RICE、RRSHID和SateHaze1K数据集上的实验表明，EM-SNN在取得有竞争力去雾性能的同时，能耗仅为强ANN基线SFRDP-Net的四分之一。
AI.conclusion: EM-SNN通过联合调制激活尺度与结构表示，有效缓解了雾霾高频衰减与脉冲阈值化的耦合问题，在保持SNN固有事件驱动稀疏性的前提下提升了去雾性能，验证了脉冲神经网络在遥感图像去雾任务中的可行性。

title: Multi-Label Topic Assignment via LLM Distillation: A Comparative Analysis of Generative vs. Discriminative Student Models
summary: Multi-label topic assignment for user-generated content (UGC) -- including product reviews and buyer-seller conversations -- poses unique scalability challenges in large-scale e-commerce due to informal language, extreme label sparsity, and rapidly evolving taxonomies. While utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs) as labeling oracles to distill ground-truth data has emerged as an industry standard to bypass prohibitive manual annotation costs, determining the optimal, low-latency architecture for the resulting student models remains an open challenge. To address this, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation across Small Language Model (SLM) parameter scales (1B, 4B, and 8B) and architectural paradigms (causal generative versus bidirectional discriminative). Comparing generative text-to-label classifiers against discriminative baselines (DeBERTa-V3 and ModernBERT), our analysis reveals a crucial data-dependent trade-off: while discriminative models outperform ultra-lightweight generative models on structured product reviews, even the smallest 1B generative model surpasses discriminative baselines on complex, multi-turn conversational data. Furthermore, generative models maintain robust performance under massive label-set expansion (up to 112 topics) and severe long-tail distributions, whereas discriminative baselines suffer a 35% drop in Macro-F1 at scale. Finally, we detail the successful production deployment of these optimized models across both product review and conversational domains, demonstrating strict latency compliance and tangible business impact at a global marketplace scale.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评测了在电商多标签主题分类任务中，不同参数规模（1B/4B/8B）与架构范式（生成式 vs 判别式）学生模型的表现，发现最优架构取决于数据类型，并成功实现生产部署。
AI.motivation: 大规模电商的用户生成内容（如产品评论与买卖对话）做多标签主题标注面临可扩展性挑战：语言非正式、标签极度稀疏、分类体系快速演化。用LLM作为标注源蒸馏数据已成业界标准，但如何为所得学生模型选择最优、低延迟的架构仍是未解问题。
AI.method: 在SLM参数规模（1B、4B、8B）和架构范式（因果生成式 vs 双向判别式）上进行全面评测，将生成式文本到标签分类器与判别式基线（DeBERTa-V3、ModernBERT）进行对比。
AI.result: 呈现数据依赖的权衡：在结构化产品评论上，判别式模型优于超轻量生成式模型；但在复杂多轮对话数据上，最小的1B生成式模型即超越判别式基线。生成式模型在标签集大规模扩展（至112个主题）和严重长尾分布下仍保持稳健，而判别式基线在大规模下Macro-F1下降35%。
AI.conclusion: 优化后的模型已成功部署于产品评论与对话两个场景，满足严格的延迟要求，并在全球市场规模下带来切实的商业价值。

title: SpecGuard: Proving a Task Is Broken Before the Agent Cheats
summary: As autonomous coding agents get increasingly deployed, the risk that accidental or adversarially injected misspecifications in tasks lead to dangerous agent behavior is critical to address. Prior work has shown that agents given such tasks rarely flag the conflict and instead cheat, editing tests or hard-coding expected outputs, and the actions taken to cheat can cause real damage, such as deleting a security defense to make a corrupted test pass. It remains unclear whether such conflicts can be established with independently verifiable evidence before the agent acts. We present SpecGuard, which detects and formally certifies these conflicts between task intent and tests. Given only the task description and codebase, SpecGuard autoformalizes the intended behaviour into a Lean 4 specification. The tests are formalized independently, and the Lean kernel checks whether any implementation could satisfy both formalizations, producing a machine-checked certificate when none can. On conflicted SWE-bench tasks, SpecGuard detects up to 72.8% of conflicts and formally certifies up to 51.1%, with a nearly five-fold lower conflict miss rate than model-based judgment. SpecGuard provides a pre-execution safety check that identifies reward-hacking opportunities through formal certification of task-level conflicts, before any agent behavior is observed. Our code is available at https://github.com/prmbiy/specguard.

AI.tldr: SpecGuard通过对任务描述与测试进行独立形式化，并在Lean 4中检查二者是否可同时满足，从而在智能体执行前检测并形式化认证任务中的规范冲突，减少奖励攻击风险。
AI.motivation: 自主编码智能体日益普及，任务中意外或对抗性注入的错误规范可能导致危险行为。已有研究表明，智能体面对此类冲突时往往不会指出冲突，而是通过修改测试或硬编码期望输出等方式作弊，甚至造成删除安全防御等真实损害。目前尚不清楚能否在智能体行动前用可独立验证的证据确立这类冲突。
AI.method: SpecGuard仅给定任务描述和代码库，将预期行为自动形式化为Lean 4规范；测试也被独立形式化；随后由Lean内核检查是否存在任何实现能同时满足两种形式化，若不存在则生成机器可检验的证书。
AI.result: 在存在冲突的SWE-bench任务上，SpecGuard可检测高达72.8%的冲突，并形式化认证高达51.1%的冲突，其冲突漏检率比基于模型的判断低近五倍。
AI.conclusion: SpecGuard提供了一种执行前安全检查，通过任务级冲突的形式化认证，在观察到任何智能体行为之前识别奖励攻击机会。代码已开源。

title: Immiscible Diffusion Policy: Preserving Multimodal Robot Actions through Label-Free Noise Assignment
summary: When diffusion policies were first introduced, they were expected to recover multi-modal action distributions. However, we find this expectation does not always hold, as diffusion policies often collapse to a single modality even when we guarantee the balance of dataset modalities and exact within-batch symmetry. Our analysis indicates that independent action-noise pairing contributes to this failure by increasing mixing and crossing among diffusion paths, which can produce averaged denoising responses and suppress modality-specific behavior. This issue is especially severe in robot planning, where action spaces are dense and low-dimensional, significantly increasing such mixing and crossing. To alleviate this problem, we propose Immiscible Diffusion Policy, a label-free training-time add-on to diffusion policy that uses action-noise assignment to preserve relatively distinct noise-to-action routes without modifying the policy architecture or inference procedure. Across five simulated and two real-world humanoid manipulation tasks spanning state, RGB, and point-cloud observations, our method significantly improves the policy's preservation of action modalities while maintaining strong task performance. It increases the proportion of the non-dominant modality by 6.0x-14.6x across three two-modality tasks and recovers demonstrated modalities that are entirely absent from vanilla policy rollouts on both four-modality tasks. These results demonstrate that Immiscible Diffusion Policy provides a simple yet robust approach to preserving action multi-modality in general robot learning tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现扩散策略常退化为单一模态，原因是独立动作-噪声配对导致路径混合与交叉，提出Immiscible Diffusion Policy通过动作-噪声分配保持噪声到动作的独特路径，显著提升多模态保持能力。
AI.motivation: 扩散策略最初被期望恢复多模态动作分布，但实际中即使保证数据集模态平衡和批内精确对称，策略仍常坍缩为单一模态。作者分析认为，独立动作-噪声配对增加了扩散路径间的混合与交叉，导致去噪响应被平均化，压制了模态特异性行为。该问题在动作空间密集且低维的机器人规划中尤为严重。
AI.method: 提出Immiscible Diffusion Policy，一种无需标签、训练时的附加组件，通过动作-噪声分配来保持相对独特的噪声到动作路径，且不修改策略架构或推理过程。
AI.result: 在五个仿真和两个真实世界人形操作任务（涵盖状态、RGB和点云观测）上，该方法显著提升了策略对动作模态的保持能力，同时维持了强任务性能。在三个双模态任务中，非主导模态比例提升6.0x-14.6x；在两个四模态任务中，恢复了原始策略 rollout 中完全缺失的演示模态。
AI.conclusion: Immiscible Diffusion Policy为在通用机器人学习任务中保持动作多模态性提供了一种简单而稳健的方法。

title: Why VLMs Miss Small Objects, and When Zooming In Is Safe
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) often miss small objects in large images. We ask three questions: what limits them, which of these limits better models can remove, and whether the classical way of handling large images, local decomposition, still has a future. We answer them with a theory built on two quantities of the image interface: S, the number of visual tokens across an object's side, and L, the content a call must cover. The limits: a W x H image sent whole within N tokens gives an object of side m at most m*sqrt(N/(WH)) tokens per side. Doubling the token budget N therefore raises the largest S a whole image can reach by only 41%, and seeing an image at the S an object needs costs at least order S^2 tokens whatever the model. If recognition improves gradually with S, any search strategy, zoom agents included, obeys a recall-cost frontier. What better models can change: the S an object needs and how much one call can carry, measured in bits per object found; the coverage cost remains. Decomposition: yes. Assuming only that more tokens per object and less content per call do not hurt on average, splitting an image cannot lower recall if no view zooms out relative to the whole image and views overlap by one object. Neither part of this condition can be dropped; we bound the cost of every such decomposition, and a simple rule approaches the bound as the image grows. We test the theory in about 177,000 requests on 797 images. On controlled images, none of 40 orderings predicted for 8 VLMs is violated. Checked after the fact on drawings, floor plans, natural and synthetic images, 61 of 89 implied orderings hold significantly and 4 fail, all for OpenAI models given more pixels than their default path. On construction drawings the rule never significantly lowered recall relative to the whole image and raised it by up to 0.28. Code and data: https://github.com/shijunzhe/vlm-small-objects

AI.tldr: 本文构建理论刻画VLM在大图中检测小物体的极限，证明局部拆解仍有必要性，并在约17.7万次请求中验证。
AI.motivation: VLM常在大型图像中漏检小物体。作者追问三点：限制源自何处、更强的模型能消除哪些限制、以及处理大图的经典局部拆解方法是否仍有前途。
AI.method: 以图像接口的两个量建立理论：(1) S，物体边长方向上的视觉token数；(2) L，单次调用需覆盖的内容量。分析token预算N与物体token数关系，推导识别随S的召回-代价前沿，并在"更多token/更少内容不降低平均表现"的假设下，界定拆解策略的召回下界与代价上界。
AI.result: 理论预测：整图在N token下，边长m物体每边最多m*sqrt(N/(WH))个token，N翻倍仅使最大S提升约41%，而达到所需S至少需S^2量级token。实验在797张图、约17.7万次请求上开展：受控图上40条预测排序无一被8个VLM违反；事后检验中89条隐含排序有61条显著成立、4条失败（均为OpenAI模型在超出默认路径像素时）；施工图上门规则从不显著降低召回，最高提升0.28。
AI.conclusion: 局部拆解仍有未来：只要无视图相对整图缩小且视图间重叠一个物体，拆图就不会降低召回，且代价可界定、有简单规则逼近上界。

title: TAP: Efficient Long-Horizon Agent Pruning via Trajectory-Anchored Recovery
summary: Emerging long-horizon agentic tasks require repeated model calls, worsening the inference cost of already-costly language models. While narrow agentic tasks suggest potential for aggressive model pruning without performance drop, empirical results show existing methods proposed for question answering tasks severely degrade task performance when applied to agentic models. We trace this failure to two decisions: what to prune and how to recover. For pruning, one-shot importance estimates fail to track how the pruned model adapts. For recovery, offline distillation covers only teacher prefixes, while full-trajectory on-policy distillation causes student errors to compound across turns. In this work, we propose Trajectory-Anchored Pruning (TAP), the first structural pruning framework for reinforcement learning (RL)-trained agents. TAP couples structural pruning with efficient on-policy recovery, anchoring interactions to teacher trajectories while allowing the student to generate each reasoning-action response. A frozen dense teacher supervises the student's response prefixes, addressing within-response training-inference mismatch while preventing student-induced deviations from propagating across training turns. Instead of one-shot pruning, TAP re-scores channels using gradients of the recovery objective on the recovered student, connecting iterative channel selection to the evolving policy. With 60% of FFN channels removed, TAP retains 99.2% and 88.0% of the dense 7B agents' task success rates on ALFWorld and WebShop, respectively, while reducing GPU time per successful task by approximately 22% and 17%. These results demonstrate effective structural compression of long-horizon agents under a limited recovery budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TAP（Trajectory-Anchored Pruning），首个针对RL训练智能体的结构化剪枝框架，通过轨迹锚定的在线策略恢复与迭代通道重评分，在移除60%FFN通道下仍保持任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 长周期智能体任务需反复调用模型，推理成本高。虽然窄任务上激进剪枝可行，但现有为问答设计的剪枝方法用于智能体模型时性能严重下降。作者将失败归因于两点：剪枝决策（一次性重要性估计无法跟上模型自适应）与恢复方式（离线蒸馏仅覆盖教师前缀、全轨迹在线策略蒸馏导致学生错误跨轮累积）。
AI.method: TAP将结构剪枝与高效在线策略恢复耦合：将交互锚定于教师轨迹，同时让学生生成每一步推理-动作响应；由冻结的稠密教师监督学生响应前缀，缓解响应内训练-推理不匹配，并防止学生偏差跨训练轮传播。同时不采用一次性剪枝，而是利用恢复目标在恢复后学生上的梯度重新为通道评分，将迭代通道选择与演化中的策略相连接。
AI.result: 移除60%FFN通道后，TAP在ALFWorld和WebShop上分别保留稠密7B智能体99.2%和88.0%的任务成功率，同时每个成功任务的GPU时间减少约22%和17%。
AI.conclusion: 在有限恢复预算下，TAP实现了长周期智能体的有效结构化压缩，验证了轨迹锚定剪枝与在线策略恢复在智能体模型压缩中的有效性。

title: Training Language Models To Be Coherent Decision-Makers
summary: Reliable decision-making requires more than accurate prediction: a model must preserve its beliefs, apply the relevant utilities, and recognize when the information needed to justify an action is missing. We study whether language models can learn this decision procedure from supervised fine-tuning and generalize it across domains and differing natural-language expressions of the decision challenge. Across 20 datasets, we explore challenges of belief instability and decision-making errors by first eliciting probabilities of outcomes and then varying only the utilities and the framing of the decision problems, while holding the evidence fixed. We train models to preserve elicited beliefs while selecting the action that maximizes expected utility, and evaluate transfer to unseen application domains, held-out framings, and different classes of payoff structures. We further introduce incomplete-information settings in which required utilities are withheld and replaced with irrelevant text, testing whether models can distinguish missing decision-relevant information from merely additional context. We find that targeted fine-tuning substantially improves coherent decision-making and that in many situations, learning transfers across domains and framings to situations unobserved during training. Further, models trained for decidability learn to identify when action cannot be justified based on missing information. Finally, we show the value of a routed system that considers separately the recognition of decision completeness and utility-sensitive decision execution.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究语言模型能否通过监督微调学会"可靠决策过程"——即在保持信念不变的前提下应用效用最大化并识别信息缺失，并检验其跨领域、跨表述的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 可靠决策不只需要预测准确，还需要模型在固定证据下保持概率信念、正确引入效用函数，并识别"支持某行动所需信息是否缺失"。作者希望探究语言模型是否可以从监督微调中习得这一决策流程，并跨领域与不同自然语言表述泛化。
AI.method: 在20个数据集上，先引出结果概率，再仅改变效用与决策问题的表述方式而保持证据固定，以研究信念不稳定与决策错误。训练模型在保持已有信念的同时选择期望效用最大的行动，并评估其向未见领域、留出表述和不同收益结构的迁移。此外引入不完整信息设置：将所需效用替换为无关文本，测试模型能否区分"缺失的决策相关信息"与"仅仅额外的上下文"。最后提出并评估一个分流系统，分别处理决策完整性识别与效用敏感决策执行。
AI.result: 针对性微调显著提升了决策的一致性；在许多情况下，学习可迁移到训练中未观察到的领域与表述。此外，为"可决策性"训练的模型能学会在信息缺失时识别行动无法被证成，并显示出将决策完整性识别与效用敏感决策执行分开处理的分流系统具有价值。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型可通过监督微调习得较为可靠的决策流程，并在领域、表述与收益结构上展现一定泛化；同时能识别因信息缺失而不可证成的行动。将"决策完整性判断"与"效用敏感执行"解耦的分流系统是提升可靠决策的有效方向。

title: IVG-UAV: An Intelligent Voice-Guided UAV System for Autonomous Ripe Fruit Harvesting with Vision-Based Classification and Adaptive Path Planning
summary: In tropical regions, their agricultural sectors remain highly dependent on manual labor for fruit harvesting. On large-scale farms, this dependency often results in significant labor cost and logistic complexities. This project presents the development and simulation of a voice-controlled Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) system designed to automate harvesting tasks in extensive plantations. The proposed system integrates speech recognition using Whisper [1] and LLM, computer vision-based ripeness classification, and adaptive path planning within a unified framework. The entire system is modeled and validated in a Gazebo simulation environment, allowing performance evaluation under controlled agricultural scenarios

AI.tldr: 热带地区水果采摘高度依赖人工，本文提出并仿真验证了一套语音控制的无人机自动采摘系统。
AI.motivation: 热带地区农业采摘高度依赖人工，大规模农场中这种依赖带来高昂的劳动力成本与复杂的物流问题，因此需要自动化采摘方案。
AI.method: 在统一框架中集成基于Whisper与LLM的语音识别、基于计算机视觉的成熟度分类，以及自适应路径规划，并在Gazebo仿真环境中对整套系统建模与验证。
AI.result: 在受控的农业场景下对系统性能进行了评估（摘要未给出具体量化结果）。
AI.conclusion: 该语音控制无人机系统可作为大规模种植园自动采摘的一种可行方案，并通过仿真得到验证。

title: SAREO-FM: Decoupled Semantic Supervision for SAR-EO Foundation Models
comment: Please visit our project page at https://kaist-viclab.github.io/SAREO-FM_site/
summary: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) and electro-optical (EO) imagery provide complementary observations: SAR enables day-and-night, weather-resilient sensing, whereas EO provides rich appearance and fine-grained semantic cues. We introduce SAREO-FM, which avoids forcing a single token stream to serve two distinct roles: modality tokens preserve how each sensor observes the scene through masked reconstruction, while learnable semantic queries capture what the scene contains under guidance from a pretrained vision foundation model (VFM). By jointly encoding these queries with SAR and EO tokens, the queries acquire modality-grounded semantic context, while the modality-token outputs remain the explicit targets of masked reconstruction. This design assigns semantic and reconstruction supervision to separate token streams while preserving their interaction within the shared encoder. Pretrained on the million-scale SAR-1M corpus, SAREO-FM achieves strong unimodal transfer for both SAR-only and EO-only inputs, while delivering substantial gains from joint SAR--EO observations on tasks that benefit from complementary sensing.

AI.tldr: 提出SAREO-FM，通过分离模态token与语义query双流设计，联合编码SAR与EO，实现跨模态互补感知。
AI.motivation: SAR与EO影像具有互补性：SAR可全天候昼夜感知，EO提供丰富的表观与细粒度语义线索。但让单一token流同时承担两种角色存在困难，需要更合理的架构来兼顾重建与语义。
AI.method: SAREO-FM避免强迫单一token流服务两种角色：模态token通过掩码重建保留各传感器的观测方式，而可学习语义query在预训练视觉基础模型（VFM）指导下捕获场景内容。将query与SAR、EO token联合编码，使query获得模态对齐的语义语境，模态token输出仍作为掩码重建的显式目标，从而将语义与重建监督分配给不同token流，同时在共享编码器内保持交互。
AI.result: 在百万级SAR-1M语料上预训练后，SAREO-FM在SAR单模态与EO单模态输入下均取得强迁移性能，并在受益于互补感知的任务上，从SAR–EO联合观测中获得显著增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过分离语义与重建监督并结合VFM引导与大规模预训练，SAREO-FM有效融合SAR与EO的互补信息，兼具单模态迁移与联合观测增益。

title: Tucker Bottleneck Attention for Multi-Dimensional Sequence Modeling
summary: The quadratic cost of self-attention limits scalability to long sequences from multidimensional data. We introduce Tucker bottleneck attention (TuBA), which exploits low-rank tensor structure for efficient global token mixing. TuBA projects hidden tensors into compact Tucker cores, performs multi-head self-attention and linear projections on the cores, and writes updates back to the ambient space, enabling subquadratic computation. Its autoregressive extension combines bidirectional interactions within cores with causal attention across cores. On video prediction and global weather forecasting, TuBA achieves favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-offs over standard and efficient attention and task-specific models. Compared to standard self-attention, TuBA reduces error and computation by up to 24.7% and 66.6% for video prediction and 37.1% and 85.1% for autoregressive weather forecasting, with speedups up to 4.27 times. Low-rank Tucker cores and multi-frame generation also outperform full-rank attention and frame-by-frame generation, respectively.

AI.tldr: TuBA利用低秩Tucker结构实现高效全局token混合，在视频预测和天气预报上取得更优的精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 自注意力的二次复杂度限制了其在多维长序列上的可扩展性，需要一种更高效的全局token混合方法。
AI.method: 将隐藏张量投影到紧凑的Tucker核心，在核心上执行多头自注意力和线性投影，再将更新写回原始空间，实现亚二次计算；其自回归扩展在核心内采用双向交互、在核心间采用因果注意力。
AI.result: 在视频预测和全球天气预报上，相比标准自注意力，误差和计算量分别最多降低24.7%/66.6%和37.1%/85.1%，加速最高达4.27倍；低秩Tucker核心优于全秩注意力，多帧生成优于逐帧生成。
AI.conclusion: TuBA通过低秩张量结构实现了高效且准确的注意力机制，在多项任务上优于标准和高效注意力及任务专用模型。

title: From Probabilities to Decisions: Search and Multi-Teacher Distillation with Jev
summary: Probability-only models, which TypeSafe calls System One models, return calibrated probabilities for fixed choices in milliseconds and generate no text. We study one such model, Jev, through two tasks that require decisions under tight constraints. In bullet chess, a bot that places Jev's judgment inside Stockfish search alongside an opening book and endgame tablebases climbs above a 2200 Lichess bullet rating against other bots. Live model calls are too slow for search, so we distill pairwise judgments into a compact evaluator that runs at every position. We then ask how best to spend a fixed labeling budget when an LLM, Qwen3-32B, is available as a second teacher. In chess, averaging both judges' labels beats spending the whole budget on Qwen alone by 9.6 Elo (95% interval 4.3 to 14.9), and the gain replicates on fresh openings; a second answer from the same judge is no substitute, and Jev is the strongest partner for Qwen among the models tested. In passage reranking, Jev's labels alone train a reranker that scores as high as Qwen's, from 21 minutes of API calls instead of 5.1 GPU-hours, and adding Qwen gains at most a few thousandths in ranking quality. Search supplies the lookahead, distillation makes the judgment cheap enough to use at every position, and an LLM partner pays off in chess.

AI.tldr: 论文研究仅输出概率的“系统一”模型Jev在严格约束下的决策能力，通过国际象棋子弹赛和段落重排序两个任务，验证其可蒸馏为快速评估器，并在有限标注预算下与LLM（Qwen3-32B）互补。
AI.motivation: 仅概率模型（System One模型）能在毫秒内给出校准概率且不生成文本，但在需要前瞻搜索与快速决策的任务中其潜力与最佳使用方式尚不明确，尤其是在与生成式LLM共享标注预算时如何分配资源缺乏实证。
AI.method: 1）在国际象棋中，将Jev的判断嵌入Stockfish搜索，并配合开局库与残局库；通过蒸馏成对判断为紧凑评估器，使其可在每个位置运行。2）在固定标注预算下，对比仅用Qwen3-32B、仅用Jev、两者平均、同模型重复标注等策略。3）在段落重排序任务中，对比Jev标签与Qwen标签训练的reranker质量及成本。
AI.result: 子弹象棋机器人达到Lichess 2200+评分；国际象棋中平均两位教师标签比全预算用Qwen提升9.6 Elo（95%区间4.3–14.9）且在新开局上可复现，同一教师重复回答无替代效果，Jev是Qwen最强搭档。段落重排序中，Jev单独训练的reranker质量与Qwen相当，成本仅为21分钟API调用而非5.1 GPU小时；加入Qwen最多提升千分之几个点。
AI.conclusion: 搜索提供前瞻，蒸馏让判断足够廉价以用于每个位置，LLM搭档在国际象棋中带来收益；仅概率模型作为高效、可蒸馏且互补的教师具有实用价值。

title: TempoBridge: Language-Guided Tempo Control for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are effective at understanding what task to perform, but provide limited control over how it should be executed, such as moving quickly or slowly. We introduce TempoBridge, a lightweight framework that uses frozen VLA representations to modulate actions according to tempo cues in the instruction at each task phase, without additional tempo-conditioned robot demonstrations or tempo-specific base-policy fine-tuning. TempoBridge extracts tempo cues from contextual VLM representations, aligns them with task progress through a causal phase router, and modulates nominal motion commands during execution. Across LIBERO tasks, TempoBridge improves Tempo Success Rate from 52.6% to 89.7% under canonical tempo instructions while retaining high task success. It also preserves near-baseline performance when no tempo cue is present and generalizes to unseen tempo expressions without additional training. Experiments on a physical robot further demonstrate language-conditioned tempo modulation in real-world manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出TempoBridge，一种轻量框架，利用冻结VLA表示依据指令中的节奏线索调制动作，无需额外节奏条件演示或微调，显著提升节奏成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型擅长理解"做什么任务"，但对"如何执行"（如快速或缓慢）缺乏控制能力，且通过额外演示或微调实现节奏控制代价高昂。
AI.method: TempoBridge从上下文VLM表示中提取节奏线索，通过因果阶段路由器将节奏线索与任务进度对齐，在执行过程中调制标称运动指令；无需节奏条件机器人演示，也无需针对节奏的基础策略微调。
AI.result: 在LIBERO任务上，规范节奏指令下节奏成功率从52.6%提升至89.7%，同时保持高任务成功率；无节奏线索时性能接近基线，并能泛化到未见节奏表达；物理机器人实验验证了真实操作中的语言条件节奏调制。
AI.conclusion: TempoBridge以轻量方式有效增强了VLA模型的执行节奏可控性，兼顾任务成功率与泛化能力，并在真实机器人场景中验证可行。

title: VIS-Ground: Video Interactive Storytelling with Contextual Grounding
summary: Video interactive storytelling enables viewers to actively steer how a video unfolds. However, once we allow viewers to intervene during generation, a new challenge arises: The viewer's request can have latent dependencies on both the grounding source and the current rendered video state. These dependencies may not be explicitly stated in any individual input, but emerge only when the source, rendered history, and new viewer intent are considered jointly. Existing interactive video generation systems primarily emphasize following viewer instructions, while source-grounded video generation methods focus on aligning generated content with an external narrative or knowledge source. This leaves a fundamental question underexplored: What context should a generation model ground on during interactive continuation, and how can heterogeneous, unstructured inputs be transformed into such grounding context? In this work, we formulate contextual grounding as the process of transforming heterogeneous input context into an executable constraint model for video generation. To address this challenge, we introduce VIS-Ground, which performs Structured Context Abstraction to recover grounded states and cross-context dependencies, Generation Constraints Induction to project relevant dependencies into candidate-specific constraints, and Constrained Video Generation to enforce these constraints through planning, verification, revision, and rendering. Across three video generation backbones, VIS-Ground consistently achieves the highest overall composite score, reaching an average absolute improvement of 10.3 points over the strongest per-backbone baselines. Detailed analysis further shows gains across both narrative and knowledge grounding, and reveals remaining challenges in dependency extraction, and faithful realization during video rendering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VIS-Ground，将交互式视频生成中的"上下文接地"形式化为把异构输入上下文转换为可执行约束模型的过程，通过三阶段框架提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 交互式视频叙事允许观众干预视频生成，但观众的请求可能对"接地源"和"当前已渲染的视频状态"存在潜在依赖。这些依赖不会在任一单独输入中显式表达，只有在源、渲染历史与新意图联合考虑时才浮现。现有交互式视频生成侧重遵循指令，而源接地方法侧重与外部叙事/知识对齐，二者都未探讨：交互续写时模型应基于何种上下文，以及如何将异构非结构化输入转化为该上下文。
AI.method: 将上下文接地建模为"将异构输入上下文转换为可执行约束模型"的过程，并提出 VIS-Ground 框架，包含三步：(1) 结构化上下文抽象（Structured Context Abstraction），恢复接地状态与跨上下文依赖；(2) 生成约束归纳（Generation Constraints Induction），将相关依赖投影为候选特定的约束；(3) 约束视频生成（Constrained Video Generation），通过规划、验证、修订与渲染来强制执行这些约束。
AI.result: 在三种视频生成骨干模型上，VIS-Ground 均取得最高的综合得分，相对各骨干最强基线平均绝对提升 10.3 分。细粒度分析显示在叙事接地与知识接地上均有增益，同时也揭示了依赖提取与视频渲染中忠实实现两方面的遗留挑战。
AI.conclusion: VIS-Ground 通过显式建模上下文接地与约束，有效提升了交互式视频续写的整体质量，具备跨骨干的稳定性；未来需进一步解决依赖提取与渲染忠实性问题。

title: FedRSPO+: A Heterogeneity-aware Algorithm for Decision-focused Federated Learning
comment: 10 pages main paper + appendix. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 main track
summary: Decision-focused learning (DFL) trains predictive models for downstream optimization, but existing methods largely assume centralized data. In cross-silo settings, federated learning offers a natural alternative, yet standard federated methods optimize prediction over decision quality and do not address heterogeneity in downstream objectives or feasible sets. This heterogeneity is especially challenging for DFL because small perturbations in polyhedral problems can cause discontinuous changes in optimal decisions, destabilizing client updates and aggregation. We propose FedRSPO+, a heterogeneity-aware framework for decision-focused federated learning, built on RSPO+, a regularized predict-then-optimize surrogate that smooths the decision map through projection. We show that RSPO+ upper bounds decision error and regret for the regularized decision and, under exact regularization and consistent LP solution selection, for the original LP decision. We further derive cross-client heterogeneity bounds that depend on both objective and feasible-set heterogeneity, vanish at homogeneity, and require no strong convexity. FedRSPO+ uses an annealed, modular training procedure compatible with standard federated personalization and aggregation methods. Experiments on synthetic knapsack, shortest-path, and real-world energy pricing tasks compare against prediction-only federated learning and DFL baselines under varying heterogeneity and communication budgets. Results suggest that smoothing is a useful ingredient for stable collaborative decision learning and provide a heterogeneity-aware foundation for federated DFL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedRSPO+，一种面向异构跨孤岛场景的决策聚焦联邦学习框架，基于正则化代理RSPO+平滑决策映射，并给出决策误差、遗憾及跨客户端异构性界，实验验证其稳定性与有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有决策聚焦学习（DFL）方法大多假设数据集中式，联邦学习虽是自然的替代方案，但标准联邦方法以预测质量为目标，忽视了下游目标函数与可行域的异构性。多面体问题中微小的扰动会导致最优决策不连续变化，从而破坏客户端更新与聚合的稳定性，这使得异构性在DFL中尤为棘手。
AI.method: 提出FedRSPO+框架，构建在RSPO+之上——一种通过投影平滑决策映射的正则化"先预测后优化"代理。理论证明RSPO+对正则化决策的决策误差与遗憾给出上界，并在精确正则化与一致LP解选择下对原始LP决策同样成立；进一步推导依赖目标异构性与可行集异构性的跨客户端异构性界。FedRSPO+采用退火、模块化的训练流程，兼容标准联邦个性化与聚合方法。
AI.result: 在合成背包、最短路以及真实世界能源定价任务上的实验，与仅预测的联邦学习和DFL基线在不同异构性与通信预算下进行比较。结果表明平滑是稳定协同决策学习的有效要素。
AI.conclusion: 平滑机制为稳定的协作决策学习提供了有用成分，FedRSPO+为联邦DFL提供了异构性感知的基础。

title: Bookkeeping, Composition, or Unreachable Gold? Reading MemoryAgentBench's Conflict-Resolution Scores Against a Frozen Last-Write Resolver
comment: Accepted at the IAB Workshop (Interpreting Agent Behavior) at NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival). 19 pages
summary: MemoryAgentBench's Conflict Resolution split is read as measuring "selective forgetting". We execute the benchmark's own rule - the newest statement about a fact wins - as a zero-learning resolver frozen on one of the four fact lists. Under the official metric the rule answers 80.25% of the questions (74.5% on the three held-out lists). Of the rest, 67 items have a released gold that the last-write graph cannot reach but overwritten statements would ("The capital of India is New Delhi." superseded by "The capital of India is Grosseto."; gold New Delhi); such items are a third of the multi-hop questions at 262K. Two long-context models and our pre-registered approximate re-implementation of the benchmark's BM25 agent, one retained run per item and outcomes only, score 84.7%, 82.6% and 41.6% on the items the rule solves against 10.4%, 11.9% and 6.0% on those 67. The failures are a reachability split plus a small parser-scope residual; the per-item split, not the aggregate, is the unit at which a score here can be read.

AI.tldr: MemoryAgentBench的"冲突解决"分片被解读为衡量"选择性遗忘"，但本文证明该分片实际测量的是"可达性"：最新事实覆盖图无法到达被覆盖语句中的答案。
AI.motivation: 现有工作将MemoryAgentBench的冲突解决分片视为衡量模型"选择性遗忘"能力的指标。本文怀疑这一解读，希望验证该分片的得分究竟反映了什么能力，以及聚合得分是否能够被如实解读。
AI.method: 将基准自身规则（关于某事实的最新陈述获胜）实现为一个零学习解析器，冻结在四个事实列表之一上运行；官方指标下比较规则得分与长上下文模型、预注册的BM25 agent近似复现的得分，按逐项（per-item）而非聚合方式分析失败来源。
AI.result: 官方指标下规则回答80.25%的问题（三个留出列表上74.5%）；剩余项中有67项的公开gold无法被最后写入图到达，但被覆盖语句可以到达（如"印度首都是新德里"被"印度首都是Grosseto"覆盖，gold为新德里），这些项在262K下占多跳问题的三分之一。两个长上下文模型与BM25 agent近似复现分别在规则可解项上得84.7%、82.6%、41.6%，而在该67项上仅得10.4%、11.9%、6.0%。
AI.conclusion: 该分片的失败由"可达性分裂"加少量解析器作用域残留构成；得分应在逐项（per-item）层面而非聚合层面解读。

title: RobotAPO: Adversarial Physics Preference Optimization for Robotic Manipulation Video Generation
summary: Robotic manipulation videos are increasingly used as visual plans for embodied agents, but optimizing purely for visual plausibility often fails to capture the fragile physical manifold of real-world interactions. Even minor physics-violating errors at the interaction boundary, such as interpenetration or premature object motion, can completely invalidate the inferred timing and pose needed for downstream execution. Because standard supervised fine-tuning lacks the direct pressure to penalize these localized failures, we introduce AgiBot-PhysPref. This rigorously curated 10,000-sample preference dataset isolates condition-matched physics violations, turning the generator's own failure distribution into a foundational signal for physical consistency. Building upon this, we propose RobotAPO, an adversarial physics preference optimization framework operating in the continuous flow-matching denoising space.
