To prevent the policy from merely memorizing static curated failures, RobotAPO employs a lightweight adversarial counterfactual proposer that learns a condition-dependent, physical-failure-biased direction in denoising space. This encourages the model to explore and better respect the physical interaction boundary, all while maintaining a pure prompt-and-reference inference interface without requiring external structural conditioning. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that explicitly correcting these localized physics violations improves downstream robot execution from generated videos. On held-out AgiBot conditions, RobotAPO outperforms the strongest controlled internal baseline in physical consistency by 6.8% hard score and 10.0% soft score. Crucially, in real-robot replay, it translates these physical-consistency gains into a 37.4% relative improvement in task success over the strongest controlled internal baseline.

AI.tldr: 论文提出AgiBot-PhysPref偏好数据集与RobotAPO对抗式物理偏好优化框架，通过修正生成视频中的物理违规提升机器人操作执行成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作视频常被用作具身智能体的视觉规划，但仅优化视觉合理性无法捕捉真实交互中脆弱的物理约束。交互边界处的微小物理违规（如穿透、物体提前移动）会导致下游执行所需的时序与位姿推断完全失效。标准监督微调缺乏对这类局部失败的惩罚压力。
AI.method: 构建AgiBot-PhysPref，一个严格筛选的1万样本偏好数据集，隔离条件匹配的物理违规，将生成器自身失败分布转化为物理一致性信号。提出RobotAPO，在连续流匹配去噪空间中进行对抗式物理偏好优化的框架，并采用轻量级对抗反事实提议器，在去噪空间中学习条件依赖、偏向物理失败的方向。无需外部结构条件，保持纯提示与参考的推理接口。
AI.result: 在留出的AgiBot条件下，RobotAPO在物理一致性上超越最强受控内部基线：hard score提升6.8%，soft score提升10.0%。在真实机器人回放中，将物理一致性增益转化为任务成功率相对提升37.4%。
AI.conclusion: 显式修正生成视频中的局部物理违规，可有效提升下游机器人执行表现，验证了物理偏好优化在具身视频生成中的关键作用。

title: Visual Jev Rewards: Reference-Bound Verification for Multi-Subject Image Generation
summary: Multi-subject image generation requires rewards that verify whether requested attributes, actions, and relations hold for the specified reference subjects. Subject presence alone does not establish that the correct subjects participate in a requested interaction. We present reference-bound Visual Jev rewards that turn these visual decisions into generator training signals. Each subject-related question receives a positive label only when the requested condition and the relevant reference identities hold jointly. We construct fixed questions offline, train a Qwen3.5-4B verifier with binary supervision, and directly read Yes probabilities from its language-model head. Their mean supplies a GRPO reward while retaining individual judgments for inspection. Using 200 MICo-150K training tasks and 30 updates, the framework raises a GPT-5.4 composite score from 41.78 to 52.50 on a manually selected 897-task MICo-Bench subset; direct 27B rewards yield 51.84. Each reward is tested in one GRPO run, and offline human evaluation does not establish a statistically significant advantage over direct scoring. The study provides an initial implementation and evaluation of Visual Jev as a reference-bound reward for multi-subject image generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 reference-bound Visual Jev 奖励，用参考绑定的视觉判断题训练验证器，作为多主体图像生成的 GRPO 训练信号。
AI.motivation: 多主体图像生成需要奖励来验证请求的属性、动作和关系是否在指定参考主体上成立；仅检测主体是否出现，无法保证正确的主体参与了所请求的交互。
AI.method: 针对每个主体相关问题，仅当请求条件与相关参考身份同时成立时给予正标签；离线构建固定问题，用二元监督训练 Qwen3.5-4B 验证器，直接读取其语言模型头的 Yes 概率，以其均值作为 GRPO 奖励，同时保留个体判断以供检查。使用 200 个 MICo-150K 训练任务、30 次更新。
AI.result: 在人工筛选的 897 任务 MICo-Bench 子集上，GPT-5.4 综合分从 41.78 提升至 52.50；直接用 27B 奖励得 51.84。每个奖励仅在一次 GRPO 运行中测试，离线人工评估未显示相对直接打分具有统计显著优势。
AI.conclusion: 该研究给出了 Visual Jev 作为多主体图像生成参考绑定奖励的初步实现与评估。

title: MaRK: Markov-adapted Recurrent Kernels for Dynamic Operator Conditioning in State Space Models
summary: State Space Models (SSMs) offer an efficient alternative to Transformers for sequence modeling, yet conditioning pre-trained SSMs for iterative generation typically operates outside the recurrent operator, through input injection or activation modulation. While such mechanisms expose the model to conditioning information, they leave the underlying temporal dynamics fixed. We introduce MaRK (Markov-adapted Recurrent Kernels), a dynamic operator-conditioning framework that maps context vectors directly into bounded modulations of a frozen SSM's recurrence ($A$), read-in ($B$), read-out ($C$), skip ($D$), and discretization ($Δ$) parameters. Viewed through the lens of LPV-SSM systems, MaRK induces a context-indexed family of Markov parameter sequences, allowing each diffusion timestep to reshape the model's input-output memory kernel. We instantiate MaRK on a frozen 111M-parameter Hydra SSM backbone and study three adapter geometries: Hypernet, Chebyshev polynomial, and Discrete Cosine Transform kernels. Since these adapters modify the Markov parameter sequence through low-rank auxiliary maps on the frozen backbone, parameter-efficient fine-tuning arises as a structural consequence of the adaptation mechanism itself, requiring only 6.3--11M trainable auxiliary parameters to transition from a bidirectional objective to an iterative diffusion regime. The bounded recurrence parameterization further yields an analytic Affine Quadratic Stability certificate for the modulated recurrence. Through synthetic LPV recovery experiments and Markov-operator diagnostics, we show that MaRK recovers coordinate-invariant temporal operators under matched assumptions and produces distinct, stable timestep-conditioned memory profiles. Empirically, the Chebyshev variant yields the strongest performance, achieving an average validation loss of 2.55, followed by the DCT (2.59) and Hypernet (3.77) geometries.

AI.tldr: MaRK 是一个动态算子条件化框架，将上下文向量直接映射为冻结 SSM 递推参数的受限调制，在仅训练 6.3–11M 辅助参数下实现从双向目标到迭代扩散的转换。
AI.motivation: 预训练 SSM 用于迭代生成时，条件化通常发生在递推算子之外（输入注入或激活调制），虽能引入条件信息，却使底层时间动力学保持固定，缺乏对记忆核的动态重塑能力。
AI.method: 提出 MaRK，将上下文向量映射为冻结 SSM 的 A、B、C、D、Δ 参数的有界调制；从 LPV-SSM 视角构造上下文索引的 Markov 参数序列族，使每个扩散时间步重塑输入-输出记忆核。在冻结的 111M 参数 Hydra SSM 上实例化三种适配器几何：Hypernet、Chebyshev 多项式与 DCT 核，并通过低秩辅助映射实现对主干的最小改动。
AI.result: 有界递推参数化给出解析的仿射二次稳定性证书；合成 LPV 恢复实验与 Markov 算子诊断表明 MaRK 在匹配假设下可恢复坐标不变时间算子，并产生稳定且随步长区分的记忆轮廓。经验上 Chebyshev 变体最优，平均验证损失 2.55，DCT 为 2.59，Hypernet 为 3.77。
AI.conclusion: MaRK 通过算子级条件化使冻结 SSM 获得上下文相关的动态记忆核，参数高效微调成为适配机制的结构性结果，兼顾稳定性与性能，Chebyshev 几何表现最佳。

title: FreeEvolve: Learning to Evolve Beyond Fixed Loops
summary: Agent evolvers automate the design of the prompts, skills and workflows around language model agents, yet the optimization process they follow is still designed by hand: a fixed search loop decides how candidates are evaluated, which are kept and when the search stops. We propose FREEEVOLVE, which automates this process as well. An environment specifies the goal, target agent, evaluator, data and resource limits; within these limits, the evolver itself decides what to test, how much evidence to collect, which candidates to pursue and when to stop. These decisions follow an editable evolution skill, which we improve through meta-evolution by scoring each candidate skill on the fresh target agent it produces. The optimization process thus becomes a capability learned from experience rather than a loop engineered in advance. On tau3-bench, ARC-AGI-2, ARC-AGI-3 and Terminal-Bench 2.1, FREEEVOLVE controls the evolution campaign by itself, yet improves the primary held-out metric by 13.6 points on average and matches or exceeds hand-designed evolvers. The learned process keeps improving with experience: meta-evolved skills add 6.9 points over the seed skill on fresh target agents, demonstrating transferability across environments.

AI.tldr: 提出 FREEEVOLVE，让智能体进化器不仅自动优化提示、技能与工作流，还自动优化"优化过程"本身：通过可编辑的进化技能与元进化，使搜索循环由经验习得而非人工设计，在多个基准上平均提升 13.6 分。
AI.motivation: 现有 agent evolvers 虽能自动设计语言模型智能体的提示、技能与工作流，但其优化过程本身仍是人工设计的：固定的搜索循环决定了候选如何评估、保留哪些候选以及何时停止。作者希望把这一层也自动化，使优化过程成为可从经验中学习的能力。
AI.method: 提出 FREEEVOLVE。环境给定目标、目标智能体、评估器、数据与资源限制；在限制内，进化器自行决定测什么、收集多少证据、追踪哪些候选以及何时停止。这些决策遵循一个可编辑的"进化技能"，并通过元进化改进：每个候选技能在其产生的新目标智能体上被评分。由此优化过程由预先工程化的循环转变为从经验中习得的能力。
AI.result: 在 tau3-bench、ARC-AGI-2、ARC-AGI-3 与 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，FREEEVOLVE 自主控制进化过程，在主要留出指标上平均提升 13.6 分，达到或超过人工设计的进化器。学习到的过程随经验持续改进：元进化后的技能在新目标智能体上比种子技能再提升 6.9 分，显示出跨环境的可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: FREEEVOLVE 证明"优化过程"本身可以被自动化并作为能力学习，性能优于或媲美人工设计的进化器，且元进化所得技能可跨环境迁移并随经验持续提升。

title: TMT: Runtime Backdoor Detection for Vision-Language-Action Policies on Unseen Tasks
summary: Backdoored vision-language-action (VLA) policies can preserve benign task performance while producing malicious actions when a trigger appears. Detecting such activation is difficult because malicious behavior can comprise individually plausible actions, while unfamiliar tasks introduce legitimate changes in observations and behavior. We introduce TMT, a runtime backdoor detector based on Token Manifold and latent Transition modeling. Trained on benign rollouts, its two branches assess input-token structure and prediction errors in adjacent-layer latent dynamics. A suspicious rollout identified by the token manifold branch, once confirmed through latent deviations, guides transition selection for subsequent monitoring. We further explore policy purification through self-distillation: a frozen copy of the backdoored policy provides benign-input actions to supervise a student on paired benign and triggered observations, without requiring a separate clean reference policy. For evaluation, we adapt traditional backdoor detectors and repurpose anomaly and failure detection methods as VLA backdoor detectors. In a post-hoc comparison with ten baselines, TMT achieves state-of-the-art backdoor detection performance on unseen tasks across three VLA backdoor attacks. Our project page is available at https://zzr42.github.io/tmt/.

AI.tldr: 提出运行时后门检测器TMT，基于Token流形与隐层转移建模，在不熟悉任务上实现SOTA检测，并探索自蒸馏净化。
AI.motivation: VLA策略被植入后门后，平时表现正常，仅在触发条件下产生恶意动作；由于恶意行为由各自看似合理的动作组成，且陌生任务本身会带来观测与行为的正常变化，导致后门激活难以被检测。
AI.method: TMT包含两个分支：一为输入Token结构分支，二为相邻层隐空间动态的预测误差分支；仅在良性rollout上训练。当Token流形分支标记出可疑rollout，并经隐空间偏差确认后，用于指导后续监控的转移选择。此外通过自蒸馏进行策略净化：用冻结的后门策略对配对的良性/触发观测生成良性输入动作，监督学生模型，无需额外干净参考策略。
AI.result: 将传统后门检测器进行适配，并把异常检测与失败检测方法改造为VLA后门检测器作为基线；在与十个基线的后验比较中，TMT在三个VLA后门攻击的未见任务上取得最优检测性能。
AI.conclusion: TMT可有效检测VLA策略后门激活并具备净化潜力，在未见任务上优于现有方法；项目主页见 https://zzr42.github.io/tmt/。

title: GRC-Net: Global Representation Consistency Network for Unsupervised Multimodal Anomaly Detection
summary: Automated quality inspection is essential for ensuring product reliability in manufacturing.While image-based methods effectively capture appearance-related defects, these methods are limited in detecting structural and geometric anomalies, motivating multimodal approaches incorporating 3D information. However, existing methods mainly rely on local patch-level representations, which often lead to unstable reconstruction errors even in normal regions. To address this limitation, we propose GRC-Net, which integrates a global-attention MLP to enforce global representation consistency across patch embeddings with a stable reconstruction module to improve reconstruction stability. The proposed method captures holistic contextual information through a global token and suppresses reconstruction noise by minimizing discrepancies between original and predicted embeddings. Experiments on MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies demonstrate that GRC-Net consistently outperforms existing methods at both image and pixel levels. Qualitative results further demonstrate reduced reconstruction errors in normal regions and more distinct reconstruction differences between normal and anomalous regions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRC-Net，通过全局注意力MLP增强patch嵌入的全局表示一致性，并结合稳定重建模块提升重建稳定性，在多模态工业异常检测任务上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 制造业中自动化质量检测对产品可靠性至关重要。基于图像的方法只能捕捉外观类缺陷，难以检测结构和几何异常，因此需要引入3D信息的多模态方法。但现有方法主要依赖局部patch级表示，导致即使在正常区域也常出现不稳定的重建误差。
AI.method: 提出GRC-Net，包含两部分：一是全局注意力MLP（global-attention MLP），通过一个全局token在patch嵌入之间强制全局表示一致性，从而捕获整体上下文信息；二是稳定重建模块，通过最小化原始嵌入与预测嵌入之间的差异来抑制重建噪声。
AI.result: 在MVTec 3D-AD和Eyecandies数据集上，GRC-Net在图像级和像素级指标上均持续优于现有方法。定性结果显示正常区域的重建误差降低，且正常与异常区域之间的重建差异更加明显。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入全局表示一致性与稳定重建机制，GRC-Net有效缓解了局部patch表示带来的重建不稳定问题，提升了多模态工业异常检测的性能与判别性。

authors: Paulo Salgado Gomes de Mattos Neto
title: Are We Really Benchmarking Forecasting Models? The Impact of Preprocessing on Time Series Performance
summary: While established literature underscores the pivotal role of preprocessing in forecasting accuracy, this stage remains largely overlooked in current research. Modern benchmarks typically resort to simple scaling, failing to account for critical transformations required to address nonstationarity, such as differencing. This omission creates a significant structural preprocessing bias that favors models with built-in data treatments while obscuring the true potential of simpler architectures. We study this effect through a preprocessing-aware benchmark that evaluates 11 forecasting models across 16 reversible preprocessing pipelines on 29,000 M4 time series. Our results identify preprocessing as a key driver of forecasting performance. Optimizing preprocessing per series yields gains of approximately 27\% to 87\% across all evaluated models, with architectures lacking internalized preprocessing experiencing the most substantial improvements. This allows simpler architectures to become highly competitive with complex, state-of-the-art models in modern forecasting benchmarks. All resources and experimental results from this benchmark are stored in a comprehensive metadataset to support future metalearning tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了现代预测基准中因预处理设置单一而导致的“结构性预处理偏差”，并通过一个预处理感知的基准，系统评估预处理对预测性能的影响，证明优化预处理能大幅提升各模型表现，使简单模型可与复杂SOTA模型竞争。
AI.motivation: 现有文献虽强调预处理对预测精度的重要性，但当前研究普遍忽视该阶段；现代基准大多仅采用简单缩放，无法处理非平稳性等所需的差分等关键变换。这种忽视造成了结构性预处理偏差，使内置数据处理机制的模型占优，并掩盖了简单架构的真实潜力。
AI.method: 构建一个“预处理感知”的基准，在29,000条M4时间序列上，评估11种预测模型与16种可逆预处理流水线的组合；对每个序列进行预处理优化，并对比不同模型的性能变化，同时将全部资源与实验结果整理为元数据集。
AI.result: 研究结果表明预处理是预测性能的关键驱动因素；按序列优化预处理可使所有被评估模型获得约27%至87%的性能提升，其中缺乏内置预处理机制的架构提升最为显著，从而使更简单的架构在现代基准中可与复杂SOTA模型高度竞争。
AI.conclusion: 预处理在预测基准中具有决定性影响，忽视它会带来结构性偏差并低估简单模型。通过显式、可逆且按序列优化的预处理，简单架构也能达到甚至接近复杂模型的表现；相关资源以元数据集形式开放，支持未来元学习研究。

title: Few Bits, One Law: Toward W2A4KV2
summary: Extreme low-bit LLM compression is most challenging when weights, activations, and KV caches are quantized together: their distributions differ, and quantization errors interact throughout the network. We introduce CanonQ, a unified quantization-aware training framework that addresses these challenges by separating source canonicalization from task-aware adaptation. Fixed rotations and energy normalization map heterogeneous tensor sources to canonical coordinates, enabling frozen Gaussian-reference codebooks to be reused across layers and models. Joint training then adapts the network to the coupled errors of weight, activation, and cache quantization within a common scalar/vector interface. We bound frozen-codebook transfer error and local task loss, and derive an exact normalization-aware straight-through Jacobian that links quantization distortion to gradient bias. The strongest gains arise under joint W2A4KV2 compression: across LLaMA3-1B/3B/8B, CanonQ-Omni achieves up to 14.28x lower WikiText-2 perplexity and up to 57.9% higher mean zero-shot accuracy than prior state-of-the-art and representative quantization baselines. The benefits extend to Qwen3-1.7B, code generation, and mathematical reasoning: on instruction-tuned MobileLLM-Pro-1B at W2A16KV16, CanonQ achieves relative improvements of 41.7% in HumanEval pass@1 and 39.1% in GSM8K exact match over the strongest evaluated quantization baseline.

AI.tldr: CanonQ是一个统一的量化感知训练框架，通过分离源规范化与任务自适应，实现权重、激活和KV缓存的极端低位联合压缩。
AI.motivation: 极端低位LLM压缩在权重、激活和KV缓存同时量化时最具挑战性：它们的分布不同，且量化误差在网络中相互作用。
AI.method: 通过固定旋转和能量归一化将异构张量源映射到规范坐标，使冻结的高斯参考码本可跨层和模型复用；联合训练在统一的标量/向量接口内使网络适应权重、激活和缓存量化的耦合误差；界定了冻结码本迁移误差和局部任务损失，并推导出精确的归一化感知直通雅可比矩阵。
AI.result: 在W2A4KV2联合压缩下，跨LLaMA3-1B/3B/8B，CanonQ-Omni相比先前SOTA实现最高14.28倍更低的WikiText-2困惑度和最高57.9%更高的零样本平均准确率；在Qwen3-1.7B、代码生成和数学推理上也有效，指令微调的MobileLLM-Pro-1B在W2A16KV16下HumanEval pass@1相对提升41.7%，GSM8K精确匹配提升39.1%。
AI.conclusion: 将源规范化与任务自适应分离可有效应对权重、激活和KV缓存联合量化的挑战，在极端低位压缩下显著优于现有方法，并具备跨模型和任务的泛化能力。

title: Precise SE(3) End-Effector Tracking in Whole-Body Humanoid Control
summary: Precise end-effector tracking during humanoid whole-body motion is challenging due to floating-base oscillations, gravity, dynamic coupling, and locomotion-induced disturbances. We propose ResGAC, a whole-body humanoid controller for precise end-effector pose tracking that combines geometric admittance control (GAC) with residual reinforcement learning. GAC provides structured $\SE$ task-space feedback and generates nominal arm joint-position targets, while residual RL compensates for unmodeled dynamics and coordinates locomotion and balance in the shared joint-position action space. The left-invariant geometric formulation allows the same GAC law to be used across manipulation reference frames. This enables the use of a ground-attached heading frame that preserves planar locomotion while removing pelvis roll, pitch, and heave from the manipulation reference, thereby reducing reference-induced end-effector motion during locomotion. ResGAC is validated on a real Unitree G1 humanoid. Across four standing end-effector tracking benchmarks, ResGAC consistently outperforms representative baselines, including SONIC, achieving lower translational and rotational errors. Real-world experiments further demonstrate reduced propagation of pelvis motion to the desired end-effector pose using the proposed ground-attached heading frame. ResGAC achieves $90\%$ success in a standing peg-in-hole task compared with $50\%$ for SONIC, and accurate world-frame $\SE$ end-effector pose tracking during lower-body motion. Experimental videos are included in the supplementary material and are also available on the project website: https://resgac.github.io/ResGAC-website/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ResGAC，一种结合几何导纳控制（GAC）与残差强化学习的全身人形控制器，实现人形机器人在全身运动中的精确末端执行器位姿跟踪，并在真实 Unitree G1 上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人在全身运动中进行精确末端执行器跟踪面临挑战：浮动基座振荡、重力、动态耦合以及行走引起的扰动，这些因素使得末端跟踪精度难以保证。
AI.method: 方法上，ResGAC 将几何导纳控制（GAC）与残差强化学习相结合。GAC 提供结构化的 SE(3) 任务空间反馈并生成名义机械臂关节位置目标；残差 RL 在共享的关节位置动作空间中补偿未建模动力学并协调行走与平衡。其左不变几何表述使同一 GAC 律可跨操作参考系使用，从而可采用地面附着航向坐标系，保留平面行走同时去除骨盆的横滚、俯仰和升降对操作参考的影响。
AI.result: 在真实 Unitree G1 人形机器人上验证。四项站立末端跟踪基准中，ResGAC 持续优于包括 SONIC 在内的基线，具有更低的平移和旋转误差。站立插孔任务成功率达 90%，而 SONIC 为 50%，并在下肢运动时实现准确的世界坐标系 SE(3) 末端位姿跟踪。
AI.conclusion: ResGAC 通过几何导纳控制与残差强化学习的结合，有效减少骨盆运动向期望末端位姿的传播，提升了人形机器人在全身运动下的末端执行器跟踪精度与任务成功率。

title: CRT-HMAR: Causal Requirement Tracing-Guided Hierarchical Multi-Agent Regulation for Open-Task-Aware Infrared-Visible Image Fusion
summary: Infrared and visible (IR-VIS) image fusion integrates complementary multimodal information into a single fused image to support downstream vision tasks. However, existing methods are typically tailored to seen tasks within a fixed task set and struggle to generalize to unseen tasks, which restricts their applicability in real-world open-task scenarios. To address this issue, this paper proposes CRT-HMAR, a Causal Requirement Tracing-Guided Hierarchical Multi-Agent Regulation Framework for open-task-aware IR-VIS image fusion. CRT-HMAR introduces a Causal Requirement Tracing Task Localization mechanism, which actively intervenes in key image information and observes task-network response variations to map task-specific semantic preferences into image-level causal requirement maps. Based on these maps, a requirement analysis agent aggregates task-specific requirement knowledge to adaptively guide requirement-customized image fusion. Moreover, CRT-HMAR incorporates History-Analysis Multi-Objective Balancing and Task-Level-Correction Conflict Mitigation mechanisms, jointly constructing a hierarchical regulation chain of "requirement interpretation - task balancing - conflict mitigation". Through multiple collaborative agents, CRT-HMAR dynamically regulates key processes including open-task requirement modeling, multi-task balanced optimization, and gradient conflict mitigation. Extensive experiments on open-task scenarios involving five downstream tasks demonstrate that CRT-HMAR significantly improves generalization to unseen tasks while maintaining the performance and balance of seen tasks. Overall, CRT-HMAR shifts IR-VIS image fusion from task-oriented modeling toward requirement-oriented modeling, promoting its extension from closed-task settings to real-world open-task scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRT-HMAR框架，通过因果需求追踪与分层多智能体调控，实现面向开放任务的红外-可见光图像融合。
AI.motivation: 现有红外-可见光图像融合方法多针对固定任务集内的已知任务设计，难以泛化到未见任务，限制了其在真实开放任务场景中的适用性。
AI.method: 提出CRT-HMAR框架，包含因果需求追踪任务定位机制（主动干预关键图像信息、观察任务-网络响应变化以构建图像级因果需求图）；基于需求图的需求分析智能体聚合任务特定需求知识，自适应引导定制化融合；并引入历史分析多目标平衡与任务级校正冲突缓解机制，构建"需求解读-任务平衡-冲突缓解"的分层调控链，通过多智能体协作动态调控开放任务需求建模、多任务均衡优化与梯度冲突缓解。
AI.result: 在涉及五个下游任务的开放任务场景中，CRT-HMAR显著提升了向未见任务的泛化能力，同时保持已知任务的性能与平衡性。
AI.conclusion: CRT-HMAR将红外-可见光图像融合从任务导向建模转向需求导向建模，推动其从封闭任务设定扩展到真实开放任务场景。

title: Convex-Concave Reinforcement Learning
summary: Policy learning drives many of the most consequential and heavily-invested applications of reinforcement learning today. Yet the core optimization problem it rests on (maximizing expected return) is notoriously non-convex, even under a direct policy parameterization, and the field has largely responded by avoiding it: optimizing convex surrogate approximations of the return under trust-region constraints (NPG, TRPO, PPO, AWR). We show that this seemingly unstructured problem is not actually structureless. In log-density-ratio coordinates $y := \log[π/π_n]$, the exact per-iteration objective, computable via per-decision importance sampling (PDIS), is a difference-of-convex-constrained difference-of-convex (DC-constrained DC) program. This structure lets us move beyond surrogate approximations: it recovers CPI, NPG, TRPO, and AWR as special cases along interpretable axes, and it opens a multi-step axis $k$ that couples consecutive decisions. We solve the per-iteration program with sequential convex programming (SCP), the standard solver for difference-of-convex problems, and give convergence guarantees under mild conditions, bridging the difference-of-convex optimization and RL literatures. Empirically, multi-step Convex-Concave RL (CCRL) wins on diagnostic MDPs where credit must propagate across a horizon (its advantage growing with the dependency length), is competitive with a tuned PPO on classic control, and on a realistic, stochastic, mid-horizon healthcare domain converges markedly faster than tuned PPO to the same near-optimal survival, with an 11.3% higher area under the training curve.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示策略优化的精确目标在log密度比坐标下是DC约束的DC规划结构，据此提出多步CCRL算法，理论与实验均优于PPO等代理方法。
AI.motivation: 策略学习的核心优化问题（最大化期望回报）即使直接参数化也是非凸的，领域普遍回避该难题，转而优化凸代理近似（NPG、TRPO、PPO、AWR）并附加信赖域约束。作者希望证明该问题其实并非无结构，从而摆脱代理近似的局限。
AI.method: 在log密度比坐标 y := log[π/π_n] 下，将可由逐步重要性采样（PDIS）计算的精确每轮目标写成DC约束的DC规划。该结构可把CPI、NPG、TRPO、AWR恢复为可解释轴上的特例，并引入耦合相邻决策的多步轴k。采用DC问题标准求解器序列凸规划（SCP）求解每轮程序，并在温和条件下给出收敛保证。
AI.result: 在需要跨时间步传播信用的诊断MDP上，多步CCRL取胜，且优势随依赖长度增长；在经典控制任务上与调优的PPO相当；在真实、随机、中等时长的医疗领域，CCRL收敛到相同近优生存率显著更快，训练曲线下面积比调优PPO高11.3%。
AI.conclusion: 精确策略优化具有DC约束DC结构，可统一并推广现有代理方法，多步CCRL在信用传播、经典控制与医疗场景中表现优异，架起了DC优化与强化学习之间的桥梁。

title: AGAR: a reinforcement learning substrate for LLM program evolution
summary: Given a task and an evaluator, a language model can rewrite a candidate program while a search loop decides which rewrites survive, offering a practical route to algorithm discovery. But that loop is governed by five constants set by hand: which parent to select, how hard to mutate, how to keep diversity, what to remember, and a scalar score that never says which part of the program earned it. Reinforcement learning already has an estimator for each. The obstacle is that program evolution is not usually written down as a decision process. We formalize it as a Markov decision process whose action is the modular prefix the model is conditioned on, rather than the program it emits. Credit assignment, value estimation, adaptive exploration, and experience memory can then attach to distinct components. AGAR (Algorithm Generation As RL) provides the resulting substrate: any estimator can be replaced or switched off without changing the controller, making the transfer auditable one mechanism at a time, with no gradient training of the backend model. Across 19 tasks, two backends, and three seeds under one harness, AGAR improves on the stronger of two published baselines on most tasks, with gains concentrated in the competitive-programming family. The formalization also yields a checkable reading of prior work: these systems are implicitly zero-discount, not by choice, but because fitness is exogenous to an individual rather than a return over successors, leaving a discount factor nothing to act on.

AI.tldr: 将程序进化形式化为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），提出AGAR框架，把信用分配、价值估计、自适应探索与经验记忆解耦到独立组件，在19个任务上超越两个已发表基线中更强的那个。
AI.motivation: 语言模型改写程序、搜索循环决定哪些改写存活，是算法发现的一条实用路径。但该循环由五个手工设定的常量控制：选择哪个父代、变异强度多大、如何保持多样性、记住什么、以及一个无法说明程序哪部分贡献了分数的标量分数。强化学习对每一项都有估计器，障碍在于程序进化通常未被写成决策过程。
AI.method: 把程序进化形式化为MDP，其动作是模型被条件化的模块化前缀，而非模型生成的程序本身。这样信用分配、价值估计、自适应探索和经验记忆即可附着到不同组件上。AGAR（Algorithm Generation As RL）作为由此得到的底座，允许替换或关闭任意估计器而不改变控制器，使迁移可按机制逐一审计，且无需对后端模型做梯度训练。
AI.result: 在19个任务、两个后端、三个随机种子、同一套测试框架下，AGAR 在多数任务上优于两个已发表基线中更强的那个，增益集中在竞赛编程类任务上。
AI.conclusion: 该形式化还给出了对既有工作的可检验解读：这些系统隐含地是零折扣的，并非出于选择，而是因为适应度对个体而言是外生的，而非对后继者的回报，使折扣因子无处发挥作用。

title: SiGNgapore - An Interactive Dataset for Sign-based Visual Navigation
summary: The future of autonomous robots in human-oriented environments depends on their ability to navigate in the absence of prebuilt maps; exploiting navigational aids, such as navigational signs, designed by humans for humans is critical for enabling autonomy. This manuscript introduces a unique dataset collected using a handheld device, at various public spaces across Singapore, representing environments that humans frequent daily, and focusing on sign-centric decision making for mapless navigation. The dataset includes RGB, sparse depth, odometry and IMU measurements of scenarios centered around navigational signs and the complex environments where they are placed. Additionally, we provide 56 long-horizon navigation missions and over 450 sign-centric scenarios. All data is provided in a human- readable format, as well as utility scripts for conversion to ROS 2. Lastly, we provide venue maps and GPS aligned scene graphs of the test environments. We discuss the potential use cases for this dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个用于无地图导航中以标志为中心决策的独特数据集，使用手持设备在新加坡多个公共场所采集，含RGB、稀疏深度、里程计和IMU数据，并提供56个长时程导航任务、450余个标志相关场景、ROS 2转换脚本及场地地图与GPS对齐场景图。
AI.motivation: 自主机器人在人类环境中实现自主性依赖无预建地图的导航能力，利用人类为人类设计的导航标志等辅助信息至关重要，但缺乏相应数据集支持相关研究。
AI.method: 使用手持设备在新加坡多个公共场所采集数据，围绕导航标志及其所处复杂环境，记录RGB、稀疏深度、里程计和IMU测量，并提供人类可读格式数据、ROS 2转换工具脚本、场地地图及GPS对齐场景图。
AI.result: 构建了包含56个长时程导航任务和超过450个以标志为中心场景的数据集，覆盖人类日常频繁活动的多样环境，并提供多种格式与配套工具。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集可支持以标志为中心的无地图导航研究，并讨论了其潜在应用场景。

title: TileSkipper: Region-Adaptive Tile Pruning for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Tiled 3D Gaussian Splatting rasterizers often use one scene-wide contribution cutoff for tile enumeration, although content differs in its sensitivity to support truncation. TileSkipper selects a static per-Gaussian cutoff policy for a frozen checkpoint. Calibration renders measure candidate pair savings and an isolated-removal distortion proxy that accounts for front transmittance and background color. The method allocates cutoffs across 64 Gaussian groups and accepts policies only after complete renders on disjoint selection views. The exported policy uses one byte per Gaussian, with no parameter updates, additional kernel, or per-frame policy inference. Across 13 scenes from Mip-NeRF 360, Tanks & Temples, and Deep Blending, a fixed-policy AccuTile sweep gives dataset-macro speedups of $1.088\times$ at standard resolution and $1.238\times$ at 3840 pixels wide, with $-0.007/-0.023$ dB mean PSNR change. Six integrations with existing opacity-aware bounds yield $1.009\times$--$1.121\times$ compiler-only speedups. For four ports from $3σ$ rasterizers, we separately attribute the prior exact-bound transition and our incremental gain. Matched-quality ablations show modest gains over scene-global calibration and parity with per-Gaussian control; the standalone comparison with AdaGScale is regime-dependent.

AI.tldr: TileSkipper 为冻结的 3D Gaussian Splatting 检查点选择静态的逐高斯贡献截断策略，在几乎不损失画质的前提下实现渲染加速。
AI.motivation: 平铺式 3D Gaussian Splatting 光栅化器通常对整个场景使用统一的贡献截断阈值来进行瓦片枚举，但不同内容对支撑截断的敏感度不同，统一阈值无法兼顾效率与质量。
AI.method: 通过校准渲染测量候选瓦片对的节省量与孤立移除失真代理（考虑前向透射率和背景色），在 64 个高斯分组间分配截断阈值，并仅在不相交的选择视图上完成完整渲染后才接受策略。导出策略每高斯占一字节，无需参数更新、额外内核或逐帧策略推断。
AI.result: 在 Mip-NeRF 360、Tanks & Temples、Deep Blending 的 13 个场景上，固定策略 AccuTile 扫描在标准分辨率下取得 1.088× 数据集宏观加速，在 3840 像素宽下取得 1.238×，平均 PSNR 变化为 -0.007/-0.023 dB。与现有透明度感知边界结合的六种集成方案获得 1.009×–1.121× 的纯编译加速。对于从 3σ 光栅化器移植的四种方案，分别归因了先前精确边界转换与本文增量收益。匹配质量消融显示相对场景全局校准有适度提升，并与逐高斯控制持平；与 AdaGScale 的独立比较结果依赖具体场景区间。
AI.conclusion: TileSkipper 通过静态逐高斯截断策略，在不更新参数、不增加内核和逐帧推断的情况下实现了有效加速，并保持画质基本不变。

title: Breaking Adversarial Transferability in Fine-Tuned Speech Recognition
summary: Many organizations fine-tune publicly available pretrained Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models and deploy them in black-box settings, assuming limited access provides protection. We show this assumption is fragile: adversarial perturbations crafted on the public base model transfer effectively to fine-tuned target models, severely degrading performance and posing concerns for safety-critical applications. We propose TransferBreaker, a unified fine-tuning framework that suppresses adversarial transfer by integrating Base Adversarial Fine-Tuning, which restricts adversarial training to base-effective perturbations; Latent Jacobian Regularization, which enforces latent-space invariance by suppressing adversarially sensitive directions; and HybridGrad-AFT, which improves robustness against adaptive attacks by interpolating transferable perturbations from base and target gradients. We theoretically justify all components and evaluate TransferBreaker across three languages and four large ASR models, reducing adversarial WER from 92.6 to 27.8. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/rohban-lab/TransferBreaker.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了在公开基座ASR模型上生成的对抗扰动可有效迁移到微调后模型，提出统一微调框架TransferBreaker以抑制对抗迁移，显著降低对抗WER。
AI.motivation: 组织常微调公开预训练的ASR模型并部署在黑盒环境中，误以为有限访问即可提供保护。作者证明该假设脆弱：在公开基座模型上构造的对抗扰动可有效迁移到微调后的目标模型，严重降低性能，对安全关键应用构成隐患。
AI.method: TransferBreaker包含三部分：1) Base Adversarial Fine-Tuning，将对抗训练限制在对基座有效的扰动上；2) Latent Jacobian Regularization，通过抑制对抗敏感方向来强制潜在空间不变性；3) HybridGrad-AFT，通过插值来自基座与目标梯度的可迁移扰动，提升对自适应攻击的鲁棒性。作者对每个组件给出理论论证。
AI.result: 在三种语言和四个大型ASR模型上评估TransferBreaker，将对抗WER从92.6降低到27.8。代码已公开于 https://github.com/rohban-lab/TransferBreaker。
AI.conclusion: 在黑盒部署假设下，对抗扰动可跨基座与微调模型有效迁移，而TransferBreaker通过融合对抗微调、潜在正则化与混合梯度方法，能大幅抑制这种迁移并提升ASR模型鲁棒性。

title: RLDISCOVER: LLM-driven co-evolution of reinforcement learning algorithms
summary: LLM-guided program evolution has enabled discoveries in mathematics and computational optimization, raising the prospect of reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms that self-evolve to improve how agents learn. However, realizing this prospect faces two obstacles. Joint search over coupled algorithmic components is difficult to scale: simultaneous changes can disrupt learning, while isolated changes overlook their dependencies. Evaluating candidate algorithms also requires costly training, with fitness remaining uncertain across random seeds. We introduce RLDiscover, a framework for the self-evolution of model-free deep RL algorithms. Progressive Co-Evolution advances from targeted component edits to joint evolution, while Progressive Probabilistic Evaluation balances search breadth and evaluation fidelity through staged training and repeated evaluation. Experiments across SAC, PPO, and DQN on four benchmark suites show substantial improvements in mean return, with per-family median gains of 32%-84% and a peak return ratio of approximately 363x over a near-zero baseline. These gains include transitions from failed learning to successful task completion, and improvements persist when evolution starts from stronger open-source implementations. On measured SAC locomotion runs, evaluation uses approximately one-fifteenth the estimated compute required to fully evaluate the same candidate pool. Remarkably, independent searches repeatedly discover interpretable combinations of adaptive robust losses, progress-dependent value targets, and running statistics, with selected programs transferring to unseen tasks. These findings point toward a broader role for self-evolution in AI: discovering interpretable algorithms that improve how agents learn.

AI.tldr: 提出 RLDiscover 框架，用 LLM 引导的渐进式协同进化与渐进式概率评估，实现无模型深度强化学习算法的自我进化，在多个基准上显著提升性能且节省算力。
AI.motivation: LLM 引导的程序进化已在数学与计算优化中带来发现，使人期待 RL 算法能自我进化以改进智能体的学习方式。但存在两大障碍：一是耦合算法组件的联合搜索难以扩展（同时改动会破坏学习，孤立改动又忽略依赖关系）；二是候选算法评估需昂贵训练，且适应度在不同随机种子下不确定。
AI.method: RLDiscover 框架包含两个机制：渐进式协同进化（Progressive Co-Evolution），从针对性的组件编辑逐步过渡到联合进化；渐进式概率评估（Progressive Probabilistic Evaluation），通过分阶段训练与重复评估，在搜索广度与评估保真度之间取得平衡。
AI.result: 在 SAC、PPO、DQN 三类算法和四个基准套件上，平均回报显著提升，各算法族中位数增益为 32%–84%，峰值回报比约为 363 倍（相对接近零的基线）。包含从学习失败到成功完成任务的转变，且从更强的开源实现出发进化仍能持续改进。在 SAC 运动任务实测中，评估所用算力约为完整评估同一候选池所需算力的十五分之一。独立搜索反复发现可解释的自适应鲁棒损失、进度相关价值目标与运行时统计量的组合，且所选程序可迁移到未见任务。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明自我进化在 AI 中有更广泛的作用：能够发现可解释的算法，改进智能体的学习方式。

title: Sparse Feature Policy Unlearning Mitigates State Hallucination in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong generalization in robotic manipulation by leveraging rich representations from pretrained vision-language models. However, their deployment in real-world environments remains limited by recurring unreliable behaviors. In this work, we study state hallucination, a recurring failure pattern in which a VLA continues acting as if an unrealized robot-object state had been achieved. Our analyses find that state hallucination coincides with weakened attention to task-relevant visual regions, and a mechanistic interpretation via sparse autoencoders reveals that hallucination-associated sparse features are activated when these failures occur. Based on this analysis, we propose SOUL (Sparse feature pOlicy UnLearning), which selectively unlearns policy knowledge associated with state hallucination behaviors, where sparse features identified from hallucination failures and successful behaviors serve as explicit forgetting and retention targets, respectively. Experiments across VLA architectures in simulated and real-world environments show that our method substantially reduces hallucinated failures and improves task success without substantially compromising the existing manipulation capabilities. These results suggest that interpretable feature analysis provides a practical basis for selectively modifying undesirable knowledge in robot policies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究VLA模型中的"状态幻觉"失败模式，通过稀疏自编码器定位相关稀疏特征，提出SOUL方法选择性遗忘幻觉相关策略知识，在仿真与真实环境中显著减少幻觉失败并提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA模型虽泛化能力强，但在真实部署中仍存在反复出现的不稳定行为。作者关注"状态幻觉"这一失败模式——模型在机器人-物体状态实际未达成时却继续按已达成的状态行动。研究动机是解释该失败的机制基础，并提供一种可行的修正手段。
AI.method: 1）分析状态幻觉发生时注意力对任务相关视觉区域减弱的现象；2）用稀疏自编码器进行机制解释，发现与幻觉相关的稀疏特征在失败时被激活；3）提出SOUL（Sparse feature pOlicy UnLearning），将幻觉失败中识别出的稀疏特征作为遗忘目标，将成功行为中的特征作为保留目标，选择性地对策略进行遗忘学习。
AI.result: 在多种VLA架构上的仿真和真实环境实验表明，该方法大幅减少幻觉性失败，提升任务成功率，同时未显著损害已有的操作能力。
AI.conclusion: 可解释的特征分析为选择性修改机器人策略中的不良知识提供了实用基础，说明机制层面的可解释性研究可指导策略纠错。

title: Do Image Editors Follow Depth-Dependent Blur and Aperture Response? A Rendered-Ground-Truth Pilot Audit
summary: General image editors are asked to make a photo look as if it were taken at f/1.4, yet it is rarely checked whether the blur they add follows thin-lens optics. A physical aperture edit spreads blur across depth in thin-lens proportions and changes the blur when the aperture changes; prior evaluations check blur monotonicity, sharpness-trend correlation, effective-aperture error, or vision-language judgments, and none we found reports the two properties separately at known depths. In this pilot audit of two editors (Gemini~3.1 Flash Image and GPT-image-2.5) we compare against a rendered oracle: Blender Cycles scenes with true thin-lens depth of field, one blur-width estimator applied identically to oracle and editor outputs, and preregistered depth and aperture indices. In 24 texture scenes rendered in one three-panel geometry, accepted and measurable panels show f/1.4-to-f/2.8 width ratios, $\barσ_{1.4}/\barσ_{2.8}$, of 0.99--1.18 against 1.98--2.13 for the oracle, and ratios of pooled median Gaussian-equivalent near/far blur widths of about 1.18--1.25 (Gemini) and 0.97--1.05 (GPT-image) against 1.69--1.82. Preregistered black-box interventions show that qualitative wording changes blur strength by roughly 2--10 times, whereas a request for 2 versus 6 px changes it 1.1--1.3 times and no tested wording of the f-number meets the registered ``followed'' criterion. The depth compression appears in the original and reversed centre-focus layouts; with the focus on the near panel, the available-panel depth index reaches the registered threshold, and the aperture response stays attenuated in every layout tested. Scalar metrics adapted from published ones give oracle-like scores to synthetic editors whose proportions are compressed.

AI.tldr: 该论文对两款图像编辑器（Gemini 3.1 Flash Image 与 GPT-image-2.5）的"物理光圈编辑"能力进行了预注册审计：以 Blender Cycles 真实薄透镜景深渲染作为 oracle，发现编辑器的模糊—深度比例与模糊—光圈响应均被显著压缩，且现有标量指标会给这种压缩型编辑器打出接近 oracle 的分数。
AI.motivation: 图像编辑常被要求模拟 f/1.4 等大光圈效果，但鲜有人验证其添加的模糊是否真正遵循薄透镜光学。物理光圈编辑应具备两个属性：模糊沿深度按薄透镜比例分布，以及光圈变化时模糊随之改变。此前的评估只检查模糊单调性、清晰度趋势相关性、有效光圈误差或视觉语言判断，没有研究报告在已知深度下分别检验这两条性质，因此本文要做一次针对性的试点审计。
AI.method: 采用以渲染 oracle 为参照的审计设计：构造 Blender Cycles 场景，包含真实薄透镜景深；对 oracle 与编辑器输出使用同一个模糊宽度估计器；预先注册深度与光圈两个指标。共 24 个纹理场景，采用统一的三面板几何布局，并进行预注册的黑盒干预（改变描述词、指定像素模糊量、指定 f 数值等），以检验编辑器对深度与光圈线索的响应。
AI.result: 可测量的面板中，f/1.4 与 f/2.8 的模糊宽度比 σ̄₁.₄/σ̄₂.₈ 仅为 0.99–1.18，而 oracle 为 1.98–2.13；合并中位高斯等效近/远模糊宽度比约为 1.18–1.25（Gemini）和 0.97–1.05（GPT-image），oracle 为 1.69–1.82。黑盒干预显示，定性措辞可使模糊强度变化约 2–10 倍，而"2 px 与 6 px"的请求仅带来 1.1–1.3 倍变化，且没有任何 f 数值措辞达到预注册的"已遵循"标准。深度压缩在原始与反转的中心对焦布局中均出现；当对焦在近面板时可用面板深度指标达到注册阈值，但光圈响应在所有布局中均衰减。改编自已发表方法的标量指标会给这种比例压缩的合成编辑器打出类似 oracle 的分数。
AI.conclusion: 现有图像编辑器并未真正遵循薄透镜光学：其模糊—深度比例和模糊—光圈响应被明显压缩，且当前流行的标量评价指标无法区分这种失效，会误判为接近物理正确的效果，因此需要能分别检验深度与光圈性质的新评估方式。

title: The Deceptive Bandit Problem: Exploratory Coupling and the Fragility of Multi-Agent Learning
summary: Randomized exploration is central to bandit learning, multi-agent reinforcement learning, and zeroth-order policy search, yet its independence and privacy are usually only treated as technical assumptions. We show that these properties are critical for security purposes and demonstrate how an adversarial agent can exploit privileged information on another agent's exploration. We analyze a deceiver-victim pair in the minimal two-player strongly monotone setting, where a deceptive player obtains leaked signals that are merely correlated with the victim's exploration. We show that, by coupling their own exploratory action with this information, the deceptive player injects an externality that steers the learning dynamics to a new steady state, called the deceptive Nash equilibrium (DNE). We prove that the deceptive bandit learning (DBL) dynamics converge to an arbitrarily small neighborhood of the DNE while retaining optimal convergence rates. Interestingly, our analysis attains these optimal rates while relaxing second-order smoothness conditions from standard bandit optimization literature. We characterize conditions under which deception strictly shifts the steady state and its effect on the deceiver's cost, illustrating the results in a resource-allocation game.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示随机探索的独立性与隐私性在安全层面的关键作用：欺骗者可利用与受害者探索相关的泄露信息，将学习动态引导至"欺骗性纳什均衡"（DNE）。
AI.motivation: 随机探索广泛应用于赌博机学习、多智能体强化学习与零阶策略搜索，但其独立性与隐私通常仅被视为技术性假设。本文旨在说明这些性质对安全至关重要，并展示对抗智能体如何利用关于他人探索的特权信息进行欺骗。
AI.method: 分析最小二人强单调设定下的"欺骗者—受害者"对：欺骗者仅获得与受害者探索相关的泄露信号，通过将自身探索动作与该信息耦合，注入外部性以改变学习动态。证明欺骗性赌博机学习（DBL）动态收敛性，并在放宽标准文献中二阶光滑性条件下保持最优收敛速率。
AI.result: DBL动态收敛至DNE的任意小邻域，且保持最优收敛速率；在放宽二阶光滑性条件下仍达到该速率。刻画了欺骗使稳态发生严格偏移的条件及其对欺骗者代价的影响，并在资源分配博弈中加以说明。
AI.conclusion: 随机探索的独立性与隐私并非纯技术假设，而是安全问题：欺骗者只需相关（非精确）的泄露信号即可将学习动态驱动至新的欺骗性纳什均衡，且不牺牲收敛速率。

title: CM-DPO: Constraint-Margin Direct Preference Optimization for LLM Planning
summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) treats all constraint violations equally: a $1 budget overshoot and a $1,000 overshoot induce the same training signal. It is also susceptible to length and style bias when preference pairs come from different model families. We introduce Constraint-Margin DPO (CM-DPO), which replaces DPO's binary preference signal with a continuous margin derived from a deterministic symbolic verifier and scaled by violation severity. Hard and soft constraints are separated through a lexicographic objective, ensuring hard constraints are never traded off against preferences. To supply CM-DPO with bias-reduced training pairs, we generate preference data through procedurally generated constraint profiles (DCCG) and minimal-edit distillation from a reasoning teacher (RT-MED), within a framework we call SynPlan-R. On TravelPlanner, NaturalPlan, and out-of-distribution PlanBench, an 8B model fine-tuned with CM-DPO achieves 89.2% pass rate and 93.4% solve rate, matching multi-agent systems at 13x lower latency while outperforming GPT-4o on unseen Blocksworld by 9.2 points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Constraint-Margin DPO（CM-DPO），将 DPO 的二元偏好信号替换为基于符号验证器的连续边际，并按违反严重程度缩放；同时引入 SynPlan-R 数据生成框架，在规划任务上取得优于多智能体系统与 GPT-4o 的表现。
AI.motivation: DPO 将所有约束违反同等对待，1 美元与 1000 美元的预算超支会产生相同训练信号；且当偏好对来自不同模型家族时易受长度与风格偏置影响。因此需要一个能体现违反严重程度、并区分硬软约束的偏好优化方法。
AI.method: 提出 CM-DPO：用确定性符号验证器导出的连续边际替代 DPO 的二元偏好信号，并按违反严重程度缩放；通过词典序目标分离硬约束与软约束，确保硬约束不会被偏好交换。为提供降偏训练对，设计 SynPlan-R 框架，包含程序化生成约束画像的 DCCG 与来自推理教师的最小编辑蒸馏 RT-MED。
AI.result: 在 TravelPlanner、NaturalPlan 及分布外 PlanBench 上，8B 模型经 CM-DPO 微调后达到 89.2% 通过率与 93.4% 求解率，以 13 倍更低延迟匹配多智能体系统，并在未见过的 Blocksworld 上超过 GPT-4o 达 9.2 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 连续、按严重程度加权的约束边际结合硬软约束的词典序处理，能有效缓解 DPO 的约束等价与偏置问题，使单模型在规划任务上兼顾高性能与低延迟。

title: Not All Uncertainty Matters: Simulation-in-the-Loop Fast-Slow Reasoning for Decision-Critical Autonomous Driving System
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) provide powerful open-world perception and reasoning for autonomous driving, but their high computational cost and inference latency make continuous cloud-side use impractical. This motivates fast--slow collaboration, where efficient onboard modules handle real-time perception and control while cloud models provide high-level reasoning only when needed. The key challenge is deciding when cloud reasoning should influence time-critical driving decisions. Existing methods often rely on perception uncertainty, heuristic triggers, or resource-driven policies, without assessing whether resolving an uncertainty will improve planning. We propose \textbf{SIGMA}, a simulation-in-the-loop framework for task-oriented fast--slow collaboration. SIGMA embeds the planner into uncertainty assessment and evaluates how plausible scene realizations under semantic and geometric uncertainty affect feasible trajectories and planning cost. Based on these outcomes, it estimates the expected reduction in planning cost from resolving uncertainty. We further introduce expected planning gain (EPG), a decision-level metric for cloud invocation, cloud-guidance integration, and request prioritization under deadline and resource constraints. Experiments in CARLA show that SIGMA reduces unnecessary cloud interactions while improving planning, efficiency, and navigation success in static and dynamic obstacle scenarios. Compared with fixed-period collaboration, SIGMA reduces unnecessary cloud interactions by 50\%, improves navigation success by more than 6\%, and cuts finish time by up to 26.2\% in dynamic scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SIGMA，一个面向任务的快慢协作仿真在环框架，通过将规划器嵌入不确定性评估，估计解决不确定性对规划成本的期望降低量，并提出期望规划增益（EPG）度量，用于决定云端调用时机与优先级。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（VLM）为自动驾驶提供强大的开放世界感知与推理能力，但其高计算成本和推理延迟使其难以持续在云端使用。这催生了快慢协作模式：车载高效模块负责实时感知与控制，云端模型仅在需要时提供高层推理。核心挑战在于判断云端推理何时应影响时间关键的驾驶决策。现有方法多依赖感知不确定性、启发式触发或资源驱动策略，未评估解决不确定性是否能改善规划。
AI.method: SIGMA将规划器嵌入不确定性评估，考察在语义与几何不确定性下，可能的场景实现如何影响可行轨迹与规划成本；基于这些结果估计解决不确定性带来的规划成本期望下降。同时提出期望规划增益（EPG），作为决策级度量，用于云端调用、云端引导整合以及在时限与资源约束下的请求优先级排序。
AI.result: 在CARLA中的实验表明，SIGMA在静态与动态障碍场景下减少了不必要的云端交互，同时提升了规划、效率与导航成功率。与固定周期协作相比，SIGMA将不必要的云端交互减少50%，导航成功率提升超过6%，在动态场景中完成时间最多缩短26.2%。
AI.conclusion: SIGMA通过仿真在环的面向任务快慢协作，将不确定性评估与规划收益直接关联，实现了更高效、更可靠的云端调用决策，在减少云端交互的同时改善了规划与导航表现。

title: Closing the Loop on Contrail Avoidance with Satellite Verification
comment: Accepted into Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning: workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Contrails are the thin ice clouds that aircraft leave behind. They cause a large share of aviation's warming, and rerouting the few flights that produce them could avoid much of it. However, an avoided contrail only counts if a satellite can confirm that it never formed, and this check is hard: contrails are one to two pixels wide, cover only 0.18% of pixels, and look very similar to natural cirrus. We build a small diffusion model (8.4M parameters, trained on one GPU) that detects them, and we run a controlled study to find out which components matter. The model reaches 0.476 PR-AUC, compared with 0.414 for a DeepLabV3+ baseline and 0.119 for an adapted MedSegDiff. Doubling the input resolution of the CNN brings it to parity (0.499, p=0.07). Three lessons apply beyond contrails. First, check the input resolution before designing a new architecture. Second, simple flips and rotations more than double accuracy and matter more than any architectural choice we measured. Third, pretraining the model on contrail shapes is harmful: the model learns that thin strokes appear everywhere and paints them onto empty scenes. Precision collapses to 1% while recall-based metrics still rate the degraded model as excellent, and no threshold or guidance heuristic repairs this failure.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个8.4M参数的小型扩散模型用于检测飞机尾迹（凝结尾迹），PR-AUC达0.476，优于DeepLabV3+（0.414）和MedSegDiff（0.119）。研究发现输入分辨率、简单数据增强比架构选择更关键，而基于形状的预训练反而有害。
AI.motivation: 凝结尾迹造成航空业很大一部分的变暖效应，通过改变少数产生尾迹的航班航线可避免大部分影响。但"避免的尾迹"只有在卫星能确认其从未形成时才成立。检测难点在于：尾迹仅1-2像素宽，仅占0.18%的像素，且与自然卷云非常相似。
AI.method: 构建一个8.4M参数、单GPU训练的小型扩散模型来检测凝结尾迹，并进行受控实验以确定哪些组件真正重要，与DeepLabV3+基线和适配的MedSegDiff进行对比。
AI.result: 模型达到0.476 PR-AUC，优于DeepLabV3+（0.414）和MedSegDiff（0.119）。将CNN输入分辨率加倍后达到持平水平（0.499，p=0.07）。简单翻转旋转增强使精度提高一倍以上，比任何架构选择都重要。基于尾迹形状的预训练有害：精度崩溃至1%，但基于召回率的指标仍将该退化模型评为优秀，且无阈值或引导启发式能修复此失败。
AI.conclusion: 三条经验可推广到尾迹之外：第一，设计新架构前先检查输入分辨率；第二，简单翻转旋转比任何测得的架构选择更重要，使精度提高一倍以上；第三，基于形状的预训练有害，模型会学到细线条无处不在并绘制到空场景中，导致精度崩溃而召回率指标无法察觉。

title: Are Parameter-Efficient Fine-tuning Methods Really Different?
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) offers many parameterizations, yet their methodological and functional differences remain unclear. We compare six methods in language and diffusion models to examine how their parameterizations relate to task performance, forgetting, and changes in pretrained weight geometry. Motivated by the spectrum-preserving design of orthogonal fine-tuning (OFT), we first ask whether spectral preservation is itself important for adaptation and retention. We find that the selected LoRA-family methods also approximately preserve pretrained geometry, and that restoring their slightly drifted singular-value spectra largely preserves task performance, questioning the necessity of explicit geometric preservation. Beyond this, we observe that some methods exhibit distinct adaptation--retention trade-offs that vary across settings: LoRA most consistently limits forgetting at competitive performance, DoRA achieves higher mean task scores than LoRA in most comparisons, while PiSSA often incurs greater retention costs. Further intervention experiments suggest that while performance gains from different PEFT methods can be attributed to modifications in different groups of spectral components, we consistently find that restoring dominant rather than intermediate or trailing components produces the largest mean reduction in general-text NLL or base-image drift. Together, these results motivate evaluating geometric constraints through their functional consequences rather than preservation alone. Code is available at https://github.com/Kuaaannn/PEFT_methods.

AI.tldr: 本文对比六种PEFT方法在语言与扩散模型中的表现，发现谱保持并非适配的必要条件，关键在于几何约束的功能后果。
AI.motivation: PEFT方法虽参数化方式多样，但其方法论与功能差异仍不清晰，尤其谱保持设计是否真正重要尚不明确。
AI.method: 比较六种PEFT方法（含LoRA族、DoRA、PiSSA、OFT等）在语言与扩散模型中的参数化方式，并进行奇异值谱恢复与谱分量干预实验。
AI.result: LoRA族方法也近似保持预训练几何，恢复其轻微漂移的奇异值谱仍能基本维持性能；LoRA最稳定地限制遗忘，DoRA平均任务分数更高，PiSSA保持性代价更大；恢复主导谱分量对降低NLL或图像漂移效果最大。
AI.conclusion: 应通过几何约束的功能后果而非仅凭保持性来评估PEFT方法。

title: Trajectory Abstraction for the Science of Language Agent Behavior
summary: Scientific studies of language agents need behavioral variables that support hypotheses across tasks and models. We formulate this research problem as learning and testing a hierarchy of trajectory abstractions. A concrete recursive procedure first measures role- and phase-indexed events, proposes temporally constrained relations, and tests their stability across conditions. It then constructs episode-level motif variables from selected relations and repeats the analysis on those variables. Explicit measurement functions connect every abstraction level to the original trajectories. Observations and randomized protocol experiments assess the resulting hypotheses, while comparisons between intervention realizations determine whether an abstraction should be retained, refined, or restricted. We derive a finite-depth bound for accepted reductions, identify protocol effects on fixed abstractions, and characterize realization disagreement and composition of abstraction error. A finite-sample test makes projected intervention consistency operational, and constructed examples illustrate motif construction and abstraction refinement. The formulation distinguishes this experimental approach from semantic taxonomies, qualitative theory induction, and behavior-model recovery. It specifies a proposed research procedure for discovering generalizable behavioral hypotheses, with literature-relative novelty assessed separately from model-relative surprise.

AI.tldr: 该论文将语言智能体的科学研究形式化为"轨迹抽象层级"的学习与检验问题，提出一套递归实验程序：先测量角色与阶段索引的事件，提出时序约束关系并检验其跨条件稳定性，再构建情节级母题变量并重复分析，从而发现可泛化的行为假设。
AI.motivation: 语言智能体的科学研究需要能够跨任务、跨模型支撑假设的行为变量。现有研究路径（语义分类学、定性理论归纳、行为模型恢复）难以提供这样可检验、可迁移的抽象变量，因此需要一个新的形式化框架。
AI.method: 提出一种递归程序：1）测量角色与阶段索引的事件；2）提出时序约束关系并检验其跨条件稳定性；3）从选定的关系构建情节级母题变量并对其重复分析。通过显式测量函数将每个抽象层级与原轨迹相连；用观测与随机化协议实验评估假设，通过干预实现的比较决定抽象应保留、细化还是受限。理论上给出接受约简的有限深度界，刻画协议效应对固定抽象的影响，并分析实现分歧与抽象误差的复合；用有限样本检验使"投影干预一致性"可操作。
AI.result: 推导出接受约简的有限深度界；识别出协议对固定抽象的影响；刻画了实现分歧与抽象误差的复合性质；有限样本检验使投影干预一致性可操作；构造实例展示了母题构建与抽象细化过程。
AI.conclusion: 该形式化将这种实验路径与语义分类学、定性理论归纳、行为模型恢复区分开来，为发现可泛化的行为假设提供了研究程序，并将文献相对新颖性与模型相对意外性分开评估。

title: Contact-Aware Imitation Learning Through Contact Factorization
summary: Generalizable contact-rich manipulation requires robots to preserve intended task behavior while adapting its physical realization to changing contact conditions. However, interaction forces can vary substantially with small changes in surface geometry, orientation, and friction, making policies trained directly on raw force measurements difficult to transfer beyond demonstrated conditions. We introduce FACE, a contact-factorized imitation learning framework that separates intended task behavior from environment-dependent contact factors. Our representation expresses interaction forces in normalized, contact-relative coordinates, while a learned contact-normal estimator and an online friction estimator infer the local contact normal and effective friction scale. Together, these estimators enable force observations to be encoded and policy outputs to be decoded into physical motion and force commands during execution. In this way, FACE adapts execution to current contact conditions while preserving the intended task behavior, without updating the policy parameters. We evaluate FACE on real-robot contact-rich manipulation under unseen variations in surface properties and geometry, demonstrating robust generalization across contact conditions through controlled comparisons with variants that adapt prior approaches to our setting. Videos and additional materials can be found on the project page: https://rcilab.khu.ac.kr/face.

AI.tldr: FACE是一个接触因子化的模仿学习框架，将任务意图与环境相关的接触因素分离，通过在归一化的接触相对坐标中表示交互力，并在不更新策略参数的情况下适应当前接触条件，实现对未见表面属性和几何变化的泛化。
AI.motivation: 通用的富接触操作要求机器人在适应不断变化的接触条件的同时保持预期的任务行为。然而，交互力会随表面几何、朝向和摩擦的细微变化而发生显著改变，导致直接在原始力测量上训练的策略难以迁移到演示条件之外。
AI.method: 提出FACE，一种接触因子化的模仿学习框架。其表示将交互力表达在归一化的、接触相对的坐标中；通过学习到的接触法向估计器和在线摩擦估计器推断局部接触法向与有效摩擦尺度。这两个估计器使力观测能够在执行过程中被编码，并将策略输出解码为物理运动和力指令，从而在不更新策略参数的情况下适应当前接触条件并保持预期任务行为。
AI.result: 在真实机器人富接触操作任务上，针对未见过的表面属性和几何变化进行评测，通过与将先前方法适配到该设定下的变体进行受控对比，展示了跨接触条件的稳健泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: FACE通过将预期任务行为与环境相关的接触因素分离，实现了无需更新策略参数即可适应变化的接触条件，验证了接触因子化表示在富接触操作泛化中的有效性。

title: Unified Multi-plane Autoregressive Diffusion for 3D Multi-contrast MRI Synthesis
summary: Acquiring a complete set of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) contrasts is time-intensive and uncomfortable for patients, despite the diagnostic value of multi-contrast imaging. This motivates synthesizing missing contrasts from those already acquired, which is an inherently 3D problem requiring anatomical coherence across axial, sagittal, and coronal planes. However, fully 3D generative models are often impracti- cal under computational resources that scale cubically with volume size. We propose a unified Multi-Plane Autoregressive Diffusion (MPAD), a latent diffusion framework that achieves full-volume 3D synthesis using efficient plane-wise 2D operations while preserving volumetric coherence. A 3D autoencoder first compresses MRI scans into an isotropic 3D la- tent representation. A 2D diffusion model is then trained to reconstruct masked latent slices of the target contrast, conditioned on both source- contrast slices and unmasked target-contrast slices. During inference, we introduce plane-wise autoregressive synthesis with inter-plane priors. Slices are generated autoregressively in random order within one plane orientation to maintain intra-plane continuity, then propagated as con- ditioning priors to orthogonal plane orientations to enforce inter-plane consistency. Compared to 3D latent diffusion baselines, MPAD reduces training and inference FLOPs by 7x and 3x, respectively, while also lowering inference time and peak memory consumption. Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that MPAD achieves superior perfor- mance, generating high-fidelity 3D volumes and supporting one-to-many translation within a single unified model.

AI.tldr: 提出统一多平面自回归扩散框架MPAD，用平面级2D操作实现全容积3D MRI对比度合成，在保持体一致性同时大幅降低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 获取完整MRI对比度集耗时长且令患者不适，需从已采集对比度合成缺失对比度。这是本质上的3D问题，要求轴向、矢状、冠状三个平面解剖一致。但全3D生成模型计算量随体积大小立方增长，资源上不实用。
AI.method: MPAD为潜在扩散框架：先用3D自编码器将MRI压缩为各向同性3D潜在表示；再训练2D扩散模型，以源对比度切片和未掩码的目标对比度切片为条件，重建目标对比度的被掩码潜在切片。推理时引入带平面间先验的平面级自回归合成：在某一平面方向内按随机顺序自回归生成切片以保持平面内连续性，再作为条件先验传播到正交平面方向以强制平面间一致性。
AI.result: 与3D潜扩散基线相比，MPAD训练和推理FLOPs分别降低7倍和3倍，同时减少推理时间和峰值内存消耗。多个数据集实验表明MPAD性能更优，能生成高保真3D体积，并在单一统一模型内支持一对多翻译。
AI.conclusion: MPAD以高效的平面级2D操作实现全容积3D MRI对比度合成，兼顾体一致性与计算可行性，性能优于3D基线并支持多对多翻译。

title: Spatial Induction Heads: In-Context Learning of Multidimensional Cellular Automata
comment: Under review at ICLR 2027. Project page: https://kimzemian.github.io/spatial-induction-heads/
summary: Induction heads provide a mechanistic account of in-context learning in sequential data, but existing theory largely assumes that the context relevant to a prediction forms a contiguous block. In multidimensional data, serialization breaks this assumption by scattering spatial neighbors across distant positions in the token sequence. We study how transformers overcome this routing problem in multidimensional stochastic and deterministic cellular automata, where each trajectory is generated by an unknown local rule and presented as a flattened sequence without an explicit coordinate-based spatial inductive bias. We introduce spatial induction heads, two-layer gather-and-match circuits in which the first layer reconstructs the relevant spatial neighborhood and the second matches the resulting configuration against earlier occurrences. We give two explicit realizations of the gather and show that the positional dimension required for spatial routing depends only on the local neighborhood and spatial dimension, not on grid volume or trajectory horizon. We further construct a matching layer which implements Bayesian counting. The end-to-end circuit can approximate the Bayesian posterior arbitrarily closely for stochastic rules and can predict exactly for deterministic rules. Empirically, trained two-layer transformers generalize to unseen rules in one and two dimensional settings, achieving near-perfect deterministic rollouts and less than 0.005 nats KL from the Bayes-optimal predictor on stochastic rules. Attention patterns and layerwise probes align with the predicted gather-and-match computation, providing mechanistic evidence for spatial induction in trained transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"空间归纳头"（spatial induction heads），解释Transformer如何在多维数据的扁平化序列中克服空间邻居被分散的路由问题，实现上下文学习。
AI.motivation: 现有归纳头理论大多假设与预测相关的上下文构成连续块。但在多维数据中，序列化会把空间邻居分散到token序列的远距离位置，破坏了这一连续性假设，因此需要研究Transformer如何解决这种空间路由问题。
AI.method: 在多维随机与确定性元胞自动机上研究该问题，每条轨迹由未知局部规则生成，并以扁平序列呈现且无显式坐标空间偏置。提出空间归纳头：一种两层"收集-匹配"（gather-and-match）电路，第一层重建相关空间邻域，第二层将所得配置与先前出现进行匹配。给出gather的两种显式实现，并构造实现贝叶斯计数的匹配层。
AI.result: 空间路由所需的位置维度仅取决于局部邻域和空间维度，而与网格体积或轨迹长度无关。端到端电路对随机规则可任意逼近贝叶斯后验，对确定性规则可精确预测。实验上，训练的两层Transformer能泛化到未见规则：在一维和二维设置下实现近乎完美的确定性rollout，随机规则下与贝叶斯最优预测器的KL散度小于0.005 nats。注意力模式和逐层探针与预测的收集-匹配计算一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为训练后Transformer中的空间归纳提供了机制性证据，扩展了归纳头理论以处理多维数据的空间路由问题。

title: The Winner's Curse in LLM Self-Improvement Loops: Selection Noise, Lock-in, and Acceptance Rules
comment: 34 pages, 4 figures, 18 tables; code and saved experimental records included as ancillary files
summary: Self-improving LLM systems propose changes to themselves and keep those that score better on a small evaluation set. We treat this keep-if-better step as selection under measurement noise, model the correlated errors of the candidates in a single decision, and study empirically what happens when the evaluation set is reused. In runs where Qwen models rewrite their own instructions and every candidate is also scored on 600 held-out items, most proposals after the first are harmful, and the model gives the size of the winner's curse of a generation's best candidate. With a prior from a separate pilot, it matches the average overstatement of first-generation commits in native loops, though not setting by setting. In a pre-registered study, the final selection-set score of greedy loops exceeded held-out accuracy by 13 to 20 points with 16 selection items and by 1 to 5 points with 256. Held-out gains grew with the selection set on TREC but not on GSM8K, and the tested acceptance rules did not beat greedy acceptance over whole runs. Gains measured on the selection set also exceeded held-out gains when a current model refined a competent instruction, and in the validation scores of GEPA and MIPROv2. Scoring the starting and the current instruction on 64 items never used for selection removes the average bias of a loop's reported gain, but single estimates remain off by about 6 points. Self-improvement studies should report held-out gains with their uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文将自我改进LLM系统中的"择优保留"步骤视为测量噪声下的选择问题，建模候选间的相关误差，实证研究评估集重用导致的赢家诅咒与虚高收益。
AI.motivation: 自我改进系统靠小评估集打分来决定保留哪些自改提案，评估集被反复重用会产生测量噪声与相关误差，导致选择偏差（赢家诅咒）和虚高的收益报告，需要量化这一现象。
AI.method: 将keep-if-better视为单次决策下带相关误差的选择问题；用Qwen模型改写自身指令，每个候选额外在600条留出项上打分；用独立试点获得的先验进行预测；开展预注册研究，比较不同选择集大小（16与256项）、不同接受规则（含贪心接受）；在TREC与GSM8K上考察留出收益；检验GEPA与MIPROv2的验证分数；并用从未用于选择的64项对起始与当前指令打分以去除偏差。
AI.result: 首代之后的多数提案有害；模型能给出某一代最佳候选赢家诅咒的规模。预注册研究中，贪心循环的最终选择集分数在16项时超出留出准确率13–20点，256项时超出1–5点。TREC上留出收益随选择集增大而增长，GSM8K上则不然；所测试的接受规则整体上未胜过贪心接受。GEPA与MIPROv2的验证分数也表现出选择集收益高于留出收益。用64项未用于选择的项目重评可消除循环报告收益的平均偏差，但单次估计仍偏离约6点。
AI.conclusion: 评估集重用会造成系统性虚高收益，随选择集增大而缓解但未消失；自我改进研究应报告留出收益及其不确定性，而非仅报选择集分数。

title: MagCilia: A Compact Magnetociliary Tactile Sensor with 3D Force Sensing for Robotic Contact Perception and Grasping Feedback
summary: Robotic grasping and surface exploration benefit from simultaneous measurement of normal and tangential forces and from surface information obtained through contact. Here, we present a compact magnetociliary tactile sensor (MagCilia) that combines a flexible magnetic-cilia structure with a Hall sensor for 3D force sensing. Quasi-static finite element analysis is used to investigate structural deformation and magnetic responses under multidirectional loading. To reconstruct forces from the coupled magnetic channels, we propose causal history fusion regression (CHFR), which combines current magnetic-field measurements with their recent changes. Five-fold cross-validation grouped by calibration record yields root-mean-square errors of 0.40, 0.57, and 0.69 N for Fx, Fy, and Fz, respectively, with corresponding coefficients of determination of 0.93, 0.90, and 0.92. Robotic experiments demonstrate tangential-force-guided gripper adjustment and multi-axis load monitoring under external perturbations. Frequency-domain features of the reconstructed forces distinguish six surface categories with 99.39% accuracy in three-fold cross-validation grouped by acquisition session. An online robotic demonstration additionally identifies all six tested surfaces. These results demonstrate 3D force reconstruction, grasping feedback, and surface recognition using a single compact tactile unit.

AI.tldr: 提出紧凑型磁纤毛触觉传感器MagCilia，结合磁纤毛结构与霍尔传感器实现三维力感知，并用因果历史融合回归CHFR重建力，完成抓取反馈与表面识别。
AI.motivation: 机器人抓取与表面探索需要同时测量法向和切向力，并获取接触表面信息，现有方案难以在单一紧凑单元中同时满足这些需求。
AI.method: MagCilia将柔性磁性纤毛结构与霍尔传感器结合实现三维力感知；采用准静态有限元分析研究多向载荷下的结构变形与磁响应；提出因果历史融合回归CHFR，将当前磁场测量与近期变化结合以从耦合磁通道重建力。
AI.result: 按校准记录分组的五折交叉验证中，Fx、Fy、Fz的均方根误差分别为0.40、0.57、0.69 N，决定系数为0.93、0.90、0.92；机器人实验实现切向力引导的夹爪调整与多轴负载监测；重建力的频域特征在按采集会话分组的三折交叉验证中以99.39%准确率区分六类表面，在线演示识别全部六种表面。
AI.conclusion: 单一紧凑触觉单元即可实现三维力重建、抓取反馈与表面识别。

title: PPCAR-Net: Projection-Refined Parametric 3D Coronary Artery Reconstruction from Sparse X-ray Angiographic Views
comment: 22 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables, including references and appendix. Code and pretrained models: https://github.com/G2304138H/PPCAR-Net . Project page with video results: https://G2304138H.github.io/PPCAR-Net/
summary: Sparse-view 3D coronary reconstruction commonly relies on cross-view correspondence and triangulation, which are vulnerable to vessel overlap and foreshortening, or on volumetric prediction followed by vascular-graph extraction, which does not directly provide centrelines and radii. We introduce PPCAR-Net, a projection-refined parametric coronary artery reconstruction network that directly predicts a branch-structured centreline-and-radius representation without explicit point matching, triangulation, or an intermediate volume. Given a variable number of segmented views, a coarse predictor combines frozen VGGT features with learned branch queries to estimate branch presence, B-spline centreline trajectories, and dense radius profiles. Projection-guided geometry and radius refiners then sample local evidence from the input views and apply residual corrections learned with 3D supervision. We evaluate representation fidelity and sparse-view reconstruction quantitatively and qualitatively. On simulated angiographic masks generated from CT-derived coronary anatomy, PPCAR-Net produces better connected artery reconstructions and achieves strong centreline accuracy, particularly for RCA, while maintaining competitive volumetric overlap. Coarse-to-fine inference takes 121 ms, enabling real-time reconstruction.

AI.tldr: PPCAR-Net 是一种投影细化参数化冠脉重建网络，可直接预测分支结构化的中心线与半径表示，无需显式点匹配、三角化或中间体积，实现快速稀疏视图重建。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视图三维冠脉重建现有方法存在不足：依赖跨视图对应与三角化的方法易受血管重叠和透视缩短影响；体素预测后提取血管图的方法不能直接提供中心线和半径。
AI.method: 给定可变数量的分割视图，粗预测器结合冻结的 VGGT 特征与可学习分支查询，估计分支存在性、B 样条中心线轨迹和稠密半径剖面；随后投影引导的几何与半径细化器从输入视图中采样局部证据，并在 3D 监督下进行残差修正。
AI.result: 在由 CT 冠脉解剖生成的模拟血管造影掩膜上，PPCAR-Net 产生更连通的动脉重建，中心线精度强，尤其对 RCA 表现突出，同时保持有竞争力的体积重叠；粗到细推理耗时 121 ms，可实现实时重建。
AI.conclusion: PPCAR-Net 通过投影细化参数化表示，绕开点匹配、三角化和中间体积，兼顾重建质量与实时性，适用于稀疏视图冠脉重建。

title: Domain-informed Adaptive Sampling for Generalizable PINNs in Metal Additive Manufacturing via Conditional Flow Matching
summary: Accurate thermal modeling is essential in metal additive manufacturing (AM) for understanding the process-structure-property chain. Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) offer effective surrogate thermal modeling by minimizing physics-based residual losses at collocation points. However, prior works typically rely on manually-crafted, static collocation sampling strategies, which are neither principled nor scalable across process conditions, hindering their generalization capability. In this work, we provide theoretical analysis through empirical risk minimization, showing that process condition-aware adaptive sampling is strictly more favorable than conventional static sampling for generalization. Building on this insight, we propose an adaptive sampling strategy within a two-stage framework: (1) a conditional Flow Matching model that learns approximate high-residual distributions across different process conditions, and (2) a mixed sampling strategy combining this distribution with a domain-informed base distribution to generate adaptive collocation points for refining the PINN predictor. Experiments on metal AM numerical benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art PINN baselines, achieving an average 62.1\% reduction in relative $L_2$ error under an identical collocation budget, by capturing process-dependent heat dissipation regions often overlooked in the literature. To the authors' knowledge, this is the first adaptive sampling strategy for PINNs in metal AM, contributing to the enhanced generalization and broader applicability.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向金属增材制造热建模的条件自适应采样策略，通过条件Flow Matching学习高残差分布并结合域先验混合采样，显著提升PINN泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 金属增材制造中准确热建模对理解工艺-结构-性能关系至关重要。PINN可作为有效代理模型，但现有工作多依赖人工设计的静态配点采样策略，缺乏原理性且难以跨工艺条件扩展，限制了泛化能力。
AI.method: 通过经验风险最小化进行理论分析，证明工艺条件感知的自适应采样在泛化上严格优于传统静态采样。在此基础上提出两阶段框架：(1) 条件Flow Matching模型学习不同工艺条件下的近似高残差分布；(2) 混合采样策略，将该分布与域知识驱动的基分布结合，生成自适应配点以精炼PINN预测器。
AI.result: 在金属增材制造数值基准上，方法持续优于最先进PINN基线，在相同配点预算下相对L2误差平均降低62.1%，成功捕捉文献中常被忽略的工艺相关散热区域。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个面向金属增材制造PINN的自适应采样策略，有助于提升泛化能力和更广泛适用性。

title: We Query, Therefore We Compute: On Oracle Computation beyond the Machine, with an Application to Agents
summary:
Agentic systems use large language models (LLMs) to carry out concrete tasks. Prior work often borrows abstractions such as scheduling, caching or isolation piecemeal from operating systems, so the mechanisms it builds share little common ground, and the shared view of the two forms of agentic system, Workflows and Agents, is limited. We construct an abstract machine that provides both.
  We treat the LLM as an Oracle and extend a two-stack pushdown automaton with one instruction, which hands the Oracle a whole stack as its query and appends the answer to that same stack. The machine thus performs two computations, the Oracle's and a Turing-complete one that we call the Priestess. A stack that the program only appends to grows autoregressively, as an agent's context does. Two symmetry breakings, S in storage and T in transitions, make a Priestess program the operating system of the programs the Oracle runs, and produce the Agent and the Workflow as the two placements of a task's program.
  For internally autoregressive Oracles, the two computations synchronize at the end of every answer under certain conditions, and through that synchronization we model caching and analyse scheduling. No guarantee that holds for every Oracle can fix which content crosses between the two computations, but such a guarantee does fix the boundary itself.
  The construction V fits the machine to a von Neumann computer. To show that it is realizable, we propose ArchNights, an extended RISC-V ISA and a Linux-style operating system implementing the machine by design. ArchNights-SE runs on gem5 as a computer system, becomes an agentic system when it runs an LLM as the Oracle, and will be open source.
  Agentic systems can then be designed as computer systems are. With a foundation built and a unified view, future work can share invariants and bounds, each with its conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种抽象机器，将LLM视为Oracle并扩展双栈下推自动机，从而统一Workflow与Agent两种智能体系统的视图，并给出可实现的硬件与操作系统设计ArchNights。
AI.motivation: 现有工作零散借用操作系统的调度、缓存、隔离等抽象来构建智能体系统，导致机制之间缺乏共通基础，且对Workflow与Agent两类智能体系统的统一认识十分有限。
AI.method: 将LLM视为Oracle，在双栈下推自动机上增加一条指令：把整个栈作为查询交给Oracle，并将答案追加回同一栈，使机器同时执行Oracle计算与图灵完备的Priestess计算；通过存储上的对称破缺S与转移上的对称破缺T，使Priestess程序成为Oracle所运行程序的操作系统，并导出Agent与Workflow作为任务程序的两种放置方式；构造V使该机器适配冯·诺依曼计算机，并提出ArchNights（扩展RISC-V ISA与类Linux操作系统）加以实现。
AI.result: 对于内部自回归的Oracle，两种计算在满足一定条件时于每次答案结束时同步，借此可建模缓存并分析调度；不存在适用于所有Oracle的保证来决定两种计算间传递的内容，但此类保证确实确定了边界本身；ArchNights-SE可在gem5上作为计算机系统运行，运行LLM作为Oracle时即成为智能体系统，并将开源。
AI.conclusion: 智能体系统此后可以像计算机系统一样被设计；有了统一基础与统一视图，未来工作可以共享不变量与界，并各自附带其适用条件。

title: Targeted Modality Dropout for Real-Robot Manipulation Robust to Intermittent Vision Loss
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to the 2027 IEEE/SICE International Symposium on System Integration (SII 2027)
summary: Imitation learning policies that integrate multiple sensory modalities are prone to overreliance on a dominant modality, such as vision, during training, which can disrupt policy execution when that modality is lost at inference time. In this paper, we introduce Targeted Modality Dropout (TMD), in which the dependence on each modality is estimated using attention and the most dominant modality is selectively dropped. This is combined with entropy regularization over the dependence distribution. Through real-robot evaluation using a bimanual manipulator, we show that under vision loss the success rate of the baseline policy drops substantially, whereas TMD sustains task execution. In contrast, a conventional dropout that selects the dropped modality at random, without the entropy regularization, fails on many tasks even without vision loss.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Targeted Modality Dropout (TMD)，通过注意力估计各模态依赖度并有选择地丢弃主导模态，结合依赖分布的熵正则化，缓解模仿学习策略对单一模态的过度依赖。真机双臂实验表明，在视觉丢失时基线成功率大幅下降，而TMD仍能维持任务执行。
AI.motivation: 融合多感官模态的模仿学习策略在训练中容易过度依赖某一主导模态（如视觉），当该模态在推理阶段丢失时，策略执行会受到严重干扰，因此需要一种方法来降低这种单模态依赖。
AI.method: 提出Targeted Modality Dropout (TMD)：利用注意力机制估计策略对每个模态的依赖程度，选择性地丢弃最主导的模态；同时对依赖分布施加熵正则化。
AI.result: 在使用双臂机械臂的真机评估中，视觉丢失时基线策略成功率大幅下降，而TMD能够维持任务执行；相比之下，随机选择丢弃模态且无熵正则化的传统dropout方法，即使在无视觉丢失的情况下也在许多任务上失败。
AI.conclusion: 针对性地丢弃主导模态并配合熵正则化，可有效提升多模态模仿学习策略在模态丢失（如视觉缺失）下的鲁棒性，优于随机dropout策略。

title: Quantifying Volumetric Risk: Class-Aware Asymmetric Weighted Conformal Prediction for 3D Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Reliable volumetric segmentation is critical for clinical diagnostics, yet foundation models such as MedSAM remain deterministic and lack calibrated uncertainty under distribution shift. Existing conformal prediction methods offer statistical guarantees but are frequently applied in 2D and assume symmetric error distributions, so they do not capture the class-specific biases that arise in 3D multi-class segmentation. We propose Class-Aware Asymmetric Weighted Conformal Prediction (CA-WCP), which combines latent-space density-ratio weighting for covariate shift with directional quantiles for the lower and upper volume bounds, and scales each bound by a class-specific asymmetry factor derived from validation-set false-positive and false-negative rates. We prove that CA-WCP retains the weighted-exchangeability marginal coverage guarantee for every class, and we evaluate it on 3D brain tumor segmentation (BraTS 2020) and on a synthetic multi-organ CT benchmark constructed under covariate shift. On both benchmarks the 95\% Clopper--Pearson interval for the observed coverage of CA-WCP contains the nominal 90\% level for every semantic class, while interval width is reduced by 8--14\% relative to symmetric weighted conformal prediction. We further encode the calibrated intervals into structured prompts for a multimodal large language model to produce uncertainty-conditioned radiology reports, linking distribution-shift-aware uncertainty quantification to interpretable clinical communication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出类别感知非对称加权共形预测（CA-WCP），用于三维多类分割的校准不确定性量化，兼顾协变量偏移与类别特异性偏差，并可将区间编码为大模型提示生成报告。
AI.motivation: 可靠的体积分割对临床诊断至关重要，但MedSAM等基础模型是确定性输出，在分布偏移下缺乏校准不确定性；现有共形预测多用于2D且假设误差对称，无法刻画3D多类分割中的类别特异性偏差。
AI.method: CA-WCP将潜在空间密度比加权（应对协变量偏移）与方向分位数结合，分别得到体积下界与上界，并用验证集假阳性/假阴性率推导的类别非对称因子对每个界进行缩放；理论上证明其对每个类别保持加权可交换的边际覆盖保证。
AI.result: 在BraTS 2020脑肿瘤分割与协变量偏移下的合成多器官CT基准上，CA-WCP的95% Clopper–Pearson区间对每个语义类别均包含名义90%覆盖水平，且区间宽度较对称加权共形预测缩小8–14%。
AI.conclusion: CA-WCP实现了分布偏移感知且类别自适应的不确定性量化，并可将校准区间编码为结构化提示交由多模态大模型生成不确定性条件化的放射报告，连接不确定性量化与可解释临床沟通。

title: Directional Evidence Guided Search-Space Reduction for Exact DAG Learning
summary: Learning a directed acyclic graph (DAG) from observational data is a challenging combinatorial problem due to the exponential growth in the number of candidate parent-set configurations. Existing exact score-based methods often require computationally intensive combinatorial search, whereas constraint-based methods can become unreliable or computationally demanding as graph size and conditioning-set complexity increase. We develop a non-parametric hybrid framework, referred to as DECO (Directional Evidence-guided Configuration Optimization), that extracts dependency and directional evidence from observation data to construct admissible parent sets prior to exact optimization. It reduces the optimization search space by eliminating empirically unsupported parent configurations while preserving flexibility for all plausible edge orientations. Theoretical analysis establishes an exponential reduction in the admissible parent-set configuration space and quantifies how bounded edge-level omission affects the probability of retaining the true parent structure. Experiments on benchmark Bayesian networks and synthetic discrete and continuous DAGs demonstrate substantial search-space reduction while achieving competitive structure-recovery performance, with favorable structural Hamming distance across many evaluated settings. These results show that directional evidence can provide an effective preprocessing mechanism for reducing the computational burden of exact DAG learning without requiring a fixed parametric structural~model.

AI.tldr: 提出非参数混合框架DECO，利用依赖与方向证据在精确优化前构建可容许父集，指数级缩小搜索空间，在保持结构恢复性能的同时降低计算负担。
AI.motivation: 从观测数据学习有向无环图（DAG）是组合难题：候选父集配置随规模指数增长。现有基于精确评分的方法需高强度组合搜索，而基于约束的方法在图规模与条件集复杂度上升时变得不可靠或计算昂贵。因此需要一种能在精确优化前有效裁剪搜索空间的机制。
AI.method: 提出非参数混合框架DECO（方向证据引导的配置优化）。它从观测数据中提取依赖关系与方向性证据，构建可容许父集，再进行精确优化。通过剔除经验上不支持的父配置来缩小搜索空间，同时保留所有合理边方向的灵活性，且不依赖固定的参数化结构模型。
AI.result: 理论分析证明可容许父集配置空间呈指数级缩减，并量化了有界边级遗漏对保留真实父结构概率的影响。在基准贝叶斯网络及合成离散、连续DAG上的实验显示，搜索空间大幅缩减，结构恢复性能具有竞争力，在多数评测设置下结构汉明距离表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 方向性证据可作为有效的预处理机制，在不需要固定参数化结构模型的前提下，降低精确DAG学习的计算负担。

title: RT-Safe: Benchmarking Agent Safety in Real-Time Embodied Environment
summary: Rapid progress in AI agents has brought growing attention to agent safety, with extensive evaluation focused on digital environments. As agents move into the physical world, embodied safety becomes increasingly important: failures can cause human injury and costly hardware damage. Beyond selecting safe actions, embodied agents must also operate under real-time constraints: the physical world does not pause while an agent reasons. As pedestrians move and vehicles approach during inference, an action that appears safe at observation time may become unsafe before execution. Real-time embodied safety therefore depends on both decision quality and decision latency. We introduce RT-SAFE, a simulated urban benchmark for evaluating embodied-agent safety under real-time constraints. RT-SAFE combines navigation tasks with moving actors, environmental hazards, and traffic rules, while allowing the world to evolve throughout inference and action execution. Across eight VLMs, agents achieve high task completion yet almost never complete safely: in the hardest setting, only 0.7% of episodes finish without a safety event. More strikingly, matched static and real-time evaluations yield task completion rates of 91.3% and 94.1%, respectively, while real-time execution increases collisions by $12.3\times$. These results reveal that standard task success can mask substantial safety failures, and that decision latency itself can become a source of physical risk. Finally, we show that RT-SAFE can support offline RL training and substantially reduce collision rates while achieving strong task completion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RT-SAFE，一个在实时约束下评估具身智能体安全性的城市仿真基准，揭示任务成功率会掩盖严重的安全失败，决策延迟本身即成为物理风险来源。
AI.motivation: AI智能体评测多集中于数字环境，随着智能体进入物理世界，具身安全愈发重要：失败可导致人身伤害与昂贵硬件损坏。此外，物理世界不会为智能体的推理而暂停，行人移动、车辆靠近会使观察时看似安全的动作在执行前变得不安全，因此实时具身安全同时取决于决策质量与决策延迟。现有评测缺乏对实时约束下安全性的系统考察。
AI.method: 提出RT-SAFE：一个模拟城市基准，用于在实时约束下评估具身智能体安全性。它结合导航任务与移动参与者、环境危险和交通规则，并允许世界在推理与动作执行过程中持续演化。在八个VLM上进行了评估，并测试了将其用于离线RL训练的效果。
AI.result: 智能体任务完成率高但几乎无法安全完成：在最难设置中仅0.7%的回合未发生安全事件。匹配的静态与实时评测任务完成率分别为91.3%与94.1%，但实时执行使碰撞增加12.3倍。将其用于离线RL训练可显著降低碰撞率，同时保持较强的任务完成表现。
AI.conclusion: 标准任务成功率会掩盖实质性的安全失败，决策延迟本身可成为物理风险的来源。RT-SAFE可作为训练与评测平台，支持离线RL训练以降低碰撞率，凸显实时安全评测的必要性。

title: Point It, Strike It: Direction-Conditioned Dynamic Manipulation of Deformable Linear Objects
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Project Page: https://deformx.github.io/DeformY
summary: Goal-conditioned dynamic manipulation of deformable linear objects has mainly specified goals as positions for a rope tip to reach. Many tasks, however, depend on how the tip arrives. We therefore study single-swing rope striking with goals that specify the tip's 3D position and arrival direction, across the workspace and on different ropes. This is challenging because rope dynamics are hard to model, no demonstrations exist, distinct swings reach the same goal with different reliability, and the sim-to-real gap extends beyond the rope. To address these challenges, we extend the state-of-the-art DLO simulator DeformX with GPU acceleration, a stable Cosserat rod solver, and a cross-flow aerodynamic model, yielding DeformX2.0, which is more than $20{,}000\times$ faster. We then propose TRACE (Trace-rooted Adaptive Cross-Entropy), which generates striking data by warm-starting each new target from the stored swing whose tip path passes closest to it. Its cost penalizes rope bending and abrupt tip motion to favor repeatable swings. A conditional flow-matching policy trained on this data reaches 92.1% accuracy in simulation. Finally, we propose RECAP (Residual Calibration Policy), which fits the simulator's rope and rig parameters to a few calibration swings and adapts actions with a correction policy trained in simulation. On a real robot, across three ropes, RECAP raises success within 5cm from 72% to 87% for position goals, and within 10cm and 10° from 50% to 79% for goals that also specify the arrival direction.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究绳索单摆击打的动态操作，目标是同时指定绳索末端的三维位置与到达方向。作者提出高加速仿真器DeformX2.0、数据生成方法TRACE，以及面向真机的残差校准策略RECAP。
AI.motivation: 现有目标条件动态操控可变形线性物体（DLO）通常只指定绳索末端的位置，而许多实际任务还取决于末端如何到达，即到达方向。这带来了绳索动力学难建模、缺乏示教、不同摆动到达同一目标可靠性不同，以及仿真到现实差距超出绳索本身的挑战。
AI.method: 1）扩展最先进的DLO仿真器DeformX，加入GPU加速、稳定的Cosserat杆求解器和横流气动模型，形成速度提升超过20000倍的DeformX2.0；2）提出TRACE（Trace-rooted Adaptive Cross-Entropy），以最接近目标的已存储摆动为热启动生成击打数据，成本函数惩罚绳索弯曲和末端突变以偏好可重复摆动；3）用条件流匹配策略在数据上训练；4）提出RECAP（Residual Calibration Policy），用少量校准摆动拟合仿真器的绳索与装置参数，并在仿真中训练修正策略来适配真实动作。
AI.result: 在仿真中，条件流匹配策略达到92.1%准确率。在真实机器人上跨三种绳索，RECAP将位置目标下的5cm内成功率从72%提升到87%；对于还指定到达方向的目标，10cm与10°内成功率从50%提升到79%。
AI.conclusion: 通过高保真高速仿真、面向方向目标的数据生成与真机残差校准，论文实现了同时满足位置与到达方向的绳索单摆击打任务，并显著缩小了仿真到现实的差距。

title: One Frame, Full Heartbeat: ECG-Free Cardiac Cine MRI Synthesis via Phase-Conditioned Flow Matching
