Source-derived spatial immune topology improved the cross-cancer robustness of frozen pathology foundation-model representations.

AI.tldr: 提出TIRA框架，利用空间免疫拓扑精炼冻结的病理基础模型表征，实现跨癌种零样本MSI与TMB预测。
AI.motivation: MSI-H和TMB-H是重要临床生物标志物，但模型在形态学差异较大的癌种间迁移时预测困难。免疫相关空间模式可跨癌种保持，而单癌种训练的基础模型预测器未显式利用该信息，限制了跨癌种泛化。
AI.method: TIRA（Tumor Immune Representation Adaptation）为无需目标域数据的框架，用空间免疫拓扑精炼冻结的基础模型表征：以拓扑监督的生物学表征来调节tile级注意力，同时仅对形态学特征进行池化以联合预测MSI和TMB。在TCGA-COAD+READ上训练。
AI.result: 在CPTAC-COAD、TCGA-STAD、TCGA-UCEC、CPTAC-UCEC上零样本评估，覆盖跨站点、跨癌种及联合分布偏移，并在UNI2、CONCH、Virchow2下测试。UNI2下TCGA-STAD零样本AUROC，MSI由0.633提升至0.766，TMB由0.651提升至0.772。
AI.conclusion: 源自源域的空间免疫拓扑提升了冻结病理基础模型表征的跨癌种鲁棒性，验证了在无需目标域数据条件下实现跨癌种生物标志物预测的可行性。

title: CurveTQ: Rotation-Free Trellis Quantization of LLM Weights via Curvature-Weighted Search
summary: The best two-bit weight quantizers for large language models, such as QTIP and Proteus, rotate each weight matrix by a random orthogonal transform, which must be undone at every decoding step, then encode it with a trellis or lattice code under a Euclidean search; the layer Hessian enters only through error feedback between coding blocks. We show that this leaves part of the Hessian unused. Error feedback turns the loss into a weighted sum of per-coordinate rounding errors whose weights, the diagonal of the Hessian's LDL factorization, existing quantizers compute but never read. We put these weights into the Viterbi branch metric, so the search follows the curvature within each coding block. This also explains the rotation: it removes this within-block variation, so weighting in the native basis and rotating are substitutes. On three models the weighted native search matches a full-dimension randomized Hadamard to within about one point of downstream accuracy, and weighting after the rotation gains little. Around this search we build CurveTQ, a trellis codec with no rotation, which handles the weights' amplitude and marginal shape with a factored scale field and a closed-form quantile table, and stores a start state per coding block so the trellis can adapt to the residual that error feedback carries into it. At two bits CurveTQ is 1-3 points higher in mean downstream accuracy than QTIP and Proteus on three 4-8B Instruct models, even after both are given our start state, which alone lifts either baseline by 1-3 points. It also leads on a 35B mixture of experts, to our knowledge the first trellis-coded result on such a model. With no rotation to undo, our decoder is the fastest of the three at all tested batch sizes and bit widths.

AI.tldr: 本文发现现有二比特权重量化器（如QTIP、Proteus）在随机正交旋转后用格/网格码进行欧氏搜索，仅通过误差反馈利用Hessian，导致部分Hessian信息未被利用。作者将Hessian的LDL分解对角元（即每坐标舍入误差的权重）引入Viterbi分支度量，使搜索在编码块内遵循曲率，并据此构建无需旋转的CurveTQ编解码器。
AI.motivation: 当前最优二比特量化器依赖随机正交旋转来消除块内曲率变化，但旋转必须在每个解码步骤撤销，带来计算开销；同时Hessian信息仅通过块间误差反馈间接使用，块内曲率信息被浪费。作者希望直接利用该信息，既提升精度又去掉旋转开销。
AI.method: 将Hessian的LDL分解对角元作为逐坐标舍入误差权重，代入Viterbi分支度量，使搜索在编码块内跟随曲率；由此论证旋转与在原生基下加权是等价替代。围绕该搜索构建CurveTQ：无旋转的网格编解码器，用因子化尺度场处理权重幅度与边缘形状，用闭式分位数表，并为每个编码块存储起始状态以适配误差反馈残差。
AI.result: 在三个模型上，加权原生搜索与全维随机Hadamard旋转的下游精度相差约1个点以内，旋转后再加权收益甚微。二比特下CurveTQ在三个4-8B Instruct模型上平均下游精度比QTIP和Proteus高1-3个点，即使给两者加入本文的起始状态后依然领先；起始状态本身可使任一基线提升1-3个点。在35B混合专家模型上同样领先，为已知首个在此类模型上的网格编码结果。无旋转需撤销，解码器在测试的所有批次大小与比特宽度下均为三者中最快。
AI.conclusion: 块内Hessian曲率可通过LDL对角权重在Viterbi度量中直接利用，从而使加权原生基搜索替代随机旋转；据此构建的无旋转CurveTQ在2比特下精度领先现有方法，并在MoE大模型上有效，同时解码速度最快。

title: LLM-Enabled UAV Dispatch: A System-Level Survey and Taxonomy
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) dispatch is beginning to move beyond isolated path planning and optimization-driven resource allocation toward system-level coordination supported by semantic reasoning and LLM-based interfaces. This survey provides a unified characterization of LLM-enabled UAV dispatch systems that bridges semantic intent, symbolic decision-making, and physical UAV execution. Rather than treating LLMs as standalone add-ons, we conceptualize them as a cross-layer semantic orchestration layer connecting human instructions, external solvers, and distributed control modules. We organize the literature into four representative dispatch paradigms: pipeline dispatch, global assignment dispatch, decentralized agentic dispatch, and divide-and-conquer dispatch. For each paradigm, we analyze its decision logic, system structure, control flow, representative methods, and potential LLM roles. We further examine how LLMs support semantic parsing, retrieval-grounded planning, solver orchestration, local agent reasoning, multi-agent coordination, safety assessment, and human-facing explanation. We discuss the implications of these paradigms for scalability, robustness, coordination burden, and verification requirements, and identify open challenges including latency-aware reasoning, grounding reliability, physical feasibility guarantees, edge deployment, privacy protection, and distributed consistency. This survey provides a system-level taxonomy and design perspective for integrating LLMs into safety-critical UAV dispatch systems.

AI.tldr: 该综述将LLM赋能无人机调度视为跨层语义编排层，提出四类调度范式并梳理关键技术角色与开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 无人机调度正从孤立路径规划与优化驱动资源分配，转向由语义推理和LLM接口支持的系统级协调，但缺乏统一刻画，需要桥接语义意图、符号决策与物理执行。
AI.method: 对文献进行系统综述与分类，将LLM定位为连接人类指令、外部求解器与分布式控制模块的跨层语义编排层；划分四类调度范式（流水线调度、全局分配调度、去中心化智能体调度、分而治之调度），并逐类分析决策逻辑、系统结构、控制流、代表方法与LLM潜在角色。
AI.result: 归纳了LLM在语义解析、检索增强规划、求解器编排、局部智能体推理、多智能体协调、安全评估和面向人的解释等方面的支持作用；讨论了各范式在可扩展性、鲁棒性、协调负担与验证要求上的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为将LLM集成到安全攸关的无人机调度系统提供了系统级分类与设计视角，并指出延迟感知推理、落地可靠性、物理可行性保证、边缘部署、隐私保护与分布式一致性等开放挑战。

title: On-Demand Robotic Assembly via Differentiable Geometric Part Repair
summary: Transitioning from a digital design to a robotic assembly process currently requires months of expert manual tuning to reconcile part geometries with robotic constraints. This paper presents an end-to-end, autonomous pipeline for the design and physical construction of bespoke wooden assemblies. A generative AI agent translates user prompts into initial 3D geometries, balancing the visual fidelity of the design with select physical constraints. The assemblability of the design is further improved by a gradient-based repair stage that backpropagates through a graph attention network surrogate to adjust component geometries. In addition to correcting for disjointed and overlapping components, we demonstrate hardware-specific corrections, differentiably optimizing the geometry of components to enable robot screwdriving for 86.7% of 60 novel natural language inputs, significantly outperforming prior work by a factor of ten. For ten of the structures, we physically demonstrate assemblability with two UR5e robots. This work marks a meaningful step toward on-demand robotic manufacturing, enabling the rapid production of customized, low-volume goods.

AI.tldr: 提出端到端自主流水线，将自然语言提示转化为可机器人装配的定制木质结构3D几何，通过梯度修复阶段优化几何，实现86.7%的机器人螺丝拧紧可装配率，并物理演示10个结构。
AI.motivation: 从数字设计到机器人装配目前需数月专家手动调试，以协调零件几何与机器人约束，效率低下。目标是实现按需机器人制造，快速生产定制化小批量产品。
AI.method: 生成式AI代理将用户提示转为初始3D几何，兼顾视觉保真度与部分物理约束；采用基于梯度的修复阶段，通过图注意力网络代理反向传播调整零件几何；除修正分离与重叠零件外，还实现硬件特定校正，可微地优化几何以支持机器人螺丝拧紧。
AI.result: 在60个新的自然语言输入中，86.7%实现机器人螺丝拧紧可装配，比先前工作提升十倍；对其中10个结构，用两台UR5e机器人进行了物理装配演示。
AI.conclusion: 该工作朝着按需机器人制造迈出重要一步，可实现定制化、小批量产品的快速生产。

title: LighTROcc: Lightweight 4D Occupancy Forecasting via Instance-Centric 3D Gaussians
summary: Forecasting future 3D occupancy from surround-view cameras is essential for autonomous driving, yet existing approaches rely on dense voxel or bird's-eye-view representations whose cost grows rapidly with spatial resolution and prediction horizon. Because these representations do not explicitly maintain object identities, they also struggle to preserve instance consistency over time. We present LighTROcc, a lightweight instance-centric framework that represents movable objects with a compact set of learned queries and predicts present and future occupancy in a single forward pass. LighTROcc localizes each query through attention-guided forward lifting, combining image-space cross-attention, query-specific depth, and camera geometry to estimate its 3D center. Each instance is modeled as a mixture of anisotropic 3D Gaussians and propagated across future steps using predicted displacements, producing continuous, temporally consistent occupancy forecasts. Experiments on nuScenes and supplemented nuScenes-Occupancy show that LighTROcc outperforms the evaluated dense and instance-wise baselines in instance-level forecasting accuracy while maintaining strong voxel-level occupancy quality. Across different model configurations, LighTROcc achieves a favorable balance between forecasting accuracy and computational efficiency, demonstrating the potential of compact instance-centric modeling for camera-based 4D occupancy forecasting.

AI.tldr: LighTROcc：一种轻量级、以实例为中心的框架，用学习到的查询表示可移动物体，单次前向即预测当前与未来的3D占用，实现高效且时序一致的4D占用预测。
AI.motivation: 现有基于环视相机的未来3D占用预测依赖稠密体素或鸟瞰图表示，成本随空间分辨率和预测时域迅速增长；且这些表示不显式维护物体身份，难以在时间上保持实例一致性。因此需要一种紧凑、以实例为中心的表示方法。
AI.method: 用一组紧凑的学习查询表示可移动物体，单次前向预测当前与未来占用。通过注意力引导的前向提升定位每个查询：结合图像空间交叉注意力、查询特定深度与相机几何估计其3D中心。每个实例建模为各向异性3D高斯的混合，并利用预测位移传播到未来步骤，产生连续、时序一致的占用预测。
AI.result: 在nuScenes与补充的nuScenes-Occupancy上，LighTROcc在实例级预测精度上优于所评估的稠密与实例级基线，同时保持较强的体素级占用质量。在不同模型配置下，取得了预测精度与计算效率之间的良好平衡。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明紧凑的实例中心建模在基于相机的4D占用预测中具有潜力，兼顾精度与效率。

title: Consistent Distribution Matching for Data-Free Diffusion Distillation
summary: Flow and diffusion models suffer from slow inference due to computationally expensive numerical integration. Distillation provides a promising way for a student model to learn from a teacher's dynamics, enabling one-step or few-step generation. However, existing methods often depend on curated distillation datasets, costly teacher rollouts, or auxiliary proxy networks, which complicate model training and scaling. In this work, we propose Consistent Distribution Matching, a simulation-free and data-free distillation method for accelerating diffusion and flow models while preserving strong generative capacity. Our key insight is to unify sample generation and score estimation with one student network. Thus, our framework uses only two models, a frozen teacher and a trainable student, and optimizes one objective. We prove that minimizing our objective indicates Wasserstein convergence of the student flow-map pushforwards to the teacher marginals. On ImageNet 256$\times$256, our method attains an FID of 2.04 with a single function evaluation (1-NFE) and a 4-NFE FID of 1.37 within 40 epochs of training, surpassing the state-of-the-art distillation baselines without data. Our code code and model are available at https://consistentdmd.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一致性分布匹配（Consistent Distribution Matching），一种无需模拟、无需数据的扩散与流模型蒸馏方法，用单一学生网络统一采样生成与分数估计，实现快速生成。
AI.motivation: 扩散与流模型因昂贵的数值积分而推理缓慢，现有蒸馏方法依赖精选数据集、昂贵的教师轨迹或辅助代理网络，增加了训练与扩展的复杂度。
AI.method: 提出一致性分布匹配，统一样本生成与分数估计于一个学生网络，仅使用一个冻结教师和一个可训练学生模型，优化单一目标函数；理论上证明最小化该目标意味着学生流映射推前分布到教师边缘分布的Wasserstein收敛。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256×256上，1-NFE的FID达2.04，4-NFE的FID为1.37，仅需40个训练epoch，在无数据条件下超越最先进蒸馏基线。
AI.conclusion: 该方法是无需模拟和数据的蒸馏方案，结构简单、可扩展，能有效加速扩散与流模型并保持强生成能力。

title: MIMESIS: Learning User Simulators as Training Environments for Interactive Agents
summary: Training and evaluating interactive language agents typically requires rich user interactions, yet collecting human feedback is expensive and difficult to scale. Simulated users offer a scalable alternative, but they must both resemble real user behavior and provide useful learning experiences for agents. In contrast, most agent-training frameworks rely on off-the-shelf assistant LLMs, whose helpfulness can make them overly cooperative, explicit, and behaviorally homogeneous compared with real users. We introduce MIMESIS, a purpose-built user simulator trained on human conversations with explicit reasoning supervision and 13 realistic behavioral patterns derived from real user interactions. Empirically, our 9B model achieves a SOUL-Index of 65.7, surpassing the strongest frontier model. Compared with Claude-Opus-5, the strongest baseline on RealUserSim and SimulatorArena, MIMESIS improves behavioral fidelity by 13.4 points and reduces Turing distance by 3.6 points, respectively. We then freeze the simulator and train an agent by interacting with the frozen simulator using multi-turn reinforcement learning. Across eight environments, training with MIMESIS yields better agent performance than training with GPT-5.5 under all nine unseen user simulators, demonstrating stronger generalization to new user simulators. Moreover, we propose Coached On-Policy Self-Distillation (CSD), which leverages simulator-generated private reasoning traces and subsequent utterances as feedback on how well the agent addresses user needs. A coach converts this information into concise coaching notes that describe how the agent can better anticipate user needs and adapt its behavior over the course of an interaction. CSD turns this feedback into dense, token-level supervision beyond sparse task rewards, yielding further gains across all nine evaluation user models.

AI.tldr: 提出 MIMESIS 用户模拟器（9B，基于真实人机对话与13种行为模式训练），其行为保真度和拟人性超过前沿模型；冻结该模拟器后用多轮强化学习训练智能体，泛化性优于用 GPT-5.5 训练；并提出 CSD 方法利用模拟器推理轨迹提供密集监督，进一步提升性能。
AI.motivation: 训练和评估交互式语言智能体需要丰富的用户交互，但人类反馈成本高、难扩展。现有模拟器多依赖通用助手型 LLM，其"有求必应"的倾向使其比真实用户更配合、更直白、行为更同质化，既缺乏行为保真度，也难以提供有效的学习经验。
AI.method: 1) MIMESIS：基于真实用户对话数据构建的用户模拟器，带有显式推理监督，并融入13种源自真实交互的行为模式，规模为9B。2) 冻结该模拟器，通过多轮强化学习让智能体与之交互进行训练。3) 提出 Coached On-Policy Self-Distillation（CSD）：利用模拟器生成的私有推理轨迹与后续发言作为反馈，由一个"教练"将其转化为简洁的指导笔记，描述智能体如何更好预判用户需求并调整行为，从而形成 token 级的密集监督。
AI.result: MIMESIS 的 SOUL-Index 达 65.7，超过最强前沿模型。在 RealUserSim 和 SimulatorArena 上，相比最强基线 Claude-Opus-5，行为保真度提升 13.4 分，图灵距离降低 3.6 分。在八个环境中，用 MIMESIS 训练的智能体在全部九种未见过的用户模拟器上均优于用 GPT-5.5 训练的结果。加入 CSD 后，在全部九个评估用户模型上均取得进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 专门构建、具备真实行为模式与推理监督的用户模拟器能显著提升行为保真度与拟人性，并可作为有效的智能体训练环境带来更强泛化能力；利用模拟器推理轨迹进行教练式自蒸馏，可将稀疏任务奖励扩展为密集监督，进一步改善智能体表现。

title: End-to-End Autonomous Generation of Human Assembly Plans
summary: Turning a CAD design into an assembly plan is still largely done by hand, requiring engineers to reason about geometric feasibility, tool access, stability, and the ergonomics of human assembly. In this work, we encode long-established design for assembly (DfA) principles into a contained, end-to-end approach for generating assembly plans. Our approach takes only a mesh assembly and produces either a step-by-step assembly manual or a structured failure report, requiring no joint metadata, fastener annotations, or additional information. Four major components of a manufacturing plan are addressed autonomously: an assembly tool list, the assembly sequence and subassemblies, an assembly manual, and design feedback for improving assemblability. For determining the sequence plan, we systematically disassemble the object in a physics simulator and apply a cost function that encodes DfA principles. Manual generation, tool labelling, and assembly feedback rely primarily on multimodal large language models. Compared with a baseline that always removes the outermost part first from Tian et al., DfA-aware sequence planning reduces simulated assembly time, measured with a robot-arm assembly-time proxy, by 35% on 136 assemblies of 5 to 30 parts. The correct tool is selected for 88.6% of assembly steps. A vision-language model judge compares the generated manuals against ablated variants, identifying which page elements carry the information a reader needs. The presented approach and open-source code are available for use by engineers or AI agents looking to rapidly accelerate the creation of manufacturing plans for a given product design.

AI.tldr: 将DfA原则编码进端到端流程，仅凭网格装配体自动生成装配计划，包括工具清单、序列与子装配、装配手册和设计反馈。
AI.motivation: 将CAD设计转化为装配计划目前仍主要依赖手工，工程师需人工推理几何可行性、工具可达性、稳定性及装配人机工效，效率低。现有方法通常需要关节元数据、紧固件标注等额外信息。
AI.method: 将长期确立的面向装配设计（DfA）原则编码为端到端方法：输入仅为网格装配体，无需关节元数据或紧固件标注。序列规划通过在物理模拟器中系统性地拆卸物体并应用编码DfA原则的代价函数实现；手册生成、工具标注和装配反馈主要依赖多模态大语言模型。
AI.result: 相比Tian等人"总是先移除最外层零件"的基线，DfA感知的序列规划在136个（5至30个零件）装配体上将模拟装配时间（以机械臂装配时间代理指标衡量）降低35%；88.6%的装配步骤选择了正确工具。视觉-语言模型评审对比生成手册与消融变体，识别出哪些页面元素承载读者所需信息。
AI.conclusion: 该方法与开源代码可供工程师或AI代理使用，以快速加速给定产品设计的制造计划创建。

title: From Global Alignment to Local Grounding: Zero-Shot Chinese Character Recognition with Radical Verification
summary: Zero-shot Chinese character recognition (ZS-CCR) aims to recognize characters whose categories are never observed during training, and typically relies on the compositional structure shared between seen and unseen characters. Recent CLIP-style methods represent this structure with the Ideographic Description Sequence (IDS) and align it with glyph images in a shared embedding space. However, they rely on a single global image--IDS similarity that discards the spatial layout of radicals and, being learned only implicitly from seen classes, generalizes poorly to unseen ones; moreover, global matching often retrieves the correct character within the top candidates yet fails to rank it first when characters differ only in subtle local radicals. To address these issues, we propose a global-to-local two-stage framework. In the first stage, STG-CLIP augments the IDS with explicit tree-position and radical-level geometric priors, yielding a spatial-aware prototype that provides a consistent spatial description across seen and unseen categories for high-recall global retrieval. In the second stage, the Radical Verification Module (RVM) uses the radical instances of each retrieved candidate as queries to verify whether the corresponding radicals can be matched to spatially compatible regions in the input glyph. A margin-based gating rule activates the RVM only when the leading global candidates receive similar similarity scores. Experiments on the ICDAR2013 benchmark demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance under the character-level zero-shot setting, obtaining 83.06% top-1 accuracy with 2,755 seen classes. Ablation studies further show that the explicit geometric priors and radical-level verification provide complementary improvements.

AI.tldr: 提出全局到局部的两阶段零样本汉字识别框架 STG-CLIP+RVM，在 ICDAR2013 上达到领先水平。
AI.motivation: 现有 CLIP 式方法用 IDS 与字形图像在共享空间中对齐，但仅依赖单一全局“图像—IDS”相似度，丢失了部首的空间布局；且相似度仅从可见类隐式学习，对未见类泛化差。此外，当字符仅局部部首细微不同时，全局匹配虽能把正确字符召回进候选，却难以将其排到第一。
AI.method: 提出全局到局部的两阶段框架。第一阶段 STG-CLIP：在 IDS 中引入显式的树位置与部首级几何先验，生成具空间感知的原型，为可见与未见类别提供一致的空间描述，实现高召回全局检索。第二阶段部首验证模块（RVM）：以每个检索候选的部首实例为查询，验证其能否与输入字形中空间相容的区域匹配。采用基于边际的门控规则，仅当领先的全局候选取到相近相似度分数时才激活 RVM。
AI.result: 在 ICDAR2013 基准上，于字符级零样本设置下取得最优性能，在 2,755 个可见类下达到 83.06% 的 top-1 准确率。消融实验表明显式几何先验与部首级验证提供了互补的提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式空间先验与局部部首验证的结合，缓解了全局匹配在空间布局缺失和细粒度区分上的不足，验证了全局到局部两阶段框架在零样本汉字识别中的有效性。

title: Conditional Accuracy Profiles: Diagnosing LLM Judges across Deployment Conditions
summary: LLM-as-judge is now a standard tool for scalable evaluation, but judge performance is still often summarized by a single accuracy number. This aggregate view hides the deployment conditions under which a judge succeeds or fails. We introduce \textbf{Conditional Accuracy Profiling} (CAP), a post-hoc diagnostic framework that decomposes pairwise LLM-judge accuracy into eight conditions organized into content sensitivity, robustness, and rationale quality. CAP is benchmark-agnostic: it can be applied directly when a benchmark provides the required annotations, approximately through task-subset proxies, or through controlled augmentation when perturbation pairs can be generated. We instantiate CAP on seven LLM judges across six pairwise judging benchmarks, including \textsc{judgerEva-Standard}, a controlled testbed we created to support all eight conditions. CAP exposes profile differences hidden by aggregate accuracy: on \textsc{judgerEva}'s judge-independent Hard-Constructed subset, the two judges most sensitive to omitted qualifications rank in the bottom three of seven by overall accuracy, so omission sensitivity is not predicted by aggregate accuracy. Across benchmarks, Position Robustness shows the strongest rank stability (mean Spearman $\barρ{=}0.87$) but is itself fragile under JudgeBench-Pro adversarial stress, showing the largest mean accuracy drop among the shared conditions, though the dominant degradation channel varies by judge. Condition-level profiles provide a more actionable basis than aggregate accuracy for selecting LLM judges.

AI.tldr: 本文提出条件准确度画像（CAP）诊断框架，将LLM判官的成对准确率分解为内容敏感性、鲁棒性和理由质量三类共八个条件，并在七个判官与六个基准上实例化验证。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM-as-judge评估常用单一准确率数字概括判官表现，掩盖了判官在何种部署条件下成功或失败，难以指导实际选型。
AI.method: CAP为事后诊断框架，把成对判官准确率分解为八个条件，归入内容敏感性、鲁棒性、理由质量三类；框架与基准无关，可直接用于带标注的基准、通过任务子集代理近似，或通过可控扰动增强实现。作者在七个LLM判官、六个成对评判基准上实例化，并构建judgerEva-Standard受控测试床以支持全部八个条件。
AI.result: CAP揭示了总体准确率所掩盖的画像差异：在judgerEva的Hard-Constructed子集上，对省略条件最敏感的两个判官总体准确率仅排七者中的后三位，说明省略敏感性无法由总体准确率预测；跨基准中位置鲁棒性排名最稳定（平均Spearman ρ=0.87），但在JudgeBench-Pro对抗压力下最脆弱，平均准确率下降最大，且主导退化渠道因判官而异。
AI.conclusion: 条件级画像比总体准确率更能为LLM判官选择提供可操作的依据。

title: The Attribution Blind Spot: Layerwise Trajectory Diagnostics for Source Reliance in Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
summary: A retrieval-augmented model can match a document without relying on it. Controlled knowledge conflicts make source choice observable and let us ask a second question that prediction alone cannot answer: which internal-state properties define useful intervention directions? We study paired hidden-state changes with Latent Trajectory Shift (LTS), a signed projection onto a training-fitted first principal component (PC1), and keep verified training exposure separate from behavioral source choice. Across the evaluated conflicts, state-change magnitude is often the stronger predictor, whereas signed PC1 is the stronger selective controller: equal-norm interventions change source preference while better preserving non-target behavior, and the frozen direction transfers across the tested datasets and aligned model pairs. A same-system OLMo study further combines positive choice and control results with inconclusive exposure detection at the achieved power. The central result is a separation: representations that diagnose what a model will choose need not be the representations that best control that choice.

AI.tldr: 本文研究检索增强模型在知识冲突下的源选择行为，提出隐轨迹偏移（LTS）方法，发现状态变化幅度更适合诊断选择，而有符号PC1投影是更强的选择性控制方向，二者存在分离。
AI.motivation: 检索增强模型可能在未依赖文档的情况下匹配文档，且仅靠预测无法回答哪些内部状态属性定义了有用的干预方向。作者希望通过受控知识冲突使源选择变得可观测，从而区分诊断性表征与控制性表征。
AI.method: 采用受控知识冲突设计，将训练暴露与行为源选择分离。研究成对隐状态变化，提出隐轨迹偏移（LTS），即对训练拟合的第一主成分（PC1）进行有符号投影，并进行等范数干预与跨数据集、对齐模型对的迁移测试，另在同一系统OLMo上开展研究。
AI.result: 在所评估的冲突中，状态变化幅度通常是更强的预测因子，而有符号PC1是更强的选择性控制器：等范数干预能改变源偏好，同时更好保留非目标行为；冻结方向可在测试数据集和对齐模型对间迁移。OLMo研究将正向选择与控制结果与在现有功效下不确定的暴露检测相结合。
AI.conclusion: 核心结论是一种分离：用于诊断模型将选择什么的表征，未必是最能控制该选择的表征。诊断性与控制性内部状态属性可以不同。

title: Enhancing Robotic Perception and Adaptability through Sensor Fusion and Origami-Inspired Designs
summary: Compact mobile robots must recover scene geometry under changing lighting and surface texture while working within tight payload and cost limits. We present a compact mobile robot that uses origami-inspired wheels for locomotion and active control of its sensing geometry. As the wheels move between terrain-adaptive configurations, the changing chassis pitch sweeps a 2D LiDAR through intermediate elevations; held wheel positions provide a chosen viewing angle. An IMU accounts for chassis attitude, and a fusion node projects LiDAR returns into the RGB-D depth stream supplied to RTAB-Map. The arrangement uses the wheel actuation already present on a sub-300 USD, sub-2 kg prototype to extend the scanner's viewing geometry. We assess depth fusion in a textureless indoor corridor and an outdoor sunlit area, with three runs per sensor configuration in each setting. Mean full-frame invalid-depth fractions fell from 21% to 11% indoors and from 48% to 18% outdoors. The prototype combines improved depth coverage with a continuously adjustable LiDAR viewpoint using the same actuation that reconfigures its wheels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种紧凑移动机器人，利用折纸启发式轮子实现运动并主动控制传感几何，通过轮子姿态变化扫动2D LiDAR视角，并与RGB-D深度流融合，在纹理缺失室内走廊和户外阳光下将无效深度比例分别从21%降至11%、从48%降至18%。
AI.motivation: 紧凑移动机器人需在光照变化和表面纹理多变的环境中恢复场景几何，同时受载荷与成本限制，因此需要一种低成本、轻量且能提升深度感知覆盖的方案。
AI.method: 采用折纸启发式轮子进行运动并主动调整传感几何；轮子在不同地形自适应配置间移动时，底盘俯仰变化带动2D LiDAR扫过中间高度，固定轮位可提供选定视角；IMU补偿底盘姿态，融合节点将LiDAR回波投影到供RTAB-Map使用的RGB-D深度流中，复用已有的轮子驱动。
AI.result: 在纹理缺失的室内走廊和户外阳光区域测试，每种传感器配置在每个场景各运行三次；平均全帧无效深度比例室内从21%降至11%，户外从48%降至18%。
AI.conclusion: 该原型利用同一套轮子重构驱动，同时实现了更好的深度覆盖与连续可调的LiDAR视角，验证了低成本紧凑机器人在复杂环境下的深度感知增强能力。

title: Iris-3B: Going Beyond the Latent with Pixel-Space Diffusion Training, Conversion and Fine-Tuning
comment: 19 pages, 13 figures, 6 tables. Project lead: Hanqiu Li Cai. Code and models: https://github.com/speridlabs
summary: Pixel-space diffusion models avoid the lossy VAE of latent models, which suggests an advantage on downstream tasks where fine-grained detail matters. We test this claim along both routes to a pixel-space backbone. We pretrain Iris-3B, a 3B-parameter pixel-space text-to-image transformer, from scratch through a $256\to512\to1024$ curriculum, after first ablating the prediction target and representation alignment at $256^2$ to decide what to scale. We also convert a pretrained latent model, FLUX.2 Klein base 4B, to pixel space. We fine-tune both families for monocular depth estimation and for image restoration/super-resolution. We find no significant improvement from using a pixel-space generative prior. Fine-tuned for depth with one matched direct-regression recipe, Iris-3B is level with the latent FLUX.2 Klein and the converted pixel FLUX.2 Klein falls behind it, and on $4\times$ DIV2K restoration neither pixel model beats a latent FLUX.2 Klein fine-tune, the converted one trailing it slightly. We document the recipes, the failure modes and the remaining confounds behind this negative result. Nevertheless, Iris-3B shows that pixel-space pretraining with the pixel-transformer (PiT) head of PixelDiT scales to 3B parameters and to text-to-image quality competitive with latent models, matching Qwen-Image on OneIG under the official evaluators at $1024^2$. We release its weights and training code in the hope that they help pave the way for further work on pixel-space generation.

AI.tldr: 通过从零训练 3B 像素空间模型 Iris-3B 并将潜空间模型 FLUX.2 Klein 4B 转换为像素空间，作者在深度估计与图像复原任务上未发现像素空间生成先验带来显著优势，但证明像素空间预训练可扩展至 3B 并达到与潜空间模型相当的文生图质量。
AI.motivation: 像素空间扩散模型绕过了潜空间模型中有损的 VAE，理论上在需要精细细节的下游任务上更具优势。本文旨在检验这一说法是否成立，并探索像素空间骨干网络的可扩展性。
AI.method: 沿两条路径构建像素空间骨干：一是从零预训练 3B 参数像素空间文生图 Transformer（Iris-3B），先经 256→512→1024 课程，并在 256² 上消融预测目标与表征对齐以决定扩展方案；二是将预训练潜空间模型 FLUX.2 Klein base 4B 转换为像素空间。随后对两族模型在单目深度估计和图像复原/超分任务上微调，并采用匹配的直接回归配方进行对比。
AI.result: 使用像素空间生成先验未带来显著提升。深度估计上，Iris-3B 与潜空间 FLUX.2 Klein 持平，而转换后的像素版 FLUX.2 Klein 落后；在 4× DIV2K 复原任务上，两个像素模型均未胜过潜空间 FLUX.2 Klein 微调版，转换版略差。同时 Iris-3B 证明像素空间预训练配合 PixelDiT 的 PiT 头可扩展至 3B，在 1024² 下用官方评测器在 OneIG 上与 Qwen-Image 持平。
AI.conclusion: 像素空间生成先验在细粒度下游任务上并不必然优于潜空间模型，这是一个负面结果，论文记录了配方、失败模式与剩余混杂因素。但像素空间预训练的可扩展性与文生图质量得到验证，作者开源 Iris-3B 权重与训练代码以推动后续研究。

title: Symmetry-Informed Causal Partial Identification
summary: Partial identification (PI) entails estimating bounds on causal effects by encoding different assumptions on data generation as a constrained optimization problem. Such bounds can suffice to inform policy decisions even if the causal effect itself is not identifiable. Often vacuous in practice, practitioners seek to exhaustively encode domain knowledge as additional constraints to make the PI bounds more informative. We introduce known data symmetries -- invariance of the causal effect under certain data transformations -- as a new source of constraints to inform PI. We operationalize this as a shape constraint on the causal function, and via a change of measure against which PI is posed using simple data pre-processing. Both approaches are shown to sharpen bounds under two canonical PI models. This is shown both theoretically for the population case, and via experiments in the finite-sample case. More broadly, our framework establishes data symmetries as a natural, underutilized source of background knowledge for robust causal inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将已知的数据对称性作为部分识别（PI）的新约束来源，通过对因果函数施加形状约束和数据预处理的方法，在两个经典PI模型中使因果效应的边界更紧。
AI.motivation: 部分识别（PI）通过在数据生成假设上编码约束来估计因果效应的边界，即便因果效应本身不可识别，边界也足以指导政策决策。但这类边界在实践中常常是空洞的（vacuous），因此研究者希望尽可能多地将领域知识编码为额外约束以使边界更具信息量。作者认为数据对称性是一类尚未被充分利用的背景知识来源，可用来强化PI。
AI.method: 作者引入"已知数据对称性"（即因果效应在某些数据变换下的不变性）作为PI的约束来源。具体操作化为两种方式：一是将其表示为对因果函数的形状约束；二是通过与简单数据预处理相关的测度变换来重新表述PI。
AI.result: 在两个经典PI模型中，两种方法均被证明能够收紧因果效应边界。这一结果在总体情形下获得了理论证明，并在有限样本情形下通过实验得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 该框架确立了数据对称性作为一种自然的、尚未被充分利用的背景知识来源，可用于稳健的因果推断，为提升部分识别边界的有效性提供了新思路。

title: Cognitive Schemas, Laws and Tasks
summary:
This paper asks how explicit representations can support reusable cognitive schemas in knowledge-based problem solving. We develop a structural framework in which schemas are organized by the information and relations required for their use, rather than introduced as unrelated primitives. The framework also distinguishes context-dependent relations from more stable structures that can be reused across different representations.
  Tasks are described through the information available, the unknowns to be determined, and the constraints that admissible solutions must satisfy. This makes it possible to separate limitations of the representation from limitations of the solving procedure. In particular, we distinguish inconsistency, underdetermination, and contextual insufficiency, where the current representation lacks distinctions or relations required by the external task meaning. We also show formally when a reduction of representation preserves the task-relevant solution structure.
  The resulting task--schema interface offers a structured way to describe representational conditions relevant to problem solving. It supports the reuse and stabilization of derived knowledge while remaining independent of the particular mechanism used to generate candidate solutions. This may provide a useful component for future solver architectures that combine structured knowledge, verification, and learned proposal mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个结构化框架，用以说明显式表示如何支持知识型问题求解中可复用的认知图式，并区分任务层面与求解程序层面的局限。
AI.motivation: 现有研究常将图式作为彼此无关的原始单元引入，缺乏对其组织方式和复用条件的结构性说明；同时难以区分表示本身的局限与求解程序的局限。
AI.method: 以使用图式所需的信息与关系来组织图式，并区分情境依赖关系与可跨表示复用的稳定结构；用可用信息、待求未知量和可容许解需满足的约束来描述任务，从而界定不一致、欠定与情境不充分三种情形；并形式化地给出表示约简保持任务相关解结构的条件。
AI.result: 建立了任务—图式接口，可结构化描述与问题求解相关的表示条件；该接口独立于候选解的生成机制，支持派生知识的复用与稳定化。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可作为未来求解器架构的组件，用于结合结构化知识、验证与学习式候选生成机制。

title: Towards Accurate End-Effector Localization for UMI-Style Robotic Manipulation Teaching
comment: 9 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://mild-web.github.io
summary: Robot demonstration learning requires accurate and temporally complete end-effector localization during close-range manipulation and camera occlusion. Existing SLAM benchmarks emphasize navigation motions, whereas manipulation datasets prioritize policy learning over localization evaluation. We introduce MILD, a Manipulation-Interface Localization Dataset with real-world and simulation sequences. The real-world subset provides 86 sensor sequences from Insta360 X5 and Insight9 across 15 repeated tabletop tasks, calibration assets, and a per-execution robot end-effector reference trajectory. The simulation subset, MILD-Sim, extends task coverage in Isaac Sim for controlled manipulation-replay studies. Benchmarking visual-inertial and fiducial-aided systems on instrumented real-world recordings reveals large differences in both TCP-relative trajectory error and temporal coverage, even under the same nominal task. To support marker-augmented teaching workspaces without a pre-surveyed fiducial map, we present AprilVINS, which combines fisheye visual-inertial estimation with sequence-local AprilTag geometry and separates prior admission from guarded export of the jointly optimized state. On Insta360 AprilTag4 recordings, AprilVINS(full) under a unified protocol with sequence-specific profiles reaches millimeter-level SE(3)-aligned TCP-relative APE RMSE with high time completion and lower reported error than the tested routes under their respective protocols, whereas fisheye VIO without tag factors remains at centimeter scale. Ablations separate accuracy from exportability, and a MILD-Sim replay study provides task-specific tolerance references for interpreting those error magnitudes. Together, MILD and AprilVINS provide a diagnostic benchmarking framework for UMI-style demonstration collection. Code, datasets, and evaluation manifests will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MILD数据集与AprilVINS方法，用于机器人演示学习中近距离操作与遮挡场景下的末端执行器定位基准测试。
AI.motivation: 机器人演示学习需要准确且时间完整的末端执行器定位，尤其在近距离操作与相机遮挡时。现有SLAM基准偏重导航运动，而操作数据集侧重策略学习而非定位评估，缺乏针对性的定位评测基准。
AI.method: 构建MILD数据集：真实子集包含来自Insta360 X5与Insight9的86个传感器序列，覆盖15个重复桌面任务，附标定资源与每次执行的末端执行器参考轨迹；仿真子集MILD-Sim基于Isaac Sim扩展任务覆盖。提出AprilVINS，将鱼眼视觉惯性估计与序列局部AprilTag几何结合，并分离先验准入与联合优化状态的受保护导出。
AI.result: 在真实录制上对视觉惯性与基准标记辅助系统进行基准测试，发现在相同任务下TCP相对轨迹误差与时间覆盖率差异显著。在Insta360 AprilTag4录制上，AprilVINS(full)达到毫米级SE(3)对齐的TCP相对APE RMSE，时间完成度高，误差低于对比路线；而无标签因子的鱼眼VIO仍为厘米级。消融实验分离了精度与可导出性，MILD-Sim回放研究提供了任务相关的容差参考。
AI.conclusion: MILD与AprilVINS共同构成面向UMI风格演示采集的诊断性基准框架，代码、数据集与评测清单将在接收后发布。

title: RLHND: Video Foundation Models as Physically Grounded Hand Trackers for Robot Learning
summary: Recently, approaches that leverage human video datasets for robot policy training have become increasingly prevalent. However, most existing hand trackers regress pose from cropped frames with limited priors on hand motion and object interaction, resulting in inaccurate and physically inconsistent estimates. Moreover, the lack of physical cues, e.g., contact and force, limits the use of human videos for robot policy training. To this end, we propose RLHND, a video foundation model-based hand tracking model that jointly estimates hand pose and realistic tactile information from monocular egocentric videos. RLHND turns the pre-trained Cosmos 3 video diffusion backbone into a deterministic clip-level feature extractor via clean-latent conditioning, carrying its learned priors on hand motion and hand-object interaction into tracking. For pose estimation, RLHND (i) predicts hand poses with anatomically plausible joint angles and (ii) enables optional conditioning on the shape parameter to maintain consistent hand shape within the same video and even across videos recorded by the same actor. For tactile estimation, a separate tactile expert stream, trained with the pose stream frozen, predicts dense contact and force over the hand surface. We further adopt LBS-based feature spreading to enable vertex-wise feature extraction without costly per-vertex attention. RLHND achieves state-of-the-art performance across various benchmark datasets for pose estimation, while also achieving state-of-the-art performance in contact and force estimation. Moreover, we demonstrate the utility of RLHND for robot learning through retargeting results and real-world robot experiments. The code will be publicly available at https://seungjun-moon.github.io/rlhnd/.

AI.tldr: RLHND 是基于视频基础模型的手部跟踪模型，从单目第一视角视频中联合估计手部姿态与触觉信息，并在姿态、接触与力估计上均达到 SOTA，且成功用于机器人学习。
AI.motivation: 利用人类视频训练机器人策略日益流行，但现有手部跟踪器多从裁剪帧回归姿态，对手部运动与手物交互的先验利用不足，估计不准确且物理不一致；同时缺乏接触、力等物理线索，限制了人类视频在机器人策略训练中的应用。
AI.method: 提出 RLHND：将预训练的 Cosmos 3 视频扩散骨干通过干净潜变量条件化转为确定性片段级特征提取器，继承手部运动与手物交互先验。姿态估计方面：(i) 预测具有解剖学合理关节角的手部姿态；(ii) 可选地以形状参数为条件，保持同一视频乃至同一演员不同视频间的手形一致。触觉估计方面：独立触觉专家流在姿态流冻结下训练，预测手部表面的密集接触与力。此外采用基于 LBS 的特征传播实现顶点级特征提取，避免昂贵的逐顶点注意力。
AI.result: RLHND 在多个姿态估计基准数据集上达到 SOTA，在接触与力估计上也达到 SOTA；并通过重定向结果与真实机器人实验验证了其在机器人学习中的实用性。
AI.conclusion: RLHND 通过引入视频基础模型先验与触觉估计，提升了单目第一视角手部跟踪的准确性与物理一致性，并为利用人类视频进行机器人策略训练提供了有效工具。代码将公开于 https://seungjun-moon.github.io/rlhnd/。

title: An Informational Curse of Horizon in Goal-Conditioned Policy Learning
summary: The difficulty of learning goal-reaching policies is often attributed to a "curse of horizon" that manifests as bias accumulation in temporal-difference backups and noisy advantage estimates. In this work, we identify an additional informational curse of horizon in goal-conditioned policy learning, where increasing the goal relabeling horizon can significantly reduce policy generalization and performance. Through a series of controlled experiments with oracle planners, we decouple the goal horizons sampled during training from those that the policy is asked to reach at test time. Even when evaluated only on a sequence of nearby subgoals, goal-conditioned behavioral cloning (BC) policies suffer from severe, training horizon-dependent performance degradation that is mitigated by reinforcement learning (RL) objectives. We explain this phenomenon as a horizon-dependent decrease in the conditional mutual information between actions and hindsight-relabeled goals, and find empirically that both BC and RL policies trained on longer-horizon goals exhibit a shift in sensitivity from goal to state information, as measured by the policy's input Jacobians. Motivated by this observation, we find that distilling the input Jacobians of short-horizon policies into long-horizon policies yields significant performance gains, especially in combinatorial manipulation tasks. Taken together, our results highlight goal relabeling horizon as an important consideration when learning generalist policies from offline data.

AI.tldr: 本文识别出目标条件策略学习中额外的"信息维度诅咒"，即增加目标重标记时间跨度会显著降低策略泛化能力，并提出通过输入雅可比蒸馏来缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 目标达成策略学习的困难常被归因于"时间跨度诅咒"，表现为时序差分备份中的偏差累积和噪声优势估计。作者希望探究在目标条件策略学习中是否存在额外的信息层面的时间跨度诅咒，即训练时的目标重标记时间跨度如何影响策略泛化与性能。
AI.method: 通过一系列使用oracle规划器的受控实验，将训练时采样的目标时间跨度与测试时要求达成的目标时间跨度解耦；分析动作与事后重标记目标之间条件互信息随时间跨度的变化；测量策略输入雅可比以观察策略对目标与状态信息敏感度的偏移；并尝试将短跨度策略的输入雅可比蒸馏到长跨度策略中。
AI.result: 即使仅在邻近子目标序列上评估，目标条件行为克隆（BC）策略也会出现严重的、依赖训练时间跨度的性能退化，而强化学习（RL）目标可缓解这一问题。研究发现动作与事后重标记目标之间的条件互信息随时间跨度增加而下降。BC和RL策略在长跨度目标训练后均表现出敏感度从目标信息向状态信息转移。将短跨度策略的输入雅可比蒸馏到长跨度策略可带来显著性能提升，尤其在组合式操作任务中。
AI.conclusion: 目标重标记时间跨度是离线数据学习通用策略时的一个重要考量因素，研究揭示了信息维度的时间跨度诅咒并提供了基于雅可比蒸馏的有效缓解方案。

title: Ream: Unfolding Mutual Awareness in Human-Agent Workspaces
summary: As AI agents work alongside humans in shared workspaces, a mutual awareness challenge arises: agents act at speeds that outpace human monitoring, and users' evolving interests are not always expressed in chat. This challenge is especially pressing in literature review, where both parties retrieve, read, and synthesize a growing body of papers. We present Ream, a literature review workspace that supports mutual awareness through structured artifacts, bidirectional engagement tracking, and localized visualizations. Users can see each party's activity within these documents, and agents can retrieve the same history to guide their work. In studies with eighteen researchers, participants used these traces to inspect evidence, steer agents, communicate through annotations, and reflect on their research focus. Shared histories also helped agents build on earlier work. These findings inform how engagement traces within shared documents can support transparency, personalized assistance, and coordination in human-agent knowledge work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Ream——一个文献综述工作空间，通过结构化制品、双向参与跟踪与局部可视化来促进人与 AI 智能体之间的相互感知，并在 18 名研究者的研究中验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 当 AI 智能体与人类在同一工作空间协作时，智能体的行动速度超过人类的监控能力，而用户不断变化的兴趣又未必体现在聊天中，这形成了"相互感知"挑战。在文献综述场景中尤为突出，因为双方都在检索、阅读和综合不断增长的论文。
AI.method: 设计并实现了 Ream 工作空间，具备三项核心机制：结构化制品、双向参与跟踪、局部可视化。用户可在文档内查看双方活动，智能体也可检索相同历史来指导自身工作。随后开展了一项包含 18 名研究者的用户研究。
AI.result: 参与者利用这些参与痕迹来审查证据、引导智能体、通过批注进行沟通，并反思自身研究重点；共享历史还帮助智能体在早期工作基础上继续推进。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，共享文档中的参与痕迹能够支持人-智能体知识工作中的透明度、个性化协助与协调。

title: Juno: Taming Predictive Latents for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) predict masked or future observations in representation space, offering a natural source of predictive latents for vision-language-action (VLA) models. Yet making these latents useful across pretraining, policy learning, and deployment requires addressing three failures: mismatch with embodiment-specific control, interference with action learning, and teacher miscalibration under distribution shifts. We introduce Juno, a unified framework built around one action-conditioned JEPA that serves as a control-aligned representation backbone, a predictive teacher, and an adaptable dynamics model. During pretraining, we train it on embodiment-matched trajectories and use a dynamic CLS loss to transfer motion-weighted patch dynamics to a compact global state. During policy learning, we fuse current-frame JEPA patches into VLA perception and use a decoupled reasoning branch with separate transformation parameters to distill future latent states for action generation. During deployment, we adapt the world model on all observed transitions, including failed rollouts, freeze the adapted teacher, and re-align the policy on verified executions using LoRA adapters and a trainable action head, without expert corrections or task rewards. On SimplerEnv, Juno raises average success from $60.9\%$ to $68.5\%$ over Qwen3GR00T, the strongest baseline, and test-time adaptation further reaches $72.7\%$; on a real robot, it retains $70\%$--$75\%$ success under background, height, and object shifts where the base policy collapses to $0\%$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一框架 Juno，围绕一个动作条件 JEPA，同时充当控制对齐表征骨干、预测教师和可适应动力学模型，改善 VLA 模型在预训练、策略学习和部署中的表现。
AI.motivation: JEPA 可在表征空间预测掩码或未来观测，为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型提供预测性隐变量。但要使其在预训练、策略学习和部署中均有效，需解决三个失败：与具体具身控制不匹配、对动作学习造成干扰、以及分布偏移下教师模型失准。
AI.method: Juno 使用一个动作条件 JEPA 作为统一骨干。预训练阶段在具身匹配轨迹上训练，并用动态 CLS 损失将运动加权 patch 动力学迁移到紧凑全局状态；策略学习阶段将当前帧 JEPA patch 融合进 VLA 感知，并使用带独立变换参数的解耦推理分支蒸馏未来隐状态用于动作生成；部署阶段在所有观测转移（含失败 rollout）上自适应世界模型，冻结适应后的教师，再用 LoRA 适配器和可训练动作头在已验证执行上重新对齐策略，无需专家纠正或任务奖励。
AI.result: 在 SimplerEnv 上，Juno 将平均成功率从最强基线 Qwen3GR00T 的 60.9% 提升到 68.5%，测试时自适应进一步提升至 72.7%；在真实机器人上，面对背景、高度和物体变化，Juno 保持 70%–75% 成功率，而基础策略降至 0%。
AI.conclusion: 通过单一动作条件 JEPA 统一表征骨干、预测教师与动力学模型，Juno 有效应对具身控制不匹配、动作学习干扰和教师失准问题，显著提升仿真与真实场景下的策略鲁棒性和成功率。

title: An Invariant Tangent-Angle Descriptor and a Band U-Net for 2D Fragment Adjacency Prediction
summary: This paper addresses the prediction of adjacency between pairs of 2D fragments based on their contours. We improved the two-stage architecture proposed in Beaulac's thesis, in which a rotation-equivariant Siamese convolutional neural network scores pairs of local image windows along the two contours of two fragments. The scores are gathered in an adjacency matrix in which a ResNet detects the partial anti-diagonal band that reveals the adjacency of two fragments. In the current work, we keep the pipeline and replace the local score by a comparison of tangent-angle profiles of contour windows, making it, by construction, invariant to fragment rotation and agnostic to the selected contour-starting point. These adaptations may be either a training-free likelihood ratio or a small one-dimensional convolutional model trained on corresponding points. We also replaced the final classifier by a band U-Net that segments the band and classifies the pair, so that the shared arc is obtained along with the decision. In the synthetic data set of the original thesis, the tangent descriptor performs as well as or better than the image-window approach in all tested configurations. The proposed pipeline reaches an accuracy of 98%, vs 93% to 95% for the original approach once its evaluation is corrected. We tested our pipeline, with models trained only on synthetic data, on the PairingNet benchmark, and obtained an AUC of 0.93. Furthermore, under the PairingNet pair-searching protocol conditions, our learned descriptor obtains a Recall@10 of 0.82 on the real set against 0.56 from the best model of the original paper.

AI.tldr: 本文改进两阶段拼图碎片配对流程，用切线角轮廓替代图像窗口得分，并用带状U-Net替代ResNet分类器，在合成数据上达98%准确率，在PairingNet上AUC为0.93。
AI.motivation: 原方法使用旋转等变孪生卷积网络对局部图像窗口打分，对碎片旋转和轮廓起点敏感，且分类器仅给出配对决策而不输出共享弧。本文希望构建对旋转与起点不变的描述子，并同时获得配对决策与共享弧。
AI.method: 保留原两阶段架构，将局部得分替换为轮廓窗口切线角轮廓的比较（构造上对旋转不变、对轮廓起点不敏感），可采用免训练似然比或在小规模对应点上训练的一维卷积模型；并将最终分类器替换为带状U-Net以分割带状区域并分类成对碎片。
AI.result: 在原论文合成数据集上，切线描述子在所有测试配置中不劣于甚至优于图像窗口方法；修正评估后流程准确率达98%，原方法为93%-95%。仅在合成数据上训练，在PairingNet上取得AUC 0.93；在PairingNet配对搜索协议下，真实集Recall@10为0.82，而原论文最佳模型为0.56。
AI.conclusion: 切线角轮廓描述子相比图像窗口方法更有效且具旋转与起点不变性，带状U-Net可同时给出配对决策与共享弧，且合成数据训练的模型能较好泛化到真实基准。

title: Efficient Best-of-N policy evaluation for inference-time alignment
summary: Best-of-N (BoN) is a common inference-time alignment method that selects the highest-scoring response among N samples from a reference model. Evaluating BoN policies from logged data is challenging under sample-only access because standard off-policy estimators require density ratios that depend on unavailable response likelihoods. In this paper, we propose a sample-only framework for evaluating and selecting BoN policies without access to these likelihoods. We show that the order-statistic structure of BoN allows the required density ratios to be expressed through score-rank probabilities that are estimable from samples alone. We then develop a doubly robust estimator of the BoN policy value (BoN-DR) that efficiently reuses a shared auxiliary sample pool across candidate budgets. We establish valid asymptotic inference even under reward estimator misspecification and prove the efficiency of our BoN-DR estimator. Since larger budgets can amplify errors in the score function and lead to reward overoptimization, we derive two selection rules: (i) maximizing the estimated policy value and (ii) maximizing a lower confidence bound on the improvement over the reference policy, which accounts for estimation uncertainty and provides a no-harm guarantee. Across synthetic experiments and GSM8K with multiple reference and reward models, our framework accurately estimates BoN policy values and selects effective sampling budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出仅依赖样本的Best-of-N策略评估与选择框架，无需响应似然，利用顺序统计结构估计密度比，并给出双重稳健估计器与两种预算选择规则。
AI.motivation: Best-of-N是一种常见的推理时对齐方法，但仅凭日志样本评估其策略十分困难，因为标准的离策略估计需要依赖不可得的响应似然来计算密度比。
AI.method: 作者证明BoN的顺序统计结构可将所需密度比表示为可由样本估计的分数-秩概率，进而提出BoN-DR双重稳健估计器，可在候选预算间复用共享辅助样本池；在奖励估计误设下仍保证渐近推断有效，并证明其效率；同时给出两种选择规则：最大化估计策略值和最大化相对参考策略改进的下置信界。
AI.result: 在合成实验以及GSM8K上使用多种参考模型和奖励模型的实验中，该框架能准确估计BoN策略价值并选出有效的采样预算。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在仅样本访问条件下实现了BoN策略的可靠评估与预算选择，并提供无损害保证，缓解了预算增大导致的奖励过度优化问题。

title: Reliability of LLM Judges for Evaluating Entity Alignment
summary: Entity Alignment (EA) identifies equivalent entities across knowledge graphs and is critical for knowledge base integration and ontology merging. Evaluating EA systems at scale requires expensive expert annotation, making systematic assessment across diverse domains practically infeasible. LLM-as-judge evaluation offers a potentially scalable alternative, yet its reliability for structured prediction tasks like EA remains unstudied. We present the first systematic benchmarking study across three frontier models, three datasets, and four EA systems, using perturbation bias diagnostics, meta-evaluation across all dataset-judge-prompt combinations, and counterfactual label-flip tests. We identify anchor bias, a failure mode in which judges invert discrimination when the system's decision label is visible. Label exposure causally collapses judge discrimination (J-ROC-AUC 0.12-0.87), while a label-free protocol recovers near-ceiling capability on distinctive-name datasets (0.93-1.00) and significant recovery on biomedical pairs (0.93-0.95). Counterfactual experiments confirm causality (FSR 53-99%) and reveal a frontier model paradox: stronger judges exhibit greater label sensitivity, not less. A blinded two-annotator human evaluation (102 pairs, Cohen's kappa=0.902) confirms this mechanism directly. We release the first biomedical EA benchmark (MeSH-SNOMED CT, 15K pairs) and a reproducible auditing framework for LLM judge reliability in EA. Code and data are available at https://github.com/vaibhavalakshmiravideshik/llm-as-a-judge-entity-alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统评测LLM-as-judge在实体对齐(EA)任务中的可靠性，发现"锚点偏差"：当系统决策标签可见时，评判模型的判别能力崩溃；而标签隐藏协议可大幅恢复评测性能。
AI.motivation: 大规模评测实体对齐系统需要昂贵的专家标注，跨领域系统评估在实践中难以实现。LLM-as-judge提供了可扩展的替代方案，但其在EA这类结构化预测任务中的可靠性尚缺乏研究。
AI.method: 跨三个前沿模型、三个数据集、四个EA系统进行基准测试，采用扰动偏差诊断、覆盖所有"数据集-评判模型-提示"组合的元评估，以及反事实标签翻转测试；并开展102对样本的双标注者盲评人类评估进行验证。
AI.result: 发现锚点偏差导致标签可见时评判判别力崩溃(J-ROC-AUC 0.12-0.87)；无标签协议在独特名称数据集上几乎恢复至上限(0.93-1.00)，在生物医学对上显著恢复(0.93-0.95)。反事实实验确认因果性(FSR 53-99%)，并揭示"前沿模型悖论"：更强的评判模型标签敏感性反而更高。人类评估(Cohen's kappa=0.902)直接证实该机制。
AI.conclusion: LLM评判在EA中存在系统性锚点偏差，标签暴露会因果性地破坏评判可靠性，且更强模型未必更可靠。研究发布了首个生物医学EA基准(MeSH-SNOMED CT, 15K对)及可复现的审计框架，为EA领域LLM评判可靠性提供评测规范。

title: Many Ways to Succeed: Diversity-Driven RL Fine-Tuning for VLA Generalization
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning improves vision-language-action (VLA) policies through closed-loop experience, yet generalization beyond the fine-tuning distribution remains limited. Our analysis reveals a selective reshaping of exploration: RL contracts behavior globally, yet diversifies successful trajectories, elicits success with fewer rollouts, and covers more of the latent task-valid solution space than supervised fine-tuning. Broader successful-mode coverage may provide alternative strategies under distribution shifts. Inspired by this, we introduce DRIVE (Diversity-driven RL fIne-tuning for VLA gEneralization), which turns successful-behavior diversity into an explicit RL objective. DRIVE groups rollouts under matched task conditions, compares their trajectories with temporal alignment, and derives a success-conditioned intrinsic reward from relative behavioral diversity. This design encourages broader coverage of feasible solutions without rewarding diverse failures or superficial timing differences. Across LIBERO-Plus, ManiSkill3, and RoboTwin 2.0, DRIVE improves the average out-of-domain (OOD) performance over vanilla RL fine-tuning by 5.3 points on $π_0$ and 2.0 points on $π_{0.5}$. On a dual-arm AgileX PiPER-X platform, DRIVE further increases average OOD success from 64.1% to 73.3% (+9.2 points), demonstrating gains that persist under physical deployment.

AI.tldr: DRIVE 将成功行为多样性转化为显式强化学习目标，提升 VLA 策略的分布外泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 强化学习微调虽通过闭环经验改进 VLA 策略，但超出微调分布后的泛化仍然有限。作者分析发现，RL 会全局收缩行为，但同时能多样化成功轨迹、用更少 rollout 取得成功，并覆盖更多潜在任务有效解空间，这种更广的成功模式覆盖有望为分布偏移提供替代策略。
AI.method: DRIVE 在匹配任务条件下对 rollout 分组，通过时间对齐比较轨迹，并从相对行为多样性中推导出成功条件下的内在奖励，从而鼓励更广的可行解覆盖，同时避免奖励多样化的失败或表面的时序差异。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-Plus、ManiSkill3 和 RoboTwin 2.0 上，DRIVE 相比普通 RL 微调在 π0 上平均 OOD 性能提升 5.3 个点，在 π0.5 上提升 2.0 个点。在双臂 AgileX PiPER-X 平台上，平均 OOD 成功率从 64.1% 提升到 73.3%（+9.2 个点）。
AI.conclusion: 将成功行为多样性作为显式 RL 目标可有效提升 VLA 策略的分布外泛化，且该增益在物理部署中依然保持。

title: InstanceBench: Diagnosing Referential Reasoning and Target Identity in Referring Expression Segmentation
summary: Referring Expression Segmentation (RES) links natural-language descriptions to pixel-level object masks. Yet standard evaluation provides limited insight into instance-level referential reasoning: it does not systematically distinguish referential logics, test target preservation across valid grounding paths, or separate target-selection from mask-generation errors. We introduce InstanceBench, an instance-centered diagnostic benchmark comprising 6,194 images, 9,264 target instances, and 25,077 human-verified expressions. Each target-centric expression set (TCES) fixes the image and target mask while pairing a minimal expression with a same-target variant that uses another valid cue or grounding path. A compact referential-logic taxonomy spans direct target evidence, same-class selection, relational and compositional grounding, and exclusion, while logic-critical construction suppresses simpler shortcuts. Identity-aware metrics measure target retention and set-level success while separating selection from mask-generation errors. Across 22 native-mask RES checkpoints from 18 model families, the strongest checkpoint reaches 67.1% mIoU but only 59.6% All@0.7. Controlled interventions confirm language sensitivity, while failure decomposition identifies target selection rather than mask decoding as the main bottleneck. On a controlled training subset, matched supervision improves identity-aware performance, showing that the diagnosed capability responds to targeted supervision. Collectively, InstanceBench supports a measure-diagnose-improve cycle: measuring target consistency across grounding paths, localizing failure sources, and evaluating targeted interventions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 InstanceBench，一个以实例为中心的 Referring Expression Segmentation 诊断基准，用于测量指代逻辑下的目标一致性与失败来源，并支持“测量—诊断—改进”闭环。
AI.motivation: 现有 RES 评估难以系统区分指代逻辑，无法验证不同有效 grounding 路径下目标是否保持，也不能清晰分离“目标选择错误”与“掩码生成错误”，因此对实例级指代推理能力洞察有限。
AI.method: 构建 InstanceBench：包含 6,194 图像、9,264 目标实例、25,077 条人工核验表达；每个目标中心表达集（TCES）固定图像与目标掩码，搭配最小表达与同一目标的变体表达，该变体使用另一有效线索或 grounding 路径。提出指代逻辑分类体系，覆盖直接目标证据、同类选择、关系与组合 grounding、排除逻辑，并通过逻辑关键构造抑制捷径。设计身份感知指标，衡量目标保持与集合级成功，并分离选择错误和掩码生成错误。
AI.result: 在来自 18 个模型家族的 22 个原生掩码 RES checkpoint 上评估，最强 checkpoint 达到 67.1% mIoU，但 All@0.7 仅 59.6%。受控干预确认语言敏感性；失败分解表明主要瓶颈是目标选择而非掩码解码。在受控训练子集上，匹配监督可提升身份感知性能。
AI.conclusion: InstanceBench 能测量不同 grounding 路径下的目标一致性、定位失败来源并评估针对性干预，支持 RES 的 measure-diagnose-improve 循环。

title: The Symbol of the Surrogate: Measuring Numerical Provenance in Neural PDE Solvers
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 AI for Science Workshop
summary: Neural PDE surrogates are trained on numerical solver outputs that contain both physical evolution and solver-specific discretization errors. Because surrogates are also evaluated against held-out trajectories from the same solver, standard benchmarks cannot distinguish fidelity to the exact evolution from imitation of the numerical scheme. We introduce an empirical Fourier-symbol diagnostic that probes a trained surrogate's linearized one-step operator with individual Fourier modes and compares it with both exact-evolution and training-scheme references. To address architectural spectral bias, we train identical networks on schemes with orthogonal dissipative and dispersive signatures and compare their learned operators. In linear advection, the learned surrogates reproduce the training schemes' amplitude and phase errors, with the twin-scheme difference reaching more than 99.8\% of the analytically predicted full-imitation ceiling. The same behavior occurs for a non-local Fourier neural operator and at the operator level for nonlinear Burgers dynamics. These results show that agreement with solver-generated test data does not by itself establish fidelity to the exact evolution. Fourier-symbol measurements provide a direct diagnostic of numerical provenance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于傅里叶符号的经验诊断方法，发现神经PDE代理模型主要在学习训练所用数值格式的离散误差，而非真实物理演化。
AI.motivation: 神经PDE代理模型的训练数据来自数值求解器，同时包含真实物理演化和求解器特有的离散误差；而模型评估也基于同一求解器的留出轨迹，因此标准基准无法区分模型是对真实演化的忠实逼近，还是对数值格式的模仿。作者希望厘清这一混淆。
AI.method: 提出经验傅里叶符号诊断：用单频傅里叶模式探测训练后代理模型的线性化单步算子，并与真实演化参考和训练格式参考进行比较。为排除架构本身的谱偏置，在具有正交耗散与色散特征的两种格式上训练结构相同的网络，并对比其学到的算子。
AI.result: 在线性平流问题中，学到的代理模型复现了训练格式的振幅和相位误差，双格式差异达到解析预测的完全模仿上限的99.8%以上；在非局部傅里叶神经算子上以及非线性Burgers动力学的算子层面也出现相同行为。
AI.conclusion: 与求解器生成的测试数据一致，本身并不能证明代理模型忠实于真实演化；傅里叶符号测量为判断数值来源提供了一种直接诊断手段。

title: DrugTargetWorld: A Synthetic Biobank for Training and Benchmarking AI Scientists
comment: 34 pages main text, 92 pages supplementary material; 6 main figures. Project: https://DrugTargetWorld.vercel.app. Code: https://github.com/sammargolis/DrugTargetWorld. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/sammargolis/DrugTargetWorld-assets
summary: Drug target discovery requires distinguishing molecules that causally drive disease from those that are merely associated with it. Training and evaluating AI agents to perform this workflow end-to-end is difficult because real world biobanks lack known causal ground truth and participant-level data is access controlled. We introduce DrugTargetWorld, a framework that procedurally generates simulated biobanks, or "worlds," with known but concealed causal structure. Each world contains genotypes, proteins, health records, outcomes, and synthetic magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) for 54,000 participants. Agents must construct a disease phenotype, identify causal driver proteins, infer the beneficial direction of modulation, and optionally conduct virtual 'wet lab' experiments. We evaluated nine agents in 540 episodes across 20 cardiovascular worlds and three experimental budgets. Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol achieved the highest mean composite scores, 39.98 and 35.38 of 100, respectively, and both recovered 64% of causal drivers on average. However, no agent reliably distinguished misleading non-causal proteins, and performance remained limited by the integrative judgments required to connect phenotype construction, causal evidence, and intervention decisions. By making each world's causal structure known to the evaluator but hidden from the agent, DrugTargetWorld turns end-to-end drug target discovery into a scalable training and evaluation problem with verifiable reward.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 DrugTargetWorld 框架，通过程序化生成具有已知但隐藏因果结构的模拟生物样本库，将端到端药物靶点发现转化为可扩展、带可验证奖励的训练与评估问题，并评测了九个 AI 智能体。
AI.motivation: 药物靶点发现需区分与疾病仅有相关性的分子和真正因果驱动疾病的分子，但真实生物样本库缺乏已知的因果真值，且参与者级数据受访问控制，导致难以端到端训练和评估 AI 智能体。
AI.method: DrugTargetWorld 程序化生成模拟生物样本库"世界"，每个世界包含 5.4 万名参与者的基因型、蛋白质、健康记录、结局和合成 MRI 数据，具有对评估者已知、对智能体隐藏的因果结构。智能体需构建疾病表型、识别因果驱动蛋白、推断调控的有益方向，并可选进行虚拟"湿实验"。在 20 个心血管世界、3 种实验预算下对九个智能体进行 540 个回合的评测。
AI.result: Opus 5 与 GPT-5.6 Sol 取得最高平均综合得分，分别为 100 分中的 39.98 和 35.38，二者平均恢复 64% 的因果驱动因子。但没有任何智能体能可靠地区分误导性的非因果蛋白，且性能仍受限于连接表型构建、因果证据和干预决策所需的整合性判断。
AI.conclusion: 通过让每个世界的因果结构对评估者已知而对智能体隐藏，DrugTargetWorld 将端到端药物靶点发现转变为可扩展、带可验证奖励的训练与评估问题。

title: Borrowed Eyes: Markerless Nano-UAV Flight with an Active Quadruped Observer
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to ICRA 2027
summary: Nano unmanned aerial vehicles (nano-UAVs) can navigate confined spaces that larger robots cannot, but their payload capacity severely limits the sensors and compute available for self-localization in global navigation satellite system (GNSS)-denied environments. We present a vision-based system that localizes a nano-UAV from a quadruped robot with an arm-mounted camera. The quadruped tracks the drone, estimates its position in its own coordinate system using segmentation masks and depth, and transmits that position over a real-time radio link. To ensure continuous tracking, we developed a perception-aware nonlinear Model Predictive Controller (NMPC) that dynamically adjusts the quadruped's body and arm to maximize the drone's visibility, treating observation reliability as a primary control objective. Relying solely on this external estimate, the nano-UAV executed predefined trajectories from takeoff to landing with a median 3D localization error of 59 mm. The system demonstrates robustness against short visual occlusions by smoothly transitioning to onboard inertial flight when line-of-sight is temporarily lost. Ultimately, this framework allows a quadruped to offload the localization burden of a nano-UAV, enabling inspection of complex spaces that neither robot could navigate alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种视觉定位系统，由搭载机械臂相机的四足机器人跟踪并定位纳米无人机，结合感知感知 NMPC 保证持续可见性，实现中位 3D 定位误差 59 mm 的起降飞行。
AI.motivation: 纳米无人机可进入大型机器人无法通行的狭窄空间，但其载荷能力严重限制了可用于自定位的传感器与算力，尤其在 GNSS 拒止环境下难以自主定位。
AI.method: 四足机器人通过臂载相机跟踪无人机，利用分割掩码与深度估计其在自身坐标系中的位置，并通过实时无线电链路把位置发送给无人机；同时设计感知感知的非线性模型预测控制器（NMPC），动态调整四足机身与机械臂以最大化无人机可见性，将观测可靠性作为主要控制目标。
AI.result: 仅依赖外部定位估计，纳米无人机完成从起飞到着陆的预设轨迹，3D 定位误差中位数为 59 mm；在短暂视觉遮挡时，系统可平滑切换到机载惯性飞行，表现出对遮挡的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架让四足机器人分担纳米无人机的定位负担，从而支持对任一单一机器人均无法通行的复杂空间进行巡检。

title: Gaussian Material Fields for Volumetric Multi-Energy CT Decomposition
summary: Volumetric material decomposition in multi-energy computed tomography requires a representation that organizes multiple three-dimensional material fields in a common spatial domain while retaining differences in composition and local structure. We observe that spatial primitives can be shared across materials without tying their coefficients, but their local capacity must respond to material-specific reconstruction needs. We introduce Gaussian material fields, which represent multiple material distributions with shared anisotropic 3D Gaussian primitives and independent nonnegative material coefficients. The shared geometry defines a continuous spatial basis, while the coefficients determine each primitive's contribution to the individual material fields. To reconstruct this representation from multi-energy projections, a differentiable spectral forward model combines Gaussian material path integrals with a calibrated basis matrix, enabling joint optimization of spatial geometry and material composition. Material-aware adaptive density control retains material-specific refinement evidence before aggregation and adjusts local representation capacity to accommodate both spatially extensive components and sparse details. Experiments use synthesized multi-energy projections generated from pseudo-reference material maps constructed by conventional methods from publicly available CT data. Across 15 cases, our approach improves average PSNR by 4.03 dB and SSIM by 4.96% over the strongest baseline, while reducing NRMSE by 33.45%. Material-wise comparisons and component ablations support improved recovery of localized structures, while runtime and memory measurements show favorable computational scaling. These results establish Gaussian material fields as an explicit, adaptive representation for volumetric multi-material reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出Gaussian material fields：用共享各向异性3D高斯基元+独立非负材料系数表示多种材料分布，配合可微光谱前向模型与材料感知自适应密度控制，从多能投影重建体积多材料场，15例平均PSNR提升4.03 dB、SSIM提升4.96%、NRMSE降低33.45%。
AI.motivation: 多能CT体积材料分解需要一种表示方式，能在统一空间域中组织多个三维材料场，同时保留材料间在组成和局部结构上的差异。现有表示往往难以兼顾空间基共享与材料特异性重建需求。
AI.method: 核心观察是空间基元可跨材料共享而系数不受耦合约束，但局部容量须响应材料特异性重建需求。方法包括：用共享各向异性3D高斯基元与独立非负材料系数构成Gaussian material fields；共享几何定义连续空间基，系数决定各基元对各材料场的贡献；设计可微光谱前向模型，将高斯材料路径积分与标定基矩阵结合，实现空间几何与材料组成的联合优化；提出材料感知自适应密度控制，在聚合前保留材料特异细化证据并调整局部表示容量，以适应空间广延成分与稀疏细节。
AI.result: 实验使用公开CT数据、由常规方法构建的伪参考材料图合成的多能投影。15个案例中，相比最强基线平均PSNR提升4.03 dB、SSIM提升4.96%、NRMSE降低33.45%；材料级对比与组件消融支持局部结构恢复改善；运行时间与内存测量显示计算扩展性良好。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了Gaussian material fields作为体积多材料重建的一种显式、自适应表示方法。

title: Evaluating Trajectory Features for Routing Final-Layer Attention
summary: Attention routing requires a signal that predicts the value of attention on the current prefix. We evaluate whether hidden-state extrapolation error, curvature and error change improve this prediction beyond uncertainty, one-step displacement, position and state projections. Paired executions of the final attention layer supply signed next-token loss differences in frozen SmolLM3-3B-Base and Qwen3.5-4B-Base checkpoints. Utility-supervised routers are tested on 100 held-out PG-19 books at an identical causal 20 percent invocation quota. None of six prespecified comparisons shows a positive gain after familywise correction. In Qwen3.5, a parameter-matched fixed-projection control lowers NLL by 0.00356 nats/token relative to the trajectory router (95 percent interval 0.00218 to 0.00487). Secondary results depend on the operation removed, feature location and scoring horizon; frozen thresholds also drift substantially at longer horizons. Actual selected-query execution yields small long-sequence latency reductions with increased NLL, while learned routers remain slower during cached continuation. The study identifies limits on the incremental value of these trajectory summaries and separates allocation quality from measured inference benefit.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验了多种轨迹摘要特征对注意力路由预测的增量价值，结果显示在严格统计校正下均无正向收益，且固定投影对照反而更优。
AI.motivation: 注意力路由需要一个能预测当前前缀上注意力价值的信号。作者希望评估隐状态外推误差、曲率与误差变化，是否能在不确定性、一步位移、位置与状态投影之外，进一步提升这一预测能力。
AI.method: 在冻结的 SmolLM3-3B-Base 与 Qwen3.5-4B-Base 检查点上，通过最终注意力层的配对执行获得带符号的下一词元损失差异。以相同因果 20% 调用配额，在 100 本留出的 PG-19 书籍上测试效用监督路由器，并进行六项预设比较（含家族式多重校正）。
AI.result: 六项预设比较在家族式校正后均未显示正向增益。在 Qwen3.5 中，参数匹配的固定投影对照相比轨迹路由器将 NLL 降低 0.00356 nats/token（95% 区间 0.00218–0.00487）。次级结果依赖于被移除的操作、特征位置与评分时域；冻结阈值在更长时域下也显著漂移。实际选中查询执行在长序列上带来小幅延迟下降，但 NLL 上升；学习型路由器在缓存续写时仍较慢。
AI.conclusion: 研究界定了这些轨迹摘要在增量价值上的局限，并将分配质量与实测推理收益区分开来。

title: World Potential Model: Pretrained World Knowledge as Progress Potentials
summary: Long-horizon language agents often receive supervision only from terminal task outcomes, leaving little signal for distinguishing productive intermediate behavior from stagnation or even regression. Rather than learning a separate value function or process reward model for every task, we ask whether pretrained models can recognize task progress from their existing world knowledge. We formalize this capability with a World Potential Model (WPM), a goal-conditioned evaluator of task-relative realized progress in agent contexts. In ALFWorld and ScienceWorld, off-the-shelf pretrained models substantially outperform chance at recovering realized-progress structure without task-specific evaluator fine-tuning. We further anchor these progress judgments to task-specific milestones to obtain scalar world potentials, whose temporal differences provide process-sensitive step-level credit for policy optimization. Under matched comparisons, WPM-guided optimization improves success over outcome-only GRPO across all evaluated configurations. Together, these results provide initial evidence that pretrained world knowledge can support reusable realized-progress evaluation and provide useful supervision for long-horizon agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出世界潜能模型（WPM），利用预训练模型已有的世界知识评估长程智能体的任务进展，为策略优化提供过程级监督。
AI.motivation: 长程语言智能体通常只从终局任务结果获得监督，难以区分有效的中间行为与停滞甚至倒退，而现有方法需为每个任务单独学习价值函数或过程奖励模型。
AI.method: 形式化提出WPM——一种目标条件的、评估智能体上下文中任务相对已实现进展的评测器；将进展判断锚定到任务特定里程碑以获得标量世界潜能，并用其时序差分提供过程敏感的步级信用用于策略优化。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和ScienceWorld中，无需任务特定评测器微调，现成预训练模型恢复已实现进展结构的能力显著优于随机；在匹配比较下，WPM引导的优化在所有评估配置中均优于仅结果监督的GRPO。
AI.conclusion: 预训练世界知识可支持可复用的已实现进展评估，并为长程智能体提供有用的过程监督。

title: Decoding Neural Population Dynamics through Robotic Analog
summary: Animal evidence shows that precise voluntary movements arise from rotational neural population dynamics in motor cortex, but their physical effects remain unknown. We developed a robotic analog of biological motor systems with artificial muscles, multimodal sensors, and a neural network controller trained via reinforcement learning. The robotic analog exhibited accurate movements, robustness to damage, and neural population dynamics akin to animals. This task-driven, embodied model illuminates the causal link between neural population dynamics and motor outcomes. We discovered that neural rotations generate oscillatory maneuvers orthogonal to the reaching direction, optimizing trajectory adjustments, which is confirmed by primate neural data. The model also revealed counterintuitive neural energy principles under sensor and motor redundancies, and striking Eureka moments during motor learning, bridging biological and artificial systems. These findings provide new perspectives on how neural dynamics contribute to accurate and flexible movement, inspiring future intelligent robots with animal-like mobility.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个带人工肌肉、多模态传感器和强化学习神经网络控制器的机器人模型，重现了动物运动皮层的旋转神经群体动力学，揭示了神经旋转与运动输出的因果联系。
AI.motivation: 动物证据表明精确的自主运动源于运动皮层中的旋转神经群体动力学，但其物理效应仍不明确，缺乏具身的因果验证模型。
AI.method: 构建生物运动系统的机器人类比物，配备人工肌肉、多模态传感器，并用强化学习训练神经网络控制器。
AI.result: 该机器人模型表现出精确运动、抗损伤鲁棒性及类似动物的神经群体动力学；发现神经旋转产生与到达方向正交的振荡操作以优化轨迹调整，并获灵长类神经数据证实；还揭示传感器与运动冗余下的反直觉神经能量原理及学习中的"尤里卡"时刻。
AI.conclusion: 研究为神经动力学如何支持精确灵活运动提供了新视角，有助于启发未来具备类动物运动能力的智能机器人。

title: SpatialUQ: Post-Hoc Uncertainty Quantification from Spatial Consistency in Black-Box Vision Models
summary: Clinical vision models are often deployed as frozen black boxes with no access to internals, retraining, or ground truth at inference time. We introduce \textbf{SpatialUQ}, a post-hoc uncertainty method using only output probabilities. It measures the Jensen-Shannon divergence between the global prediction and the mean of five fixed spatial crops in six deterministic forward passes. The premise is simple, trustworthy predictions are spatially consistent. On NIH ChestX-ray14 (DenseNet-121, $N{=}25{,}596$), our Multicrop Uncertainty Score (MUS) reaches $0.784$ failure-detection AUC versus $0.664$ for MC-Dropout ($p{<}10^{-6}$) at one-fifth the compute, with native calibration ($\text{SCE}{=}0.049$ vs.\ $0.127$ for $\ell_1$), the best-calibrated among methods above 0.78 AUC. A supervised fusion of MUS with entropy, confidence, and $\ell_1$ reaches $0.832$, outperforming a five-member ensemble ($0.813$). MUS scales with model quality, reaching $0.899$ with BiomedCLIP ($ρ= 0.846$), while this relationship remains meaningful in-distribution ($ρ= 0.523$) but breaks down under severe distribution shift (VinBigData, $ρ= 0.027$). MUS is well-suited to diffuse findings but is less dependable for small focal lesions such as nodules. Code and experimental materials are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/kawsher11/SpatialUQ.

AI.tldr: SpatialUQ是一种仅依赖输出概率的事后不确定性方法，通过测量全局预测与五个固定空间裁剪均值之间的Jensen-Shannon散度来检测失效，在CheXpert式胸片任务上以更低算力取得优于MC-Dropout的失效检测AUC与校准表现。
AI.motivation: 临床视觉模型常以冻结黑盒方式部署，推理时无法访问内部结构、无法重训练、也无真值标签，因此需要一种仅依赖输出概率的事后不确定性估计方法，且要求低算力、校准良好，用于识别不可信预测。
AI.method: 提出SpatialUQ：在六次确定性前向传播中计算全局预测与五个固定空间裁剪预测均值之间的Jensen-Shannon散度，得到Multicrop Uncertainty Score (MUS)；核心假设是可信预测应具备空间一致性。此外将MUS与熵、置信度及ℓ1进行监督式融合。
AI.result: 在NIH ChestX-ray14（DenseNet-121，N=25,596）上，MUS失效检测AUC为0.784，优于MC-Dropout的0.664（p<10^-6）且算力仅为其五分之一；SCE=0.049，明显优于ℓ1的0.127，是AUC>0.78方法中校准最好的。监督式融合达到0.832，超过五成员集成（0.813）。MUS随模型质量提升，BiomedCLIP上达0.899（ρ=0.846）；同分布下关系仍显著（ρ=0.523），但在严重分布偏移（VinBigData）下失效（ρ=0.027）。对弥漫性病变表现好，对小焦点病变（如结节）可靠性较低。
AI.conclusion: SpatialUQ用极少算力实现高效事后不确定性估计，兼具良好校准与失效检测能力，且随基础模型质量提升而增强，但依赖空间一致性假设，在严重分布偏移及小结节类病灶上表现受限。代码与实验材料已公开。

title: Twist Flow for Inverse Problems
summary: In Bayesian inverse problems, posterior sampling requires generating samples that are consistent with given observations while capturing the range of plausible solutions. Direct conditional generative models introduce latent noise to model this ambiguity, but paired inverse-problem training can still encourage an almost deterministic map from the observation to the target. As a result, generated samples may be observation-consistent while under-representing posterior variability, especially when the posterior is multimodal, leading to undercoverage, mode distortion, or artificial transitions between distinct feasible solutions. We propose joint twist-flow, an augmented flow-matching formulation that learns a continuous transport from the augmented source state $(z_x, y)$ to the augmented terminal state $(x, z_y)$. Here x is the target variable, $y$ is the observation, $z_x$ is the Gaussian reference coordinate for posterior sampling, and $z_y$ is a Gaussian likelihood-side coordinate associated with the observation branch. Under a Gaussian observation model, $z_y$ is motivated by the normalized observation residual associated with observation compatibility. Its role is not to replace uncertainty in $x$, but to couple generated samples of x to observation consistency, helping reduce likelihood-inconsistent variation while preserving variability in weakly constrained directions. We validate the method on low-dimensional inverse problems with reference posterior samples, where joint twist-flow better preserves multimodal posterior support than a direct conditional-flow baseline. We further evaluate the method on image restoration and seismic subsurface velocity-model inversion, showing increased posterior variability while maintaining observation consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出 joint twist-flow，一种增强流匹配方法，将增广源状态 (z_x, y) 连续传输到增广终点状态 (x, z_y)，以在保持观测一致性的同时恢复后验的多样性，缓解条件生成模型后验覆盖不足与模式失真问题。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯逆问题的后验采样需在符合观测的同时体现可能解的范围。直接条件生成模型虽引入隐噪声建模歧义，但配对训练易退化为近乎确定性的映射，导致样本虽观测一致却低估后验变异性，在多峰后验下出现覆盖不足、模式失真或不同可行解间的虚假过渡。
AI.method: 提出 joint twist-flow：一种增广流匹配形式，学习从增广源状态 (z_x, y) 到增广终点状态 (x, z_y) 的连续传输。其中 x 为目标变量，y 为观测，z_x 为后验采样的高斯参考坐标，z_y 为与观测分支相关的高斯似然侧坐标。在高斯观测模型下，z_y 由归一化观测残差启发得到，用于刻画观测相容性；其作用不是替代 x 的不确定性，而是将生成的 x 样本与观测一致性耦合，在减弱似然不一致变化的同时保留弱约束方向上的变异性。
AI.result: 在带有参考后验样本的低维逆问题上验证，joint twist-flow 相比直接条件流基线更能保持多峰后验支撑；在图像复原与地震地下速度模型反演任务上也显示后验变异性增加，同时维持观测一致性。
AI.conclusion: joint twist-flow 通过增广似然侧坐标实现观测一致性与后验变异性的解耦，能有效改善多峰后验的覆盖与多样性，并在实际逆问题任务中兼顾观测一致性。

title: Dual- versus Single-Suggestion AI Support for Radiographic Interpretation in Residents: Randomized Multireader Study
summary:
Purpose: To compare dual- and single-suggestion AI support for radiographic interpretation by residents, particularly when the shared AI suggestion was incorrect.
  Materials and Methods: This prospective, multicenter, randomized three-arm reader study was conducted at three hospitals in China from July to September 2026 (ChiCTR2600129243). After specialty stratification, 132 residents with fewer than 3 years of clinical experience were randomized 1:1:1 to GPT-5.4 alone (group A), GPT-5.4 plus Kimi-K2.6 (group B), or GPT-5.4 plus Gemini-3.6 Flash (group C); 123 were analyzed. Participants interpreted 60 radiographs before and after AI support. The primary outcome was accuracy change. Welch ANOVA and Holm-adjusted t tests compared support conditions; HC3 linear models assessed specialty interaction.
  Results: Among 123 residents (mean age, 24.1 years +/- 1.4; 65 women), radiology residents showed greater accuracy improvement with dual- than single-suggestion support (B-A, 6.69 percentage points [95% CI, 0.97-12.40]; C-A, 7.87 percentage points [95% CI, 1.64-14.11]; Holm-adjusted P = .030 for both), whereas accuracy change did not differ in non-radiology residents (P = .20). When GPT-5.4 was incorrect, AI-assisted accuracy was higher with dual- than single-suggestion support in radiology residents (40.1% and 40.4% vs 20.0%) and non-radiology residents (31.3% and 31.0% vs 12.1%) (all Holm-adjusted P < .001). The dual-suggestion effect differed by specialty (interaction difference, 10.44 percentage points; 95% CI, 4.36-16.52; P < .001).
  Conclusion: Dual-suggestion support may mitigate the influence of erroneous AI suggestions, with greater accuracy improvement observed in radiology but not non-radiology residents.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过多中心随机三臂读者研究比较了双重与单一AI建议对住院医师影像判读的支持效果，发现双重建议能减轻错误AI建议的负面影响，且对放射科住院医师的准确率提升更显著。
AI.motivation: 单一AI建议可能误导医师，尤其当AI建议错误时，因此需要探索双重（多模型）建议是否能缓解错误AI建议的影响，并比较其对不同专科住院医师的作用差异。
AI.method: 前瞻性、多中心、随机三臂读者研究，在中国三所医院开展。132名临床经验少于3年的住院医师按专科分层后1:1:1随机分为三组：单用GPT-5.4（A组）、GPT-5.4加Kimi-K2.6（B组）、GPT-5.4加Gemini-3.6 Flash（C组），最终分析123人。参与者分别在AI支持前后判读60张X线片。主要结局为准确率变化，采用Welch ANOVA和Holm校正t检验比较支持条件，HC3线性模型评估专科交互作用。
AI.result: 在123名住院医师中（平均年龄24.1岁±1.4，65名女性），放射科住院医师使用双重建议的准确率提升大于单一建议（B-A为6.69个百分点，95%CI 0.97-12.40；C-A为7.87个百分点，95%CI 1.64-14.11；Holm校正P均为.030），而非放射科住院医师的准确率变化无差异（P=.20）。当GPT-5.4错误时，放射科住院医师（40.1%和40.4% vs 20.0%）及非放射科住院医师（31.3%和31.0% vs 12.1%）在双重建议下AI辅助准确率均高于单一建议（Holm校正P均<.001）。双重建议效应因专科而异（交互差异10.44个百分点，95%CI 4.36-16.52，P<.001）。
AI.conclusion: 双重建议支持可能减轻错误AI建议的影响，在放射科住院医师中观察到更明显的准确率提升，而非放射科住院医师未见此效果。

title: Tactile Reconstruction of Contact Task Frames and Forces for Hybrid Force/Motion Control
comment: 14 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables. Video: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLejKMZmW8AvI. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23209032
summary: Hybrid force/motion control requires knowledge of the interaction force and of a task frame defining the force- and motion-controlled directions. These quantities are usually obtained from force/torque sensing or model-based residuals, often assuming also a nominal environment model. This work addresses the online estimation of the contact force and a possibly time-varying task frame using only soft optical tactile sensing, under the assumption of locally planar contact with a negligible contact moment. The proposed method maps a single image of the deformed elastomer of a soft optical tactile sensor to observable contact variables: indentation depth, two surface-to-sensor tilt angles, and 3D contact force, each with a per-sample uncertainty estimate. The mapping is learned through a self-labeling acquisition procedure, in which a manipulator imposes controlled contacts while an auxiliary Force/Torque sensor is used offline to provide ground-truth labels. The tactile measurement is then fused with robot proprioceptive data in an Extended Kalman Filter, producing a continuously updated estimate of the contact task frame and of the interaction force. Control experiments with a DigiTac sensor mounted on a UR10 manipulator demonstrate closed-loop contact force regulation against a flat rigid board in linear and angular motion by a human operator, with touch as the only exteroceptive feedback.

AI.tldr: 该工作仅用软光学触觉传感，在线估计接触力与时变任务框架，无需力/力矩传感器或环境模型。
AI.motivation: 混合力/运动控制需要交互力与任务框架信息，传统方法依赖力/力矩传感或模型残差，且常需标称环境模型，成本与适用性受限。作者希望仅靠触觉实现这些量的在线估计。
AI.method: 假设局部平面接触、接触力矩可忽略。将软光学触觉传感器变形弹性体的单张图像映射为可观测量：压入深度、两个表面-传感器倾角、3D接触力，并给出逐样本不确定性估计。映射通过自标注采集流程学习：机械臂施加受控接触，辅助力/力矩传感器离线提供真值标签。再将触觉测量与机器人本体感知数据在扩展卡尔曼滤波中融合，持续更新任务框架与交互力估计。
AI.result: 在UR10机械臂上搭载DigiTac传感器进行控制实验，在人工操作者使刚性平板做线性与角运动的情况下，仅以触觉作为外感知反馈，实现了闭环接触力调节。
AI.conclusion: 表明仅凭软光学触觉即可在线估计接触力与时变任务框架，并支撑闭环力控制，减少对力/力矩传感器和环境模型的依赖。

title: RT-DETR-World: Transferring Rich LLM Semantics to Real-Time Open-Vocabulary Detection
summary: Open-vocabulary detection (OVD) recognizes categories unseen during training through textual category queries, yet achieving strong generalization with real-time efficiency remains challenging. Beyond vocabulary scaling, zero-shot generalization may benefit from reusable visual--semantic cues learned from seen data, including attributes, actions, states, and contextual relations. Existing real-time OVD methods primarily emphasize vocabulary coverage and efficient region/query--text matching; under strict efficiency constraints, compact detectors may struggle to absorb rich instance semantics and scene context. We propose RT-DETR-World, a compact DETR-style detector that transfers the rich semantics conveyed by descriptions during training while retaining lightweight query--text matching at inference. We construct GroundingCapv2 with three levels of supervision: category names for standard OVD, object descriptions conveying instance-level semantics, and image descriptions conveying object relations and scene context. These descriptions serve only as training-time semantic supervision. To help the compact detector absorb these semantics, we propose Dual-Path Description Alignment (DDA), combining a deployment-consistent MiniLM pathway with a training-only LLM teacher. MiniLM provides query--category supervision and object-description alignment, while offline teacher features supervise matched queries and global visual representations at the object and image levels, respectively. All teacher features are precomputed, and the teacher-side modules are removed after training. We further propose Relation-Aware Negative Relaxation (RNR), which uses teacher-derived semantic similarities to relax related negatives while preserving exact positives. Experiments demonstrate competitive zero-shot accuracy and a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off. The code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出 RT-DETR-World，一种紧凑的 DETR 式开放词汇检测器，通过训练期描述语义监督（DDA）与关系感知负样本松弛（RNR），在保持推理轻量高效的同时提升零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 实时开放词汇检测（OVD）在严格效率约束下，紧凑检测器难以吸收丰富的实例语义与场景上下文。现有实时 OVD 方法主要关注词汇覆盖和高效区域/查询-文本匹配，忽略了可从已见数据中复用视觉-语义线索（属性、动作、状态、上下文关系）来增强零样本泛化的潜力。
AI.method: 1) 构建 GroundingCapv2 数据集，含三级监督：类别名（标准 OVD）、对象描述（实例级语义）、图像描述（对象关系与场景上下文），描述仅作训练期监督。2) 双路径描述对齐（DDA）：部署一致的 MiniLM 路径 + 仅训练用的 LLM 教师；MiniLM 提供查询-类别监督和对象描述对齐，离线教师特征在对象/图像级监督匹配查询与全局视觉表示；教师特征预计算，训练后移除教师模块。3) 关系感知负样本松弛（RNR）：利用教师语义相似度松弛相关负样本，同时保留精确正样本。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法取得有竞争力的零样本精度，并在精度-效率权衡上表现良好。
AI.conclusion: RT-DETR-World 证明：通过训练期描述语义监督与关系感知负样本松弛，可在不增加推理成本的前提下，让紧凑实时检测器获得更强的零样本开放词汇泛化能力。代码将开源。

title: Self-attention summary networks for subsurface velocity-model building from common-image gathers
summary: Common-image gathers (CIGs) contain physically meaningful information about velocity-model errors through reflector focusing and residual moveout, but in conventional imaging workflows they are typically used only as diagnostic tools.
