The learned hierarchy exhibits automatic speed-dependent gait adaptation, transitioning from pacing at low speeds to trotting at higher speeds. We validate the proposed approach in simulation against representative single-policy and hierarchical locomotion baselines, demonstrating reduced CoT over a broad range of commanded velocities, while maintaining robust locomotion across flat, uneven rough, and inclined terrains. We further demonstrate its practical feasibility through zero-shot deployment on a physical Unitree AlienGo quadruped.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种分层强化学习（HRL）框架，将高频关节运动执行策略与低频步态自适应策略分离，后者显式最小化运输成本（CoT），实现零样本仿真到现实迁移，并在速度变化与多地形下提升能效与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 足式机器人运动控制中，能效与鲁棒性难以兼顾；端到端RL策略将步态生成、运动执行与能量优化耦合在一起，导致对奖励设计高度敏感，难以在不同速度范围和地形条件下同时实现低能耗与稳健性能。
AI.method: 提出分层强化学习框架：高频策略负责稳定鲁棒的关节级运动执行，低频策略负责显式最小化运输成本（CoT）的步态自适应；采用基于Isaac的三阶段训练流程，实现零样本仿真到现实迁移。
AI.result: 在仿真中与代表性单策略及分层运动基线对比，在所给速度范围内降低CoT，并在平地、崎岖不平与倾斜地形上保持鲁棒运动；学习到的层级结构呈现自动速度相关步态适应，低速pacing、高速trotting；并在Unitree AlienGo四足机器人上完成零样本部署验证。
AI.conclusion: 分层解耦高频运动执行与低频能效步态自适应，可有效降低对奖励设计的敏感性，在宽速度范围和多地形下兼顾能效、跟踪精度与鲁棒性，并具备实际机器人部署的可行性。

title: Gradient-Based Trajectory Optimisation over Continuous Poses for Sparse-View Cone-Beam CT
summary: Trajectory optimisation for cone-beam computed tomography (CT) determines which information sparse-view scans acquire. Fixed candidate pools prevent off-grid refinement and require new object-specific precomputation for each acquisition manifold. We make every source pose an individual continuous variable and move all poses jointly by gradient ascent on the scanner's kinematic manifold. The objective combines soft-Tuy plane coverage, continuous View Covariance Loss, and an analytic attenuation-aware ray-bundle penalty. The same optimiser handles circular, limited C-arm, two-axis, and freesphere parametrisations. On a Defrise flange, continuous selection recovers laminar defects invisible to a circular orbit, matches discrete swap search on the free sphere at the sparser budget, and leads at the denser one, with the same objective evaluated in every arm. A moderate elevation band already recovers most of the free-sphere gain at the defects, so the same optimiser transfers to bounded scanner envelopes. Photon noise preserves the ordering on the flange and compresses it on a dense fuel nozzle. Sparseprescan planning benefits from matching prescan and planned acquisition manifolds. Selection takes seconds rather than minutes without an object-specific reconstruction basis. Prescan-planned poses were executed on a robot CT bench and reconstructed in a common frame, demonstrating feasibility but no consistent metric gain over uniform band sampling. Continuous pose optimisation incorporates attenuation and scanner constraints directly into sparse-view acquisition design.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将稀疏视角CT中每个X射线源位姿视为连续变量，在扫描仪运动流形上通过梯度上升联合优化轨迹，从而在无需目标专用预计算的情况下实现离网轨迹精化。
AI.motivation: 传统轨迹优化依赖固定的候选位姿池，无法进行离网精化，且每换一种采集流形都需针对目标重新预计算。作者希望把衰减信息与扫描仪运动学约束直接纳入稀疏视角采集设计，并让同一优化器适用于多种扫描仪参数化。
AI.method: 将每个源位姿设为独立连续变量，在扫描仪运动学流形上对所有位姿做梯度上升联合优化。目标函数融合软Tuy平面覆盖、连续视角协方差损失（View Covariance Loss）和解析的衰减感知射线束惩罚。同一优化器可处理圆形、受限C臂、双轴和自由球（freesphere）等多种参数化。
AI.result: 在Defrise法兰上，连续选择能恢复圆形轨道看不到的层状缺陷，在更稀疏预算下与自由球上的离散交换搜索相当，在更密集预算下更优（各实验组使用同一目标函数）。中等仰角带即可恢复大部分自由球增益。光子噪声在法兰上保持排序、在密集燃料喷嘴上压缩差异。选择耗时从数分钟降到数秒，且无需目标专用重建基。预扫描规划的位姿在机器人CT台上执行并重建，验证了可行性，但相对均匀带采样未取得一致的指标提升。
AI.conclusion: 连续位姿优化能把衰减与扫描仪约束直接纳入稀疏视角采集设计。同一优化器可迁移到受限扫描仪包络，稀疏预扫描规划受益于预扫描与规划采集流形相匹配。

title: From Retrieval to Customer Context: Evaluating Frontier-Model Systems for Voice-of-Customer Analysis
summary: Organizations increasingly use frontier language models to analyze customer feedback, but answer quality also depends on how that feedback is organized and made available. We define a \emph{customer context graph} as a unified model of customer and business context. Typed relationships connect customer objects (feedback, conversations, users, and accounts), operational objects (tickets, support agents, opportunities, and competitors), and analytical or action objects (taxonomy concepts, evidence, insights, work items, and outcomes). This lets an agent investigate not only what customers say, but why, who is affected, what action followed, who owns it, and whether it was resolved. For this experiment, the graph is populated from public Cursor feedback; the same architecture can support any type of feedback source. We compare Agentic RAG, a Deep Research Agent, and a Customer Context Graph-backed Agent on the same 9,432 public Cursor feedback records using 30 realistic product, incident, comparison, and metadata questions. Without exhaustive ground truth, we jointly score responses on answer quality (coverage and organization), analytical depth (specificity and decomposition), and evidence quality (citation support and traceability), using a comparative rubric calibrated on 28 of the 30 questions. We sample cited records against their claims and weight the three dimensions equally. Under this aligned rubric, the Customer Context Graph-backed Agent scores 0.961 overall, versus 0.710 for the Deep Research Agent and 0.651 for Agentic RAG, and leads the Deep Research Agent on 27 of 30 paired questions (sign-test p < 10^(-5); strictly best on 26 of 30). Its largest advantage is analytical depth (0.967 versus 0.642), reflecting more specific, hierarchically developed findings with quantified themes and traceable evidence...

AI.tldr: 本文提出"客户上下文图"（Customer Context Graph）架构，将客户反馈、运营与行动对象通过类型化关系统一建模，使智能体不仅知道客户说了什么，还能追溯原因、影响者、后续行动与解决情况。在9,432条公开Cursor反馈、30个真实问题上，该架构支撑的智能体总体得分0.961，显著优于Deep Research Agent（0.710）与Agentic RAG（0.651）。
AI.motivation: 组织越来越多地使用前沿语言模型分析客户反馈，但回答质量不仅取决于模型本身，还取决于反馈如何被组织与获取。现有RAG等方法难以支持对反馈背后原因、受影响对象、后续行动与解决状态的深层调查，因此需要一种统一建模客户与业务上下文的架构。
AI.method: 定义"客户上下文图"作为客户与业务上下文的统一模型，用类型化关系连接客户对象（反馈、对话、用户、账户）、运营对象（工单、客服、商机、竞品）与分析/行动对象（分类概念、证据、洞察、工作项、结果）。实验从公开Cursor反馈中填充图谱（该架构可迁移至任意反馈源），在相同的9,432条记录与30个真实产品、事件、对比、元数据问题上，对比Agentic RAG、Deep Research Agent与图谱支撑智能体。在缺乏完整标注的情况下，采用校准后的比较性评分标准，从答案质量（覆盖度与组织性）、分析深度（具体性与分解性）、证据质量（引用支持与可追溯性）三方面等权评分，并抽取被引用记录核查其支撑性。
AI.result: 在该对齐评分标准下，客户上下文图支撑的智能体总体得分为0.961，Deep Research Agent为0.710，Agentic RAG为0.651。图谱智能体在30个配对问题中的27个上领先Deep Research Agent（符号检验p < 10^(-5)；在30个问题中有26个严格最佳）。其最大优势体现在分析深度（0.967 对 0.642），表现为更具体、层次化展开的发现，带有量化主题与可追溯证据。
AI.conclusion: 将客户反馈组织为统一的客户上下文图，可显著提升智能体在答案质量、分析深度与证据质量上的表现，尤其是分析深度方面远优于传统RAG与深度研究智能体，且该架构具有跨反馈源的可迁移性。

title: SkillForge: Co-Evolving Skills and Agents via Dynamic Skill Lifecycles
summary: Memory-augmented reinforcement learning strengthens LLM agents' ability to solve complex long-horizon tasks. Skills are one such form of memory, pairing instructions with an applicability condition over task types. However, retaining every skill indiscriminately as the policy improves lets obsolete or harmful entries accumulate and mislead the agent. We propose SkillForge, an agentic RL method that compiles and evolves the skill library through a fitness-driven skill lifecycle of trial, active, stable, and retired states, so that the skills and the model co-evolve throughout training. A pre-RL evaluation phase first uses the base model's own rollouts to pre-retire low-fitness skills, yielding a filtered library that then seeds supervised fine-tuning. Reinforcement learning takes over from this checkpoint, and at each iteration selective retirement, stabilization, and LLM-guided mutation continue to forge the skill library alongside policy optimization. Across multiple interactive agent benchmarks, SkillForge achieves the highest aggregate success rate, delivering up to 7.8% relative improvement over the strongest baseline while keeping the skill library compact throughout training. We introduce SkillFurnace, a dataset of 5k+ annotated records bundling retirement-filtered SFT trajectories, evolved skill libraries with fitness annotations, and retirement events with human-annotated failure categories to support research on skill quality and lifecycle management.

AI.tldr: SkillForge：通过"试用—活跃—稳定—退役"的适应度驱动技能生命周期，让技能库与策略在强化学习中协同进化，并在多个交互式智能体基准上取得最高总成功率。
AI.motivation: 记忆增强强化学习能提升LLM智能体解决长时程任务的能力，技能（指令+适用条件）是其中一种记忆形式。但若不加甄别地保留所有技能，随着策略改进，过时或有害的技能会不断累积并误导智能体，因此需要一套技能质量与生命周期管理机制。
AI.method: 提出SkillForge智能体强化学习方法，通过适应度驱动的技能生命周期（trial、active、stable、retired四态）来编译和演化技能库。先用基础模型自身rollout进行RL前评估，预退役低适应度技能，得到过滤后的技能库用于监督微调；随后在RL中，每次迭代通过选择性退役、稳定化和LLM引导的变异，使技能库与策略优化同步锻造。同时构建SkillFurnace数据集（5k+标注记录，含退役过滤的SFT轨迹、带适应度标注的演化技能库、退役事件及人工标注失败类别）。
AI.result: 在多个交互式智能体基准上取得最高总成功率，相对最强基线最高提升7.8%，且训练全程技能库保持紧凑。
AI.conclusion: 技能库与模型共同演化（co-evolve）优于静态累积技能的方式，退役与变异等生命周期机制能在提升性能的同时控制技能库规模；配套数据集为技能质量与生命周期管理研究提供支持。

title: Hall Effect-Based Tactile Force Detection Sensor for Robot-Assisted Minimally Invasive Surgery
summary: Robotic minimally invasive surgery has revolutionized surgical practice. However, as the surgeons are mechanically separated from the surgical tools, loss of tactile feedback occurs. We present a compact force sensor with three, millimeter scale sensing elements (taxels) that can be affixed to the grasping face of a robotic surgical tool. The sensor features a miniaturized design using Hall effect sensors and magnets embedded in a deformable elastomer contact layer. Sensor calibration is achieved with a 6 degree of freedom (DoF) parallel robot. Each taxel can detect applied normal and shear forces with average RMSE of 2.133 kPa. The calibrated sensor was validated on phantom and ex vivo porcine tissue, demonstrating tactile sensing during retraction as well as slip. This work introduces a small-scale Hall effect based tactile sensor, enabling sensing for force-sensitive robotic surgical applications.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种紧凑的三轴触觉力传感器，采用霍尔效应元件与磁体嵌入弹性体，可贴附于机器人手术工具夹持面，用于恢复微创手术中丢失的触觉反馈。
AI.motivation: 机器人微创手术虽革新了外科实践，但由于外科医生与手术工具在机械上被隔离开，导致触觉反馈丢失。为解决这一问题，需要一种可集成到手术工具上的小型化力传感器。
AI.method: 设计了一种紧凑力传感器，包含三个毫米级传感单元（taxel），可贴附于机器人手术工具的夹持面；传感器采用小型化设计，将霍尔效应传感器与磁体嵌入可变形弹性体接触层；使用六自由度并联机器人进行标定。
AI.result: 每个taxel均可检测施加的法向力和剪切力，平均RMSE为2.133 kPa；标定后的传感器在体模和离体猪组织上完成验证，展示了在牵拉以及滑移过程中的触觉感知能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一种基于霍尔效应的小型触觉传感器，可为对力敏感的机器人手术应用提供触觉感知能力。

title: STORK: Spatio-Temporal Observation of uterine contRactions via neural networKs
comment: Accepted at the PIPPI Workshop at MICCAI 2026 and will appear in the workshop proceedings (Springer)
summary: Uterine contractions in fetal MRI are typically identified manually and discarded, limiting insights into contraction dynamics. We formalize Uterine Contractile Activity Detection (UCAD) as a weakly-supervised learning problem and introduce STORK, a multi-instance learning model trained on dynamic MRI series using only coarse, series-level labels. STORK factorizes 3D spatio-temporal convolutions into parallel branches across temporal hyperplanes to capture coherent tissue motion without the cost of full 4D convolutions. Per-frame embeddings, combining intensity and Demons-estimated displacement fields, are aggregated by a linear mean-pooling head. This ensures that frame-level contraction scores can be recovered post-hoc without frame-level training supervision. Evaluated on around 700 multi-vendor dynamic fetal MRI series, STORK achieves a series-level AUROC of 95.0% and AUPRC of 94.6%, substantially outperforming 3D ResNet and ConvNeXt baselines. Grad-CAM analysis suggests that the model draws on predictive features extending beyond the placenta into the uterine tissue, offering an automated tool for richer phenotyping of uterine behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出子宫收缩活动检测（UCAD）任务，并设计了STORK多实例学习模型，仅用序列级粗标签在动态胎儿MRI上训练，实现序列级AUROC 95.0%、AUPRC 94.6%，可用于子宫收缩的自动化分析。
AI.motivation: 胎儿MRI中的子宫收缩通常被人工识别并丢弃，限制了对收缩动力学的研究。作者希望将子宫收缩活动检测形式化，实现自动化识别与更丰富的表型分析。
AI.method: 将UCAD定义为弱监督学习问题，提出STORK多实例学习模型，仅使用序列级粗标签训练。模型将3D时空卷积分解为跨时间超平面的并行分支，避免完整4D卷积开销；逐帧嵌入结合强度信息与Demons估计的位移场，通过线性均值池化头聚合，从而在无帧级监督下事后恢复帧级收缩评分。
AI.result: 在约700个多厂商动态胎儿MRI序列上评估，STORK取得序列级AUROC 95.0%、AUPRC 94.6%，显著优于3D ResNet和ConvNeXt基线。Grad-CAM分析表明模型使用的预测特征超出胎盘，延伸至子宫组织。
AI.conclusion: STORK为子宫收缩行为的自动化检测与更丰富的表型分析提供了有效工具，验证了弱监督多实例学习在动态胎儿MRI分析中的可行性。

title: Noise, Denoise, Correct: MCMC Posterior Sampling with Diffusion Priors in Three Steps
summary: Pretrained diffusion models are powerful priors for inverse problems, but posterior sampling under nonlinear, non-differentiable forward models remain hard. We introduce diffusion waltz, an MCMC method using SDEdit-style noising-denoising as a proposal, corrected via Metropolis-Hastings for exact posterior sampling without prior evaluation. We further propose injecting observations into the proposal while preserving exactness, using a gradient-free ensemble Kalman update. On a non-differentiable Navier-Stokes initial condition recovery task, diffusion waltz outperforms existing baselines across different noise and nonlinearity regimes.

AI.tldr: 提出 Diffusion Waltz，一种利用 SDEdit 式加噪-去噪作为提议、并通过 Metropolis-Hastings 校正的 MCMC 方法，可在无需评估先验的情况下实现精确后验采样，还能借助无梯度集合 Kalman 更新将观测注入提议并保持精确性。
AI.motivation: 预训练扩散模型是求解逆问题的强大先验，但在非线性、不可微的前向模型下进行后验采样仍然困难。
AI.method: 使用 SDEdit 风格的加噪-去噪作为 MCMC 提议，并通过 Metropolis-Hastings 进行校正以实现精确后验采样，且无需先验评估；进一步引入无梯度集合 Kalman 更新，将观测注入提议同时保持采样精确性。
AI.result: 在不可微的 Navier-Stokes 初始条件恢复任务上，Diffusion Waltz 在不同噪声与非线性程度下均优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: Diffusion Waltz 为非线性、不可微前向模型下的扩散先验后验采样提供了精确且有效的方案。

title: Self-Evolve With a Reference:Anchored Training of Tool-Integrated Agents
summary: Self-evolving tool-integrated agents learn from tasks and feedback generated within their own training loop. A Curriculum Agent generates tasks, while an Executor Agent learns from self-consistency signals through reinforcement learning. However, relying solely on the current Executor for feedback has two limitations: group-relative advantages vanish under full consensus, while uncertainty-based curriculum rewards favor disagreement without showing whether the generated tasks support further learning. These limitations motivate an additional reference beyond the current Executor. We propose \textit{AnchorLoop}, which introduces a frozen copy of the previous iteration's Executor as a historical reference and reuses it on both sides of the training loop. For the Executor, the anchor provides a cross-reference advantage that evaluates current outputs against both current and historical majority answers. For the Curriculum, it provides an agreement-based reference based on differences in sampled majority agreement. Since the Executor and anchor have identical parameters during Curriculum training, this comparison serves as a proxy for task selection rather than evidence of inter-version improvement or correctness. Across 13 reasoning benchmarks, AnchorLoop improves over Agent0 by 2.5\% on mathematical reasoning and 2.8\% on general reasoning tasks. It also maintains higher effective-advantage variance and continues improving in later iterations as the unanchored baseline shows diminishing gains. These results demonstrate the benefit of introducing a lightweight historical reference into self-evolving tool-integrated agents without external task or answer supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出 AnchorLoop，利用上一轮 Executor 的冻结副本作为历史参考，在自演化工具智能体的训练回路的执行端与课程端复用，缓解自一致性信号的两个缺陷，在 13 个推理基准上优于 Agent0。
AI.motivation: 现有自演化工具智能体仅依赖当前 Executor 的反馈存在两个问题：一是完全一致时组相对优势消失；二是基于不确定性的课程奖励偏好分歧，却无法说明生成任务是否支持进一步学习。因此需要引入当前 Executor 之外的额外参考。
AI.method: AnchorLoop 引入上一轮 Executor 的冻结副本作为锚点，并在训练回路两侧复用：对 Executor 提供交叉参考优势，将当前输出同时与当前和历史多数答案比较；对 Curriculum 提供基于采样多数一致度差异的一致性参考。由于课程训练阶段 Executor 与锚点参数相同，该比较仅作为任务选择的代理信号，而非版本间改进或正确性证据。
AI.result: 在 13 个推理基准上，AnchorLoop 相较 Agent0 在数学推理上提升 2.5%，在通用推理任务上提升 2.8%；同时保持更高的有效优势方差，并在后续迭代中持续改进，而未加锚点的基线收益递减。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在无需外部任务或答案监督的前提下，将轻量级历史参考引入自演化工具智能体是有效的。

title: MultiFly: A Real-World Multimodal Aerial Dataset with Annotation-Efficient Label Transfer and Cross-Modal Semantic Consistency
summary: We introduce MultiFly, a real-world, low-altitude UAV dataset for semantic perception across RGB, thermal, LiDAR, and radar modalities. MultiFly provides 17,272 synchronized samples from four suburban scenes with frame-wise annotations for 15 semantic classes, together with calibration and GNSS-RTK/IMU measurements. To avoid costly and inconsistent modality-specific annotation, we propagate labels from only 115 manually annotated RGB images through shared geometric representations to all four modalities. This approach generates semantic labels for 17,157 additional RGB images, 17,272 thermal images, 840M LiDAR points, and 3.4M radar points. Transferred annotations achieve 89.93% average agreement with held-out manual annotations, and 90.94% average semantic consistency across all six modality pairs. We further establish semantic segmentation benchmarks for all four modalities, revealing distinct architectural behavior for dense LiDAR and sparse radar data. Taken together, MultiFly provides a scalable foundation for multimodal aerial perception and, to the best of our knowledge, the first public real-world low-altitude aerial benchmark that combines consistent frame-wise semantic annotations for RGB, thermal, LiDAR, and radar. Data at https://github.com/markus-42/multifly.

AI.tldr: MultiFly是首个公开的真实低空无人机多模态语义感知数据集，涵盖RGB、热成像、LiDAR与雷达四种模态，通过几何标签传播实现一致语义标注，并建立分割基准。
AI.motivation: 低空无人机多模态语义感知缺乏统一、真实且标注一致的数据集；逐模态人工标注成本高且不一致。
AI.method: 构建MultiFly数据集：来自4个郊区场景的17,272个同步样本，15类逐帧标注，含标定与GNSS-RTK/IMU；仅人工标注115张RGB图像，经共享几何表示将标签传播至全部四种模态。
AI.result: 额外生成17,157张RGB、17,272张热成像、8.4亿LiDAR点、340万雷达点的语义标签；迁移标注与人工标注平均一致率89.93%，六种模态两两间平均语义一致性90.94%；并建立四模态语义分割基准。
AI.conclusion: MultiFly为多模态空中感知提供可扩展基础，是首个公开的真实低空航空基准，统一了RGB、热成像、LiDAR和雷达的逐帧一致语义标注。数据见 https://github.com/markus-42/multifly。

authors: for the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
title: Identity-Duplication Auditing in National-Scale Neuroimaging Repositories
summary: National-scale magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) repositories increasingly integrate data from different studies and institutions. However, subject identifiers that are valid only within individual datasets are no longer guaranteed to remain globally unique after aggregation, making it possible for the same subject to be assigned multiple identifiers, which we define as identity duplication. Such duplication can create leakage between training and test data and inflate apparent performance in downstream biomedical studies. Existing methods do not provide an end-to-end, image-based workflow for auditing this problem at repository scale. In this work, we present HAPPEN, a human-in-the-loop pipeline for auditing identity duplication in T1-weighted brain MRI repositories. It combines SHA-256 fingerprinting for exact-duplicate detection with supervised contrastive retrieval of non-identical scans that may originate from the same person. Retrieved pairs are reviewed as candidates in a locally hosted interface rather than automatically classified as duplicates. We deployed the workflow in a 95,129-scan aggregated repository and assessed end-to-end recovery using 54 genetic-reference pairs. Transferability was assessed by locally deploying the same workflow on 22,386 scans at an independent institution without model retraining or image transfer. Deployment in the study repository identified 1,316 exact-duplicate scan groups and 1,275 reviewer-supported near-duplicate subject groups. Of these groups, 56% and 82%, respectively, crossed dataset boundaries. All 54 genetic-reference pairs were recovered. The external team independently completed the full workflow using a locally selected operating threshold and review standard.

AI.tldr: 提出HAPPEN——一个人机协同流程，用于在大规模T1加权脑MRI数据仓储中审查身份重复问题。
AI.motivation: 全国性MRI数据仓储整合多研究、多机构数据后，仅在单个数据集内有效的受试者标识符无法保证全局唯一，同一受试者可能被赋予多个标识符（身份重复），造成训练与测试数据泄漏并虚高下游研究性能，而现有方法缺乏仓储规模、端到端的基于图像的审查流程。
AI.method: HAPPEN结合SHA-256指纹进行完全重复检测，并用监督对比检索找出可能来自同一人的非完全相同扫描；检索出的配对作为候选在本地部署界面中由人工审查，而非自动判定为重复。
AI.result: 在95,129例扫描的聚合仓储中部署，用54对遗传参考配对评估端到端召回，全部54对被成功找回；识别出1,316个完全重复扫描组和1,275个审查者支持的近重复受试者组，其中分别有56%和82%跨越数据集边界。在另一机构22,386例扫描上本地部署同一流程，无需重训练或图像传输，外部团队以自选阈值和审查标准独立完成全流程。
AI.conclusion: HAPPEN可在大规模MRI仓储中有效审计身份重复、支持跨数据集边界的重复发现，并具备无需模型重训练的可迁移性。

title: Stability and Diversity of Networked Self-Consuming Generative Ecosystems
comment: Published as a conference paper at NeurIPS 2026
summary: The widespread deployment of generative AI has made it increasingly difficult to distinguish synthetic content from real data. Consequently, synthetic data is inevitably incorporated into the training pipelines of future model generations, forming a self-consuming training loop. Prior work has studied the effects of such recursive self-consuming training, but analyses have largely been limited to isolated models, where a model consumes only its own synthetic data, or to simplified interactions between two models. This paper takes a first step toward understanding networked self-consuming generative models, in which multiple models consume synthetic data generated by one another through complex interaction pathways. We introduce a theoretical framework representing models as nodes in a directed, weighted graph, with edge weights governing the flow of synthetic data among models. Using this framework, we analyze the long-term behavior of networked models under retraining dynamics, establishing conditions for convergence and characterizing the resulting fixed points. We further investigate how the system's long-term stability and diversity are shaped by each model's access to real data, cross-model data consumption, and the structure of the interaction graph.

AI.tldr: 该文研究网络化自消耗生成模型：将多个模型建模为有向加权图节点，边权控制合成数据流动，分析重训练动态下的长期收敛行为与不动点，并考察真实数据可及性、跨模型数据消耗和图结构对稳定性与多样性的影响。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI广泛部署使合成内容难以与真实数据区分，合成数据不可避免进入未来模型训练管线，形成自消耗训练循环。已有分析多局限于单模型自我消耗或简化的双模型交互，缺乏对多模型通过网络化路径相互消耗合成数据的理解。
AI.method: 提出理论框架，将模型表示为有向加权图的节点，边权控制模型间合成数据流动；在此框架下分析网络化模型在重训练动态下的长期行为，建立收敛条件并刻画所得不动点。
AI.result: 建立了网络化自消耗模型在重训练动态下的收敛条件，刻画了长期不动点；并揭示系统长期稳定性与多样性如何受各模型对真实数据的可及性、跨模型数据消耗以及交互图结构的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次迈出理解网络化自消耗生成模型的一步，为分析多模型合成数据循环下的长期稳定性与多样性提供了理论基础。

title: LiveMACE: Process-Aware Evaluation of LLM Agent Capabilities in Evolving Markets
summary: Evaluating agents by outcomes alone can obscure the capabilities that produce them. This problem is especially pronounced in evolving environments, where outcomes reflect a closed-loop interaction between agent behavior and changing external conditions. We introduce LiveMACEBench, a process-aware benchmark that uses live financial markets as a naturally evolving testbed for persistent LLM agents. Five frontier LLMs operate along continuous trajectories under matched Tool Use, Persistent Memory, Rule Following, and Multi-Agent Collaboration configurations. We evaluate them through both realized outcomes and mechanism-specific diagnostics derived from complete decision traces. Across 30 days of live evaluation, we find a pronounced outcome-capability gap: realized returns often diverge from capability-specific measurements, and similar outcomes can arise from markedly different patterns of mechanism use. Trace-level diagnostics further expose distinct bottlenecks across capabilities, demonstrating that mechanism access, effective mechanism use, and downstream performance are not interchangeable measures of agent capability. LiveMACEBench makes this distinction measurable, turning live markets from a performance leaderboard into a diagnostic environment for agent capability

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LiveMACEBench，一个以真实金融市场为动态测试环境的过程感知基准，用于评估持久型 LLM 智能体，并揭示"结果—能力鸿沟"。
AI.motivation: 仅以结果评价智能体会掩盖其背后的真实能力，在动态演化环境中尤为突出：结果往往是智能体行为与外部条件闭环交互的产物，无法反映机制使用的差异。
AI.method: 以实时金融市场作为自然演化的测试平台，让五个前沿 LLM 在连续轨迹上运行，并匹配四种配置：工具使用、持久记忆、规则遵循、多智能体协作。评估同时采用实际结果指标与基于完整决策轨迹的机制特异性诊断。
AI.result: 在 30 天实时评估中发现了明显的结果—能力鸿沟：实际收益常与能力测量结果背离，相似结果可能源于截然不同的机制使用模式；轨迹级诊断进一步揭示了各能力维度上的不同瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 机制可及性、机制的有效使用与下游表现并不等价，LiveMACEBench 使这一区分可测量，将实时市场从性能排行榜转变为智能体能力的诊断环境。

title: Semantic-Aware Predictive Mapping for Exploration and Navigation
summary: Predictive mapping can support robotic exploration and navigation by estimating unseen geometric layouts from partial occupancy observations. However, occupancy-only representations may fail to distinguish semantically different structures with similar geometry. This is particularly relevant for indoor doors, which may appear as occupied cells like walls but indicate possible connected rooms or corridors beyond the observed region. This work investigates whether semantic door cues improve predictive geometric occupancy mapping around such ambiguous regions. We modify a subset of the CogniPlan dataset by inserting door-induced ambiguities into partial occupancy maps while keeping the ground-truth layouts unchanged. We compare a geometry-only control model with a semantic-cued model trained on the same modified dataset, where the semantic-cued model receives an additional door channel. Evaluation uses L1 error, F1 score, and Intersection over Union (IoU) over both the full map and a 10-pixel door-region mask. Full-map performance remains broadly similar between models, but localized door-region results show a clear qualitative improvement: L1 decreases from 0.004342 to 0.000025, while F1 and IoU improve from 0.031311 and 0.015905 to 1.000000 and 1.000000, respectively. These results suggest that semantic cues can improve predictive occupancy completion in regions where geometric observations alone are ambiguous.

AI.tldr: 该研究探究语义门线索是否能提升室内模糊区域的预测性几何占据建图，结果显示局部门区域性能大幅提升。
AI.motivation: 预测性建图可通过部分占据观测估计未见几何布局，但纯占据表示难以区分几何相似而语义不同的结构。室内门常表现为类似墙壁的占据单元，却可能指示观测范围外存在连通房间或走廊，因此需要研究语义门线索能否改善此类模糊区域的预测建图。
AI.method: 修改 CogniPlan 数据集的一个子集，在保持真值布局不变的前提下向部分占据图中注入由门引起的歧义。对比仅几何的对照模型与在同一修改数据集上训练的语义线索模型，后者额外接收一个门通道。评估指标为 L1 误差、F1 和 IoU，分别在完整地图和 10 像素的门区域掩码上计算。
AI.result: 完整地图性能在两模型间大致相当，但局部门区域结果显示出明显的定性改善：L1 从 0.004342 降至 0.000025，F1 和 IoU 分别从 0.031311 和 0.015905 提升至 1.000000 和 1.000000。
AI.conclusion: 语义线索可以改善在几何观测本身存在歧义区域的预测性占据补全，表明在预测性建图中引入语义信息具有潜在价值。

title: Quasi-Binarized Autoencoders: An Architecture-Independent Information Bottleneck for Medical Image Anomaly Detection
summary: Unsupervised anomaly detection, which learns only from normal images, is a central task in medical image analysis and remains an open problem. Reconstruction-based methods pass an image through an encoder-decoder network trained on normal data and detect anomalies from the residual between the image and its reconstruction. This works only if the information passed from the encoder to the decoder is limited; otherwise the network learns an identity mapping and reconstructs anomalies too. This limit is usually imposed through architectural choices, tuned per dataset, that cannot be stated in bits. We introduce the quasi-binarizing (QB) layer, which squashes each latent element into [0, 1] and adds Laplace noise of scale 1/epsilon. Each element is then epsilon-locally differentially private, and the mutual information between an image and its reconstruction is bounded by a quantity that depends only on epsilon and the number of QB elements, whatever the encoder and decoder. Placing a QB layer on every encoder-decoder path, including all skip connections, we build QBAE, a seven-level attention U-Net with 32,768 QB elements. On the seven datasets of the MedIAnomaly benchmark, QBAE with one architecture and one configuration reaches a mean image-level AUROC of 0.828, the highest among methods that do not adapt to each dataset, and the best reported results on BraTS2021 (AUROC 0.911, pixel-level AP 0.838). The noise is kept at test time, so that every reconstruction satisfies the bound. Without input corruption, the bottleneck alone prevents identity collapse (mean AUROC 0.805 vs. 0.590). Code is available at https://github.com/hanaokalog/MedIAnomalyQB.

AI.tldr: 提出准二值化（QB）层，通过向潜变量加噪限制重建互信息，构建QBAE实现医学图像无监督异常检测，单一配置在MedIAnomaly基准达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 基于重建的无监督异常检测依赖编码器-解码器网络，只有当编码器到解码器的信息被限制时才有效，否则网络会学成恒等映射，连异常也能重建出来。现有约束多通过逐数据集调参的架构设计实现，无法用比特数度量。
AI.method: 提出准二值化（QB）层：将每个潜元素压缩到[0,1]并加入尺度为1/ε的拉普拉斯噪声，使每个元素满足ε-局部差分隐私，从而将图像与其重建之间的互信息上界限制为仅依赖ε和QB元素数的量，与编码器解码器结构无关。在每个编码-解码路径（含所有跳跃连接）放置QB层，构建QBAE——含32,768个QB元素的七层注意力U-Net，测试时保留噪声。
AI.result: 在MedIAnomaly基准的七个数据集上，QBAE以单一架构和单一配置取得平均图像级AUROC 0.828，在不针对数据集调整的方法中最优；在BraTS2021上取得最佳结果（AUROC 0.911，像素级AP 0.838）。仅靠瓶颈即可防止恒等坍缩（平均AUROC 0.805 vs. 0.590）。
AI.conclusion: QB层通过差分隐私机制为重建互信息提供可量化的理论上界，无需逐数据集调参即能防止恒等映射，QBAE在医学异常检测中展现强泛化性与SOTA性能，代码已开源。

title: Shared Geometry As A Rosetta Stone: Cross-Modal Alignment Without Paired Data
summary: Multimodal representations enable zero-shot classification and retrieval, but aligning independently trained models usually requires large amounts of paired data. Yet, the Platonic Representation Hypothesis suggests that models trained on different modalities may converge spontaneously toward a shared representation geometry. But then, do we even need paired examples for cross-modal alignment? Remarkably, we show that paired examples are unnecessary for coarse cross-modal alignment. Our simple Wasserstein Procrustes method with a coarse geometric initialization aligns two disjoint embedding sets by estimating a single orthogonal map without seeing any pairs. Across datasets, modalities, and unimodal models, we show that we can consistently align independently trained representations without pairs, and standard geometric alignment metrics accurately predict when this is possible. Nevertheless, we can naturally benefit from paired examples. In the very few-pair regime, our method substantially outperforms existing ones, while staying competitive with pair-based methods with more added examples. Finally, we demonstrate that the resulting alignments can enable text-to-image generation without paired examples. These results show that independently trained models often share enough geometry to establish cross-modal correspondence with little or no paired data.

AI.tldr: 无需配对样本，仅用粗几何初始化与Wasserstein Procrustes方法估计单一正交映射，即可实现跨模态粗对齐。
AI.motivation: 多模态表示可支持零样本分类与检索，但独立训练的模型对齐通常依赖大量配对数据。受Platonic Representation Hypothesis启发，作者探究跨模态对齐是否真的需要配对样本。
AI.method: 提出Wasserstein Procrustes方法，配合粗几何初始化，在无任何配对样本的情况下，通过估计单一正交映射来对齐两组不相交的嵌入集合。
AI.result: 在多种数据集、模态和单模态模型上，无需配对即可稳定对齐独立训练的表示；标准几何对齐指标能准确预测可行性。在极少配对场景下显著优于现有方法，加入更多配对后与基于配对的方法相当。该对齐还能支持无配对的文本到图像生成。
AI.conclusion: 独立训练的模型往往共享足够几何结构，使得在极少或无需配对数据的情况下即可建立跨模态对应关系。

title: Think Before You Paint: Recursive Latent Reasoning for Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models generate realistic images but often fail on visual reasoning tasks, such as filling in a Sudoku or drawing the path through a maze. When a discrete symbolic representation is available, recursive methods such as the Tiny Recursive Model (TRM) solve even hard instances of these puzzles. We ask how such reasoning can be carried over to pixels, where no symbolic representation is available. We propose Painter-Thinker (PaTh): a small recursive network (the Thinker) reasons over a grid of learned tokens that encode the noisy image and the conditioning, refines a latent state within every denoising step, and steers a frozen diffusion model (the Painter) through ControlNet adapters. The Thinker is trained with the standard reconstruction loss alone, without symbolic targets, a solver, or a verifier. PaTh solves 92.5% of hard MNIST Sudoku puzzles (prior best 75%) and 71.2% of extreme ones (prior best 4.1%), with 10M parameters against 82M for a standard diffusion model. It also improves on mazes, Queens, and CLEVR scenes with specified spatial relations, and its advantage grows with problem size. Diagnostic experiments show that PaTh recovers from injected mistakes that the diffusion model cannot repair, especially when many cells are wrong. Together, these results show that reasoning mechanisms developed for symbolic data can be integrated into pixel-space diffusion without symbolic supervision, opening a path toward generating data under increasingly complex constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出 Painter-Thinker (PaTh)，用小型递归网络在噪声图像上做隐式推理，引导冻结扩散模型完成 Sudoku、迷宫等像素级视觉推理任务，无需符号监督。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型能生成逼真图像，但在 Sudoku、迷宫等需要视觉推理的任务上表现不佳。当存在离散符号表示时，TRM 等递归方法可解难题，但像素空间没有符号表示，如何把这种推理能力迁移到像素上是一个开放问题。
AI.method: PaTh 由两部分组成：Thinker 是一个小型递归网络，在编码噪声图像与条件的学习 token 网格上推理，并在每个去噪步内细化隐状态；Painter 是冻结的扩散模型，通过 ControlNet 适配器被 Thinker 引导。Thinker 仅用标准重建损失训练，不需要符号目标、求解器或验证器。
AI.result: 在困难 MNIST Sudoku 上解出 92.5%（此前最佳 75%），极端难度上 71.2%（此前最佳 4.1%）；参数量 10M，而标准扩散模型为 82M。在迷宫、Queens 以及带空间关系约束的 CLEVR 场景上也有提升，且优势随问题规模增大。诊断实验显示 PaTh 能纠正扩散模型无法修复的注入错误，尤其是大量格子出错时。
AI.conclusion: 为符号数据开发的推理机制可以在无符号监督下融入像素空间扩散模型，为在日益复杂的约束下生成数据开辟了道路。

title: OpenViTac: Learning and Benchmarking Visuo-Tactile Policies in a Unified Sim-and-Real Framework
summary: Tactile feedback provides embodied agents with physical information beyond visual observations, enabling more reliable interaction with the real world. However, despite the rapid progress of vision-tactile-language-action (VTLA) policies, there remains a lack of unified benchmarks for evaluating tactile-enabled robot manipulation across simulation and the real world. To address this gap, we introduce OpenViTac, a visuo-tactile manipulation benchmark for evaluating robot policies across simulation and the real world. OpenViTac organizes contact-rich manipulation into four tactile-relevant capability dimensions and provides paired simulation-real-world settings for consistent evaluation of VLA, WAM, and VTLA policies. Building upon this benchmark, we investigate how different tactile representations and integration strategies affect the performance of pretrained VLA models. Correspondingly, we introduce OpenVTLA, a tactile augmentation framework that combines the best-performing representation and integration strategy. Furthermore, we leverage the paired benchmark setting to study sim-real co-training and analyze factors affecting cross-domain policy learning. Together, OpenViTac provides a unified platform for evaluating and advancing visuo-tactile robot manipulation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 OpenViTac，一个跨仿真与真实世界的视触觉机器人操作统一基准，并基于此提出触觉增强框架 OpenVTLA。
AI.motivation: 触觉反馈能为智能体提供视觉之外的物理信息，提升真实世界交互可靠性，但视触觉-语言-动作（VTLA）策略虽发展迅速，仍缺乏跨仿真与真实世界评估触觉机器人操作的统一基准。
AI.method: OpenViTac 将接触密集型操作组织为四个触觉相关能力维度，并提供配对的仿真-真实设置以统一评估 VLA、WAM 与 VTLA 策略；在此基础上研究不同触觉表示与集成策略对预训练 VLA 模型性能的影响，进而提出结合最优表示与集成策略的触觉增强框架 OpenVTLA；并利用配对设置研究仿真-真实协同训练，分析跨域策略学习的影响因素。
AI.result: 论文考察了不同触觉表示与集成策略对预训练 VLA 模型性能的影响，确定了表现最佳的表示与集成方案，并通过配对基准设置分析了跨域策略学习的影响因素。
AI.conclusion: OpenViTac 为评估与推进视触觉机器人操作提供了统一平台。

title: A Multi-Source Ultrasound Benchmark Revealing the Limits of Contemporary Self-Supervised Anomaly Detection Methods
summary: Self-supervised anomaly detection is a promising paradigm for medical ultrasound, as normal images are often easier to obtain than exhaustive annotations of all possible pathologies. However, most existing evaluations are limited to a single anatomy or task, making it unclear whether models learn a robust notion of normal ultrasound appearance or only a source-specific representation. We introduce the SADUSI benchmark, a multi-source ultrasound dataset designed to train and evaluate anomaly detection methods across a broad range of anatomical regions, views, and acquisition protocols. The goal of SADUSI is to provide a diverse normal ultrasound distribution and a benchmark for visible structural anomalies that can be assessed from single images. We evaluate representative self-supervised anomaly detection methods and find that current approaches struggle in this setting. In particular, reconstruction-based diffusion methods such as AnoDDPM and DeCo-Diff achieve pixel-level AUROC values of 0.56-0.72 and maximum F1 scores of 0.10-0.26, indicating limited separation of pathology from normal image regions. Feature-based PatchCore variants perform better, reaching pixel-level AUROC values of 0.76-0.83, but remain limited with maximum F1 scores of 0.14-0.40. These findings suggest that broad multi-source ultrasound anomaly detection remains an open challenge and that SADUSI can serve as a resource for developing methods that generalize beyond anatomy-specific settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SADUSI——一个多源超声异常检测基准，覆盖多种解剖区域、视图与采集协议，用于训练和评估自监督异常检测方法。实验显示现有方法在此设定下表现有限，说明跨解剖区域的超声异常检测仍是开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 自监督异常检测在医学超声中很有前景，因为正常图像比穷尽标注各类病理更易获得。但现有评估多局限于单一解剖部位或任务，无法判断模型学到的是稳健的正常超声表征，还是仅针对特定数据源的表征。为此需要多源基准来检验方法的泛化性。
AI.method: 构建SADUSI基准：一个多源超声数据集，旨在提供多样化的正常超声分布，并针对单张图像可判断的可见结构性异常建立评测基准。作者在该基准上评估了代表性的自监督异常检测方法，包括基于重建的扩散方法（AnoDDPM、DeCo-Diff）和基于特征的PatchCore变体。
AI.result: 基于重建的扩散方法（如AnoDDPM、DeCo-Diff）像素级AUROC为0.56–0.72，最大F1仅0.10–0.26，病理与正常图像区域的区分能力有限。基于特征的PatchCore变体表现更好，像素级AUROC达0.76–0.83，但最大F1仍仅为0.14–0.40。
AI.conclusion: 广泛的多源超声异常检测仍是开放挑战，现有方法难以在跨解剖设定下有效区分异常。SADUSI可作为资源，推动开发能超越解剖特异性设定、具备泛化能力的方法。

title: Self-Consuming Generative Models with Co-Evolving Human Preferences
comment: Published as a conference paper at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Generative models are increasingly trained in self-consuming iterative loops, where users curate preferred samples from model-generated candidates and the curated samples are used to train future generations of the model. Prior work has largely assumed fixed user preferences, but in practice exposure to model outputs gradually reshapes what users perceive as desirable, creating a feedback loop in which model distributions and user preferences co-evolve. We take a first step toward understanding the long-term behavior of such coupled dynamics. We show that when training relies entirely on user-curated synthetic data, iterative curation amplifies initial biases and drives the system toward one of multiple singleton equilibria in which the instance holding an initial advantage eventually dominates. In contrast, injecting reference data into training at a sufficiently large rate fundamentally changes the dynamics and yields a unique globally attracting equilibrium. Building on this insight, we study how reference-data injection can be used to control long-term outcomes, and propose an efficient algorithm that jointly selects a reference distribution and its mixing weight to steer the coupled system toward equilibria that preserve desired attributes while minimizing data collection costs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究用户偏好与模型分布共同演化的自消耗迭代训练循环，发现完全依赖用户筛选的合成数据会放大初始偏差并收敛到单一主导均衡，而注入足量真实参考数据可产生唯一全局吸引均衡，并据此提出选择参考分布与混合权重的控制算法。
AI.motivation: 生成模型越来越多地在自消耗迭代循环中训练：用户从模型生成的候选中筛选偏好样本，再用这些样本训练下一代模型。以往工作大多假设用户偏好固定，但实际上接触模型输出会逐渐改变用户对"理想样本"的认知，从而形成模型分布与用户偏好共同演化的反馈回路。理解这种耦合动态的长期行为是一个尚未被充分研究的问题。
AI.method: 作者对模型分布与用户偏好耦合演化动态进行了理论分析。首先考察完全依赖用户筛选合成数据的训练情形，分析其均衡性质与偏差放大机制；随后引入参考数据注入，证明当注入比例足够大时系统动力学发生根本变化，得到唯一全局吸引均衡；在此基础上提出一种高效算法，联合选择参考分布及其混合权重，以将系统引导至保留期望属性的均衡，同时最小化数据采集成本。
AI.result: 理论结果显示：(1) 当训练完全依赖用户筛选的合成数据时，迭代筛选会放大初始偏差，系统趋向多个单点均衡之一，即初始占优的实例最终主导整个分布；(2) 当以足够大的速率注入参考数据时，动力学发生本质改变，系统存在唯一的全局吸引均衡。基于此的控制算法能够联合优化参考分布与混合权重，在保留期望属性与控制数据采集成本之间取得平衡。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次刻画了用户偏好与模型分布共同演化下的长期行为，揭示了纯合成数据训练导致偏差放大与多均衡崩塌的风险，并证明参考数据注入可作为有效的控制手段，将系统引导至理想的稳定均衡，为可持续的迭代训练提供了理论与实践工具。

title: Outperformance Inverse Optimization: Learning Objective Functions that Outperform Agent Decisions
summary: Inverse optimization estimates the weights of an objective function that explain observed decisions as optimal solutions, and is used in a variety of fields. For mixed-integer linear programs (MILPs), existing methods aim to reproduce the observations as optimal solutions, and thus learn compromise weights when the observations are suboptimal. We propose outperformance inverse optimization, which instead seeks weights that induce, at each state, an optimal solution outperforming the observed action in every component. We give a loss function that can be evaluated with forward-problem oracles alone and is thus applicable to MILPs, together with gradient-based and DC optimization algorithms for minimizing it. For weights inducing a unique outperforming optimal solution at all observations, we prove that the probability of failing to induce such a solution at a new state (the generalization error) is bounded by a quantity inversely proportional to the number of observations, and that this bound is tight in the number of observations up to logarithmic factors. In experiments on synthetic and real data, the proposed methods improve the prediction of solutions outperforming the actions over existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"优于式逆优化"(outperformance inverse optimization)，用于混合整数线性规划(MILP)，寻找使最优解在每个分量上均优于观测动作的权重，并给出可仅用前向求解器评估的损失函数及优化算法，同时证明了泛化误差界。
AI.motivation: 现有MILP逆优化方法以"复现观测为最优解"为目标，当观测为次优解时只能学到折中的权重，无法反映决策者偏好的真实方向。
AI.method: 提出outperformance inverse optimization，目标是在每个状态找到使最优解在所有分量上优于观测动作的权重；设计了一个仅依赖前向问题oracle即可评估的损失函数，从而适用于MILP；并采用基于梯度和DC优化的算法来最小化该损失。
AI.result: 理论上，对于在所有观测点上诱导唯一优于式最优解的权重，证明其在新状态上失败的概率(泛化误差)被一个与观测数量成反比的量所界定，且该界在观测数量上(至多相差对数因子)是紧的；在合成数据与真实数据实验中，所提方法在预测优于动作的解方面优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将逆优化的目标从"复现观测"转向"超越观测"，本文为MILP提供了一种具有可计算损失、优化算法与泛化保证的新框架，并在实验中取得了更好的表现。

title: NeRFifyMesh: Optimizing Neural Radiance Fields from Textured Meshes for Robotics Scene Building
summary: In robotics, scene representation plays a pivotal role in understanding and interacting with the environment. The advent of Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and its variants, as a novel representation, has opened a new frontier of research. In applications such as semantic mapping and simulation, roboticists aim to build scenes using multiple NeRF models, each representing an object. While extensive datasets of 3D mesh models already exist, there is an urgent need to develop tools to convert these assets to NeRF models for rapid algorithm development and testing. This paper presents a new pipeline for converting existing mesh models to NeRF representations by artificially generating a ground truth point-based radiance field through sampling mesh geometry and texture. This approach alleviates the need for camera-based sampling or rendering multi-view images of the original mesh to train the NeRF model. Extensive benchmarking demonstrates that our method yields comparable rendering quality to the baselines. Additionally, the application of this representation is shown by constructing unified NeRF scenes and performing collision simulations with extracted geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将已有3D网格模型转换为NeRF表示的流程，通过采样网格几何与纹理生成点基辐射场真值，无需相机采样或多视图渲染训练，基准测试显示渲染质量与基线相当，并可用于构建统一NeRF场景及碰撞仿真。
AI.motivation: 机器人领域需要以多个NeRF模型构建场景用于语义建图与仿真，但已有大量3D网格资产缺乏转换为NeRF模型的工具，阻碍了算法的快速开发与测试。
AI.method: 通过采样网格的几何与纹理，人为生成基于点的辐射场真值，从而将现有网格模型转换为NeRF表示，避免了对原网格进行相机采样或渲染多视图图像来训练NeRF。
AI.result: 大量基准测试表明，该方法可获得与基线相当的渲染质量；并展示了构建统一NeRF场景及利用提取几何进行碰撞仿真的应用。
AI.conclusion: 该流程为网格资产向NeRF表示的转换提供了高效途径，提升了机器人研究中场景构建与仿真的便利性。

title: What Makes Synthetic Hard Negatives Work in Vision-Language Pretraining?
summary: Synthetic hard negatives generated in the representation space have proven effective for unimodal self-supervised learning, but transferring this idea to vision-language pretraining is not straightforward. We analyze six representation-space synthesis strategies and identify two failure modes in their transfer to vision-language pretraining: cross-modal constructions that produce overly easy negatives or pull them toward the query, and intra-modal constructions that incorporate the matched positive. We also observe logit-scale saturation when training with synthetic hard negatives and a learnable temperature, and find that fixing the temperature improves downstream performance. Using this geometric analysis we propose SNAP, which generates intra-modal hard negatives that never involve the positive from either modality, avoiding both failure modes entirely. SNAP is model-agnostic, requires no external generative models, and adds less than 10% training time overhead. Evaluated on top of CLIP and FLIP across multiple architectures and datasets, SNAP delivers consistent improvements on zero-shot retrieval, zero-shot classification, and linear probe evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文分析将表征空间合成难负样本迁移到视觉-语言预训练时的失效模式，提出 SNAP 方法生成不涉及正样本的模态内难负样本，在 CLIP 和 FLIP 上取得一致的零样本检索、零样本分类和线性探针性能提升。
AI.motivation: 合成难负样本在单模态自监督学习中有效，但直接迁移到视觉-语言预训练并不简单。作者希望厘清迁移失败的原因，并设计一种能规避这些问题的通用方法。
AI.method: 分析六种表征空间合成策略，识别出两类失效模式：跨模态构造产生过易负样本或将其拉向查询；模态内构造混入匹配的正样本。同时发现使用合成难负样本与可学习温度时出现 logit 尺度饱和，固定温度可改善下游性能。据此提出 SNAP，生成从不涉及任一模态正样本的模态内难负样本，方法模型无关、无需外部生成模型、训练时间开销低于 10%。
AI.result: 在 CLIP 和 FLIP 之上、跨多种架构与数据集评估，SNAP 在零样本检索、零样本分类和线性探针评估上均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过几何分析揭示合成难负样本迁移的失效模式与温度饱和问题，SNAP 以模态内、不含正样本的构造方式同时规避两类问题，是一种高效、通用的视觉-语言预训练增强方法。

title: What a Reporting Convention Hides: A Matched-Budget Audit of Quantum Natural Gradient with an Exactly Computed Metric
comment: 29 pages, 6 figures, 12 tables. Lu Wei and Yufeng Wang contributed equally
summary: Several published comparisons of variational quantum optimizers time only runs that reach a target loss, or read the verdict at a single target. Either convention could decide whether an optimizer's costlier steps pay off. We measure how much each convention changes verdicts among Adam, simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation (SPSA) and quantum natural gradient (QNG), on initializations held out from the selection of settings. We compute the exact metric that preconditions QNG, price every step in circuit evaluations and give every method the same budget. In a median pooled over circuit widths, cost families and a sweep of settings with common misses, SPSA needs more than twice Adam's evaluations to reach a loose target. Dropping the censored runs that miss the target hides this gap. On the global-cost family we hold fixed the settings selected for a strict target. QNG then usually reaches the loose target after Adam but the strict target first. QNG's strict-target lead disappears when the metric's simulator price, linear in the number of parameters, is replaced by an assumed hardware count quadratic in that number. We recommend charging every miss the budget and reporting verdicts across targets.

AI.tldr: 该论文考察变分量子优化器比较中"仅统计达标运行"与"单一目标阈值"两种评测惯例对结论的影响，发现不同惯例会改变Adam、SPSA与QNG之间的优劣判定。
AI.motivation: 已发表的变分量子优化器对比常只计时达到目标损失的运行，或仅在单一目标处读取结论；这两种惯例都可能左右"更昂贵的步骤是否值得"的判断，因此需要量化惯例本身对结论的影响。
AI.method: 在从超参数选择中留出的初始化上，比较Adam、同时扰动随机逼近（SPSA）与量子自然梯度（QNG）；精确计算QNG预条件所用的度量，将每步折算为电路评估次数，并给所有方法相同预算，同时考察删除未达标（删失）运行与不同目标阈值下的结论变化。
AI.result: 在跨电路宽度、代价族与设置扫描的中位汇总中，达到宽松目标时SPSA所需评估次数超过Adam的两倍；若剔除未达标的删失运行，这一差距被掩盖。在全局代价族上固定为严格目标所选设置后，QNG通常晚于Adam达到宽松目标、但最先达到严格目标；当把度量中随参数个数线性的模拟器代价替换为假设的、随参数个数二次增长的硬件计数后，QNG的严格目标领先优势消失。
AI.conclusion: 建议对每次未达标运行都计入完整预算，并在多个目标阈值下报告结论，以避免评测惯例人为决定优化器优劣。

title: NL2Hull: A Natural Language-Driven Constrained Ship Design Decision Framework
summary: Ship-form design combines smooth geometric representation, local shape editing, and constraints on the resulting hull. We present the Natural-Language-to-Hull Framework (NL2Hull Framework), which formulates ship-form editing as a typed discrete decision problem and connects language decisions to numerical geometry. Its Constrained Free-Form Deformation Engine (CFFD Engine) represents hull waterlines with non-uniform rational B-splines (NURBS), applies free-form deformation (FFD) to their control points, reconstructs the hull, and checks geometric constraints. We construct the Ship Design Decision Dataset (SDD Dataset) with 134,558 cleaned records and evaluate compared models on its subset Ship Design Decision Benchmark (SDDBench), containing 5,000 records and 43,496 typed questions. We propose Chip, a constrained ship-design decision model for processing natural-language requests. Chip reaches 95.90\% question accuracy and 99.32\% FFD exact match, with a negative log-likelihood of 0.0951, an expected calibration error of 0.0032, and a Brier score of 0.0551. The NL2Hull Framework provides a reproducible interface for evaluating language-based ship-form decisions while identifying the geometry and continuous-control components that require further development. Our code and dataset is available at https://github.com/wenhuahuo/NL2Hull.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NL2Hull 框架，将自然语言驱动的船体型线编辑建模为带类型的离散决策问题，并结合 NURBS 与 FFD 几何引擎实现语言到船体几何的连接，配套构建了数据集与决策模型 Chip。
AI.motivation: 船体型线设计融合了光滑几何表示、局部形状编辑与船体约束，但缺乏将自然语言请求与数值几何相连接的可复现接口，语言驱动的船型决策在几何与连续控制层面仍待探索。
AI.method: 将船型编辑表述为带类型的离散决策问题；CFFD Engine 用 NURBS 表示水线，对控制点施加 FFD，重建船体并校验几何约束；构建含 134,558 条清洗记录的 SDD 数据集，并在含 5,000 条记录、43,496 道带类型问题的 SDDBench 上评测；提出约束型船舶设计决策模型 Chip。
AI.result: Chip 达到 95.90% 的问题准确率和 99.32% 的 FFD 精确匹配，负对数似然 0.0951，期望校准误差 0.0032，Brier 分数 0.0551。
AI.conclusion: NL2Hull 为基于语言的船型决策提供了可复现的评测接口，同时指出了仍需进一步发展的几何与连续控制组件；代码与数据集已开源。

title: RoboQuest: Generalist Physical Agents that Search, Inspect and Test
summary: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models have made them capable generalist physical agents for a range of manipulation tasks. However, successful operation in an unfamiliar environment may require an agent to seek task-relevant information through interaction when it is absent from the observations: it may need to determine where a relevant object is, inspect an unobserved property, or discover the effect of an unfamiliar tool. We thus introduce RoboQuest, a benchmark for goal-directed embodied exploration, where agents must actively acquire task-relevant information through physical interaction, use the resulting evidence to adapt subsequent actions, and autonomously decide when to commit to task completion. RoboQuest comprises ten mobile manipulation tasks centered on three forms of uncertainty: search, manipulation-based inspection, and interactive testing. We evaluate five frontier multimodal agents through a common visuomotor interface, as well as a $π_{0.5}$ policy fine-tuned on the full-episode demonstrations we release. The best agent succeeds in only 23\% of the episodes, and the fine-tuned policy almost never succeeds. Isolated tests of the execution skills the tasks are built from, with the hidden information supplied, show that the agents can carry out most of the required actions, and our failure analysis attributes only a minority of the failures to execution. Our failure analysis further finds that the agents often stop exploring too early as they make decisions before observing the required evidence for task completion. We also find that agents rarely prevent or repair the disturbances caused by their exploration. Moreover, learning by trial and error remains difficult for most models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RoboQuest，一个面向目标导向具身探索的基准测试，包含十项移动操作任务，覆盖搜索、基于操作的检查与交互测试三类不确定性，用于评估智能体通过物理交互主动获取任务相关信息并据此调整行动的能力。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态基础模型已能作为通用物理智能体完成多种操作任务，但在陌生环境中，任务相关信息往往不在观测中，智能体需通过交互主动获取（如定位物体、检查未观测属性、探索陌工具效果），而现有基准缺乏对此类能力的系统评估。
AI.method: 构建 RoboQuest 基准，含十项移动操作任务，围绕搜索、基于操作的检查、交互测试三种不确定性形式；通过统一的视觉—运动接口评估五个前沿多模态智能体，并在所发布的全情节演示数据上微调 π₀.₅ 策略进行对比；此外设置隔离的执行技能测试（提供隐藏信息）以区分执行能力与探索能力。
AI.result: 最佳智能体仅在 23% 的情节中成功，微调后的策略几乎从不成功；隔离技能测试显示智能体在提供隐藏信息时能完成大多数所需动作，失败分析表明仅少数失败源于执行层面。
AI.conclusion: 智能体常在未观察到完成任务所需证据前就过早停止探索并做出决策；很少预防或修复探索造成的干扰；多数模型仍难以通过试错学习。说明具身探索中的信息获取与自适应决策是当前模型的主要瓶颈。

title: Latent Watermarks under Generative Editing: A Benchmark and Analysis of Detection Survival
summary: Ordinary prompt-based editing can cause latent watermark detection to fail without explicitly targeting the watermark. We benchmark eight watermark methods against five editors across four generative backbones, four editing strengths, and five semantic categories, with edit-validity and threshold checks. Separating editing from seven subsequent distortions reveals that editing alone primarily distinguishes Tree-Ring, while added distortions expose a broader spectrum of detection survival. Sequential edits reveal a second hidden difference: score separation can decline while detection rates remain near their ceiling. Across methods, standardized clean score separation ($d'$) organizes composite-survival tiers, whereas spatial overlap adds little to predicting edit-only survival beyond clean detectability. Embedding-strength interventions in two methods link higher clean separation to higher post-edit separation. In HSTR, the margin contrast is positive, while the angular layout contrast at matched clean separation remains unresolved. Together, outcome decomposition and continuous separation expose differences hidden by aggregate TPR. Method tiers are stable under threshold recalibration at the main operating points and alternative composite weights. Clean $d'$ is thus a useful empirical diagnostic within this benchmark, with mixed transfer to unseen methods. Code and supporting artifacts are planned for a separate release.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评测了图像编辑对八种水印方法潜伏检测的影响，发现编辑本身主要削弱 Tree-Ring，而后续失真暴露更广的检测存活差异；标准化干净分数分离度 d' 可作为预测编辑后存活的实用诊断指标。
AI.motivation: 普通基于提示的编辑会在未刻意针对水印的情况下导致潜伏水印检测失败，因此需要系统弄清不同水印方法在编辑及后续失真下的检测存活规律，并寻找可用于预测存活性的诊断量。
AI.method: 构建基准：8 种水印方法 × 5 种编辑器，覆盖 4 种生成骨干、4 种编辑强度、5 个语义类别，并加入编辑有效性与阈值检验；将编辑与 7 种后续失真分离考察，进行顺序编辑分析，并用标准化干净分数分离度 d' 与空间重叠度预测存活；在两种方法中做嵌入强度干预，在 HSTR 中检验边际对比与角布局对比。
AI.result: 单独编辑主要区分出 Tree-Ring，加入失真后才显现更广的检测存活谱系；顺序编辑显示分数分离度可下降而检测率仍接近上限；干净 d' 能组织复合存活层级，空间重叠在干净可检测性之外对仅编辑存活预测增益很小；嵌入强度干预显示更高干净分离对应更高编辑后分离；HSTR 中边际对比为正，而匹配干净分离下的角布局对比仍未解决；方法层级在阈值重校准与替代复合权重下稳定。
AI.conclusion: 结果分解与连续分离度揭示了聚合 TPR 所掩盖的方法差异；在该基准内，干净 d' 是有用的经验诊断指标，但对未见方法的迁移效果不一。代码与支持性材料计划另行发布。

title: An extended deep energy method for thermo-mechanical crack propagation
summary: Thermo-mechanical fracture couples transient heat conduction on a cracked domain with a crack that grows as the temperature and the displacement evolve. Neural energy solvers have been proposed for phase-field fracture and later extended to represent a sharp crack through the network input, but heat conduction on the cracked domain and crack propagation under the resulting thermal stresses have not yet been treated together in these solvers. We present an extended deep energy method for thermo-mechanical crack propagation in which the crack remains a sharp polyline. Two networks represent the temperature and the displacement and receive the crack through a scalar embedding function, discontinuous across the crack and smooth elsewhere, so that both fields can jump across it without a regularization length, and the displacement is enriched near the tip by the Williams expansion with trainable amplitudes. The two fields are obtained by minimizing an incremental conduction functional and the thermoelastic potential energy in a staggered sequence, with Monte Carlo integration on points stratified over background elements, densified near the tip and redrawn during training. The stress intensity factors are extracted by the interaction integral with the area term of Wilson and Yu and checked by a sweep of the contour radius, and the crack advances at the maximum hoop stress angle when the energy release rate of the kink reaches the critical value at the crack-tip temperature. On a stationary thermal edge crack the extracted stress intensity factor agrees with the published value to 0.11%, in a functionally graded shear test initiation agrees with an independent sharp-crack finite element solution to within one load step, and on a notched cruciform specimen the crack paths follow the published solutions under mechanical, thermal and combined loading.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种扩展深度能量方法，用于热-力耦合裂纹扩展，裂纹保持为尖锐折线。温度与位移由两个网络表示，通过跨裂纹不连续的标量嵌入函数输入裂纹信息，并在裂尖用工况展开富集位移。两场通过交错最小化增量传导泛函和热弹势能获得，采用分层蒙特卡洛积分。在静止热边缘裂纹、功能梯度剪切试验和缺口十字试样上验证，结果与已发表解吻合。
AI.motivation: 神经能量求解器已用于相场断裂并能以网络输入表示尖锐裂纹，但尚未同时处理裂纹域上的热传导及由此产生的热应力下的裂纹扩展。本文旨在填补这一空白，将热-力耦合裂纹扩展纳入深度能量框架。
AI.method: 采用扩展深度能量方法，裂纹保持尖锐折线。两个网络分别表示温度和位移，通过一个跨裂纹不连续、其他区域光滑的标量嵌入函数接收裂纹，使两场无需正则化长度即可跳跃，位移在裂尖由带可训练幅值的Williams展开富集。通过交错序列最小化增量传导泛函与热弹势能，蒙特卡洛积分点在后景单元上分层、在裂尖加密并在训练中重绘。用交互积分结合Wilson与Yu的面积项提取应力强度因子，并通过轮廓半径扫描校核。当折裂能量释放率达到裂尖温度下临界值时，裂纹沿最大周向应力角扩展。
AI.result: 在静止热边缘裂纹上，提取的应力强度因子与已发表值吻合至0.11%；在功能梯度剪切试验中，起裂与独立尖锐裂纹有限元解在一个载荷步内一致；在缺口十字试样上，裂纹路径在机械、热及组合加载下均与已发表解一致。
AI.conclusion: 该扩展深度能量方法能有效模拟热-力耦合下的尖锐裂纹扩展，避免正则化长度，且在多种验证案例中达到高精度，为热-力断裂问题提供了可行的神经能量求解途径。

title: Where Can a Decision Model Diagnose HVAC Faults? Reasoning Demand, Physical Representation, and Robustness Under Shift
comment: 58 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. Submitted to Energy and Buildings
summary: Artificial intelligence supports building operations in several forms, each with its own barrier. Expert rules must be tuned for every system, supervised models need labeled data that buildings rarely record, and language models return free text that requires human-in-the-loop checking, since their stated confidence is unreliable. A newer kind of pretrained model, here called a decision model, returns a probability for every allowed answer, so one model could serve many decisions without training. This study answers three open questions for fault diagnosis in heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning systems: which decisions such a model can make, what input it needs, and whether its probabilities hold when conditions change. On 128 fault days from four public datasets of real equipment, faults are graded by the reasoning their diagnosis demands, with data given raw, as physical features, or with Brick topology. The decision model Jev, open language models, and a supervised model face nine tests that change season, control configuration, or building. Given physical features, Jev and the larger open model diagnosed faults whose evidence one feature carries, but not faults that need operating context. Under shift they kept their accuracy and calibration, while the supervised model lost 0.33 macro-F1 yet led or tied within a building. Their probabilities still needed correction, and detection was weak. The study maps which faults a decision model can diagnose and from what input, and supports a division of work in which code computes the physics and the model ranks candidate faults for an operator.

AI.tldr: 本文针对HVAC系统故障诊断，评估"决策模型"（返回每个候选答案概率的预训练模型）在多种输入形式与条件变化下的诊断能力。
AI.motivation: 现有AI运维方法各有障碍：专家规则需逐系统调参，监督模型需建筑很少记录的有标注数据，语言模型输出自由文本且置信度不可靠，需人工复核。因此需要一种无需训练、可直接返回各候选答案概率的"决策模型"来服务多种决策，但其适用范围尚不明确。
AI.method: 使用四个真实设备公开数据集的128个故障日，按诊断所需推理对故障分级，输入分为原始数据、物理特征和Brick拓扑三种形式。让决策模型Jev、开放语言模型和监督模型接受九项测试，分别改变季节、控制配置或建筑。
AI.result: 在给定物理特征时，Jev和较大的开放模型能诊断出证据由单一特征承载的故障，但无法诊断需要运行上下文才能判断的故障。条件变化下前两者保持准确率与校准，而监督模型损失0.33 macro-F1，但在单一建筑内仍领先或持平。其概率仍需校正，且检测能力较弱。
AI.conclusion: 本研究明确了决策模型可诊断哪些故障、需要何种输入，并支持一种分工方式：由代码计算物理量，由模型为操作员排序候选故障。

title: RobotWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Robot Use Across Diverse Tasks and Embodiments
summary: General-purpose agents increasingly write code, use tools, and complete complex digital tasks, raising the question of how far these capabilities carry into the physical world. To investigate this, we introduce RobotWorld, a challenging simulation testbed for robot use: turning instructions and observations into physical task execution through robot interfaces. Its 84 tasks span manipulation, mobile manipulation, locomotion, driving, and aerial control, with explicit interaction budgets and executable success checks. By analysing task outcomes alongside execution traces, we identify both the capabilities that transfer and the gaps that prevent reliable completion. Furthermore, we find that current agents can construct sophisticated perception and control workflows, including image segmentation, camera calibration, spatial estimation, and dynamics-based computation. These capabilities, however, do not consistently compose into successful behaviour: agents lose task-relevant object states despite reaching commanded poses, fail to correct ineffective actions, recover too late, or mistake unfinished tasks for completion. This uneven transfer also differs across models: Astra succeeds more often on spatial and constrained-contact goals, whereas Opus 5.5 succeeds more often on continuous-balance and timed-interaction goals. By linking these outcomes to execution behaviour, RobotWorld provides both a rigorous proving ground and an empirical account of the remaining capability gaps, thereby establishing concrete targets for training and designing more reliable physical-world agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RobotWorld——一个面向"机器人使用"的仿真测试平台，含 84 个跨操作、移动操作、运动、驾驶与空中控制的任务，带交互预算和可执行成功判定，用于考察通用智能体能力向物理世界迁移的程度与瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 通用智能体已能写代码、用工具、完成复杂数字任务，但这些能力在多大程度上能迁移到物理世界尚不清楚，缺乏严格的评测环境与对失败原因的实证刻画。
AI.method: 构建仿真测试床 RobotWorld，把指令与观测通过机器人接口转化为物理任务执行；任务覆盖五类场景，共 84 项，并设置显式交互预算与可执行的成功检查。评测时将任务结果与执行轨迹联合分析，定位可迁移能力与阻碍可靠完成的差距，并跨模型比较表现差异。
AI.result: 智能体已能构建复杂的感知与控制流程，包括图像分割、相机标定、空间估计与基于动力学的计算；但这些能力未能稳定组合成成功行为：智能体在到达指定位姿后仍丢失任务相关物体状态、无法纠正无效动作、恢复过晚，或把未完成任务误判为已完成。表现还存在模型差异：Astra 更擅长空间与受限接触目标，Opus 5.5 更擅长连续平衡与限时交互目标。
AI.conclusion: RobotWorld 既提供严格的验证平台，也给出关于剩余能力缺口（能力可分离、难以可靠组合）的实证说明，为训练与设计更可靠的物理世界智能体确立了具体目标。

title: Enhancing Multi-Region Stylization with Interior-Guided Boundary Repair
summary: Region-based neural style transfer enables fine-grained artistic control by allowing independent stylization of semantic image regions. However, compositing these regions often leads to boundary artifacts, degrading visual quality. We propose Interior-Guided Boundary Repair (IGBR), a lightweight and model-agnostic method that improves boundary handling in multi-region stylization. IGBR repairs boundary pixels using interior-guided propagation and applies inward, distance-based blending restricted to object-background boundaries, preventing inter-object style leakage. The method is derived from a region-wise constrained formulation with a closed-form solution and can be seamlessly integrated into existing stylization pipelines without retraining. To evaluate efficiency of our IGBR, we introduce quantitative metrics that measure boundary consistency, gradient artifacts, inter-object leakage, and interior preservation without requiring annotated stylized images. Our experiments and evaluations demonstrate that the proposed IGBR consistently produces plausible boundaries, outperforming prior blending techniques in boundary consistency, gradient stability, and interior preservation. The code is available at https://github.com/Son-SDT/IGBR.

AI.tldr: 提出一种轻量、模型无关的内部引导边界修复方法（IGBR），用于解决多区域风格迁移中的边界伪影问题。
AI.motivation: 区域化神经风格迁移能通过独立风格化语义区域实现细粒度艺术控制，但区域合成时易产生边界伪影，且存在物体间风格泄漏，降低视觉质量。
AI.method: IGBR 采用内部引导传播修复边界像素，并仅对物体—背景边界施加基于距离的向内混合，避免物体间风格泄漏；方法源自区域约束公式的闭式解，可无缝集成到现有风格化流程，无需重新训练。
AI.result: 提出无需标注风格化图像的定量指标，衡量边界一致性、梯度伪影、物体间泄漏和内部保持；实验表明 IGBR 在边界一致性、梯度稳定性和内部保持上优于既有混合技术。
AI.conclusion: IGBR 能一致地生成合理的边界，提升多区域风格迁移的视觉质量，且易于集成，代码已开源。

title: GeoPrior-Mamba: Structured Process Priors with Mamba for Fine-Resolution XCO2 Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing fine-resolution column-averaged dry-air CO2 (XCO2) fields from sparse satellite observations requires models to infer spatial structure that is only weakly constrained by direct measurements. Existing learning-based methods typically treat environmental covariates as ordinary numerical inputs and must therefore learn heterogeneous source-sink relationships largely from sparse supervision. We introduce GeoPrior-Mamba, a multi-directional Mamba framework augmented with offline language-model-induced structured process priors. Rather than using a language model to predict XCO2, we use it before training to organize relative process knowledge for biospheric uptake, ecosystem respiration, and anthropogenic emissions into deterministic prior tables. These priors are spatially instantiated using geographic, ecological, emission-related, and seasonal information and are adaptively injected into the reconstruction backbone through a lightweight knowledge adapter. Using OCO-2 observations from 2018-2020, GeoPrior-Mamba achieves an RMSE of 0.81 ppm and an R2 of 0.93 on held-out observations, reducing RMSE by 48.2% relative to CAMS background interpolation and by 3.1% relative to Trans-XCO2 under the same evaluation protocol. Ablation experiments show a measurable contribution from the knowledge-prior branch and substantially faster convergence than the knowledge-free Mamba backbone. Independent TCCON evaluation further supports the consistency of the reconstructed fields with ground-based column CO2 measurements. These results suggest that language models can provide a practical mechanism for constructing structured process priors when globally consistent process-response representations are difficult to obtain directly, while remaining outside the numerical prediction loop.

AI.tldr: 提出GeoPrior-Mamba，利用语言模型离线构建生物圈吸收、生态呼吸与人为排放的结构化过程先验，并在训练前将其空间化后注入多方向Mamba骨干网络，实现高分辨率XCO2场重建。
AI.motivation: 由稀疏卫星观测重建精细分辨率XCO2场需要模型推断直接测量约束很弱的空间结构。现有学习方法把环境协变量当作普通数值输入，必须在稀疏监督下从零学习异质源汇关系。作者希望借助语言模型组织过程知识，为重建提供结构化先验。
AI.method: GeoPrior-Mamba：多方向Mamba框架。不用语言模型预测XCO2，而是在训练前用其整理生物圈吸收、生态呼吸、人为排放的相对过程知识，形成确定性先验表；再结合地理、生态、排放相关和季节信息进行空间实例化，通过轻量知识适配器自适应注入重建骨干网络。
AI.result: 基于2018—2020年OCO-2观测，在留出观测上RMSE为0.81 ppm，R2为0.93；相比CAMS背景插值RMSE降低48.2%，在同一评估协议下相比Trans-XCO2降低3.1%。消融实验显示知识先验分支有可测贡献，且收敛明显快于无知识的Mamba骨干。独立TCCON评估进一步支持重建场与地基柱CO2测量的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，当难以直接获得全球一致的过程—响应表示时，语言模型可作为构建结构化过程先验的实用机制，同时保持在数值预测循环之外。

title: AgentTime: Can Agents Estimate and Control Their Own Runtime?
summary: An essential control of AI agents is their ability to manage runtime. This ability requires a sense of time-awareness, to predict and estimate wall-clock time and to control their own actions. Prior work has focused on time-awareness, but duration-following and control in native agent harnesses remain unexplored. We present AgentTime, a benchmark for testing whether agents can work for a requested duration, predict their runtime, and estimate elapsed time afterward. It comprises 222 tasks from 18 sources spanning coding, computer use, agentic work, and automated research. Duration-following experiments append a single instruction specifying how long to work, with requests ranging from about a minute to multiple days. Accuracy on these instructions varies substantially: Fable 5.1 in Claude Code deviates from requested runtimes by a typical factor of 2.9$\times$, compared with only 1.2$\times$ for GPT-6 Astra in Codex. However, matching the requested runtime does not, by itself, establish continued work on the task. Among 158 reviewed Astra runs with classifiable transcripts, 14 explicitly slept after appearing to finish. In forecasting experiments, predictions tend to overestimate natural runtimes. In retrospective experiments, removing temporal information more than doubles deviation for Sol and Astra and nearly doubles it for Fable. An agent's ability to complete a task does not guarantee that it can control its own time or work for the whole requested duration. For agents to run reliably, safely, and autonomously over long horizons, we require the evaluation of both.

AI.tldr: 提出 AgentTime 基准，评估 AI 智能体按时长工作、预测运行时长与估计已用时间的能力，发现时长遵循与时间感知存在明显缺陷。
AI.motivation: AI 智能体要可靠、安全、长时程自主运行，需要具备时间感知与控制自身运行时长的能力。已有研究多关注时间感知，而原生智能体框架中的"时长遵循"与运行时控制尚未被探索。
AI.method: 构建 AgentTime 基准，包含来自 18 个来源的 222 个任务，覆盖编程、计算机使用、智能体工作与自动化科研。设计三类实验：时长遵循（附加单条指定工作时长的指令，从约一分钟到数天）、运行时长预测、以及回顾性时间估计，并审查智能体轨迹记录。
AI.result: 时长遵循准确度差异显著：Claude Code 中的 Fable 5.1 偏离请求时长约 2.9 倍，而 Codex 中的 GPT-6 Astra 仅 1.2 倍。但在 158 次可分类的 Astra 运行中，有 14 次在看似完成任务后显式休眠，说明匹配时长不等于持续工作。预测实验倾向于高估自然运行时长；回顾实验中移除时间信息使 Sol 和 Astra 的偏差增加一倍以上，Fable 接近翻倍。
AI.conclusion: 智能体能完成任务并不意味着能控制自身时间或在整个请求时长内持续工作。要实现长时程可靠、安全、自主运行，必须同时评估任务完成能力与时间控制能力。

title: AirGroundVLN: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Goal-Oriented Air-Ground Collaborative Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Goal-oriented Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires agents to locate and reach targets described in natural language without prescribed routes. Air--ground collaboration is valuable for tasks requiring both wide-area search and fine-grained localization. However, systematic study of goal-oriented air--ground collaborative VLN remains limited by the lack of large-scale, diverse benchmarks and two core challenges: 1) substantial differences between aerial and ground views, together with useful observations becoming unavailable as navigation proceeds, make it difficult to maintain spatially consistent context across platforms and over time; and 2) asymmetric spatial observability makes ground perception locally detailed but spatially limited and aerial perception broad but locally coarse, limiting the reliability of single-platform planning. To address these limitations, we introduce AirGroundVLN, a benchmark containing 10,281 navigation episodes and 955 target instances across 19 Unreal Engine environments, with seen/unseen splits and an aerial-visibility protocol for systematic evaluation. Alongside the benchmark, we propose AG-CoNAV, a trainable reference framework comprising two key components: Spatiotemporally Anchored Collaborative Memory (SACM) and Aerial-Guided Regional-to-Local Planning (AGRLP). SACM maintains and retrieves spatially consistent historical context across aerial and ground observations. Meanwhile, AGRLP combines regional aerial guidance with fine-grained ground navigation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of AG-CoNAV and establish AirGroundVLN as a comprehensive benchmark for future exploration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AirGroundVLN基准与AG-CoNAV框架，用于空地协同的目标导向视觉语言导航，解决跨平台时空一致性与非对称空间可观测性难题。
AI.motivation: 目标导向VLN需要智能体自主定位并到达自然语言描述的目标。空地协同可兼顾广域搜索与精细定位，但缺乏大规模多样化基准，且存在两大挑战：一是空中与地面视角差异大且有用观测随导航推进而消失，难以维持跨平台、跨时间的空间一致上下文；二是空地空间可观测性不对称，地面感知局部精细但范围有限，空中感知范围广但局部粗糙，限制单平台规划的可靠性。
AI.method: 构建AirGroundVLN基准，含10,281个导航回合、955个目标实例，覆盖19个Unreal Engine环境，并提供seen/unseen划分与空中可见性协议。同时提出可训练参考框架AG-CoNAV，包含两个核心组件：时空锚定协同记忆（SACM）跨空地观测维持并检索空间一致的历史上下文；空中引导区域到局部规划（AGRLP）将区域级空中引导与细粒度地面导航相结合。
AI.result: 大量实验验证了AG-CoNAV的有效性，并确立AirGroundVLN作为面向未来探索的综合基准。
AI.conclusion: AirGroundVLN与AG-CoNAV为面向目标的空地协同视觉语言导航提供了系统化评估基准与可行方法框架，弥补了该方向基准与方法上的空白。

title: DynStream: Online Streaming 4D Gaussian Reconstruction of Dynamic Worlds from Unposed Video
summary: Online reconstruction of dynamic 4D scenes from long, unposed streaming videos requires both continuous processing and photorealistic rendering, which existing methods struggle to achieve simultaneously. Existing feed-forward Gaussian methods are restricted to offline processing, whereas online point-cloud approaches struggle to maintain dense geometry and high-fidelity rendering. We present DynStream, a framework for streaming 4D Gaussian reconstruction from long, unposed videos. Given a continuous video stream, DynStream reconstructs the scene within local temporal windows and incrementally aligns and fuses these local reconstructions into a globally consistent scene, enabling online 4D reconstruction without per-scene optimization. By jointly enforcing cross-window geometric consistency and modeling time-varying scene content, DynStream supports efficient reconstruction and photorealistic rendering over extended video streams. Experiments demonstrate that DynStream enables high-fidelity online dynamic reconstruction and rendering from long video streams, achieving state-of-the-art performance across diverse dynamic indoor and outdoor scenes.

AI.tldr: DynStream 提出一种从长时、无位姿视频流中进行在线 4D 高斯重建的框架，实现无需逐场景优化的高效动态重建与逼真渲染。
AI.motivation: 在线重建长时无位姿流视频的动态 4D 场景需要同时满足连续处理与逼真渲染，但现有前馈高斯方法仅支持离线处理，在线点云方法又难以保持稠密几何与高保真渲染。
AI.method: 在局部时间窗口内重建场景，并增量对齐与融合到全局一致场景；通过联合约束跨窗口几何一致性与建模时变场景内容，实现无逐场景优化的在线 4D 重建。
AI.result: 实验表明 DynStream 能在长视频流上实现高保真在线动态重建与渲染，在多种动态室内外场景上达到 SOTA 性能。
AI.conclusion: DynStream 兼顾在线处理与高质量渲染，为长时无位姿视频流的动态 4D 重建提供了有效方案。

title: DSReg: Provably Recovering Individual World Latents without Reconstruction
summary: Methods that recover individual latent variables of the world, from nonlinear ICA to dictionary learning and causal representation learning, anchor the latents to observations through reconstruction, auxiliary supervision, or distributional asymmetries such as non-Gaussianity. Methods without these anchors, including joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs), identify the latent state only up to a linear transformation, so individual latents remain mixed. We close this gap: individual world latents can be provably recovered with no reconstruction, no decoder, and no labels. The key condition is Structural Diversity: different latents leave distinct dependency footprints on observations, just as no two snowflakes are alike. Building on the linear identifiability that LeJEPA provides, we prove that under Structural Diversity, DSReg (Dependency-Sparsity Regularization) recovers individual world latents up to signed permutation, without reconstruction or a decoder. It applies post hoc to any linearly identified representation, reusing trained checkpoints at no loss over joint training, and establishes the first fully identifiable JEPA that recovers every world latent. Moreover, as a condition on dependency footprints, Structural Diversity is strictly weaker than all structural conditions of prior identifiable latent variable models. Across synthetic regimes, world model probes, learned visual encoders, and external renderers, DSReg preserves dense prediction while improving individual-latent recovery and downstream use with scales.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出在无重建、无解码器、无标签条件下可证明地恢复世界潜在变量的方法，核心条件是 Structural Diversity。
AI.motivation: 现有恢复潜在变量的方法依赖重建、辅助监督或非高斯性等分布不对称作为锚点；而无锚点方法（如 JEPA）只能识别到线性变换，单个潜在变量仍然混合。论文旨在弥补这一差距。
AI.method: 利用 JEPA 提供的线性可识别性，在 Structural Diversity 条件下，提出 DSReg（Dependency-Sparsity Regularization），以事后方式应用于任意线性可识别表示，无需重建或解码器。
AI.result: 证明在 Structural Diversity 下 DSReg 可恢复单个潜在变量至符号置换；该方法可复用在已训练检查点上且性能不逊于联合训练；在合成场景、世界模型探针、视觉编码器和外部渲染器中保持密集预测性能并提升单独潜在恢复及下游表现。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了首个完全可识别的 JEPA，能够恢复每个世界潜在变量；且 Structural Diversity 作为依赖足迹条件，严格弱于以往可识别潜在变量模型的结构条件。

title: Successive Training Stages and Large Language Model Persuasion: Effects of Misalignment, Supervised Fine-Tuning, and Preference Optimization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can be tuned to influence human attitudes, yet the respective contributions of successive post-training stages remain un-clear. This study examines how three successive training stages affect LLM persuasiveness: (1) misalignment through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on conspiracy data, (2) additional persuasive SFT on argumentative data, and (3) Identity Preference Optimization (IPO), a preference-optimization method. A total of 835 participants recruited on Prolific were randomly assigned to five between-subject conditions (neutral text, conspiracy-trained model, persuasion-trained model, preference-optimized model, and GPT-4) and were exposed to texts on 10 divisive political issues, personalized from their individual profiles in all model conditions. Attitude change was measured as the difference between pre- and post-exposure positions on continuous Likert scales and analyzed with an analysis of covariance (ANCOVA). A significant condition x baseline-attitude interaction, F (4, 825) = 5.33, p < .001, indicated that training effects depended on participants' initial attitudes. Persuasive SFT produced greater attitude change than conspiracy training alone, d = 0.30, whereas IPO provided no additional benefit, d = 0.03, and GPT-4 did not differ from neutral text, d = --0.01. These results show that targeted supervised training on persuasive data increases LLM persuasiveness, whereas preference optimization yields no significant gains beyond it.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过835名被试的随机对照实验，考察了LLM连续后训练阶段（阴谋论SFT、说服性SFT、IPO偏好优化）对人类态度改变的影响。结果发现：说服性SFT比单纯阴谋论训练更能改变态度（d=0.30），而IPO未带来额外增益（d=0.03），GPT-4与中性文本无差异（d=-0.01）。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能够被调优以影响人类态度，但各连续后训练阶段各自贡献多少尚不明确。研究旨在厘清不同训练阶段（对齐破坏SFT、说服性SFT、偏好优化IPO）对LLM说服力的独立作用。
AI.method: 在Prolific招募835名被试，随机分配至五个组间条件（中性文本、阴谋论训练模型、说服训练模型、偏好优化模型、GPT-4），就10个争议性政治议题接受基于个人画像定制的文本。态度改变以暴露前后连续Likert量表得分差异衡量，采用协方差分析（ANCOVA）。
AI.result: 条件与基线态度交互显著，F(4, 825)=5.33, p<.001，表明训练效应取决于被试初始态度。说服性SFT引发的态度改变大于单纯阴谋论训练（d=0.30）；IPO无额外增益（d=0.03）；GPT-4与中性文本无差异（d=-0.01）。
AI.conclusion: 针对说服性数据的定向监督训练能够提升LLM的说服力，而偏好优化（IPO）在此基础之上未产生显著增益。

title: RFPO: Rectified Flow Policy Optimization for Embodied Control
summary: Flow-based policies provide an expressive framework for continuous robot control, but their iterative ODE integration incurs substantial inference cost. Naively reducing the integration budget can severely degrade control, since policies optimized under full-step execution are not explicitly constrained to remain reliable under coarse numerical integration. We refer to this mismatch as the few-step discretization gap. To address this problem, we introduce RFPO, a flow-policy optimization framework for reliable few-step execution. Reward-aware online Reflow rectifies student-induced transport paths during on-policy learning, making the resulting policy more robust to coarse integration. A frozen Gaussian PPO controller supplies complementary action-space supervision at full and intermediate integration budgets, while the deployed policy remains a single flow student executed with one Euler step. Across Unitree Go2, Boston Dynamics Spot, Unitree H1, and Unitree G1, RFPO consistently preserves full-step control performance under one-step execution, with one-step returns remaining within 2.4% of their corresponding 64-step values across both zero and random initialization. On Unitree Go2, one-step execution retains 98.5% of the 64-step reward while reducing onboard mean inference latency from 4.39 ms to 0.08 ms, yielding a 54.9x speedup. Real-robot experiments further validate stable one-step locomotion. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/RFPO. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/RFPO.

AI.tldr: RFPO是一种流策略优化框架，通过奖励感知在线Reflow与冻结高斯PPO控制器监督，实现可靠的单步ODE执行，在保持控制性能的同时大幅降低推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 基于流的策略表达能力强，但ODE迭代积分推理成本高。直接减少积分步数会严重损害控制效果，因为策略在全步执行下优化，未受约束以在粗粒度数值积分下保持可靠，作者将此不匹配称为"少步离散化差距"。
AI.method: 提出RFPO框架。采用奖励感知的在线Reflow，在在线策略学习中修正学生引起的传输路径，使策略对粗粒度积分更具鲁棒性；同时用一个冻结的高斯PPO控制器在全步和中间积分预算下提供互补的动作空间监督，而部署策略仅为单步欧拉执行的单个流学生模型。
AI.result: 在Unitree Go2、Boston Dynamics Spot、Unitree H1和Unitree G1上，单步执行下的回报保持在对应64步值的2.4%以内（零初始化与随机初始化均适用）。在Unitree Go2上，单步执行保留64步回报的98.5%，机载平均推理延迟从4.39 ms降至0.08 ms，加速54.9倍，真机实验验证了稳定的单步运动。
AI.conclusion: RFPO有效弥合了少步离散化差距，实现了高性能、低延迟的单步流策略部署，并具备真机可行性。

title: MeshCarve: Artisan Mesh Generation with Flow Matching in Compact Latent Spaces
summary: Prior artisan mesh generation works largely predict face tokens autoregressively, which makes inference slow. Recent methods instead flow match continuous latents built by Variational AutoEncoders (VAEs), but reconstruction quality drops significantly when geometry and topology are jointly encoded, and further when the latent space is compressed. We present MeshCarve, a flow matching method that generates entirely in compact latent spaces, generating vertex positions and edge connections separately and sidestepping the difficulty of a joint compact latent. To shorten the token sequence, we propose a hierarchical sparse transformer backbone, instantiated as VertexVAE and EdgeVAE. Instead of encoding fields over the surface voxels, both VAEs anchor on discrete vertices in their latent spaces, which drastically reduces the token sequence length, and our spatial-aware compression shortens it further without costing reconstruction. VertexVAE directly encodes vertex occupancy. For connectivity, we propose vertex-link encoding, which turns arbitrary connectivity between vertices into fixed-length continuous per-vertex embeddings and recovers complex artistic topology faithfully. MeshCarve combines these VAEs with an anchor generator and flow matches on the shortened token sequences. It shows advantages over state-of-the-art autoregressive and flow matching methods on Objaverse and generalizes to Toys4K. To the best of our knowledge, it is among the first artisan mesh generation methods whose every generative stage runs in a spatially compressed latent, with a token sequence only a fraction of the most compressed previous autoregressive and flow matching works.

AI.tldr: MeshCarve 提出一种完全在紧凑隐空间中进行流匹配的工艺网格生成方法，将顶点位置与边连接分开生成，并借助分层稀疏 Transformer 骨干（VertexVAE、EdgeVAE）大幅缩短 token 序列，在 Objaverse 上优于现有自回归与流匹配方法，并可泛化到 Toys4K。
AI.motivation: 现有工艺网格生成方法存在效率与质量的两难：自回归方法逐 token 预测面片，推理缓慢；流匹配方法虽在连续隐空间生成更快，但当几何与拓扑联合编码时重建质量显著下降，隐空间进一步压缩后更差。核心难点在于联合紧凑隐表示难以同时保留几何与拓扑信息。
AI.method: MeshCarve 将顶点位置与边连接分离生成，规避联合紧凑隐空间难题。提出分层稀疏 Transformer 骨干，实例化为 VertexVAE 与 EdgeVAE：两者均以隐空间中的离散顶点为锚点（而非在表面体素上编码场），从而大幅降低 token 序列长度；空间感知压缩进一步缩短序列且不损失重建。VertexVAE 直接编码顶点占据；针对连接性提出 vertex-link encoding，将任意顶点间连接转为定长连续逐顶点嵌入，忠实恢复复杂工艺拓扑。最终将两个 VAE 与锚点生成器结合，在缩短的 token 序列上进行流匹配。
AI.result: 在 Objaverse 数据集上，MeshCarve 相较当前最优的自回归与流匹配方法展现优势，并泛化至 Toys4K。据作者所知，该方法是首批每个生成阶段均在空间压缩隐空间中运行的工艺网格生成方法之一，其 token 序列仅为此前最紧凑的自回归与流匹配工作的极小一部分。
AI.conclusion: 通过分离几何与拓扑生成、以离散顶点为锚点的分层稀疏 VAE 及空间感知压缩，MeshCarve 在保持高重建质量与复杂拓扑忠实度的同时实现高效流匹配生成，验证了全阶段紧凑隐空间生成的可行性。

title: When Should an In-Context Learner Expand Its Hypothesis Space?
