summary: Binary Neural Networks (BNNs) enable efficient deep learning deployment on resource constrained devices with weights and activations compressed to one bit, substantially reducing model size and inference cost. Event cameras offer complementary advantages, including low latency, high dynamic range, and low power consumption, by capturing asynchronous streams of events rather than dense image frames. Despite their shared emphasis on efficiency, the combination of these technologies remains largely unexplored. This work aims at adapting and evaluating modern deep BNN architectures on event data. We also show that cross-modal pretraining from RGB data can improve the classification accuracy of BNNs on neuromorphic datasets. We introduce the Polar-wise Binary Event Volume (PBEV), a binary representation that enables event-camera data to be processed directly by BNNs and represents a step toward fully binarized event-based vision systems. Best evaluated BNN on N-Caltech101 classification benchmarks shows 90.58% accuracy with 7.5x less operations than their full-precision counterparts.

AI.tldr: 本文将现代二值神经网络(BNN)架构适配到事件相机数据上，并提出二值事件表示PBEV及跨模态预训练方法，在N-Caltech101上以更少运算量取得高精度。
AI.motivation: BNN与事件相机都强调高效性，但二者结合尚未充分探索，本文旨在将现代深度BNN架构适配并评估于事件数据上。
AI.method: 适配并评估现代深度BNN架构处理事件数据；采用RGB数据的跨模态预训练提升BNN在神经形态数据集上的分类精度；提出Polar-wise Binary Event Volume (PBEV)，一种使事件相机数据可直接被BNN处理的二值表示，迈向全二值化事件视觉系统。
AI.result: 在N-Caltech101分类基准上，最佳BNN取得90.58%准确率，运算量比全精度对应模型少7.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明二值神经网络可与事件相机数据有效结合，PBEV与跨模态预训练能够提升性能，为高效全二值化事件视觉系统提供了可行路径。

title: Closed-Form Noise Calibration Against Membership Inference for Random-Allocation DP-SGD
summary: DP-SGD protects training data by adding Gaussian noise to clipped gradients. The amount of noise is usually chosen by running a numerical privacy accountant inside a search. We study DP-SGD with random allocation, where each epoch uses every record once, at a randomly chosen step. For this setting we give a one-line formula that bounds the accuracy of every membership inference attack (MIA) on the trained model. With $M$ steps per epoch, $E$ epochs and noise multiplier $σ$, and with membership and non-membership equally likely a priori, the attack accuracy is at most $\frac12+\frac14\sqrt{(1+(e^{1/σ^2}-1)/M)^E-1}$. The formula comes from the chi-square divergence between a Gaussian distribution and a Gaussian mixture that dominates random allocation. It is interpretable and gives $σ$ in about a microsecond. Where applicable, our formula needs at most about half the noise of the state-of-the-art closed-form bound. To measure how close the bound is, we also derive an exact expression for the attack accuracy of these two distributions and evaluate it numerically. Calibrating to this exact expression requires $13.0\%$ to $20.2\%$ less noise than the formula in our main experiments, and since it is exact, no accountant that knows only $M$, $E$ and $σ$ can certify a smaller $σ$. In training, the resulting $σ$ outperforms the formula and matches a published accountant in test accuracy. It is found in seconds and certified in minutes, whereas every search we ran with that accountant took longer or returned at least $0.62\%$ more noise. We show that MIAs on the trained models stay below the bound.

AI.tldr: 本文研究随机分配下的DP-SGD，推导出一个简洁公式以刻画成员推断攻击准确率上界，并给出精确表达式用于更紧的噪声校准。
AI.motivation: DP-SGD通过裁剪梯度并加高斯噪声保护训练数据，噪声量通常需借助数值隐私会计器搜索确定，计算开销大且缺乏可解释性，因此需要更简洁、可解释且紧致的噪声校准方法。
AI.method: 针对随机分配（每个epoch每条记录只在随机选取的步上使用一次）的DP-SGD，利用高斯分布与支配随机分配的高斯混合分布之间的卡方散度，推导出攻击准确率上界的一行公式，并推导这两种分布的精确攻击准确率表达式进行数值评估。
AI.result: 上界公式为 1/2+1/4√((1+(e^{1/σ²}-1)/M)^E-1)；该公式可微秒级求解σ，适用时所需噪声约为最先进闭式上界的一半；校准到精确表达式可比公式少需13.0%至20.2%的噪声，且训练得到的σ在测试准确率上优于公式并匹配已发表会计器，求解仅需数秒、认证数分钟，而该会计器每次搜索更慢或至少多出0.62%噪声，实测MIA均低于该上界。
AI.conclusion: 该一行公式为随机分配DP-SGD提供了可解释、高效的隐私上界，其精确表达式可用于更紧的噪声校准，在不损失测试准确率的前提下显著减少噪声与计算开销。

title: RECAST: Learning to Compute the Right Context through Adaptive Evidence Routing
summary: Large language models are increasingly applied to tasks grounded in long, heterogeneous information sources. Conventional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) relies on fixed similarity-based retrieval, while agentic variants adapt queries and tool use but remain largely retrieval-centric. However, in many tasks, the evidence required for a solution is not explicitly present in any single source item. Instead, it must be derived through filtering, aggregation, or computation across multiple source items. In this work, we introduce RECAST (Routing Evidence through Computation, Access, and Synthesized Tools), a learned framework that formulates evidence construction as a sequential decision process over heterogeneous retrieval and computation operations, allowing evidence to be actively derived rather than merely retrieved. A lightweight RouterLM iteratively selects and formulates primitive operations or specifies customized operations for a frozen CompilerLM to translate into executable code. Once it judges the evidence sufficient, RouterLM passes the accepted evidence to a frozen AnswerLM to produce the final solution. We train RouterLM with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by group relative policy optimization (GRPO). Across six heterogeneous benchmark families, RECAST achieves a mean success rate of 75.6%, outperforming the strongest large-model baseline by 15.9%. Moreover, training enables the Qwen3.5-9B RouterLM to outperform a training-free Gemini 3.5 Flash RouterLM by 5.0%. On three held-out benchmarks, RECAST improves over the strongest baseline by 15.0% on average, demonstrating strong zero-shot generalization across tasks and heterogeneous source representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RECAST框架，将证据构建建模为在异构检索与计算操作上的序列决策过程，通过轻量RouterLM迭代选择/定制操作，经CompilerLM编译为可执行代码，证据充分后交由AnswerLM生成答案，在六个基准上平均成功率75.6%。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG依赖固定相似度检索，agentic变体虽能调整查询与工具使用，但仍以检索为中心；而在许多任务中，所需证据并不显式存在于任何单一来源中，必须通过跨多个来源的过滤、聚合或计算推导出来。
AI.method: 提出RECAST，将证据构建形式化为对异构检索与计算操作的序列决策过程。轻量RouterLM迭代地选择并构造原始操作，或为冻结的CompilerLM指定定制操作以翻译为可执行代码；当RouterLM判定证据充分时，将接受的证据传给冻结的AnswerLM生成最终答案。训练采用监督微调（SFT）后进行组相对策略优化（GRPO）。
AI.result: 在六个异构基准族上，RECAST平均成功率达75.6%，比最强的大模型基线高15.9%；训练使Qwen3.5-9B RouterLM比免训练的Gemini 3.5 Flash RouterLM高5.0%；在三个留出基准上，RECAST平均比最强基线提升15.0%，展现出强零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过将证据构建从"检索"转向"主动推导"，并以学习式路由结合检索与计算操作，RECAST在多类异构任务上显著优于检索中心的方法，并在未见过任务与异构来源表示上具备良好泛化性。

title: SANet: Selective Attention Network for Infrared Small Target Detection
summary: Infrared small target detection aims to accurately identify and locate dim targets in complex backgrounds and supports applications such as maritime surveillance and military search and rescue. However, the small size and weak contrast of infrared targets make it difficult to balance detection accuracy and false alarms. This paper proposes a selective attention network (SANet) for infrared small target detection. A dual-path semantic-aware module combines standard and pinwheel-shaped convolutions to preserve local spatial consistency and capture broader contextual information. Spatial and channel attention further refine the features and improve target-background discrimination. To address the limitations of static skip connections in U-Net, a selective attention fusion module adaptively integrates features across scales using spatially varying weights. It selectively enhances salient regions and improves discrimination between true targets and false alarms. Experiments on three public benchmarks, NUAA-SIRST, IRSTD-1K, and NUDT-SIRST, show that SANet achieves competitive performance in intersection over union (IoU), normalized IoU, detection probability, and false alarm rate. Its IoU exceeds that of the second-best method by 1.93, 4.32, and 2.21 percentage points, respectively. These results support the effectiveness of SANet in dim-target perception, discriminative feature representation, and background suppression.

AI.tldr: 提出选择性注意力网络SANet用于红外小目标检测，通过双路径语义感知模块与选择性注意力融合模块提升精度并抑制虚警。
AI.motivation: 红外小目标尺寸小、对比度弱，在复杂背景下难以兼顾检测精度与虚警率。U-Net中静态跳跃连接也限制了跨尺度特征的有效融合。
AI.method: 设计双路径语义感知模块，结合标准卷积与风车形卷积以保持局部空间一致性并捕获更广上下文；引入空间与通道注意力细化特征；提出选择性注意力融合模块，用空间变化权重自适应整合跨尺度特征，替代静态跳跃连接。
AI.result: 在NUAA-SIRST、IRSTD-1K、NUDT-SIRST三个公开基准上，IoU较次优方法分别高出1.93、4.32、2.21个百分点，IoU、nIoU、检测概率与虚警率均具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: SANet在弱目标感知、判别性特征表示与背景抑制方面有效，能较好平衡检测精度与虚警。

title: DSTNet: Dynamic Spectral Trajectory Network for Causal Multi-Horizon Financial Forecasting
comment: 27 Pages, 8 figures, 19 tables, Paper in Review
summary: Wavelet-based financial forecasters typically use the transform only to denoise, or reduce it to a single spectral snapshot at the forecast origin, and the convolution that produces the coefficients is usually bilateral, so it can read past the forecast origin. DSTNet instead retains the recent evolution of filter-bank magnitudes as a causal Dynamic Spectral Trajectory, built from seven trailing technical indicators over a twenty-day lookback with a one-sided Morlet-derived filter bank and an explicit burn-in for the left-boundary transient. A factorized Scale-Temporal Spectral Transformer attends along the time and filter-bank axes separately, a learned gate fuses the spectral branch with a CNN-BiLSTM, and horizon-specific gates emit one, three, five, and ten day forecasts in a single pass. We evaluate seven equity indices and gold under a common expanding-window protocol and an untouched one-year hold-out, against nine learned baselines and a random-walk persistence benchmark. Under MAE and MAPE, persistence is the strongest of the ten fixed competitors in 29 of the 32 series-horizon cells and DSTNet is the only model below it in every cell, by 0.7 to 0.9 percent at one day and 3.4 to 4.5 percent at ten days. At one day, paired testing favours DSTNet against the weaker learned baselines but is inconclusive against persistence and the strongest learned forecasters. A downstream allocation diagnostic does not support an equity-timing advantage on any of the seven indices.

AI.tldr: DSTNet提出因果动态谱轨迹表示与尺度-时间谱Transformer，单次输出多步股价预测，在8类资产32个系列-步长单元中均优于十种固定基线，但相对随机游走优势有限，且不构成择时优势。
AI.motivation: 现有小波金融预测多仅用于去噪，或将变换压缩为预测起点处的单一谱快照；且产生系数的卷积通常为双边，能够读取预测起点之后的信息，存在因果性泄漏问题。本文希望构建严格因果、保留谱随时间演化的金融预测框架。
AI.method: 以20日回看、七个滞后技术指标、单边Morlet衍生滤波器组构建因果动态谱轨迹，并对左边界瞬态做显式预烧；采用因子化的尺度-时间谱Transformer分别沿时间轴与滤波器组轴注意力建模；用学习门控融合谱分支与CNN-BiLSTM；由各预测步专属门控一次输出1、3、5、10日预测。评估在七个股指与黄金上，采用统一扩展窗口协议与未触碰的一年留出集，对比九种学习基线与随机游走持续性基准，并做配对检验与下游配置诊断。
AI.result: 在MAE与MAPE下，持续性在32个系列-步长单元中的29个为十种固定竞争者中最强；DSTNet是唯一在每个单元都低于持续性的模型，1日领先0.7%-0.9%，10日领先3.4%-4.5%。1日步长上，配对检验支持DSTNet优于较弱学习基线，但与持续性及最强学习预测器相比结论不确定。下游配置诊断在七个指数上均不支持择时优势。
AI.conclusion: DSTNet在统计上稳定优于持续性与学习基线，尤其在中长步长上增益更明显，但1日相对持续性优势不显著；其谱表示尚未转化为可交易配置收益，择时价值未获支持。

title: SciExam for ENSO: Can AI Agents Build Climate Models?
summary: Language-model agents are increasingly asked to carry out open-ended scientific research, yet their results are usually graded against a known answer, a rubric, or a language-model reviewer, none of which can tell whether a new scientific model is valid. The AI Science Exam for El Nino-Southern Oscillation (SciExam for ENSO) is a benchmark in which agents build low-order stochastic models of ENSO, the dominant mode of interannual climate variability, from real observations. Within a six-hour budget, agents process the observations, write their own diagnostics, which are then frozen, and develop a model using only these diagnostics as feedback. Hidden graders then test whether the model reproduces ENSO's statistics, recovers unobserved variables, and forecasts held-out years, and score a published model in the same way. Across twelve agent systems, six produce models that score higher than the published model, mainly through better reconstruction and forecasting. The simplified forms of the stronger models are each compatible with one of the two competing explanations of ENSO's warm-cold asymmetry, an open debate that the task never mentions. Controlled runs of the top system under varied information suggest that its scores do not come from recalling the dated observational record and that the information it receives shapes how it builds its model. SciExam for ENSO can thus evaluate agent research where no answer is known, and the results suggest that agents can already build competitive models whose structures bear on questions that scientists still debate.

AI.tldr: 提出SciExam for ENSO基准，让语言模型智能体从真实观测中构建ENSO低阶随机模型，隐藏评分器检验统计复现、未观测变量恢复与预报能力，并能评测无已知答案的开放式科研。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体被越来越多地用于开放式科学研究，但现有评估多依赖已知答案、评分细则或语言模型评审，均无法判断一个新科学模型是否有效。需要一个没有已知答案、基于真实数据的评测方式。
AI.method: 构建SciExam for ENSO基准：智能体在六小时内处理真实ENSO观测，自行编写诊断程序并冻结，仅以这些诊断为反馈开发模型，不可再访问原始数据。隐藏评分器测试模型是否复现ENSO统计特征、恢复未观测变量、预报留出年份，并对一个已发表模型作同样评分。对12个智能体系统进行测试，并对最优系统做信息控制实验。
AI.result: 12个智能体系统中有6个构建的模型得分高于已发表模型，优势主要体现在重建与预报。较强模型的简化形式分别与ENSO冷热不对称性的两种竞争解释之一相容，而任务本身从未提及该争论。对最优系统的控制实验表明，其得分并非来自记忆有日期的观测记录，且所获信息会影响其建模方式。
AI.conclusion: SciExam for ENSO可在无已知答案的情形下评估智能体的科研能力；结果表明智能体已能构建有竞争力的模型，且其模型结构触及科学家仍在争论的问题。

title: FedSSMCoOp: SSM Encoders for light-weight Federated Prompt Learning for Few-shot Classification
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong performance across a wide range of downstream vision tasks, thanks to the complementary information contained in the respective domains. Despite the performance gains, most of these approaches rely on aligning these domains using the cosine similarity metric, which fails to capture token-level structure and cross-modal interactions prior to the classification stage. This is especially critical in biomedical applications under federated constraints, where data sharing is restricted, labeled data is scarce at each site, and it differs widely across institutions, leading to substantial statistical heterogeneity. To overcome this issue, we propose FedSSMCoOp, a federated few-shot image classification framework that enables multimodal learning while preserving data privacy. With the help of the SSM-based Vision Mamba and Cross Mamba blocks, and by optimizing only the soft-prompt and communication-prompt updates in the federated setting, the framework prioritizes both computation and performance. Importantly, this eliminates the need to use an external Large Language Model (LLM) for feature alignment. The framework is further trained and evaluated on various biomedical image datasets, and its performance is assessed. The proposed framework delivers stable performance relative to the baselines and is, on average, 1.96 times lighter. The corresponding script will be made available soon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedSSMCoOp，一个联邦少样本图像分类框架，利用SSM的Vision Mamba与Cross Mamba模块，在保护隐私的联邦环境下进行多模态学习，无需外部LLM即可实现特征对齐，性能稳定且平均轻量化1.96倍。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型多依赖余弦相似度对齐两个模态，无法捕捉分类前的token级结构和跨模态交互；在生物医学联邦场景下，数据不能共享、各站点标注数据稀缺且分布差异大，存在显著统计异质性，因此需要新的对齐与学习框架。
AI.method: 提出FedSSMCoOp联邦少样本图像分类框架。使用基于SSM的Vision Mamba和Cross Mamba模块进行多模态建模，在联邦设置下仅优化soft-prompt和communication-prompt更新，兼顾计算效率与性能，且无需外部LLM进行特征对齐。
AI.result: 在多个生物医学图像数据集上训练和评估，框架相对基线表现稳定，且平均轻量化约1.96倍。相关脚本将很快公开。
AI.conclusion: FedSSMCoOp能够在联邦约束下有效进行多模态少样本分类，避免外部LLM依赖，在保持稳定性能的同时显著降低模型负担，适用于生物医学图像场景。

title: Gauss-Newton Accuracy and Indefinite Hessians: Uniform Coexistence in Low-Cost Sets
summary: We study the accuracy of Gauss-Newton curvature in ridge-regularized nonlinear least squares. Under local regularity and persistence of level-set curvature magnitude along an exact-fit section, we prove uniform coexistence of two curvature regimes. Global minimizers exist, and every global minimizer has relative Hessian error below $(1+\sqrt2)/8$, while the same low-cost set contains a point with an indefinite Hessian and relative error at least $15/8$. One positive ridge cap works for all independent center and label perturbations in fixed neighborhoods and every positive ridge weight up to the cap. These neighborhoods do not shrink as the ridge weight tends to zero. A pointwise certificate based on the current prediction level set controls the normal, mixed, and tangent parts of the Hessian correction. We prove a sharp relative-error bound over the stated pointwise class when the prediction map and ridge vary. Analytic examples describe the roles of output alignment, curvature orientation, and persistence. A separate structural result gives full Jacobian row rank throughout low-cost sets and exact interpolation near a rank-deficient reference.

AI.tldr: 本文研究岭正则化非线性最小二乘中高斯-牛顿曲率的精度问题，证明在局部正则性与水平集曲率幅值持续性条件下，两种曲率机制可一致共存，并给出尖锐的相对误差界与结构结果。
AI.motivation: 高斯-牛顿方法广泛用于非线性最小二乘，但其曲率近似（用高斯-牛顿矩阵代替真实Hessian）的精度在岭正则化下缺乏严格刻画。本文旨在明确在何种条件下高斯-牛顿曲率可靠、何时失效，并给出可验证的误差控制机制。
AI.method: 在局部正则性及水平集曲率幅值沿精确拟合截面持续存在的假设下，分析岭正则化非线性最小二乘的Hessian与高斯-牛顿矩阵之差；利用基于当前预测水平集的逐点证书控制Hessian修正的法向、混合与切向分量；并证明在预测映射与岭参数变化时的尖锐相对误差界。
AI.result: 证明了两种曲率机制的一致共存：全局极小值存在，且每个全局极小值的相对Hessian误差低于$(1+\sqrt2)/8$；同一低成本集合中存在Hessian不定、相对误差至少为$15/8$的点。一个正的岭上界适用于固定邻域内所有独立的中心与标签扰动以及不超过该上界的任意正岭权重，且这些邻域在岭权重趋于零时不收缩。另给出结构结果：低成本集合上Jacobian行满秩，并在秩亏参考点附近实现精确插值。
AI.conclusion: 岭正则化下高斯-牛顿曲率可在低成本集合的大部分区域保持高精度，但并非全局可靠；逐点证书与岭上界可指导误差控制。解析例子说明了输出对齐、曲率方向与持续性的作用，相关结论在岭权重趋于零时依然稳健。

title: RoboJEPA: Scaling Robotic Latent World Models
summary: Latent world models have shown a remarkable ability to predict future states and to plan in the real world. In practice, however, we lack a principled way to estimate how their capabilities scale with model size, data, and compute, an open problem that slows progress in the field. In this work we present RoboJEPA, a world model based on the Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) and trained on a large-scale dataset spanning 12 robotic embodiments. We show that RoboJEPA's imagination error, the error of its latent rollouts, follows a second-order power law in compute, allowing us to predict model quality well beyond the scale at which the law is fit. We further show that downstream robotic planning performance improves predictably with compute, and that imagination error is strongly correlated with it, making it a reliable proxy for real-robot evaluation. Finally, we demonstrate that latent world models can be deployed zero-shot as robotic agents, planning toward a single goal image to solve tasks requiring long-horizon planning on real hardware. We release all model checkpoints together with our training and robot deployment code. To our knowledge, this is the first work to establish scaling laws for multi-embodiment robotic world models trained on real robot data, and RoboJEPA, at 8B parameters, is the largest JEPA predictor model trained to date.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RoboJEPA（8B参数的JEPA世界模型，规模最大），在12种机器人形态的真实数据集上训练，首次为多形态机器人世界模型建立了计算量、想象误差与下游规划性能之间的缩放定律。
AI.motivation: 潜在世界模型在预测未来状态与规划方面表现优异，但学界缺乏一种有原则的方法来估计其能力如何随模型规模、数据和计算量缩放，这一开放问题拖慢了领域进展。
AI.method: 基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）构建RoboJEPA世界模型，在覆盖12种机器人形态的大规模数据集上训练；通过分析想象误差（潜在推演的误差）与计算量的关系拟合缩放定律，并考察下游机器人规划性能的变化。
AI.result: 想象误差随计算量呈二阶幂律下降，可用于外推预测超出拟合规模之外的模型质量；下游规划性能随计算量可预测地提升，且想象误差与其强相关，可作为真实机器人评测的可靠代理指标；模型可零样本部署为机器人智能体，依靠单一目标图像完成真实硬件上的长时程规划任务。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次为基于真实机器人数据训练的多形态机器人世界模型建立缩放定律；RoboJEPA（8B参数）是迄今训练的最大JEPA预测器模型，且所有模型检查点、训练与部署代码均开源。

title: Do Generative Priors Align with Human Naturalness Perception?
summary: Visual generative models are trained to capture the probability distributions of natural images, yet whether their native priors reflect the regularities governing human perception of image naturalness remains an open question. Here, we probe these priors through native prediction errors across 25 open image and video generators. Because raw single-image losses are dominated by scene content and visual complexity, we evaluate directional loss differences using content-preserving, paired relational interventions that selectively disrupt facial configurations or physical illumination consistency while limiting changes in low-level image statistics. Across both domains, these loss differences reproduce human-like selective sensitivities and tolerances, capturing the classic Thatcher effect on faces and shape-dependent responses to illumination inconsistencies. Notably, these loss differences reliably track continuous gradations of human naturalness judgments across individual stimulus pairs (peaking at $r = .84$ on faces and $.64$ on physical scenes) and retain unique human-aligned signals even after controlling for feature distances from frozen vision encoders and standard image quality metrics. We also find that while overall sensitivity to these violations broadly covaries with human alignment across models, the two systematically decouple along denoising schedules, with alignment peaking earlier than sensitivity, revealing that human-like naturalness judgments dissociate from generic violation detection. Together, these findings demonstrate that learning visual distributions yields generative loss landscapes that capture distinct aspects of human naturalness perception.

AI.tldr: 本文通过25个图像与视频生成模型的“原生预测误差”探测其先验，利用保持内容的关系型干预（破坏人脸构型或光照一致性）评估方向性损失差异。结果发现这些损失差异能复现类人的选择性敏感性与容忍度（如撒切尔效应、光照不一致的形状依赖反应），并能追踪人类自然度判断的连续变化，且与人类对齐在去噪过程中与敏感度系统性解耦。
AI.motivation: 视觉生成模型被训练以捕捉自然图像的概率分布，但其内在先验是否反映支配人类感知图像自然性的规律，仍是未解问题。作者希望检验生成模型的损失景观是否携带与人类自然度感知一致的信号。
AI.method: 在25个开放图像与视频生成模型上探测原生预测误差。由于单图原始损失受场景内容与视觉复杂度主导，采用保持内容、成对的关系型干预，选择性地破坏人脸构型或物理光照一致性，同时限制低层图像统计的变化，从而评估方向性损失差异。
AI.result: 在两个领域中，损失差异复现了类人的选择性敏感性与容忍度，捕捉到经典的撒切尔效应以及光照不一致的形状依赖反应。损失差异能可靠追踪单个刺激对上人类自然度判断的连续梯度（人脸r=.84，物理场景r=.64），在控制冻结视觉编码器的特征距离与标准图像质量指标后仍保留独特的人类对齐信号。此外，对违规的总体敏感度与人类对齐在模型间大体共变，但沿去噪调度系统性解耦，对齐峰值早于敏感度峰值。
AI.conclusion: 学习视觉分布会使生成式损失景观捕捉人类自然度感知的不同侧面；类人的自然度判断与通用的违规检测是可分离的。这表明生成模型先验可作为研究人类感知规律的工具与对象。

title: CERO: Where and When to Allocate Rollouts for RL Post-Training
summary: Adaptive rollout methods for group-relative reinforcement learning typically allocate a fixed per-update budget across prompts. We instead study how to coordinate a finite rollout budget over the entire training horizon. We formulate this problem using a concave surrogate utility of cumulative prompt exposure and introduce CERO, an online primal dual scheduler for prompt admission and budget pacing. In our experiments, each admitted prompt receives a fixed-size response group. CERO instead adapts which prompts are selected, how often they are revisited across rounds, and how many groups are generated in each round. A compact Fenchel representation linearizes the dependence on cumulative exposure, while projected online gradient descent updates prompt-specific supporting slopes and a shared budget price using reward-variation feedback and budget deviations. We establish pathwise guarantees for the surrogate allocation objective against fixed-rate and same-path time-varying benchmarks, with explicit terms for proxy discrepancy and rate variation. Under matched training-response budgets, CERO attains the highest avg@16 macro-average on each of three backbones across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks. Mechanistic analyses link CERO's prompt choices to within-group reward contrast, while multi-seed ablations show gains from adaptive pacing over both uniform and preset spending schedules.

AI.tldr: 提出 CERO，一个基于在线原始-对偶的提示准入与预算配速调度器，用于在完整训练周期内协调有限 rollout 预算，并在数学推理基准上取得最优平均表现。
AI.motivation: 现有 group-relative 强化学习的自适应 rollout 方法通常把固定的单次更新预算平均分配到各提示上，缺乏对整体训练周期内有限 rollout 预算的协调与规划。
AI.method: 将问题建模为累计提示曝光量的凹代理效用，使用紧凑 Fenchel 表示对累计曝光的依赖进行线性化；通过投影在线梯度下降更新提示特异支撑斜率与共享预算价格，反馈信号来自奖励变化与预算偏差。
AI.result: 在匹配训练响应预算下，CERO 在五个数学推理基准、三个骨干模型上均取得最高的 avg@16 宏平均；机制分析将其提示选择与组内奖励对比关联，多种子消融显示自适应配速优于均匀与预设消费计划。
AI.conclusion: CERO 能自适应决定提示选取、跨轮复访频率与每轮组数，并在代理分配目标上具有对固定速率与同路径时变基准的路径级保证。

title: Purifying Backdoored Large Vision-Language Models by Removing Hijacked Directions
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical applications, yet they remain vulnerable to backdoor attacks. Defending against such attacks remains costly, as existing methods require either extensive retraining on clean data or per-query intervention at inference time. To address this limitation, we propose OrthoPurify, a more efficient method to purify backdoored model weights via one-step orthogonal projection. Specifically, through structural analysis of backdoor weight updates, we find that the backdoor is encoded by diverting a small number of weight update directions from task adaptation to backdoor shortcut encoding, a phenomenon we term direction hijacking. However, identifying these hijacked directions requires a benign reference model, which is typically inaccessible to the defender. We show that a pseudo-benign model, obtained by fine-tuning the pretrained weights on only a small set of clean samples, provides a sufficient approximation, as the dominant update directions stabilize within the first few gradient steps. OrthoPurify uses this pseudo-benign reference to isolate the hijacked directions and removes them through a single projection on the weight update. Extensive experiments show that OrthoPurify reduces the attack success rate to near zero while preserving the original performance across diverse benchmarks, without retraining the backdoored model or introducing inference-time overhead. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/womeimingzi/OrthoPurify.

AI.tldr: OrthoPurify：通过一步正交投影高效净化后门模型权重，无需重训练或推理干预。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）广泛应用于安全关键场景，却易受后门攻击；现有防御要么需大量干净数据重训练，要么需逐查询推理干预，成本高昂。
AI.method: 通过后门权重更新的结构分析，发现后门由少数权重更新方向被"方向劫持"（从任务适配转向后门捷径编码）所编码；由于防守方无法获得良性参考模型，作者用少量干净样本微调预训练权重得到"伪良性模型"（主导更新方向在前几步梯度即稳定）来近似；OrthoPurify 以此为参考隔离被劫持方向，并对权重更新做一次正交投影予以移除。
AI.result: 在多种基准上，OrthoPurify 将攻击成功率降至接近零，同时保持原始性能，且无需重训练后门模型、不增加推理开销。
AI.conclusion: OrthoPurify 提供了一种高效、无需重训练与推理干预的后门净化方法，代码已公开。

title: Few-Shot Learning for Personalised Automated Pain Assessment
summary: Pain perception varies substantially across individuals, making it difficult for population-based classifiers to generalise across all subjects in a dataset. One way to account for subject variability is to train personalised classifiers. In this work, we evaluate Few-Shot Learning, a sub-area of Meta-Learning, as an approach to personalisation in automated pain assessment. We re-interpret the shift from population-level to subject-level evaluation as a task-domain shift, where the observed classes remain fixed but the target subject changes. We evaluate our method on the BioVid Pain Database, the SenseEmotion Database, and the PainMonit Experimental Dataset (PMED), reaching 85.75% and 35.49% accuracy on BioVid and 82.37% and 41.88% on SenseEmotion in the binary and multi-class settings under a Leave-One-Subject-Out CV protocol respectively, and 90.47% on PMED, for which only a binary benchmark exists. Using samples to implement k-shot conditioning, the accuracies can be improved to 86.25%, 40.06%, 83.43%, 44.08%, and 91.25%, respectively. To further evaluate the effects and robustness of our method, we provide additional ablation experiments and investigate the personalisation effects. Our results suggest that support-conditioned few-shot adaptation can improve average performance under inter-subject variability.

AI.tldr: 本文评估小样本学习作为疼痛评估个性化方法，将跨被试评估重构为任务域偏移问题，在三个数据集上验证了支持样本条件化的小样本适应能提升性能。
AI.motivation: 疼痛感知在个体间差异显著，导致基于群体的分类器难以在所有被试上泛化。
AI.method: 采用元学习中的小样本学习实现个性化，将从群体级到被试级评估的转变重新解释为任务域偏移（类别固定但目标被试改变）。在BioVid、SenseEmotion和PMED数据集上评估，使用留一被试交叉验证协议，并通过k-shot支持样本条件化以及额外消融实验研究个性化效果。
AI.result: 在二分类与多分类下，BioVid达85.75%和35.49%，SenseEmotion达82.37%和41.88%，PMED（仅二分类）达90.47%。使用k-shot条件化后分别提升至86.25%、40.06%、83.43%、44.08%和91.25%。
AI.conclusion: 支持样本条件化的小样本适应可在被试间变异性下提升平均性能。

title: Beyond Policy Support: Interaction Constrained Offline Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Driving
summary: Offline reinforcement learning enables reward-driven policy improvement from fixed datasets without requiring online exploration, making it particularly attractive in safety-critical domains. A central challenge, however, is distribution shift: policy optimization may favor actions that are weakly supported by the offline data, rendering value estimates unreliable. Existing approaches primarily control this shift in the policy's own action space. In interactive environments such as autonomous driving, this can be insufficient: a candidate ego trajectory may remain well supported under the marginal behavior distribution while being poorly supported jointly with the surrounding-agent behavior observed in the logged interaction. We refer to this degradation in interaction support as \emph{interaction distribution shift} (IDS), and introduce \emph{Interaction-Constrained Drive Policy} (ICDP), an offline reinforcement learning framework that explicitly controls interaction-level distribution shift. Starting from the joint data distribution over ego and surrounding-agent futures, we show that joint-support degradation decomposes exactly into an ego-support component and a residual interaction-support component. We recover the latter through contrastive density-ratio estimation, isolating interaction compatibility without explicit joint-density modeling, surrounding-agent prediction, or rollouts in reactive simulators or learned world models during policy optimization. Closed-loop evaluations on nuPlan, Interplan and real-world truck experiments show that ICDP suppresses high-value yet interaction-unsupported trajectory selections and improves performance in interaction-critical driving scenarios. Project webpage: https://mahmoud-selim.github.io/ICDP/

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ICDP框架，在离线强化学习中显式控制"交互分布偏移"（IDS），通过对比密度比估计分离交互支持度，提升自动驾驶等交互关键场景的闭环性能。
AI.motivation: 离线强化学习面临分布偏移挑战，策略优化可能偏向离线数据支持不足的动作，导致价值估计不可靠。现有方法主要控制策略自身动作空间的偏移，但在自动驾驶等交互环境中不足：候选自车轨迹在边际行为分布下支持良好，却在与日志交互中周围车辆行为的联合支持上不足，即"交互分布偏移"（IDS）。
AI.method: 从自车与周围车辆未来的联合数据分布出发，证明联合支持度退化可精确分解为自车支持分量与残差交互支持分量。通过对比密度比估计恢复残差交互支持分量，在策略优化中隔离交互兼容性，无需显式联合密度建模、周围车辆预测，也无需在反应式模拟器或学习世界模型中进行rollout。
AI.result: 在nuPlan、InterPlan及真实卡车实验的闭环评估中，ICDP抑制了高价值但交互不支持的轨迹选择，并提升了交互关键驾驶场景的性能。
AI.conclusion: ICDP通过显式控制交互级分布偏移，有效解决离线强化学习在交互环境中的分布偏移问题，提升自动驾驶等安全关键场景的策略表现。

title: MSU Team at the Explainable Deepfake Detection Challenge 2026: Grounded Artifact Evidence for Deepfake Detection
summary: Recent advances in generative image models have made many manipulated images highly realistic, raising the need for detectors that are not only accurate but also able to provide visual evidence for their decisions. In this paper, we present our solution to the Explainable Deepfake Detection Challenge [2] on the XPlainVerse dataset [1], where systems are required to predict whether an image is real or fake and generate both complex and simple explanations grounded in visible forensic cues. Our method follows a modular detection-and-explanation design. For the real/fake decision, we build a multi-backbone detector that combines several DINOv3 models with Mesorch manipulation-localization features, bringing together pretrained visual representations, DCT-aware cues, and multi-scale forensic information. To inject explanation evidence into the detector, we use a Grounding-DINO-based pseudo-mask generation pipeline that converts local artifact descriptions from training explanations into weak patch- level supervision for an Artifact Evidence Map. We further introduce a local patch-level contrastive objective that separates artifact and authenticity evidence in the detector feature space without requiring paired images or pixel-level manipulation masks. For language output, we use class-conditional Qwen3-VL models to generate complex explanations for fake and real predictions, followed by a GRPO-optimized text simplification model. The proposed methods were trained and evaluated on the challenge subset of XPlainVerse. On the full test split, our submission achieves 0.9349 detection accuracy, 0.5571 explanation score, and a 0.7456 final challenge score.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套模块化的检测与解释方案，用于可解释深度伪造检测挑战赛：用多骨干检测器判断图像真伪，用Grounding-DINO伪掩码与局部对比学习注入证据，用Qwen3-VL加GRPO生成并简化解释文本。
AI.motivation: 生成式图像模型使伪造图像高度逼真，现有检测器不仅要准确，还需为判断提供可视化取证依据，即可解释性不足。
AI.method: 采用模块化"检测+解释"设计：检测端由多个DINOv3模型与Mesorch篡改定位特征融合成多骨干检测器，结合预训练视觉表征、DCT感知线索与多尺度取证信息；通过Grounding-DINO伪掩码生成管线，将训练解释中的局部伪影描述转为弱块级监督以构建伪影证据图；引入局部块级对比目标，在无配对图像和像素级掩码条件下分离伪影与真实性证据；语言端用类别条件Qwen3-VL生成真/假复杂解释，再用GRPO优化的文本简化模型输出简单解释。
AI.result: 在XPlainVerse挑战子集上训练与评估，完整测试集上取得0.9349检测准确率、0.5571解释分数、0.7456最终挑战分数。
AI.conclusion: 该模块化检测-解释框架在保持高检测精度的同时提供了基于可见取证线索的解释，验证了弱监督证据图与免配对对比学习在可解释深度伪造检测中的有效性。

title: Pretraining Shapes Spectral Structure: Architecture- and Strategy-Conditional Prediction of OOD Robustness in Foundation Models
summary: Can we determine whether a foundation model will generalize out-of-distribution (OOD) before any target data is available? Existing diagnostics require source or target data, which rules them out before a target domain exists. Those that use the weights alone apply one statistic to every architecture, and do not separate robust models from fragile ones. We show the answer is encoded in the spectral structure of pretrained weights. Two forces shape that structure. Architecture determines how information is stored in weight matrices. Pretraining strategy determines what is rewarded. Together they set a spectral geometry that governs OOD robustness. We prove that the OOD accuracy gap is bounded by how tightly the source representations concentrate. A statistic computed from the pretrained weights alone serves as a proxy for that concentration. The direction of that proxy reverses between architecture families. We operationalize it: the direction is stable within one (architecture X strategy) combination, the finest grouping we test, which we call a cell. Pooled over 116 models spanning 7 modalities, a single statistic ranks OOD robustness weakly, because cells of opposite direction cancel. Within a cell, the statistic selected for it orders 92% of model pairs by OOD robustness in-sample. The selection does not leak the target: for each model family outside the matrix we logged the cell, metric and sign before running its OOD evaluation, and the predicted direction held in every case: EEG, genomic and protein. Acting on spectral concentration narrows the OOD gap by 24% at 87.5% ID retention. The diagnostic operates on released weights alone, so OOD robustness becomes checkable at model-selection time, before data or compute is committed to a target domain.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种仅基于预训练权重谱结构的诊断方法，可在无目标数据时预测基础模型的分布外（OOD）鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有OOD诊断需要源域或目标域数据，在目标域尚不存在时无法使用；且仅用权重的方法对所有架构套用单一统计量，无法区分鲁棒与脆弱模型。
AI.method: 作者从理论证明OOD精度差距被源表示的集中程度所界定，并用仅依赖预训练权重的统计量作为该集中度的代理。该代理的方向在不同架构族间会反转，因此按（架构×策略）这一最细分组（称为"cell"）来稳定方向。
AI.result: 在7种模态、116个模型上，全局单一统计量排序OOD鲁棒性较弱（因相反方向的cell相互抵消）；而在同一cell内，针对性选择的统计量可在样本内对92%的模型对正确排序。在矩阵外模型上，预测方向在EEG、基因组和蛋白质任务中均成立。依据谱集中度行动可将OOD差距缩小24%，同时保持87.5%的ID保留率。
AI.conclusion: 该诊断仅需已发布的预训练权重即可运行，使OOD鲁棒性可在模型选择阶段、投入目标域数据或算力之前进行检验。

title: Perceptually Aligned Evaluation of Style Transfer
summary: Style transfer lacks a reliable evaluation standard: ground truth is inherently ill-defined, and existing automatic metrics often fail to reflect human preference. This paper introduces ASTRA (Assessment of Style TRansfer Algorithms), an approach for automatic evaluation of style transfer algorithms; it contains two components, ASTRA-Data and ASTRA-Score. ASTRA-Data consists of a benchmark image set of content and style references, a collection of style transfer results generated on the benchmark set, and user study data capturing human judgements through a two-stage pairwise comparison protocol. From these annotations, we derive ranking-based ground truth for content preservation, style fidelity, and overall preference. Based on ASTRA-Data, we construct ASTRA-Score, a learnt evaluator that predicts preference-aligned scores from content-style-stylization image triplets, enabling automatic and scalable evaluation of new models applied to the benchmark set. Experimental results demonstrate that ASTRA-Score achieves substantially higher correlation with human rankings compared to prior metrics. Overall, ASTRA establishes a robust mechanism for standardised evaluation of style transfer methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ASTRA，用于风格迁移算法的自动评估，包含基准数据与学习型评分器两部分。
AI.motivation: 风格迁移缺乏可靠评估标准：真实参考结果本身定义模糊，现有自动指标难以反映人类偏好。
AI.method: ASTRA由两部分组成：ASTRA-Data构建基准图像集（内容与风格参考）、风格迁移结果集合，以及通过两阶段成对比较协议收集的人类判断数据，并据此导出内容保持、风格保真和整体偏好的排序型真值；ASTRA-Score基于该数据训练，输入内容-风格-风格化图像三元组，预测与人类偏好一致的分数，实现对新模型的可扩展自动评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，ASTRA-Score与人类排序的相关性显著高于已有指标。
AI.conclusion: ASTRA为风格迁移方法提供了稳健的标准化评估机制。

title: EC-EarthFlow: Probabilistic emulation of daily transient global climate model simulations with flow matching
summary: We introduce EC-EarthFlow, a generative flow matching model that emulates simulations from the physical climate model EC-Earth3. The model is trained on transient simulations from EC-Earth3 (1950-2166, SSP2-4.5) to predict the day ahead temperature field from the previous days temperature as well as annual mean temperature. Predictions are made auto-regressively with rollout periods of between a month and an extended season. Using only this variable of interest, we are able to reproduce the daily variability, spatial patterns, annual cycle and long-term trend from EC-Earth3 at a substantially lower computational cost than the physical model. We demonstrate that EC-EarthFlow is stable for long inference periods, and that it can learn the physical relationships as simulated in EC-Earth3.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EC-EarthFlow，一种基于生成式流匹配（flow matching）的模型，用于模拟物理气候模型EC-Earth3的仿真结果，实现低成本的日尺度温度场预测。
AI.motivation: 物理气候模型（如EC-Earth3）计算成本高昂。作者希望用生成式机器学习模型在保持关键气候特征的前提下，以显著更低的计算代价替代或加速物理仿真。
AI.method: 构建EC-EarthFlow生成式流匹配模型，在EC-Earth3的瞬态仿真数据（1950-2166年，SSP2-4.5情景）上训练。模型仅以目标变量（温度）为输入，利用前几天的温度场及年平均温度预测次日的温度场，并以自回归方式滚动推理，推理时长从一个月到更长季节。
AI.result: 模型成功复现了EC-Earth3的日尺度变率、空间分布形态、年循环及长期趋势，计算成本显著低于物理模型；在长时间推理中保持稳定，并能学习到EC-Earth3所模拟的物理关系。
AI.conclusion: EC-EarthFlow证明生成式流匹配方法能以低成本模拟气候模型，具备长时间稳定推理能力和对物理关系的再现能力，为气候仿真加速提供了有前景的途径。

title: Multi-Agent Coordination via Support-Preserving Distillation
summary: Offline MARL increasingly relies on generative policies to model multimodal joint behavior, typically by distilling a centralized teacher into decentralized one-step actors under the CTDE. We identify a failure mode at the teacher training stage: standard flow-based teachers pair noise with replay targets independently, so nearby noise samples can be routed toward conflicting coordination modes. The teacher then produces samples between valid modes, and because the distillation loss regresses each local actor onto the conditional mean of the teacher's output given local input, this error is not absorbed but propagated to the student. To remove this teacher-side artifact, we propose Mode-Support Semi-Discrete Optimal Transport (MoSDOT), which summarizes multimodal replay into a finite mode support with prescribed capacities and uses conditional semi-discrete optimal transport to assign each noise sample to a single mode before teacher training. We additionally study a shared-randomness variant that uses a shared noise component at execution to expose the residual gap intrinsic to strict-product execution. On controlled diagnostics and offline MARL benchmarks, MoSDOT improves endpoint quality and routing consistency, particularly on datasets exhibiting multimodal joint behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文识别出离线MARL中基于流模型的教师训练存在路由冲突问题，并提出MoSDOT方法以消除该教师侧伪影。
AI.motivation: 离线MARL常用生成式策略建模多模态联合行为：先将集中式教师蒸馏为CTDE下的去中心化单步actor。作者发现教师训练阶段存在失败模式：标准流式教师将噪声与回放目标独立配对，导致相近噪声样本被路由到相互冲突的协调模式，教师输出落在有效模式之间；而蒸馏损失将各局部actor回归到教师输出的条件均值，使该误差被传播至学生而非被吸收。
AI.method: 提出Mode-Support Semi-Discrete Optimal Transport（MoSDOT）：将多模态回放数据总结为具有预定容量的有限模式支撑集，并使用条件半离散最优传输在教师训练前将每个噪声样本分配给单一模式。此外研究了共享随机性变体，在执行时使用共享噪声分量，以暴露严格乘积执行固有的残余差距。
AI.result: 在受控诊断实验和离线MARL基准上，MoSDOT提升了端点质量和路由一致性，在呈现多模态联合行为的数据集上尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 通过将噪声样本与单一模式进行条件半离散最优传输分配，MoSDOT能够在教师训练阶段消除多模式间插值的伪影，从而改善离线MARL中生成式策略的蒸馏效果，并揭示严格乘积执行的残余差距。

title: Playing with Kruskal: algorithms for flat and hierarchical watershed cuts
summary: In the framework of edge-weighted graphs, watersheds have proven to be linked to well-known optimization problems, as Minimum Spanning Tree, which allowed the design of efficient algorithms for computing (hierarchical) watershed segmentations. In the present article, after reviewing the literature related to watershed segmentation, we present a detailed end-to-end pipeline of algorithms to compute (hierarchical) watershed segmentations, starting from the computation of graph-based image representations, up to the computation of connected components of the final (hierarchical) segmentation. We consider the several variations of watersheds, including their supervised and unsupervised versions, and the various ways of computing seeds, to name a few. For the first time, we bring together all these watershed notions and algorithms in a compact and understandable way. We aim at providing a reference for those interested in employing and reimplementing the watershed segmentation framework for their task at hand.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了基于边加权图的（层次）分水岭分割方法，梳理了从图表示到分割连通分量计算的完整算法流程，并首次将各类分水岭概念与算法统一整合。
AI.motivation: 分水岭与最小生成树等经典优化问题相关联，可高效计算（层次）分水岭分割，但相关概念和算法分散，缺乏系统的整合性参考。
AI.method: 在边加权图框架下，回顾分水岭分割相关文献，给出从图基图像表示计算到最终（层次）分割连通分量计算的端到端算法流程；涵盖分水岭的多种变体，包括有监督与无监督版本及不同种子计算方式。
AI.result: 首次以紧凑且易懂的方式将各类分水岭概念与算法汇集在一起，形成完整的算法流程体系。
AI.conclusion: 为有意应用或重新实现分水岭分割框架的研究者提供参考。

title: SoftSEEPS improves ML-based precipitation forecasting
summary: In this paper we have developed a differentiable approximation of the well-known SEEPS score, which we name SoftSEEPS. This allows the training of a Machine Learning model to forecast precipitation directly. We test SoftSEEPS on the IMERG dataset (0.1 degree resolution) by training a decoder for precipitation on the latent space of a pre-trained low-resolution forecasting model. Combining SoftSEEPS and RMSE in a joint objective is possible with marginal trade-offs in either metric.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可微分的 SoftSEEPS 评分，用于直接训练降水预报的机器学习模型。
AI.motivation: SEEPS 是降水评估的常用评分，但不可微分，难以直接用于机器学习模型的训练，因此需要其可微近似。
AI.method: 构造 SEEPS 的可微分近似 SoftSEEPS，并在 IMERG 数据集（0.1 度分辨率）上，基于预训练低分辨率预报模型的隐空间训练一个降水解码器；同时将 SoftSEEPS 与 RMSE 组合为联合目标。
AI.result: SoftSEEPS 能够用于降水预报模型的直接训练；联合目标在两项指标上仅有轻微折衷。
AI.conclusion: 可微分评分使降水预报可直接以评估指标为优化目标，且与 RMSE 联合使用具有可行性。

title: Video Prediction Policy 2: Predict Better, Act Better
summary: World action models (WAMs) have emerged as an important class of generalist robot policies, aiming to transfer video prediction priors to action learning. However, we find that existing WAMs frequently produce incorrect motion predictions in open-ended environment, leading to erroneous actions. We attribute this limitation to two factors: (1) base video models are not optimized for manipulation, and (2) naively incorporating action components into video models can substantially degrade their generalization capabilities. We introduce Video Prediction Policy 2 (VPP2), a WAM that enables strong zero-shot generalization in both video prediction and action generation. First, we curate a large-scale, diverse dataset of manipulation videos to continue pretraining the base video foundation model. We annotate video clips with detailed captions and perform \textit{event-level} video pretraining to promote generalization across open-ended manipulation tasks. Second, we post-train and distill the video model into a single-step visual planner with fixed prediction horizon. Finally, we introduce action module via a mixture-of-transformers (MoT) architecture to learn implicit inverse dynamics model. Experiments demonstrate three key results: (1) VPP2-14B outperforms Cosmos3-64B by 11.0\% points in video prediction instruction-following success rate on open-ended tasks; (2) VPP2 surpasses the strongest baseline by 18.5\% points in success rate on real-world zero-shot ALOHA manipulation tasks; and (3) following benchmark-specific post-training, VPP2 achieves the highest success rates among evaluated methods on the challenging LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-OOD, and RoboDojo benchmarks.

AI.tldr: VPP2 是一种世界动作模型，通过事件级视频预训练与单步视觉规划器加 MoT 动作模块，实现了视频预测与动作生成的强零样本泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）在开放环境中常产生错误的动作预测，进而导致错误动作。作者将原因归结为两点：基础视频模型未针对操作任务优化；以及简单地将动作组件融入视频模型会显著削弱其泛化能力。
AI.method: 1) 构建大规模多样化操作视频数据集，对基础视频模型进行继续预训练，配以详细视频字幕并进行"事件级"视频预训练；2) 后训练并蒸馏视频模型为固定预测视界的单步视觉规划器；3) 通过混合 Transformer（MoT）架构引入动作模块以学习隐式逆动力学模型。
AI.result: (1) VPP2-14B 在开放任务的视频预测指令遵循成功率上领先 Cosmos3-64B 达 11.0 个百分点；(2) 在真实世界零样本 ALOHA 操作任务中成功率超最强基线 18.5 个百分点；(3) 经基准特定后训练后，在 LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-OOD 与 RoboDojo 基准上取得所评估方法中的最高成功率。
AI.conclusion: VPP2 验证了以事件级视频预训练加单步规划器与 MoT 动作模块的 WAM 设计，能同时提升视频预测与动作生成的零样本泛化能力，并可在多个基准上达到领先水平。

title: Scalable Patch-Level Self-Supervised Learning
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) at scale produces powerful visual representations. However, most scalable SSL methods rely on ad hoc combinations of multiple objectives and stabilization mechanisms. Taking a step back, we ask if we can design a high-performing, yet principled SSL algorithm. Starting from the multi-view assumption, stipulating that task-relevant content is captured by the information common to different views, we construct an information-theoretic objective decomposing into interpretable terms. This derivation yields JEM, a student-teacher method that learns by aligning corresponding patch representations across views, explicitly regularized by information and structure preservation losses. JEM trains stably from 300M to 7B parameters, and, to our knowledge, is the first latent-space patch-level method demonstrated at 7B scale. Across all scales, JEM reaches strong performance on both global and dense probing tasks, on segmentation benchmarks consistently surpassing the DINOv2 algorithm, an influential foundation for today's strongest visual SSL methods. Notably, at 7B parameters, it exceeds the performance of DINOv3 on panoptic segmentation, despite being trained on $12\times$ less data without refinement stages. These results demonstrate that we can indeed design an SSL algorithm that learns strong representations, is principled and stable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JEM，一种基于信息论、从多视图假设出发推导出的学生-教师自监督学习算法，通过对齐跨视图的patch表示，并显式加入信息与结构保持损失进行正则化。JEM可在3亿到70亿参数间稳定训练，是首个在70亿参数规模验证的潜在空间patch级方法。它在全局与密集探测任务上表现强劲，分割基准上持续超过DINOv2；在70亿参数下，全场景分割性能超过DINOv3，且训练数据量少12倍、无需精调阶段。
AI.motivation: 当前大规模自监督学习方法多依赖多种目标的临时组合与稳定化机制，缺乏原则性设计。作者希望从多视图假设出发，设计一个既有原则性又能达到高性能的自监督学习算法。
AI.method: 从多视图假设（任务相关内容由不同视图共享的信息捕获）出发，构造一个可分解为可解释项的信息论目标，由此推导出JEM。JEM是一种学生-教师方法，通过对齐跨视图对应的patch表示进行学习，并用信息保持损失和结构保持损失显式正则化，训练过程稳定。
AI.result: JEM可在3亿至70亿参数范围内稳定训练，是首个在70亿参数规模验证的潜在空间patch级方法。在所有规模下，JEM在全局和密集探测任务上均取得强劲性能；分割基准上持续超过DINOv2；在70亿参数下，全场景分割性能超过DINOv3，且训练数据量少12倍、无需精调阶段。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，可以设计出一种既学习强表示、又具有原则性和稳定性的自监督学习算法，为构建高性能且原理清晰的自监督方法提供了可行路径。

title: EntroPrefill: Renyi-Guided Context Pruning with Conditional Stability Guarantees for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: 16 pages, 0 figures. Theoretical framework and conditional stability guarantees for context pruning; no empirical evaluation or benchmarks are included
summary: Mid-prefill pruning can reduce the sequence processed by deeper transformer layers, but attention concentration alone does not certify that discarded context is dispensable. We formulate EntroPrefill as a Renyi-guided proposal mechanism coupled to explicit constraints on discarded attention mass. Sink-isolated, regularized head pooling respects grouped-query attention while exposing a quantitative trade-off between specialization and worst-head coverage. We derive a mixture-to-head deletion envelope, a computable upper bound on feasible token removal, and a finite-sample observer guarantee that remains valid when the pruning layer is selected adaptively. We then establish a conditional transformer perturbation bound with explicit sufficient Lipschitz constants and a first-token decision-margin corollary. A counterexample shows why shallow observations alone cannot imply an unconditional future-output guarantee. The systems analysis distinguishes query-head unions, physical page allocation, and KV-transfer payload, and gives an arithmetic break-even condition for pruning. This manuscript is theoretical in scope: it defines the procedure, its assumptions, and its formal limits, but does not report measured acceleration or task-accuracy preservation. Experiments are reserved for subsequent validation of the assumptions, approximation tightness, and end-to-end resource trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EntroPrefill，一个基于 Renyi 熵引导的预填充期剪枝理论框架，通过显式约束被丢弃注意力质量，建立可计算剪枝上限、有限样本保证与条件扰动界；论文为纯理论，暂不报告加速或精度实验结果。
AI.motivation: 中期预填充剪枝能减少深层 Transformer 处理的序列长度，但仅凭注意力集中现象不足以证明被丢弃上下文可舍弃，需要更严格的理论判据。
AI.method: 将 EntroPrefill 形式化为 Renyi 引导的提议机制，并施加对被丢弃注意力质量的显式约束；采用汇点隔离、正则化的头池化以兼容分组查询注意力；推导混合到头的删除包络、可行 token 删除的可计算上界、剪枝层自适应选择下仍成立的有限样本观测保证，以及带显式 Lipschitz 常数的条件 Transformer 扰动界与首 token 决策间隔推论。
AI.result: 给出删除包络、可行剪枝上界、有限样本保证（适应自适应层选择）、条件扰动界与决策间隔推论；通过反例说明浅层观测不能推出无条件未来输出保证；系统分析区分查询头并集、物理页分配与 KV 传输负载，给出剪枝的算术盈亏平衡条件。
AI.conclusion: 该手稿属理论范畴，定义方法流程、假设与形式化边界，未报告实测加速或任务精度保持，实验留待后续验证假设、近似紧度与端到端资源权衡。

title: Temporally Interpretable Differentiable Decision Trees
summary: Interpretability offers a solution to safe autonomy by providing transparency into an agent's underlying decision-making model. Within sequential-decision making tasks, differentiable decision trees (DDTs) are one approach to such interpretability, maintaining automatic-differentiable policies while providing humans with a discrete tree-based visualization. Nonetheless, current implementations of DDTs are not well-suited for sequential-decision making domains, as there exists an inherent mismatch between a tree's single-timestep behavior and a human's multi-timestep planning. Our work thus introduces time as a new dimension of interpretability, coined as temporal interpretability, and demonstrates how temporal abstractions via action chunking improve it. We achieve this by first introducing two novel policy gradient algorithms that incorporate action chunking. Additionally, to maintain parameter-efficient trees, we develop an information-theoretic tree restructuring algorithm that modifies the tree during training. Across four simulation environments, we find that warm-starting action chunked DDTs from a distilled action chunked policy is the most effective way to obtain temporally interpretable trees: they match neural network policies in three of the four domains while using up to 80$\%$ fewer parameters. Our code is available at https://github.com/ei5uke/temp-interp.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"时间可解释性"概念，通过动作分块与两套策略梯度算法及信息论树重构算法，使可微决策树在序列决策中实现时间抽象，在四个仿真环境中以最多减少80%参数达到与神经网络策略相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 可微决策树（DDT）虽能提供离散树状可视化以实现可解释的安全自主决策，但现有实现难以适配序列决策任务：树的单时间步行为与人类多时间步规划之间存在固有错配。为此需要引入时间维度提升可解释性。
AI.method: 1）引入"时间可解释性"，通过动作分块（action chunking）实现时间抽象；2）提出两种融入动作分块的策略梯度算法；3）开发基于信息论的树重构算法，在训练中修改树结构以保持参数高效；4）采用蒸馏的动作分块策略对动作分块DDT进行热启动训练。
AI.result: 在两个仿真环境（共四个）中，从蒸馏的动作分块策略热启动动作分块DDT效果最佳：在其中三个环境中性能与神经网络策略相当，同时参数最多减少80%。
AI.conclusion: 动作分块结合热启动蒸馏是获得时间可解释决策树的有效途径，可在保持可解释性与参数效率的同时达到接近神经网络策略的性能。

title: AdSpark: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Product-Centric Advertisement Video Generation
summary: Product-centric advertisement video generation aims to create promotional videos that preserve fine-grained product identity while presenting selling points through coherent multi-shot narratives. However, this emerging task remains underexplored due to the lack of large-scale advertisement-specific datasets and comprehensive evaluation frameworks. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{AdSpark}, a large-scale dataset and benchmark for product-centric advertisement video generation, based on data from a major e-commerce platform. \textit{AdSpark-300K} contains approximately 300K reference image--prompt--video triplets, comprising a real-world subset and a synthetic subset. Each sample provides structured advertisement annotations, including product identity annotations, selling-point descriptions, creative plans, and aligned audio scripts, enabling models to learn product preservation and advertisement-oriented visual storytelling. We further propose \textit{AdSpark-Bench}, a diagnostic benchmark that evaluates generated advertisements across six dimensions, including visual quality, product fidelity, instruction adherence, temporal coherence, audio alignment, and advertisement effectiveness. Based on AdSpark-Bench, we evaluate representative models, revealing key challenges in product preservation, multi-shot storytelling, and selling-point visualization. Experiments with AdSpark-300K-finetuned models further validate the effectiveness of our dataset. AdSpark provides a unified dataset and benchmark for future research, and we will release the dataset upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdSpark，一个面向产品中心广告视频生成的大规模数据集与评测基准，包含约300K图文视频三元组及六维度诊断评测，揭示产品保真、多镜头叙事与卖点可视化等挑战。
AI.motivation: 产品中心广告视频生成需在保持细粒度产品身份的同时，通过连贯多镜头叙事呈现卖点，但该任务因缺乏大规模广告专用数据集与完整评测框架而研究不足。
AI.method: 构建AdSpark-300K数据集，包含约300K参考图像—提示—视频三元组，分真实与合成子集，每样本提供产品身份标注、卖点描述、创意方案与对齐音频脚本；并提出AdSpark-Bench，从视觉质量、产品保真、指令遵循、时序连贯、音频对齐、广告效果六个维度评测。
AI.result: 基于AdSpark-Bench评测代表性模型，发现产品保持、多镜头叙事与卖点可视化方面的关键挑战；使用AdSpark-300K微调的模型实验进一步验证了数据集有效性。
AI.conclusion: AdSpark为未来研究提供统一的数据集与基准，并将在论文接收后公开数据集。

title: Unrolled Flow Models for Reasoning
summary: Flow matching enables language generation in few steps, but whether additional integration steps improve reasoning remains unclear. We prove that a flow parameterized by a two-layer Transformer can solve graph reachability, with the required number of integration steps increasing with the target's distance from the root. Yet, standard flow language models can fail to benefit from additional steps on reasoning tasks. We attribute this limitation to objectives that supervise each time point independently, without explicitly training successive steps to build on one another. To address this, we instead train through the model's own latent rollout over a randomly sampled subinterval of [0, 1], decoding only at the endpoint. On ProsQA, this raises accuracy to 97% and enables performance to improve with additional integration steps. For the longer rollouts required by reasoning tasks such as Sudoku and Maze, retracting the latent state onto a sphere stabilizes the dynamics and yields substantial gains over baselines with more than three times as many parameters. Sampling multiple rollouts further improves performance when paired with a parameter-free selection score, although reliable selection remains challenging for longer answers. Together, these results establish a theoretical basis for reasoning with flows and show how rollout training, stable latent dynamics, and rollout selection help realize this capacity in practice.

AI.tldr: 该论文从理论与方法两方面研究流匹配（flow matching）模型在推理任务中的能力：证明两层 Transformer 参数化的 flow 可解图可达性，提出通过对模型自身潜变量 rollout 进行训练、稳定潜动力学与 rollout 选择来释放多步积分带来的推理增益。
AI.motivation: 流匹配能用少量步骤生成语言，但增加积分步数是否提升推理能力尚不明确；标准流语言模型在推理任务上往往无法从更多步数中获益，其原因在于训练目标对各时间点独立监督，未显式训练相邻步骤相互构建。
AI.method: 1) 理论证明：由两层 Transformer 参数化的流可解决图可达性问题，所需积分步数随目标节点到根的距离增加。2) 训练方法：在 [0,1] 的随机子区间上沿模型自身潜变量 rollout 进行端到端训练，仅在端点解码。3) 稳定性：对长 rollout（如 Sudoku、Maze）将潜状态回缩到球面上以稳定动力学。4) 采样多条 rollout 并配以无参数选择评分。
AI.result: 在 ProsQA 上准确率提升至 97%，并随积分步数增加而持续改善；在 Sudoku 和 Maze 等需要更长 rollout 的任务上，回缩到球面稳定了动力学，相较参数量三倍以上的基线取得显著提升；多条 rollout 采样结合无参数选择评分可进一步提升性能，但对更长答案的可靠选择仍具挑战。
AI.conclusion: 研究为基于流的推理建立了理论基础，并表明 rollout 训练、稳定潜动力学与 rollout 选择三者协同可在实践中实现该能力。

title: Rubix: Global Correspondence-Free Point Set Alignment through Assignment Geometry
comment: 67 pages, 20 figures. Includes full proofs and experimental appendices
summary: Procrustes-Wasserstein alignment jointly estimates a matching and rotation without supplied correspondences, but alternating minimization can stop at suboptimal solutions. Rubix solves the equally weighted planar problem globally under squared Euclidean loss. Each matching $σ$ of two centered $n$-point sets defines a complex correlation $z_σ=\sum_i\bar x_i y_{σ(i)}$. Their convex hull is the permutation polygon: supporting vertices give optimal matchings at fixed rotations, and the farthest vertex gives the global alignment. We prove the sharp bound of $n(n-1)$ vertices for $n\ge2$, answering Rote's rotation-assignment open problem. In exact arithmetic, assignment queries recover the polygon in $\mathcal O(n^5)$ operations. Assignment-based bounds extend the approach to three-dimensional rotations and partial matching at a supplied translation through branch-and-bound. On timed MPEG-7 shape pairs, Rubix attains every numerical reference value in 12 ms on average, 50 times faster than a rotation grid at the same accuracy. Its distances improve gravity-aligned matching of real 3D scans, shape retrieval and noisy crystal classification over alternating minimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Rubix，通过“排列多边形”（permutation polygon）的几何刻画，全局求解等权平面 Procrustes-Wasserstein 对齐问题，并证明最优顶点数上界，回答了 Rote 的旋转-分配公开问题。
AI.motivation: Procrustes-Wasserstein 对齐需在无对应关系下同时估计匹配与旋转，交替最小化易陷入次优解。已有全局方法多局限于特定设定，缺乏对平面等权问题的全局、精确求解，且最优匹配数目的几何结构（Rote 公开问题）尚未解决。
AI.method: 对两个中心化 n 点集，每个匹配 σ 对应复相关 z_σ=Σ_i x̄_i y_{σ(i)}，其凸包即排列多边形：支撑顶点给出固定旋转下的最优匹配，最远顶点给出全局对齐。据此用分配查询恢复多边形，并推广到三维旋转、固定平移下的部分匹配，结合分支定界。
AI.result: 证明了 n≥2 时排列多边形顶点数的紧上界为 n(n-1)，解决 Rote 公开问题；精确算术下 O(n^5) 次操作可恢复多边形。在计时 MPEG-7 形状对上，平均 12 ms 达到所有数值参考值，比同精度旋转网格快 50 倍；在真实 3D 扫描、形状检索与噪声晶体分类上优于交替最小化。
AI.conclusion: Rubix 为等权平面 Procrustes-Wasserstein 提供了全局精确且高效的求解途径，并通过几何上界与分配查询实现理论突破与实用加速，在多项任务上超越交替最小化。

title: From Pixel to Coding: Evaluating the Figure Reproduction Capabilities of MLLMs
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in both visual understanding and code generation. However, existing benchmarks typically evaluate these two modalities in isolation, lacking a dedicated assessment of their unification, i.e., how a model can perceive complex visual structures and synthesize them into precise, executable code. Moreover, current visual code generation benchmarks often rely on simplified layouts within single programming environments, falling short of evaluating true unified multimodal reasoning. To bridge this gap, we propose FigCodeBench, a comprehensive framework for rigorously evaluating MLLMs on figure reproduction, integrating multimodal comprehension and generation. We first design a systematic dataset construction pipeline, resulting in a total of 6,194 instances that cover 7 functional categories and 4 types of programming languages. We further categorize figure reproduction into three tiers with visual and code complexity modeling, specifically targeting complex structural reasoning, varying aspect ratios, and dense geometric constraints. We introduce a multi-dimensional evaluation protocol, encompassing visual fidelity and syntactic isomorphism, that aligns highly with the Mean Machine Opinion Score (MMOS) and human preferences. Based on our framework, we conducted extensive experiments on 24 widely used proprietary and open-source MLLMs (e.g., Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT-5.4, and Kimi-K2.5), where we observed a universal, non-linear performance cliff across different programming languages and difficulty scenarios for all models, and gained several insights, such as the significant metric decline in rigid declarative languages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FigCodeBench，一个用于严格评估多模态大模型（MLLMs）图表复现能力的综合基准，涵盖多模态理解与代码生成，包含 6,194 个实例、7 类功能、4 种编程语言与三维难度分层，并设计了与人类偏好对齐的多维评测协议。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型虽在视觉理解与代码生成上表现优异，但基准多将两者孤立评估，缺乏对"视觉结构感知—可执行代码合成"统一能力的专门评测；且现有视觉代码生成基准多依赖单一编程环境下的简化布局，难以衡量真正的统一多模态推理能力。
AI.method: 1）设计系统化数据集构建流程，产出 6,194 个实例，覆盖 7 个功能类别与 4 种编程语言；2）依据视觉与代码复杂度建模，将图表复现划分为三个层级，分别针对复杂结构推理、不同宽高比与密集几何约束；3）提出多维评测协议，包含视觉保真度与句法同构性，并与 Mean Machine Opinion Score（MMOS）及人类偏好高度对齐。
AI.result: 在 24 个主流闭源与开源 MLLM（如 Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT-5.4、Kimi-K2.5）上开展大规模实验，发现所有模型在不同编程语言与难度场景下普遍存在非线性的性能断崖，并获得若干洞见，例如在刚性声明式语言上指标出现显著下降。
AI.conclusion: FigCodeBench 填补了统一多模态理解与代码生成评测的空白，揭示了当前 MLLMs 在跨语言、跨难度图表复现任务上的系统性脆弱性，为后续模型能力提升提供了可复现的评测基准与方向。

title: Leaner Transformers Can Easily Learn to Cluster
summary: Transformers have in-context learning capabilities, where some known learning algorithms can be executed in the forward pass through the model. Recent work shows that transformers can exactly perform Lloyd's algorithm for $k$-means clustering with $n$ points in $d$ dimensions with an embedding size $d_{\textsf{emb}} = d+k$ (thus, requiring attention projection matrices of size $(d+k)^2$). In this work, we build upon this result in the following ways: First, we present an equally expressive but smaller transformer that executes Lloyd's algorithm with embedding size $d_{\textsf{emb}} = (d + \lceil \log_2 k \rceil)$. Next, we train these transformers to learn the clustering algorithms given a distribution of clustering tasks, and theoretically characterize and empirically validate the factors affecting the convergence and in-distribution generalization of learning algorithms based on stochastic gradients. Finally, we probe the general clustering abilities of these learned algorithms (in the form of transformers), and try to understand situations where they succeed and fail.

AI.tldr: 本文在Transformer可执行Lloyd算法的已有结果上，提出了表达力相同但嵌入规模更小的Transformer（d_emb=d+⌈log₂k⌉），并在聚类任务分布上训练与理论分析其收敛性与泛化性，探索其聚类能力。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明Transformer可在前向传播中精确执行Lloyd的k-means聚类算法，但所需嵌入规模为d+k，导致注意力投影矩阵为(d+k)²，规模较大。作者希望降低模型规模，同时理解训练所得Transformer聚类算法的收敛、泛化与能力边界。
AI.method: 1）构造一个表达力相同但嵌入规模更小的Transformer，嵌入维度为d+⌈log₂k⌉，以执行Lloyd算法；2）在给定聚类任务分布下训练这些Transformer学习聚类算法，并从理论上刻画、实验上验证影响基于随机梯度的学习算法收敛性与分布内泛化的因素；3）探测学到的Transformer算法的通用聚类能力，分析其成功与失败的情境。
AI.result: 提出了嵌入规模为d+⌈log₂k⌉的更小Transformer，其表达力与先前d+k的方案相同；从理论和实验两方面给出了影响基于随机梯度学习算法收敛性和分布内泛化的因素；并揭示了所学Transformer在通用聚类任务中成功与失败的若干情形。
AI.conclusion: 通过更紧凑的嵌入设计可在不损失表达力的情况下执行Lloyd算法，同时基于随机梯度的训练在聚类任务上具有可刻画的收敛与泛化特性，且学习到的Transformer算法在聚类能力上存在可识别的成功与失败边界。

title: Q-Learning with Scalar Adjoint Matching
summary: Flow policies capture rich and diverse action distributions, and fine-tuning them with off-policy RL to improve beyond the demonstrations has drawn growing interest. However, fine-tuning a flow policy against a learned value function is not trivial, because the policy generates its action over many flow steps. Adjoint matching offers a principled way to update the flow model itself by propagating value information from the final action back to each flow step, but it requires a vector--Jacobian product through the policy at every step, a cost that grows with the number of flow steps and the policy size. We observe that the batch-averaged velocity Jacobian of pretrained flow policies concentrates on its diagonal. Motivated by this finding, we derive a closed-form scalar adjoint that scales the value gradient at the final action by the flow time, eliminating the per-step vector--Jacobian products. We further find that controlling the critic's value at policy-generated actions is particularly important under the scalar adjoint. Based on these findings, we propose Q-learning with Scalar Adjoint Matching (SQAM), which combines the scalar adjoint with a value penalty at those actions. SQAM's gains concentrate on the four hardest OGBench domains, where its success rate exceeds that of the strongest baseline in each domain by 18 to 35 percentage points. To test whether SQAM extends to large pretrained policies, we also fine-tune a vision-language-action policy on a real bimanual robot. SQAM improves over supervised fine-tuning on all three tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SQAM方法，通过标量伴随匹配显著降低流策略离策略强化学习微调的计算成本，并在最难基准任务与真实双臂机器人上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 流策略能刻画丰富多样的动作分布，但用离策略强化学习（RL）微调以超越示范存在困难：策略在多个流步骤上生成动作，基于学习到的价值函数进行微调并不简单。伴随匹配（adjoint matching）虽可原理性地更新流模型，但需要在每一步通过策略计算向量-雅可比积，其成本随流步数和策略规模增长。
AI.method: 作者观察到预训练流策略的批次平均速度雅可比集中在对角线上。据此推导出一个闭式标量伴随：以流时间缩放最终动作处的价值梯度，从而无需每步的向量-雅可比积。同时发现，在标量伴随下，控制评论家（critic）在策略生成动作上的价值尤为重要。由此提出SQAM（Q-learning with Scalar Adjoint Matching），将标量伴随与这些动作上的价值惩罚相结合。
AI.result: SQAM的收益集中在四个最难的OGBench域，其成功率在每个域均超过最强基线18到35个百分点。为验证其能否扩展到大预训练策略，作者还在真实双臂机器人上微调了一个视觉-语言-动作策略，SQAM在全部三项任务上均优于监督微调。
AI.conclusion: 利用流策略雅可比的对角集中特性，标量伴随匹配能够在避免昂贵向量-雅可比积的同时有效微调流策略；配合生成动作上的价值惩罚，SQAM在困难基准和真实机器人任务上均取得显著优势。

title: Temporal Residual Bottleneck for Robust Asynchronous Collaborative Perception
summary: Collaborative perception extends the sensing range of autonomous vehicles, but its performance degrades when shared features arrive stale or incomplete. Most latency-robust methods compensate delayed collaborator features through flow-guided alignment or direct feature transport. In this work, we formulate asynchronous collaborative perception as temporal residual prediction. Our Temporal Residual Bottleneck keeps a deterministic pose-warped collaborator feature as a conservative anchor and uses a $Δt$-conditioned xLSTM to extract residual temporal evidence from the available history. A detector-facing residual bottleneck then applies only gated, regularized corrections before ego-side fusion, reducing the risk of overwriting reliable static structure when temporal correspondence is uncertain. Experiments on DAIR-V2X and OPV2V show that our method is especially effective under severe fixed/irregular delays and packet drops. On DAIR-V2X, the reported checkpoint trades a small amount of synchronized peak accuracy for better robustness under stronger communication degradation. Controlled diagnostics further indicate that direct feature transport has oracle headroom but can become unreliable when deployed without accurate correspondence. These results support temporal residual fusion as a practical alternative for asynchronous and incomplete collaborative perception. Code will be publicly released at https://url.fzi.de/8dk38.

AI.tldr: 该论文将异步协同感知建模为时序残差预测，提出时序残差瓶颈模块，在保守锚点上仅施加门控、正则化的残差修正，显著提升严重延迟与丢包下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 协同感知可扩展自动驾驶的感知范围，但当共享特征因延迟或不完整而变得陈旧时性能会下降。现有延迟鲁棒方法多依赖光流引导对齐或直接特征传输，在时序对应关系不确定时可能覆盖可靠的静态结构。
AI.method: 将异步协同感知形式化为时序残差预测。Temporal Residual Bottleneck 保留确定性的位姿变换协同者特征作为保守锚点，并用 Δt 条件化的 xLSTM 从可用历史中提取残差时序证据；面向检测器的残差瓶颈在自车侧融合前仅施加门控、正则化的修正，以降低误覆盖可靠静态结构的风险。
AI.result: 在 DAIR-V2X 与 OPV2V 上验证，方法在严重固定/不规则延迟和丢包下尤为有效。在 DAIR-V2X 上，所用模型以少量同步峰值精度的牺牲换取更强通信退化下的鲁棒性。受控诊断表明直接特征传输存在 oracle 上限，但在缺乏精确对应时部署可能不可靠。
AI.conclusion: 时序残差融合是异步且不完整协同感知的一种实用替代方案，代码将公开于 https://url.fzi.de/8dk38。

title: ECHO: Embodied Camera Observations of Human Object Carrying
summary: Embodied and assistive agents must do more than recognize objects: they must reason about where an object belongs given the layout of an environment and the habits of the people who live in it. Progress on this problem has been limited, in part because no dedicated benchmark or dataset exists to define and evaluate it. Existing RGB-D scan datasets reconstruct static rooms without human activity, while human-object-interaction datasets capture motion without a navigable, fully reconstructed scene or a ground-truth notion of an object's natural destination. We introduce contextual object placement as a benchmark task: predicting an object's destination during an observed object-carrying episode. To support this task, we present Embodied Camera observations of Human Object carrying (ECHO), a large-scale synthetic dataset that pairs dense RGB-D scans of indoor scenes with recordings of an embodied human carrying everyday objects to context-appropriate destinations. ECHO is the first publicly available dataset to combine reconstructed scenes, human activity, natural language, and contextual-placement annotations. It comprises 3,805 human-annotated episodes across 159 floors of 115 HM3D scenes, involving 198 distinct objects. Each floor includes a complete RGB-D scan with human-annotated room labels and a surface list. Each episode provides synchronized RGB-D encounter clips; 6-DoF camera, human, and object trajectories; start and destination surfaces; an action caption; and a human-written context: a single sentence describing the inhabitant's routine that implies the destination without naming it. We evaluate contextual object placement using input-masked probes and an end-to-end baseline. Results show that no single input modality is sufficient, highlighting the need to jointly reason over scene structure, human activity, and contextual knowledge.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"情境化物体放置"基准任务，并构建ECHO大规模合成数据集（3805个片段、115个HM3D场景、198类物体），用于预测物体携带过程中的目的地。
AI.motivation: 具身与辅助智能体不仅要识别物体，还需结合环境布局与居住者习惯推理物体的合理去向。但此前缺乏专门基准与数据集：现有RGB-D扫描数据集只重建静态房间、无人类活动；人-物交互数据集有人体动作却缺少可导航的完整重建场景与"自然目的地"的真值标注。
AI.method: 定义"情境化物体放置"任务：在观测到的携带物体片段中预测物体目的地。构建ECHO数据集——大规模合成数据，将室内场景的稠密RGB-D扫描与具身人类携带日常物品至情境适配目的地的记录配对。每个楼层含完整RGB-D扫描、人工标注的房间标签与表面清单；每个片段提供同步RGB-D遭遇片段、6自由度相机/人/物体轨迹、起止表面、动作描述，以及人类撰写的"情境"单句（描述居住者日常惯例，隐含但不明说目的地）。评估采用输入掩蔽探针与端到端基线。
AI.result: 评估结果表明，没有任何单一输入模态足以完成该任务，说明必须联合推理场景结构、人类活动与情境知识。
AI.conclusion: ECHO是首个同时融合重建场景、人类活动、自然语言与情境化放置标注的公开数据集，为情境化物体放置任务提供了基准，并揭示多模态联合推理的必要性。

title: A Probabilistic Perspective on Wasserstein-Based Evidential Uncertainty for Out-of-Distribution Segmentation
summary: Semantic segmentation networks operate on a fixed set of classes and therefore fail when out-of-distribution (OOD) objects appear during deployment, a critical limitation for safety-critical applications such as autonomous driving. Reliably identifying OOD objects requires well-calibrated epistemic uncertainty, yet common softmax-based confidence scores remain overconfident, while Bayesian alternatives such as Monte Carlo dropout or deep ensembles require costly repeated forward passes. Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) offers an efficient alternative by modeling class probabilities as a Dirichlet distribution learned from a single deterministic forward pass. Existing EDL formulations rely on Euclidean objectives that push predictions towards the simplex vertices, encouraging overconfidence rather than preserving uncertainty for unfamiliar inputs. We instead employ Wasserstein-based objectives, which respect the geometry of the probability simplex, and study the influence of the Wasserstein order on segmentation accuracy and OOD detection within a unified evidential framework. We evaluate this framework on a convolutional (DeepLabV3+) and a transformer-based (SegFormer) architecture on the SegmentMeIfYouCan benchmark, including LostAndFound, RoadObstacle21, RoadAnomaly21, and Fishyscapes. Our results show the optimal Wasserstein order is architecture-dependent: second-order objectives dominate on the convolutional backbone, third-order objectives on the transformer backbone, and our framework surpasses comparable baselines on most metrics, with a single deterministic forward pass.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用基于Wasserstein的目标函数改进证据深度学习（EDL），以更好地建模语义分割中的认知不确定性并检测OOD目标，单次前向传播即可，且最优Wasserstein阶数依赖网络架构。
AI.motivation: 语义分割网络仅针对固定类别，部署时遇到分布外（OOD）物体会失效，这对自动驾驶等安全关键应用是重大缺陷。可靠识别OOD需要良好校准的认知不确定性，但常用softmax置信度过度自信，而贝叶斯方法（MC dropout、深度集成）需多次前向传播代价高。现有EDL虽高效（单次确定性前向），却采用欧氏目标推动预测趋向单纯形顶点，导致过度自信而非保留对陌生输入的不确定性。
AI.method: 采用尊重概率单纯形几何结构的Wasserstein目标函数替代欧氏目标，在统一的证据框架下研究Wasserstein阶数对分割精度与OOD检测的影响。在卷积架构DeepLabV3+和Transformer架构SegFormer上评估，使用SegmentMeIfYouCan基准，包括LostAndFound、RoadObstacle21、RoadAnomaly21和Fishyscapes。
AI.result: 最优Wasserstein阶数依赖于架构：卷积骨干上二阶目标占优，Transformer骨干上三阶目标占优。该框架在多数指标上超越同类基线，且仅需单次确定性前向传播。
AI.conclusion: Wasserstein目标能更好契合概率单纯形几何，改善EDL的认知不确定性建模；其最优阶数随网络架构变化，为语义分割OOD检测提供了一种高效且有效的方案。

title: Fluctuations of Nonlinear Observables in Mean Field Neural Network Training
summary: Mean field limits describe the training dynamics of wide neural networks through the evolution of the empirical distribution of their parameters. Although functional central limit theorems characterize the asymptotic fluctuations of this distribution, quantities of practical interest are typically nonlinear observables of the parameter distribution rather than the distribution itself. In this work, we show how these mean field fluctuations propagate to finite dimensional nonlinear observables for shallow neural networks trained by stochastic gradient descent. Working in the weighted Sobolev space in which the limiting fluctuation process is constructed, we apply a functional Delta method under ordinary Fr{é}chet differentiability, without requiring Lions derivatives with respect to the measure variable. We obtain a central limit theorem for the observables and, under a suitable representation of their differentials, an explicit covariance formula inherited from the underlying mean field fluctuation theory. We also study whether prescribed quantities of interest can be recovered from the selected observations. Under a constant rank assumption, we prove that a quantity of interest factors locally through the observation functional if and only if, throughout a neighborhood, the kernel of the differential of the observation is contained in that of the quantity of interest. Thus, a differential condition expressed directly in the ambient Sobolev space yields an exact nonlinear local factorization. These results provide a framework both for quantifying finite-width uncertainty on observable, statistically or physically meaningful quantities and for assessing whether the chosen observations contain the information required to identify them.

AI.tldr: 本文研究浅层神经网络在随机梯度下降训练下，均值场涨落如何传播到参数分布的有限维非线性可观测量，并给出可观测量的中心极限定理、显式协方差公式，以及可识别性的局部因子分解判据。
AI.motivation: 均值场极限虽能刻画宽神经网络的训练动态，但实际关心的是参数分布的非线性可观测量而非分布本身；已有的函数型中心极限定理只描述分布层面的涨落，无法直接回答有限维可观测量的统计不确定性，以及所选观测量是否包含识别目标量所需的信息。
AI.method: 在构造极限涨落过程的加权Sobolev空间中，对浅层神经网络（SGD训练）应用函数型Delta方法；采用普通Fréchet可微性，避免对测度变量使用Lions导数；通过观测泛函微分的适当表示推导可观测量的中心极限定理与协方差公式；并在常数秩假设下，利用微分核的包含关系证明可识别性的局部非线性因子分解等价条件。
AI.result: 得到有限维非线性可观测量的中心极限定理，并在微分表示合适时给出继承自均值场涨落理论的显式协方差公式；在常数秩假设下证明：目标量在观测泛函的某邻域内局部因子化，当且仅当该邻域上观测泛函微分的核包含于目标量微分的核中，即由环境Sobolev空间中直接的微分条件给出精确的非线性局部因子分解。
AI.conclusion: 该框架既能量化有限宽度下具有统计或物理意义的可观测量的不确定性，也能判定所选观测是否含有识别目标量所需的信息，为宽神经网络训练动态的可观测分析与可识别性评估提供了统一工具。

title: HarnessIR: Harnessing Multimodal Foundation Models for Universal Real-World Image Restoration
summary: Real-world low-quality images suffer from complex mixed degradations, including but not limited to noise, blur, atmospheric effects, etc. Recent agentic methods usually model real-world image restoration (Real-IR) as a sequential tool calling problem over task-specific single-degradation restoration models. This paradigm, however, is fundamentally limited because complex real-world degradations cannot be cleanly undone degradation by degradation, and the tool used for task-specific models caps the capability of the agent system. In this work, we present HarnessIR, an agentic framework for Real-IR by harnessing a multimodal foundation model (MFM) as the executor. HarnessIR consists of five stages: perception and diagnosis, on-demand tool invocation, prompt composition, execution, and verification-driven refinement. Unlike prior agentic Real-IR methods that rely on tool chains assembled from task-specific models, HarnessIR feeds the restoration requirements, the perceptual diagnosis, and the evidence into an MFM that performs restoration in a single pass, followed by verification stages to determine whether the result warrants further processing. Under our harness, off-the-shelf MFMs handle restoration tasks remarkably well, achieving state-of-the-art results on the widely used MiO100 synthetic benchmark. More importantly, by exploiting the strong generalization ability of MFMs, HarnessIR delivers compelling restoration quality on challenging real-world scenes where previous agentic IR systems often struggle. Codes is available at https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/HarnessIR.

AI.tldr: 提出HarnessIR智能体框架，用多模态基础模型作为恢复执行器，实现真实世界图像恢复。
AI.motivation: 真实世界低质图像包含噪声、模糊、大气效应等复杂混合退化，现有智能体方法将恢复建模为针对单一退化任务模型的顺序工具调用问题，但这种范式有根本局限：复杂退化无法逐项干净去除，且任务专用工具限制了智能体系统的能力上限。
AI.method: HarnessIR包含五个阶段：感知与诊断、按需工具调用、提示词组合、执行、验证驱动的精化。不同于依赖任务专用模型工具链的先前方法，HarnessIR将恢复需求、感知诊断与证据输入多模态基础模型，一次前向完成恢复，随后通过验证阶段判断结果是否需要进一步处理。
AI.result: 在广泛使用的MiO100合成基准上取得最先进结果；借助MFM的强泛化能力，在先前智能体IR系统常失败的真实复杂场景中也展现了出色的恢复质量。
AI.conclusion: 以多模态基础模型为执行器的智能体框架能有效应对真实世界复杂混合退化，突破任务专用工具链的能力瓶颈，代码已开源。

title: AdaPS-LiNGAM: Adaptive Predecessor Selection for Linear Non-Gaussian Acyclic Models under Small-Sample Settings
summary: Causal discovery becomes particularly challenging when the available sample size is small relative to the number of variables. This challenge also arises in the linear non-Gaussian acyclic model (LiNGAM), an identifiable framework for causal discovery from observational data. DirectLiNGAM estimates a causal order, which arranges variables so that causes precede their effects, by sequentially identifying an exogenous variable and removing its linear effect from the remaining variables. We establish a structural limitation of this procedure: when the number of variables exceeds the sample size, repeated residualization necessarily becomes degenerate before the full causal order can be determined. Our analysis further reveals that each residual can be reconstructed using only a graph-determined subset of variables already placed earlier in the causal order, termed the active boundary. This result motivates AdaPS-LiNGAM (Adaptive Predecessor Selection LiNGAM), which reconstructs each residual directly from the original observations using an adaptively chosen sparse subset of those earlier variables. The same subset-selection principle is also applied to the final pruning step for edge estimation. Experiments on synthetic data demonstrate that AdaPS-LiNGAM provides accurate causal-structure recovery in sample-limited settings and degrades more gradually as the sample size decreases.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示DirectLiNGAM在小样本下反复残差化必然退化，并提出AdaPS-LiNGAM，用自适应前驱变量子集重建残差，从而在样本量不足时更稳健地恢复因果结构。
AI.motivation: 因果发现中样本量相对变量数偏小的情形极具挑战，LiNGAM框架同样面临此问题。DirectLiNGAM通过依次识别外生变量并移除其线性效应来估计因果顺序，但其在小样本下的结构性局限此前未被明确刻画。
AI.method: 作者首先从理论上证明：当变量数超过样本量时，DirectLiNGAM的反复残差化在完整因果顺序确定之前必然退化。分析进一步发现，每个残差可仅由已排在因果顺序前面的、由图结构决定的变量子集（称为active boundary）重建。据此提出AdaPS-LiNGAM，用自适应选择的稀疏前驱变量子集直接从原始观测重建每个残差；同一子集选择原则也用于边估计的最终剪枝步骤。
AI.result: 合成数据实验表明，AdaPS-LiNGAM在样本受限情形下能准确恢复因果结构，并且随着样本量减小，其性能退化更为平缓。
AI.conclusion: AdaPS-LiNGAM通过避免直接对残差反复操作、改用原始观测中的自适应稀疏前驱子集重建残差，克服了DirectLiNGAM在变量数超过样本量时的结构性退化问题，在样本受限场景下具有更好的鲁棒性。

title: Never Look Back: Understanding Persistence in 3D Object Memory from Egocentric Videos
summary: As we move through the world and carry out everyday tasks, we encounter objects that may become relevant only later. We are capable of recalling where we left something or what was inside a container, even without knowing we would need it later. Here, we study how an embodied assistant can build a similar memory from egocentric videos, by observing a person's day-to-day activities. We present Ledger, a persistent 3D object memory that combines object locations, their histories, and contextual descriptions. It associates observations across the recording and retains objects after they leave the view, including those the person never touches. It clusters each object's observations by resting locations and records a move only after repeated evidence, reducing the effect of localization noise. Short descriptions preserve details such as an object's contents or supporting surface. It saves these records to later answer spatial questions without having to access the original images or video. Our memory raises HD-EPIC accuracy from 29.7% to 42.6%, UCS-Bench accuracy from 33.8% to 38.5% and localizes Ego4D objects with a 0.99 m median error on returned predictions. Our analyses identify complementary roles for temporal persistence, contextual descriptions, and retrieval. Our study on 100 stitched streams of multiple scenes each further exposes failures in both retrieval and construction. Per-scene construction partially recovers the performance lost across scene changes compared to that of single scene streams.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Ledger，一种持久化 3D 物体记忆系统，通过第一人称视频构建物体的位置、历史与上下文描述，无需访问原始图像即可回答空间问题。
AI.motivation: 人类能在日常活动中记住物品的位置与内容，即使当时并不知道以后会用到。作者希望让具身助手通过观察人的第一人称视频，构建类似记忆能力。
AI.method: Ledger 将物体的位置、历史与上下文描述组合为持久 3D 物体记忆；跨录像关联观测，物体离开视野后仍保留（包括从未被触碰的物体）；按静止位置聚类观测，仅在多次证据后才记录移动以降低定位噪声；用简短描述保留内容或支撑面等细节，并保存记录以供后续空间问答，无需访问原始图像或视频。
AI.result: HD-EPIC 准确率从 29.7% 提升至 42.6%，UCS-Bench 从 33.8% 提升至 38.5%；Ego4D 物体定位返回预测的中位误差为 0.99 m。分析表明时间持久性、上下文描述与检索各有互补作用。100 条多场景拼接流的实验暴露出检索与构建两方面的失败；相比单场景流，逐场景构建可部分恢复跨场景切换导致的性能损失。
AI.conclusion: Ledger 证明了持久 3D 物体记忆在具身助手中的有效性，时间持久性、上下文描述与检索相互补充；但在多场景流中检索与构建仍存在失败，逐场景构建可部分缓解跨场景性能损失。

title: HeiCo-FOCUS: A Clinically Grounded Dataset for Long-Context Video Understanding
