summary: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have led to rapid progress in video understanding across a wide range of benchmark tasks. However, existing evaluations largely focus on short-term reasoning, failing to assess a critical capability: maintaining cumulative temporal consistency over extended time horizons. To close this evaluation gap, we introduce HeiCo-FOCUS, a clinically grounded dataset for evaluating long-context video understanding through the task of Foreign Object Contextual Understanding in Surgery. Built on a dataset of Heidelberg Colorectal surgeries, this task requires models to continuously track multiple objects as they are inserted, manipulated, occluded, and removed over procedures lasting up to hours. HeiCo-FOCUS comprises 30,000 visual question answering (VQA) pairs covering five core capabilities: object recognition, temporal grounding, aggregation, event and procedural understanding, and complex reasoning. The dataset was constructed through a rigorous multi-stage annotation pipeline involving large-scale crowd annotation and 39 surgical domain experts to ensure high quality and clinical relevance. To systematically probe model behavior, we introduce a multi-track evaluation framework that progressively increases temporal and contextual demands from single frames to full procedures. Experiments with ten frontier VLMs show that HeiCo-FOCUS tasks are far from solved: only around half of the models clearly outperform a text-only baseline. Across the video tracks, models perform best on event and procedural understanding (mean Accuracy: 56.5% across all models), while temporal grounding remains particularly challenging for all evaluated models (mean Accuracy: 19.7%). We therefore expect HeiCo-FOCUS to serve as a catalyst for the development of models capable of reliable, temporally consistent reasoning over hours-long videos.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 HeiCo-FOCUS，一个基于海德堡结直肠手术视频的临床数据集，用于评估长时程视频理解中的累积时序一致性，包含约3万个VQA对和五类核心能力，并设计多层级评测框架。实验显示现有前沿VLM仍远未解决该任务，尤其在时序定位上表现较差。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型（VLM）的视频理解评测主要聚焦短时推理，缺乏对长时程累积时序一致性这一关键能力的评估，存在明显的评测空白。
AI.method: 构建 HeiCo-FOCUS 数据集，基于海德堡结直肠手术视频，任务为手术中异物情境理解，要求模型持续追踪多个物体在插入、操作、遮挡和移除过程中的状态。数据集含30,000个VQA对，覆盖物体识别、时序定位、聚合、事件与流程理解、复杂推理五类能力，通过大规模众包标注与39位外科领域专家参与的多阶段流程构建。同时提出多层级评测框架，从单帧到完整手术逐步提升时序与情境要求。
AI.result: 对十个前沿VLM的实验显示任务远未解决：仅约一半模型明显优于纯文本基线。视频任务中，模型在事件与流程理解上表现最好（平均准确率56.5%），而时序定位对所有模型都最具挑战（平均准确率19.7%）。
AI.conclusion: HeiCo-FOCUS 有望成为推动模型在数小时长视频上实现可靠、时序一致推理的重要评测基准与发展催化剂。

title: A Proof-of-Concept Study of Weakly Supervised Labeling of Fine-Grained EEG Components for Artifact Attenuation
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) is highly susceptible to electromyographic (EMG) artifacts, whose temporal heterogeneity and spatial-spectral overlap with neural activity can leave mixed sources after blind source separation. Existing artifact-removal methods are further limited by scarce reliable component-level ground truth: expert annotations are costly and subjective, while no established method provides realistic simulation-based ground truth for EMG contamination in multichannel scalp EEG. To address these limitations, we propose a framework combining a frequency-aware high-dimensional representation with Multi-Instance Learning. The representation unfolds separated components into frequency-resolved intra-components, creating a space in which mixed neural and muscular activity becomes more separable, while the weakly supervised learning formulation enables artifact-likelihood scores for individual intra-components to be learned from epoch-level labels without finer-grained ground truth. The resulting intra-component classifier supports fine-grained EMG artifact detection and score-guided attenuation. Experiments on held-out subjects show that the framework learns informative intra-component scores and reduces artifact-related spectral deviations most clearly for jaw tension, with moderate effects for raising eyebrows and limited effects for frowning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合频率感知高维表示与多示例学习（MIL）的框架，用于解决多通道头皮EEG中EMG伪迹的细粒度检测与衰减问题，在缺乏可靠成分级标注的情况下，利用epoch级弱标签学习成分内（intra-component）伪迹评分。
AI.motivation: EEG极易受到EMG伪迹干扰，且EMG与神经活动在时间上异质、在空间-频谱上重叠，导致盲源分离后仍存在混合源。现有去除方法受限于缺乏可靠的成分级真值：专家标注成本高且主观，且尚无方法能为多通道头皮EEG中的EMG污染提供基于仿真的真实标签。
AI.method: 框架包含两部分：（1）频率感知高维表示，将分离出的成分展开为频率分辨的成分内（intra-components），构造使神经与肌肉活动更可分的新空间；（2）多示例学习（MIL）的弱监督学习形式，使单个成分内的伪迹似然评分可从epoch级标签中学习，无需更细粒度真值。所得成分内分类器支持细粒度EMG检测与评分引导的衰减。
AI.result: 在留出被试上的实验表明，该框架学到了有信息量的成分内评分，并最明显地降低了咬紧牙关（jaw tension）相关的频谱偏差，抬眉（raising eyebrows）效果中等，皱眉（frowning）效果有限。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过频率感知表示与弱监督多示例学习，在缺少成分级真值的条件下实现了细粒度EMG伪迹检测与衰减，且不同面部动作的去除效果存在差异。

title: BagDINO: Multi-View Baggage Re-Identification with DINOv3
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables, IEEE International Conference on Evolving and Adaptive Intelligent Systems 2026 (IEEE EAIS 2026)
summary: Mishandled checked baggage remains a recurrent issue in airport operations, and current recovery workflows still largely rely on tag-based tracking, which does not directly support visual identification when tag evidence is missing or unavailable. This paper investigates baggage re-identification as an instance-level retrieval problem in a multi-camera setting, leveraging DINOv3 foundation-model representations to match a query image against a gallery of registered baggage images. A Torchreid-style BNNeck re-identification head is placed on top of a DINOv3 backbone, and parameter-efficient adaptation is performed via LoRA. Experiments are conducted on the MVB benchmark using a progressive study that compares a fully frozen backbone against LoRA and fine-tuning strategies. Results indicate that parameter-efficient adaptation of foundation-model features provides an effective and stable approach for multi-view baggage re-identification under limited training data.

AI.tldr: 本文探究多摄像头场景下行李重识别问题，基于DINOv3基础模型特征并采用LoRA参数高效微调，在MVB基准上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 机场行李错运是常见问题，现有回收流程主要依赖标签追踪，当标签证据缺失时无法直接支持视觉识别，因此需要一种基于视觉的行李重识别方法。
AI.method: 将行李重识别建模为多摄像头下的实例级检索任务，用DINOv3基础模型表示匹配查询图像与注册行李图库；在DINOv3骨干上叠加Torchreid风格的BNNeck重识别头，并通过LoRA进行参数高效适配。
AI.result: 在MVB基准上开展渐进式研究，对比完全冻结骨干、LoRA与全量微调策略，结果表明参数高效适配在有限训练数据下稳定有效。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型特征的参数高效适配为多视角行李重识别提供了一种有效且稳定的方案。

title: BoT-GRPO: Efficient Process-Reward RL for Reasoning via Bag-of-Token Aggregation
comment: Published at the COLM 2026 Workshop on Efficient Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning is now central to eliciting reasoning in large language models, while in the popular algorithm Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) every token in a rollout receives the same advantage. We ask how to make process supervision efficient: accelerating convergence and improving final quality without the cost of value networks. We propose Bag-of-Tokens Group Relative Policy Optimization (BoT-GRPO), which extends GRPO to token-level reward models through a length-invariant "bag of tokens" aggregation: it collects all token-level rewards across rollouts, weights each by the inverse of its source sequence length, and computes per-token advantages relative to weighted group statistics. BoT-GRPO is critic-free, and is a drop-in replacement wherever GRPO is used when token-level reward is available. On React front-end code generation, BoT-GRPO reaches $80\%$ compile rate up to $1.9\times$ faster than GRPO and converges faster than modern GRPO variants (GSPO, DAPO, PURE) while reaching higher final compile and VLM-judged win rates. On a second task, AIME mathematical reasoning, BoT-GRPO delivers absolute Pass@$k$ gains up to $8.1\%$ over GRPO in half the steps. For both tasks we compare the algorithm's performance on reasoning vs. non-reasoning base-model families (Qwen2.5-3B, SmolLM3-3B, Phi-4-mini-reasoning). Our experiments also yield a practical recipe for the reward model itself: reward stability matters more than richness: clean, bounded, stable fine-grained signals consistently accelerate learning where noisier alternatives stall.

AI.tldr: 提出 BoT-GRPO，将 GRPO 扩展到 token 级奖励模型，通过长度不变的"bag of tokens"聚合实现无 critic 的过程监督，加速收敛并提升最终质量。
AI.motivation: GRPO 中 rollout 内每个 token 共享同一优势值，缺乏过程监督；而引入过程监督通常需价值网络，成本高。作者希望在不使用价值网络的前提下，让过程监督更高效：既加速收敛又提升最终质量。
AI.method: 提出 BoT-GRPO，将 GRPO 扩展到 token 级奖励模型：收集所有 rollout 的 token 级奖励，按来源序列长度取倒数加权，并基于加权组统计量计算每个 token 的优势。方法无 critic，在可获取 token 级奖励时可作为 GRPO 的直接替代。
AI.result: 在 React 前端代码生成任务上，BoT-GRPO 达到 80% 编译率的速度比 GRPO 快至多 1.9 倍，收敛快于 GSPO、DAPO、PURE 等 GRPO 变体，最终编译率与 VLM 评判胜率更高。在 AIME 数学推理任务上，Pass@k 绝对提升最高达 8.1%，且步数仅为 GRPO 的一半。还对比了推理与非推理基座模型家族（Qwen2.5-3B、SmolLM3-3B、Phi-4-mini-reasoning）。
AI.conclusion: BoT-GRPO 以无 critic 方式实现高效 token 级过程监督，通用性强且可即插即用。实验还给出奖励模型的实用准则：奖励稳定性比丰富性更重要，干净、有界、稳定的细粒度信号能持续加速学习，而噪声更大的替代方案会停滞。

title: Beyond Anonymous Captions: Grounding Character Identity in Video Captioning and Question Answering
summary: Linking people's appearance and actions to character identities is essential for understanding video narratives. We present a framework for identity-aware video captioning and person-centric question answering that combines automatic character identification, explicit spatial grounding, and task-specific adaptation. Starting from LSMDC v2 movie clips, our pipeline matches detected faces to actor reference images, tracks characters across frames, and builds inputs with identity-linked bounding boxes. A strong vision-language model generates identity-aware captions and questions, which are manually verified and filtered to create a benchmark of 750 captioned clips and 3,000 person-centric questions. We study five grounding strategies combining textual coordinates with visual face or estimated person boxes across Video-MLLM families at roughly 2B, 4B, and 8B parameters and larger frontier models. Combining visual face boxes with textual coordinates yields the most consistent performance across scales and significantly improves overall performance over coordinates alone. Smaller models tend to over-assign known identities when the queried person is not grounded, while larger models better recognize such UNIDENTIFIED cases. We introduce BAC by LoRA fine-tuning Qwen models at 2B, 4B, and 8B scales on about 32K identity-aware captioned clips. Across all scales, BAC outperforms every other evaluated model family of comparable size. BAC-8B reaches 93.20\% overall QA accuracy, ranking behind only GPT-5.6 Sol among the frontier models evaluated in our study. Overall, explicitly communicating who is where, together with lightweight task-specific adaptation, substantially improves identity-aware video understanding without changing the underlying architecture. We release the benchmark, training data, code, and BAC checkpoints at https://github.com/momentslab/beyond-anonymous-captions.

AI.tldr: 提出身份感知视频理解框架：通过人脸-演员匹配、跨帧跟踪与身份链接边界框构建输入，生成基准（750片段/3000问题），发现视觉人脸框+文本坐标最有效，并用LoRA微调Qwen得到BAC，8B版本QA准确率达93.20%。
AI.motivation: 视频叙事理解需要将人物外貌与行为同角色身份关联，而现有视频字幕与问答多将人物视为匿名实体，缺乏身份感知与空间定位，限制了叙事级理解能力。
AI.method: 基于LSMDC v2电影片段，匹配检测人脸与演员参考图、跨帧跟踪角色、构建带身份链接边界框的输入；用强视觉语言模型生成身份感知字幕与问题，人工校验过滤得基准；对比五种接地策略（文本坐标、视觉人脸框、估计人体框等）在2B/4B/8B及前沿模型上的表现；用约32K身份感知字幕片段对Qwen做LoRA微调得到BAC。
AI.result: 视觉人脸框结合文本坐标在各规模下性能最一致，显著优于仅用坐标；小模型在人物未接地时易过度分配已知身份，大模型更能识别UNIDENTIFIED情形；BAC在各规模均优于同尺寸其他模型族，BAC-8B总体QA准确率93.20%，仅低于所评估的前沿模型GPT-5.6 Sol。
AI.conclusion: 显式表达“谁在哪里”，配合轻量级任务适配，可在不改动底层架构的前提下显著提升身份感知视频理解；基准、训练数据、代码与BAC检查点已开源。

title: Homogenization in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) leverage interactions between agents to perform complex tasks. Despite their success, we show that these interactions can also lead to homogenization, i.e., agents converging to similar behaviors. Homogenization in MAS can reduce agent diversity and reinforce shared failures. In this paper, we operationalize homogenization using three metrics: conformity to the majority, polarization towards extremes, and growing inertia against changes over subsequent interactions. We evaluate homogenization in MAS for code generation, hiring, and scientific peer review. Across these tasks, we show that homogenization translates to concrete downstream risks: in code generation, it hides and amplifies correlated errors which can create systemic vulnerabilities; in hiring, it allows the influence of biased agents to persist long after their removal; and in peer review, it creates uneven evaluation standards across research areas. Our results establish homogenization as a failure mode of MAS, demonstrating that MAS evaluations must move beyond aggregate performance to carefully analyze interaction dynamics. Finally, we show that simple approaches to increase diversity---leveraging sampling stochasticity and mixed-models MAS---fail to reduce homogenization risks, highlighting the need for strategies to effectively leverage agent diversity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多智能体系统（MAS）存在"同质化"失效模式，通过三个指标测量同质化，并在代码生成、招聘、同行评审任务中证明其带来具体下游风险，且简单的多样化手段无法缓解。
AI.motivation: MAS通过智能体间交互完成复杂任务，但已有研究忽视了一个问题：这些交互可能使智能体行为趋同。同质化会削弱智能体多样性并强化共同失败，因此需要将其作为MAS的失效模式加以系统研究。
AI.method: 作者将同质化操作化为三个指标：对多数的从众性、向极端的极化、以及随交互加深对变化的惰性。并在代码生成、招聘、科学同行评审三类任务上评估MAS中的同质化现象，同时测试两类提升多样性的简单方法（采样随机性、混合模型MAS）的效果。
AI.result: 在三个任务中同质化均带来具体风险：代码生成中隐藏并放大相关错误，形成系统性漏洞；招聘中使有偏见智能体的影响在其移除后长期存续；同行评审中导致不同研究领域的评价标准不均衡。此外，利用采样随机性和混合模型MAS等简单增加多样性的方法未能降低同质化风险。
AI.conclusion: 同质化应被确立为MAS的一种失效模式，MAS评估必须超越聚合性能，深入分析交互动态；同时需要有效的策略来真正利用智能体多样性，而非依赖简单的随机性或模型混合。

title: Argos: Adapt Rich Geometric Priors for Generalizable Online Scene-Change-Detection
comment: More details on the project website: https://www.multyxu.com/argos/
summary: Robots operating in dynamic environments require reliable detection of how their surroundings change over time. Existing learning-based methods largely rely on pairwise 2D image features, which struggle under large viewpoint changes and occlusions, are sensitive to noise, and show limited generalization across domains, while explicit 3D approaches typically require costly offline optimization. We show that the implicit 3D knowledge of Geometric Foundation Models (GFMs) provides a strong basis for addressing these limitations. We introduce Argos, which adapts GFM features for joint scene change detection and 3D reconstruction. To address data scarcity and take a step toward a foundation model for scene change detection, we introduce a large-scale benchmark comprising two synthetic datasets and one real-world dataset, and train jointly across diverse datasets to improve cross-domain generalization. We further introduce Argos-SLAM, a real-time system designed for robotics, which performs online change detection and change-aware 4D mapping. Across benchmarks, our framework substantially outperforms existing baselines, with gains of up to 42.01% in change IoU and 27.91% in F1, while supporting scalable deployment in changing real-world environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Argos，利用几何基础模型（GFM）的隐式3D知识，实现场景变化检测与3D重建的联合框架，并构建大规模基准数据集及实时的Argos-SLAM系统。
AI.motivation: 动态环境中的机器人需可靠检测环境随时间的变化。现有基于学习的方法多依赖成对2D图像特征，在大视角变化和遮挡下表现不佳、对噪声敏感、跨域泛化有限；而显式3D方法通常需要昂贵的离线优化。
AI.method: 作者提出Argos，将GFM特征适配用于联合的场景变化检测与3D重建。为应对数据稀缺，构建了包含两个合成数据集和一个真实数据集的大规模基准，并进行多数据集联合训练以提升跨域泛化。此外提出Argos-SLAM，一个面向机器人、可实时执行在线变化检测与变化感知4D建图的系统。
AI.result: 在各基准上，该框架显著优于现有基线，变化IoU最高提升42.01%，F1最高提升27.91%，并支持在变化的真实环境中可扩展部署。
AI.conclusion: 利用GFM的隐式3D知识可有效解决2D特征与显式3D方法的局限，结合大规模基准与联合训练，Argos实现了高精度、可跨域泛化且实时的场景变化检测与4D建图。

title: Dual-QK: Sharp Queries and Flat Keys for Prunable 2-bit KV Caches
summary: Long inputs and extended generation increase the storage and access costs of the key-value (KV) cache. Low-bit quantization reduces storage and memory traffic, while query-channel pruning can further reduce key-cache reads. Rotation-based quantization redistributes the energy of key outliers across channels. To maintain computational invariance, the same orthogonal transform must be applied to queries, preserving query-key dot products. However, this rotation can disperse query energy, weakening the separation between a few large components to retain and many small ones to prune. We introduce Dual-QK, which uses paired non-orthogonal query and key transforms to address this conflict. Using calibrated query and key statistics, Dual-QK combines partial key whitening with a query-aligned basis to balance key scales for INT2 quantization and concentrate query energy for dynamic channel pruning. Channel-0 protection and bucket-relative RoPE support low-bit accuracy over long contexts. Experiments on four models across five generative benchmarks and long-context retrieval tasks show improved accuracy over OSCAR on most tasks at 40% query-channel sparsity. At a 128K context, Dual-QK provides $6.8\times$ KV-cache compression and an estimated $8.3\times$ reduction in KV read volume relative to unpruned BF16. Under the evaluated configurations, our SGLang implementation achieves up to $3.75\times$ the decoding throughput of unpruned BF16.

AI.tldr: Dual-QK 通过成对非正交的 query/key 变换，兼顾低比特 KV 量化的键缩放平衡与动态通道剪枝的查询能量集中，实现长上下文下的高压缩与高吞吐。
AI.motivation: 长输入与长生成显著增加 KV cache 的存储与访问开销。低比特量化可降低存储与访存，查询通道剪枝可减少 key cache 读取；但基于旋转的量化要求对 query 施加相同正交变换以保持点积不变，这会把 query 能量分散，削弱大小分量之间的可分性，从而损害剪枝效果，形成冲突。
AI.method: 提出 Dual-QK，采用成对的非正交 query 与 key 变换。利用校准得到的 query/key 统计量，将部分 key 白化与查询对齐基相结合：一方面平衡 key 尺度以适配 INT2 量化，另一方面集中 query 能量以支持动态通道剪枝。同时引入 channel-0 保护与 bucket-relative RoPE 以维持长上下文的低比特精度。
AI.result: 在四个模型、五个生成基准及长上下文检索任务上，40% query 通道稀疏度下多数任务精度优于 OSCAR。128K 上下文时实现 6.8× KV cache 压缩，KV 读取量相对未剪枝 BF16 估计减少 8.3×；SGLang 实现最高达未剪枝 BF16 的 3.75× 解码吞吐。
AI.conclusion: Dual-QK 通过解耦量化旋转与剪枝所需的查询能量集中，缓解了旋转量化与查询通道剪枝之间的冲突，在低比特、高稀疏、长上下文条件下同时实现显著压缩与吞吐提升。

title: VideoEvolve: Co-Evolving Memory and Retrieval for Long Video Understanding
summary: Long video understanding increasingly relies on external memory to organize massive visual streams into compact representations. However, most memory-based methods dynamically adapt how information is retrieved for different questions, while largely fixing what is remembered. This mismatch makes missing details costly to recover, whereas stored information is valuable only when it can be reliably retrieved. To address this issue, we propose VideoEvolve, a novel self-evolving framework that jointly evolves memory and retrieval for long video understanding. Specifically, starting from a coarse low-frame-rate overview, VideoEvolve couples a Memory Evolver for selective memory augmentation with a Retrieval Evolver for adaptive retrieval over the evolving memory. We then co-evolve the two Evolvers through alternating agentic reinforcement learning (Agentic RL), updating one while freezing the other. To steer this alternating evolution, Bottleneck-Aware Evolution Feedback (BEF) identifies whether the current bottleneck lies in memory or retrieval and directs optimization toward the more limiting side. Furthermore, VideoEvolve introduces Capability-Aware Evolution Feedback (CEF) to alleviate downstream feedback from over-specializing memory to a fixed set of training questions, shifting training toward underdeveloped yet learnable video capabilities. By integrating Agentic RL with BEF and CEF, VideoEvolve transforms downstream reasoning experience into transferable capability updates, providing a concrete path from static long-video systems toward experience-driven, self-improving multimodal intelligence. Extensive experiments on multiple long video understanding benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of VideoEvolve.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VideoEvolve，一个联合演化记忆与检索的自演化框架，用于长视频理解，通过交替的智能体强化学习与两类演化反馈机制实现经验的迁移与自我改进。
AI.motivation: 现有基于记忆的长视频理解方法大多只动态调整“如何检索”，却基本固定“记住什么”，这种不匹配导致遗漏的细节难以恢复；而存储的信息只有在能被可靠检索时才有价值。因此需要让记忆与检索协同演化。
AI.method: VideoEvolve从低帧率粗粒度概览出发，将Memory Evolver（选择性记忆增强）与Retrieval Evolver（在演化记忆上的自适应检索）耦合，并通过交替的Agentic RL共同演化，更新一个时冻结另一个。为此引入Bottleneck-Aware Evolution Feedback (BEF)判断瓶颈在记忆还是检索并定向优化；引入Capability-Aware Evolution Feedback (CEF)缓解下游反馈使记忆过度特化于固定训练问题，转向欠发达但可学习的视频能力。
AI.result: 在多个长视频理解基准上的大量实验证明了VideoEvolve的有效性。
AI.conclusion: VideoEvolve通过Agentic RL结合BEF与CEF，将下游推理经验转化为可迁移的能力更新，为从静态长视频系统走向经验驱动、可自我改进的多模态智能提供了一条具体路径。

title: Fully Interpretable Minimal Transformers: From Geometry to Algorithm
comment: 27 pages, 15 figures, 2 tables. Code and training-dynamics animations: https://github.com/Raneem-mahajne/creating_transformer
summary: We present a framework for building and interpreting minimal transformer models. By constraining a transformer's embedding dimension and head size to 2, we enable full two-dimensional visualization of its internal representations. Embeddings, query/key/value transforms, attention outputs, residual streams, and decision boundaries can all be seen directly. Our central claim is that the learned geometry implies an algorithm; the arrangement of points and boundaries in R^2 can be read as a step-by-step procedure. We train a transformer on a simple task where it must produce the most recently observed even number whenever the '+' operator appears in a sequence of digits. Once trained, we visually walk through every step of the transformer's computation. We show how the model embeds the tokens and their respective positions in the sequence, transforms them via the Q, K, and V matrices, uses the dot product between the Q and K representations to form the attention matrix, and uses the attention matrix to select values that move the representation of each input token to the region of the domain of the output layer that will correctly predict the next token. We introduce a suite of interpretability visualizations that make the algorithmic interpretation of this procedure explicit. Our framework offers a pedagogical and experimental testbed to explore how transformers use informational geometry to implement next-token prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个用于构建和解释极简Transformer模型的框架，将嵌入维度和注意力头大小限制为2，从而实现内部表示的全二维可视化，并证明学习到的几何结构隐含了算法步骤。
AI.motivation: Transformer内部表示通常处于高维空间，难以直观理解其计算过程。作者希望构建一个可完全可视化、可逐步解读的极简模型，以作为教学与实验平台，探索Transformer如何利用信息几何实现下一词元预测。
AI.method: 将Transformer的嵌入维度和头大小约束为2，使嵌入、Q/K/V变换、注意力输出、残差流和决策边界都可直接在R^2中观察。在简单任务上训练模型：当数字序列中出现'+'运算符时，输出最近观察到的偶数。随后逐步骤可视化其计算流程，包括词元与位置嵌入、Q/K/V矩阵变换、Q与K点积形成注意力矩阵、以及注意力矩阵选择值以将输入表示移动到输出层能正确预测下一词元的区域。并引入一套可解释性可视化工具。
AI.result: 通过在二维空间中完整可视化，作者展示了模型对词元及其位置进行嵌入、经Q/K/V变换、通过Q-K点积形成注意力矩阵、并用注意力矩阵选择值以正确预测下一词元的全过程。可视化工具使该算法的解释变得直观明确。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为探索Transformer如何利用信息几何实现下一词元预测提供了教学与实验测试平台，并支持对极简Transformer算法机制的逐步解读。

title: HuLiGen: Human LiDAR Generation from Parametric Body Models
summary: LiDAR point clouds of humans are extremely expensive to collect and annotate, thus represent a scarce resource that hinders the development of human analysis using this modality. To alleviate this scarcity, prior work relies on simulated human LiDAR, but such samples do not fully reflect the geometry and sensing characteristics of real observations. In contrast, we introduce HuLiGen, a generative model that generates human LiDAR point clouds from a parametric body model, using a point transformer trained with a flow-matching objective. We show that our generated point clouds are closer to the real capture distribution. Using HuLiGen to generate synthetic data, we propose a synthetic-only pretraining scheme for LiDAR-based HPE that achieves state-of-the-art performance, with even larger gains in low-annotation and low-data regimes, where MPJPE is reduced by up to 50%. Code, models and generated samples are available at https://github.com/valeoai/HuLiGen.

AI.tldr: 提出HuLiGen生成模型，从参数化人体模型生成人类LiDAR点云，用于LiDAR人体姿态估计的合成预训练。
AI.motivation: 人类LiDAR点云采集与标注成本极高，属于稀缺资源，阻碍了基于该模态的人体分析发展。已有工作依赖模拟LiDAR，但模拟样本无法完全反映真实观测的几何与传感特性。
AI.method: 提出HuLiGen：以参数化人体模型为输入，使用采用flow-matching目标训练的点云Transformer，生成人类LiDAR点云。并基于此生成合成数据，设计仅用合成数据的预训练方案用于LiDAR人体姿态估计（HPE）。
AI.result: 生成的LiDAR点云更接近真实采集分布。合成数据预训练方案在LiDAR HPE上达到最优性能，在低标注和低数据场景下增益更大，MPJPE最多降低50%。
AI.conclusion: HuLiGen为缓解真实LiDAR人体数据稀缺提供有效途径，代码、模型和生成样本已开源。

title: For Those Who Believe in Faithfulness: Optimizing the Area Under Insertion and Deletion Curves for Ranking Relative Feature Importance
summary: The adoption of machine learning for socially relevant tasks requires effective explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) methods to better understand the behavior of machine learning models. Attribution methods are a popular XAI approach in which input-output relationships are characterized by heat maps that reflect the relative importance of input features for a particular prediction. The quality of such maps is often assessed by measuring faithfulness based on the area under insertion and deletion curves, which measures changes in the model output as features are added and removed. In this study, we derive an objective function from this notion of faithfulness and a way to approximate its gradient. We establish the connection between insertion curves and top-$k$ feature selection, which leads to a loss function measuring the quality of attributions. Randomization of the loss allows us to efficiently approximate its gradient. To show the effectiveness of the general approach, we combine the loss function with the neural explanation mask framework. The resulting method, termed Ra-NEM, can be used with any differentiable model without affecting the model's performance. Experiments demonstrate that Ra-NEM provides accurate attributions robustly and efficiently. Compared to other algorithms, the attributions have not only higher faithfulness but also perform well in terms of other XAI metrics. The high inference speed of Ra-NEM makes the method suitable for online applications. The code is available online: https://github.com/baerminator/Ra_Nem

AI.tldr: 本文提出Ra-NEM方法，基于忠实性（插入/删除曲线）推导损失函数并用随机化近似其梯度，结合神经解释掩码框架，为任意可微模型提供高效、准确的归因。
AI.motivation: 社会相关任务中机器学习模型需要有效的可解释AI（XAI）方法。归因方法通过热图反映输入特征对预测的相对重要性，但其质量通常依赖插入/删除曲线下面积来评估忠实性。作者希望从这种忠实性概念出发，构造可优化的目标，以提升归因质量并实现高效计算。
AI.method: 从忠实性概念推导目标函数及其梯度的近似方式；建立插入曲线与top-k特征选择之间的联系，从而得到衡量归因质量的损失函数；通过对损失进行随机化来高效近似其梯度；将该损失函数与神经解释掩码框架结合，形成Ra-NEM。该方法适用于任意可微模型，且不影响模型本身性能。
AI.result: 实验表明，Ra-NEM能稳健且高效地提供准确归因。与其他算法相比，其归因不仅忠实性更高，在其他XAI指标上也表现良好；同时推理速度快，适合在线应用。
AI.conclusion: Ra-NEM通过将忠实性目标与top-k特征选择联系并结合随机化梯度近似，提供了一种通用、高效、可在不损害模型性能前提下使用的归因方法，并已开源代码。

title: VolCo: Volumetric Contact for High-Fidelity Human Grasp Generation
summary: Accurate contact modeling is fundamental to understanding hand-object interaction, yet existing contact representations are typically restricted to object surfaces and rely on hand-crafted rules to recover contact details, leading to severe penetrations and implausible results. To better exploit the rich detail in motion-capture data, we introduce Volumetric Contact (VolCo), a representation that expands surface points to a set of 3D volumetric grids. VolCo encodes 3D contact that allows precise hand part recovery, and is organized in an inherent hierarchy: local contact details within each volume and global hand geometry across all volumes. Our framework, VolCoDiff, employs two modules to capture local and global features following this hierarchy. For local contact details, we use a 3D variational autoencoder to model the possible hand configurations conditioned on the local object signed distance field (SDF). For global hand geometry, we design a prior-guided diffusion model that learns the distribution of compressed latent features aggregated from the volumetric grids. We evaluate our method on two benchmark datasets and demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in penetration and stability, indicating the capability to generate tight grasps with much less severe penetrations. Our code is available at https://github.com/chzh9311/volco.

AI.tldr: 提出体素化接触表示VolCo及配套框架VolCoDiff，实现高精度、低穿透的手-物抓取生成。
AI.motivation: 现有手-物接触表示局限于物体表面，依赖手工规则恢复接触细节，导致严重穿透与不合理结果，且未能充分利用动作捕捉数据中的丰富细节。
AI.method: 提出VolCo，将表面点扩展为3D体素网格集合，编码3D接触并具备固有层级结构（体素内局部细节与跨体素全局手部几何）。框架VolCoDiff含两个模块：局部用3D变分自编码器，以局部物体SDF为条件建模手部配置；全局用先验引导扩散模型，学习体素网格压缩隐特征的分布。
AI.result: 在两个基准数据集上评估，穿透与稳定性指标达到state-of-the-art，能够生成紧密抓取且穿透显著减少。
AI.conclusion: VolCo与VolCoDiff验证了体素化接触表示的有效性，可生成高质量、低穿透的手-物抓取，代码已开源。

title: Stream-Based Active Learning with Cooperative Neural Networks for Data-Efficient Partial Inverse Design: An Automotive Glass Run Channel Case Study
summary: Inverse design in engineering often runs into a simple problem. Each labeled training sample must be produced through expensive simulation, so building a large dataset is slow and costly. This study addresses that problem for partial inverse design, where only some design variables are specified and the rest must be inferred to reach a target performance value. We propose CoNN-AL, a framework for data-efficient partial inverse design that adds stream-based active learning to the Cooperative Neural Network with Denoising Autoencoder (CoNN-DAE). The model estimates predictive uncertainty through Monte Carlo dropout and uses it to decide, in real time, which incoming candidate samples are worth labeling, so the limited labeling budget is spent on the most informative designs. We validate the framework on a real-world automotive glass run channel dataset of more than 900,000 unique simulated designs. With only 20,000 actively selected labels, about 2.3% of the training pool, CoNN-AL reaches R-squared values of 0.967 to 0.982 across all missing-variable levels, approaching the upper-bound models trained on far more data. It reaches R-squared of at least 0.95 with 30 to 40% fewer labels than random sampling at the more difficult missing-variable levels and, at the most challenging level, is the only strategy in this study to reach R-squared of 0.98. Together with this work, we publicly release the dataset to support future research on data-driven design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CoNN-AL 框架，将基于流的主动学习与带去噪自编码器的协作神经网络结合，用于数据高效的部分逆向设计，并以汽车玻璃导槽数据集验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 逆向设计中，每个带标签训练样本都需昂贵仿真生成，构建大规模数据集既慢又贵。本文针对部分逆向设计（仅指定部分设计变量、需推断其余变量以达到目标性能）这一场景，寻求降低标注成本的数据高效方法。
AI.method: 提出 CoNN-AL：在 CoNN-DAE（带去噪自编码器的协作神经网络）基础上加入基于流的主动学习。模型通过 Monte Carlo dropout 估计预测不确定性，并据此实时决定哪些候选样本值得标注，使有限标注预算集中在信息量最大的设计上。
AI.result: 在超过 90 万个独特仿真设计的真实汽车玻璃导槽数据集上验证。仅用 2 万个主动选择的标签（约训练池的 2.3%），CoNN-AL 在所有缺失变量水平上达到 0.967–0.982 的 R²，接近用更多数据训练的上界模型；在较难缺失变量水平上比随机采样少用 30–40% 标签即可达到 R²≥0.95，并在最具挑战性水平上是本研究唯一达到 R²=0.98 的策略。
AI.conclusion: CoNN-AL 能显著提升部分逆向设计的数据效率，在极少标注预算下逼近上界性能；同时作者公开该数据集以支持未来数据驱动设计研究。

title: Masked Feature Encoding for Large-Scale Whole Slide Image Representation
summary: Whole slide image (WSI) analysis in computational pathology follows a multiple instance learning (MIL) pipeline where patch embeddings are extracted independently and aggregated for slide-level prediction, but within-slide variance from staining, scanner, and local texture can overwhelm the discriminative signal. We propose Masked Feature Encoding for Multiple Instance Learning (MFE-MIL), a feature-space masking framework that trains a lightweight MLP adapter jointly with a window-based masked reconstruction branch and a MIL classification head. The two objectives are complementary. Classification guides the adapter to suppress within-slide patch variance, while window-based masked reconstruction provides an auxiliary regularizer for the adapted features without using patch coordinates, coordinate graphs, or segmentation preprocessing. The raster patch-extraction order is used only as a weak implicit prior. At inference, the decoder is removed, leaving only the adapter and MIL head. Across CAMELYON16/17, PANDA, and TCGA-BRCA with four diverse encoders, MFE-MIL improves ACC/F1 for nearly all tested aggregator-encoder settings and AUC in most, outperforms coordinate-based spatial methods (CAMIL), and achieves higher AUC than 2DMamba on three of four datasets (UNI). On five TCGA survival cohorts it improves the average concordance index for every aggregator tested, its most consistent gain. Code is available at https://github.com/AtlasAnalyticsLab/MFE-MIL.

AI.tldr: 提出MFE-MIL，一种特征空间掩码框架，联合训练轻量MLP适配器、窗口掩码重建分支与MIL分类头，抑制切片内方差，推理时仅保留适配器与分类头。
AI.motivation: WSI分析采用MIL流程，patch嵌入独立提取后聚合，但染色、扫描仪和局部纹理带来的切片内方差会淹没判别信号。同时，现有方法常依赖patch坐标、坐标图或分割预处理。
AI.method: 在特征空间做掩码：训练轻量MLP适配器，与基于窗口的掩码重建分支和MIL分类头联合优化。两个目标互补——分类引导适配器抑制切片内patch方差，窗口掩码重建作为适配特征的辅助正则。不使用patch坐标、坐标图或分割预处理，仅将栅格化patch提取顺序作为弱隐式先验。推理时移除解码器。
AI.result: 在CAMELYON16/17、PANDA、TCGA-BRCA上，配合四种编码器，几乎全部聚合器-编码器组合的ACC/F1提升，多数AUC提升；优于基于坐标的空间方法CAMIL；在UNI下于四个数据集中的三个取得高于2DMamba的AUC。五个TCGA生存队列上，对每种聚合器均提升平均一致性指数，为该工作最一致的增益。
AI.conclusion: MFE-MIL通过特征空间掩码与分类目标互补，在不依赖坐标与分割预处理的前提下提升了多数据集、多编码器与多聚合器下的分类与生存预测性能。代码已开源。

title: MUNITE: Unified Multimodal Latent Inference for Any-to-Any Multimodal Generation
summary: We introduce MUNITE, a latent-variable framework for flexible any-to-any multimodal generation that treats encoding and latent generation as the same inference problem under different amounts of observed evidence. Given any subset of modalities, MUNITE models the conditional distribution over the latent representation associated with the complete observation. Full observation recovers deterministic encoding, no observation recovers the latent marginal, and intermediate subsets define conditional latent inference, all within a single conditional flow model. A shared latent sample captures variation that must remain consistent across generated targets, while modality-specific generative decoders model the remaining uncertainty independently. To learn these conditional distributions from incomplete training examples, we extend conditional flow matching through self-distillation: predictions conditioned on richer available observations supervise the same model conditioned on smaller subsets at the same intermediate latent state. When the richer-evidence trajectory follows the exact conditional flow, this provides the same expected learning signal as full-target denoising. Across PolyMNIST-D-Q, FFHQ64, and image-text-audio, MUNITE achieves competitive or better generation quality and source-target alignment, with higher joint-generation coherence. In particular, it attains the highest coherence in all one-to-many and unconditional image-text-audio comparisons, showing the effectiveness of unified latent inference across diverse multimodal settings.

AI.tldr: MUNITE 是一个潜在变量框架，将多模态编码与潜在生成统一为同一推断问题，通过条件流匹配与自蒸馏实现灵活的任何到任何多模态生成。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态生成方法通常将编码与生成分离处理，难以灵活应对任意输入模态子集（从全观察到无观察）的生成需求，且在部分观察条件下缺乏统一的潜在推断机制。
AI.method: 将编码和潜在生成视为同一推断问题在不同观察证据量下的表现：给定任意模态子集，建模完整观察对应潜在表示的条件分布。全观察对应确定性编码，无观察对应潜在边缘分布，中间子集对应条件潜在推断，统一在单一条件流模型中。共享潜在样本保证跨目标一致性，模态特定解码器建模各自不确定性。为从不完整训练样本学习，扩展条件流匹配，通过自蒸馏让基于更丰富观察的预测监督同模型在更小子集、同一中间潜在状态下的预测。
AI.result: 在 PolyMNIST-D-Q、FFHQ64 及图文音频任务上，MUNITE 取得有竞争力或更优的生成质量与源-目标对齐，联合生成连贯性更高；在所有一对多及无条件图文音频比较中连贯性最高。
AI.conclusion: 统一潜在推断在多样多模态设置中有效，MUNITE 为灵活的任何到任何多模态生成提供了可行方案。

title: Geometry-Supervised Visual Representation Learning for Multi-Phenotype Lesion Interpretation in Medical VLMs
summary: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) have shown increasing potential for clinical image interpretation. However, these models still struggle to interpret multi-phenotype lesions whose diagnosis requires the joint assessment of multiple pathological phenotypes. Existing vision-language alignment methods produce visual representations that fail to preserve anatomical hierarchies and relationships among phenotypic subclasses. This stems from their reliance on semantic supervision, which lacks geometric constraints to preserve these relationships in the visual embedding space. Moreover, the sparsity of lesion-related anatomical and phenotypic representations makes it difficult for medical VLMs to capture important diagnostic evidence. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{PureVision}, a geometry-supervised visual representation learning framework for multi-phenotype lesion interpretation in medical VLMs. It combines a geometry-supervised representation learning module, \textbf{PureEyes}, and an anatomy-guided evidence aggregation module, \textbf{PureNeurons}. PureEyes provides geometric supervision through ideal spatial distributions that encode anatomical hierarchies and phenotypic subclass relationships. PureNeurons projects visual representations into the learned latent space, using their positions to selectively aggregate lesion-specific anatomical and phenotypic evidence. Experiments on \textit{LIDC-IDRI}, \textit{CBIS-DDSM}, and \textit{3DReasonKnee} demonstrate that PureVision improves lesion grounding and phenotype characterization in visual question answering and radiology report generation. Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/purevision-06C2.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PureVision，一种几何监督的视觉表征学习框架，用于医学VLM中的多表型病变解释，通过PureEyes几何监督与PureNeurons证据聚合提升病变定位与表型表征。
AI.motivation: 医学视觉语言模型在临床图像解释中潜力渐显，但难以解读需联合评估多个病理表型的多表型病变。现有视觉语言对齐方法生成的视觉表征无法保留解剖层级与表型子类间关系，根源在于依赖缺乏几何约束的语义监督；同时病变相关解剖与表型表征的稀疏性也阻碍模型捕获关键诊断证据。
AI.method: 提出PureVision框架，包含两个模块：PureEyes几何监督表征学习模块，通过编码解剖层级与表型子类关系的理想空间分布提供几何监督；PureNeurons解剖引导证据聚合模块，将视觉表征投影到学习到的潜空间，利用其位置选择性聚合病变特异的解剖与表型证据。
AI.result: 在LIDC-IDRI、CBIS-DDSM和3DReasonKnee上的实验表明，PureVision在视觉问答与放射报告生成任务中提升了病变定位与表型表征能力。
AI.conclusion: 几何监督的视觉表征学习能有效解决医学VLM中多表型病变解释的表征缺陷，为临床图像理解提供更可靠的病变定位与表型刻画能力。

title: Layerwise Error Attribution for Fast and Robust Mixed-Precision Post-Training Quantization
summary: Mixed-precision post-training quantization is a network compression method that assigns bits layer by layer, under a global memory budget using a small calibration set. The main difficulties are to overcome the combinatorial nature of the allocation problem and to manage the sensitivity to small, potentially corrupted databases. Hence, an efficient allocation method should be fast to compute and preserve model quality when calibration data are corrupted. To design such a method, we derive a layerwise probabilistic analysis of the quantization error that separates propagated error from the local perturbation introduced at a given layer. We use this local term to build a separable score for a simple allocation algorithm, that requires no external solver. The probabilistic nature of our approach brings robustness to corrupted data. On denoising tasks with DRUNet, with an average budget of 4 bits per weight, our method matches or improves state-of-the-art mixed-precision baselines under clean calibration, and is more robust to corrupted calibration, with PSNR gains of up to 7.5 dB under the tested corruptions. Experiments show bit-allocation speed-ups from 28x to 2,570x over the studied baselines. For quantized diffusion models, our experiments show that a direct application of our framework also improves the state-of-the-art.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于逐层概率误差分析的混合精度训练后量化方法，通过可分离评分实现快速、鲁棒的比特分配。
AI.motivation: 混合精度训练后量化需在全局内存预算下逐层分配比特，主要难点在于分配问题的组合爆炸性以及校准数据可能被污染时对数据敏感的鲁棒性问题。因此需要一种计算快速、且在数据受污染时仍能保持模型质量的高效分配方法。
AI.method: 作者推导了量化误差的逐层概率分析，将传播误差与某一层引入的局部扰动分离开来；利用该局部项构建可分离评分，进而设计出一种无需外部求解器的简单分配算法，其概率特性带来对污染数据的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在 DRUNet 去噪任务上，平均每权重 4 比特预算下，方法在干净校准下匹配或优于当前最优混合精度基线，在污染校准下更鲁棒，PSNR 最高提升 7.5 dB；比特分配速度相比基线提升 28 倍至 2,570 倍；在量化扩散模型中直接应用该框架也改进了当前最优结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过概率化的逐层误差分解实现了快速、鲁棒的混合精度比特分配，无需外部求解器，并在去噪与扩散模型任务上验证了其有效性与效率优势。

title: LoomSC: Scalable Deep Subspace Clustering with Projector Factorization and Exact Spectral Reduction
summary: Dense self-expression matrices and full-affinity spectral clustering limit the scalability of subspace clustering. We introduce the Latent Orthogonal Optimization Model for Subspace Clustering (LoomSC), a framework that addresses both bottlenecks through projector factorization and exact spectral reduction. Motivated by the spectral structure of least-squares regression, LoomSC jointly learns latent features and a projector self-representation through two thin factors. Alternating Procrustes and least-squares updates preserve the sample factor's orthogonality while keeping the coefficient matrix implicit. We construct a nonnegative quadratic affinity that preserves the projector's support. An exact feature map then reduces its normalized spectral problem to an eigenproblem whose dimension depends only on the factor width. Neither the full affinity nor the sample Laplacian needs to be formed. Our analysis quantifies the projector approximation and identifies conditions for subspace preservation and within-subspace connectivity. For fixed dimensions and iteration budgets, the complete pipeline has linear time and memory complexity in the number of samples. Across five image-clustering benchmarks, LoomSC ranks first or second in all 15 dataset-metric comparisons against 9 state-of-the-art baselines. Its mean accuracy exceeds the highest baseline mean by 6.66 percentage points. Synthetic experiments scale to 500,000 samples while maintaining at least 99.8% accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出 LoomSC 子空间聚类框架，通过投影因子分解与精确谱降维，避免构造稠密自表示矩阵和全亲和矩阵，实现线性复杂度，在多个基准上取得领先精度并扩展至 50 万样本。
AI.motivation: 传统子空间聚类受限于稠密自表示矩阵与全亲和谱聚类，难以扩展到大样本规模，需同时缓解这两个瓶颈。
AI.method: 基于最小二乘回归的谱结构，联合学习潜在特征与投影自表示，用两个薄因子表示；交替 Procrustes 与最小二乘更新保持样本因子正交并隐式维护系数矩阵；构造保留投影支撑的非负二次亲和，并用精确特征映射把归一化谱问题降为仅依赖因子宽度的特征问题，不显式构造全亲和或样本拉普拉斯。
AI.result: 在 5 个图像聚类基准、15 项数据集-指标比较中，LoomSC 对 9 个先进基线均排名第一或第二；平均精度比最佳基线均值高 6.66 个百分点；合成实验扩展到 50 万样本仍保持至少 99.8% 精度；固定维度与迭代预算下，整体流水线在样本数上具线性时间与内存复杂度。
AI.conclusion: LoomSC 通过投影因子化与精确谱降维有效解决子空间聚类的可扩展性问题，并给出子空间保持与子空间内连通性的理论条件，兼顾精度与大规模扩展能力。

title: Identifiability of a dissipative knowledge-dynamics model: exact recovery under designed excitation, degeneration on observational data
summary: Human learning is a dissipative dynamical process: mastery accumulates through practice, decays through forgetting, and propagates across interdependent concepts. We model it as a nonlinear dissipative system of ordinary differential equations whose parameters are mechanistically meaningful (a concept-transfer matrix encoding prerequisite coupling, per-concept forgetting rates, and a saturating practice-response gain), and we study when those parameters can actually be recovered from data. We prove a structural identifiability theorem for the associated inverse problem under explicit excitation conditions, with constructive closed-form recovery for the two-concept case, together with monotonicity, robustness and L-stability results. We derive a semi-implicit L-stable scheme for the dissipative subsystem and a batched solver numerically equivalent to the per-trajectory formulation (bit-exact predictions, gradients to $10^{-10}$) yet two orders of magnitude faster, making estimation feasible on cohorts of $10^5$ learners. The empirical study is two-sided. Under the theorem's excitation conditions, synthetic recovery is exact: parameters to machine precision, prerequisite structure at $F_1 = 1.0$. On large observational benchmarks it is not. An apparently strong recovery, with forgetting rates correlating with topic difficulty at Spearman $ρ= 0.83$, is refuted by four independent controls: it survives destroying the temporal order of the data, is matched by a classical Bayesian baseline, and is unaffected by removing real timestamps. We trace this to the stationary structure of the model and show that it is the degeneration the theorem predicts in the absence of designed excitation. The result delineates a sharp boundary between identifiable and unidentifiable regimes and yields a validation protocol for interpretability claims.

AI.tldr: 该论文将人类学习建模为非线性耗散常微分方程组，证明了其逆问题的结构可辨识性定理，并揭示观测数据中"可解释"参数恢复实为定理预测的退化现象。
AI.motivation: 人类学习是耗散动力学过程：掌握随练习累积、随遗忘衰减、并在相互依赖的概念间传播。作者希望建立一个参数具有机制含义的模型，并研究这些参数何时能从数据中被真正恢复，从而厘清可辨识与不可辨识的边界。
AI.method: 构建含概念转移矩阵（编码先修耦合）、各概念遗忘率和饱和练习响应增益的非线性耗散ODE系统；在显式激励条件下证明逆问题的结构可辨识性定理，给出双概念情形的构造性闭式恢复及单调性、稳健性和L-稳定性结果；推导半隐式L-稳定格式与等效批处理求解器（位精确预测、梯度到1e-10，快两个数量级）；并在合成数据与大规模观测基准上做双侧实证，配合四项独立控制实验。
AI.result: 在定理的激励条件下，合成数据恢复精确：参数达机器精度，先修结构F1=1.0。在大型观测基准上则不然：看似强恢复（遗忘率与主题难度相关，Spearman ρ=0.83）被四项独立控制推翻——它在破坏时间顺序后依然存在、被经典贝叶斯基线匹配、且移除真实时间戳后不受影响。作者追溯其源于模型的平稳结构，属定理预测的无设计激励时的退化。批处理求解器使对10^5学习者的队列估计变得可行。
AI.conclusion: 研究划定了可辨识与不可辨识机制之间的清晰边界，并提供了一套验证协议，用于检验可解释性主张，警示观测数据中的机制参数恢复可能是虚假的。

title: RollVerify: Bridging Efficiency and Accuracy in Long-Tail Rollout Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning is crucial for improving large language models' reasoning and generalization. It relies on massive rollouts whose lengths become increasingly long-tailed as context windows grow. In on-policy training, these long-tail rollouts can result in GPU bubbles, reducing system utilization and limiting RL scalability. Asynchronous or partial-rollout methods improve throughput by relaxing synchronization, but inevitably introduce stale off-policy samples (trajectories) that may hurt final accuracy. Existing approaches mainly mitigate this off-policy issue by reweighting off-policy samples during training, yet they can still leave a performance gap compared to fully on-policy training. In this work, rather than passively reweighting samples during training, we propose RollVerify, a lightweight RL framework built on partial rollout that actively verifies and repairs samples before they enter training. Specifically, it introduces an off-policy shift metric OPS, to quantify the off-policy deviation of partially generated trajectories. Guided by the OPS constraint, RollVerify performs both sequence-level and token-level verification to identify and truncate invalid suffixes of trajectories. This yields high-quality samples that protect the models' accuracy while preserving the efficiency gains of partial rollout. Experiments on mathematical and tool-assisted mathematical reasoning show that RollVerify achieves accuracy comparable to on-policy training while reducing training cost. Additional code-generation results provide preliminary evidence beyond mathematics.

AI.tldr: 提出 RollVerify 框架，通过主动验证与修复部分采样轨迹来缓解 off-policy 偏差，在保持接近 on-policy 精度的同时降低训练成本。
AI.motivation: RL 提升大模型推理能力依赖大量 rollout，随上下文窗口增大，轨迹长度呈长尾分布，导致 on-policy 训练出现 GPU 空泡，降低利用率并限制扩展性。异步/部分采样虽提升吞吐，却引入过时 off-policy 样本，损害最终精度。现有方法主要靠训练中重加权来缓解，仍与完全 on-policy 训练存在性能差距。
AI.method: 提出 RollVerify，一个基于 partial rollout 的轻量级 RL 框架，在样本进入训练前主动验证和修复。引入 off-policy shift 度量 OPS 量化部分生成轨迹的偏差，在该约束指导下进行序列级和 token 级验证，识别并截断轨迹中无效的后缀，从而获得高质量样本。
AI.result: 在数学推理与工具辅助数学推理实验中，RollVerify 达到与 on-policy 训练相当的精度，同时降低训练成本；额外的代码生成结果提供了超出数学领域的初步证据。
AI.conclusion: 主动验证与修复优于被动重加权：通过 OPS 约束截断无效后缀，可兼顾精度与 partial rollout 的效率收益，具备跨任务推广潜力。

title: $Δ$Representation: Geometry Supervised Representation Learning of Phenotypes via Counterfactual Reasoning for Medical VLMs
summary: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) have shown increasing potential for radiological image interpretation. Medical VLMs encode radiological images into visual representations that capture both anatomical and phenotypic information for diagnosis. Existing approaches improve pathological phenotype representations through semantic-guided representation alignment. However, pathological phenotypes arise as lesion-specific visual changes superimposed on underlying normal anatomy. Such semantic alignment approaches fail to model the phenotype-specific increment relative to the corresponding normal anatomical representation. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{$Δ$Representation}, a visual phenotype representation learning framework based on counterfactual reasoning for medical VLMs. It comprises \textbf{BaseAnatomy}, a geometry-supervised representation learning module, and \textbf{$Δ$Phenotype}, a counterfactual incremental representation learning module. BaseAnatomy provides fine-grained geometric supervision through spatial relationships across and within anatomical structures. $Δ$Phenotype computes the representation increment between lesion representations and their corresponding normal anatomical representations, and supervises increments associated with the same phenotype to cluster in the representation space. Experiments on \textit{ReXGroundingCT} and \textit{LIDC-IDRI} demonstrate that $Δ$Representation effectively structures pathological phenotype representations and improves lesion grounding and phenotype characterization accuracy in medical VLMs. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/deltarep-CF6D.

AI.tldr: 提出ΔRepresentation框架，基于反事实推理学习医学视觉语言模型的病理表型视觉表征，通过BaseAnatomy几何监督与ΔPhenotype增量表征学习，在ReXGroundingCT和LIDC-IDRI上提升病灶定位与表型刻画精度。
AI.motivation: 现有医学视觉语言模型通过语义引导的表征对齐改进病理表型表征，但病理表型本质上是叠加在正常解剖结构之上的病灶特异性视觉变化，这类方法无法建模表型相对于对应正常解剖表征的增量信息。
AI.method: 提出ΔRepresentation视觉表型表征学习框架，包含两个模块：BaseAnatomy负责几何监督的表征学习，通过解剖结构之间与内部的空间关系提供细粒度几何监督；ΔPhenotype负责反事实增量表征学习，计算病灶表征与其对应正常解剖表征之间的表征增量，并监督同一表型相关的增量在表征空间中聚类。
AI.result: 在ReXGroundingCT和LIDC-IDRI数据集上的实验表明，ΔRepresentation能有效结构化病理表型表征，提升医学视觉语言模型中病灶定位与表型刻画的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 以反事实增量建模表型相对正常解剖的表征差异，可有效改进医学视觉语言模型的病理表型表征质量，代码已开源。

title: NeuralZip: Reusable Setup for Fast Lossless Compression
summary: Lossless compression can reduce the storage and movement of model weights without changing their floating-point values, but repeated statistical analysis and code construction add computational overhead. We study whether the statistical structure of exponents can be prepared once and reused. For this, we introduce NeuralZip, which groups chunks with similar exponent distributions, shares Huffman codes, and selectively represents recurring exponent tuples using packed exponents, thereby achieving additional moderate compression ratios. A setup chooses these representations before subsequent encodings, while every encoding still processes the current tensor values. In floating-point model checkpoints, post-setup compression is 1.81-21.33$\times$ faster than the baselines and achieves exact bit-to-bit reconstruction. We show that this setup can be precomputed and transferred from another compatible architecture, preserving similar compression ratios and avoiding the need to amortize setup costs. Therefore, compression adaptation is transferable and reusable. Training checkpoints demonstrate continued reuse as the weights evolve. Finally, GPU experiments reduce active memory usage by up to 27.5$\%$ while reproducing the logits exactly.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NeuralZip，通过一次性的统计结构准备与复用，实现浮点模型权重的无损压缩，在保持逐比特精确重建的同时提升压缩速度，并证明压缩适配可迁移与复用。
AI.motivation: 无损压缩可减少模型权重的存储与传输而不改变浮点数值，但重复的统计分析和编码构造会带来额外计算开销。作者希望探究指数的统计结构能否被一次性准备并重复使用，从而降低压缩成本。
AI.method: NeuralZip 将指数分布相似的块分组，共享 Huffman 码，并对重复出现的指数元组采用打包指数进行选择性表示，从而获得额外的适度压缩比。该表示由一个 setup 过程在后续编码之前选定，而每次编码仍处理当前张量值。
AI.result: 在浮点模型检查点上，setup 后的压缩比基线快 1.81–21.33 倍，并实现逐比特精确重建；setup 可预计算并从其他兼容架构迁移，保持相似压缩比且无需摊销 setup 成本。训练检查点显示权重演化过程中仍可继续复用。GPU 实验在精确复现 logits 的同时将活跃显存占用最多降低 27.5%。
AI.conclusion: 压缩适配是可迁移且可复用的：一次性的 setup 可跨兼容架构迁移并随权重演化持续复用，在保证无损精度的同时显著降低压缩开销与显存占用。

title: TouchScale: 500 Hours of Human Vision and Touch for Visual-Tactile Learning
summary: Large-scale egocentric human interaction data is becoming an important source of physical supervision for embodied learning, yet video alone leaves the contact and pressure that characterize physical interaction unrecorded. Recent visual-tactile datasets provide this missing supervision, but their synchronized tactile data remain far smaller in volume than human video. Moreover, the largest resources often merge recordings from different sensors or annotation procedures, which makes the effect of data scale difficult to isolate. We therefore introduce TouchScale, a 500-hour dataset of contact-rich human interaction recorded with a single unified wearable setup. Its approximately 2K predefined task descriptions span everyday activities and structured manipulation, and each recording temporally aligns egocentric RGB-D video with wrist RGB video and dense full-hand bimanual tactile measurements. Compared with prior tactile data, training on the full TouchScale raises zero-shot contact IoU on data from an unseen tactile sensor from 0.134 to 0.383. Pretraining a visual encoder on TouchScale also yields the highest action recognition accuracy on three benchmarks among the compared visual-tactile datasets. Used for visual-tactile mid-training of a robot policy, TouchScale improves the average real-world success rate across four contact-rich manipulation tasks from 22.5% to 57.5%. With the sensor and collection protocol held fixed, both zero-shot tactile prediction and robot success show an overall upward trend as more TouchScale data is used. These results suggest that human visual-tactile data collected at scale with consistent sensing benefits both perception and robot manipulation. We will publicly release TouchScale, including all synchronized visual-tactile recordings and reconstructed object models, to support future research on scalable visual-tactile learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TouchScale，一个 500 小时、采用统一可穿戴设备采集的接触密集型人类交互视觉-触觉数据集，验证了数据规模对触觉预测与机器人操作的正向作用。
AI.motivation: 大规模自我中心人类交互数据是具身学习的重要物理监督来源，但视频无法记录物理交互中的接触与压力信息。现有视觉-触觉数据集虽提供此类监督，但同步触觉数据量远小于人类视频；且最大规模资源常混合不同传感器或标注流程，难以分离数据规模的影响。
AI.method: 构建 TouchScale 数据集：采用单一统一可穿戴设备采集 500 小时接触密集型人类交互数据，包含约 2K 预定义任务描述，涵盖日常活动与结构化操作；每条记录将自我中心 RGB-D 视频与手腕 RGB 视频及密集全手双手触觉测量在时间上对齐。在此基础上进行触觉预测、视觉编码器预训练及机器人策略的视觉-触觉中期训练。
AI.result: 在未见触觉传感器数据上的零样本接触 IoU 从 0.134 提升至 0.383；预训练视觉编码器在三个基准上取得对比数据集中最高的动作识别准确率；用于机器人策略中期训练时，四个接触密集型操作任务的真实世界平均成功率从 22.5% 提升至 57.5%；在传感器与采集协议固定的条件下，零样本触觉预测与机器人成功率随数据量增加总体呈上升趋势。
AI.conclusion: 以一致传感方式大规模采集的人类视觉-触觉数据能同时提升感知与机器人操作性能。作者将公开释放 TouchScale，包括全部同步视觉-触觉记录与重建物体模型，以支持可扩展视觉-触觉学习的未来研究。

title: Eigenvalues of the Hessian in Deep Learning: The Origin of Symmetry and Its Breaking
summary:
Hessian spectra at trained models in deep learning exhibit a persistent pattern: eigenvalues organize into distinct clusters, including a large bulk near zero and a few isolated outliers. This paper shows that a natural account of these spectral phenomena emerges when the original setting is understood as a departure from a nearby, otherwise hidden, highly symmetric reference.
  Modifications, including changes to the architecture, data distribution, or parameter metric, expose a nearby reference configuration whose Hessian exhibits rich invariances-ones not accounted for by weight symmetries. There, symmetry enables a precise description of the spectra, forcing high-dimensional kernels and eigenvalues of large multiplicity. Returning to the original configuration breaks the Hessian symmetry and thereby produces the observed hierarchy of clusters and outliers.
  The framework is developed in some generality, with a detailed analysis of three-layer ReLU networks and applications to convolutional, graph, and transformer models, as well as to the NTK. The same mechanism is further shown to yield analogous spectral structures in layerwise Hessians and the Gauss-Newton matrix.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种统一框架，将深度模型训练后Hessian谱的“零附近大块+孤立离群值”结构，解释为对某个隐含高对称参考构型的偏离。
AI.motivation: 训练后的深度网络Hessian谱普遍呈现特征值聚簇：零附近的大块加少数孤立离群点。这一现象缺乏统一的机理解释，本文试图给出一个自然且普遍的解释。
AI.method: 通过修改架构、数据分布或参数度量，暴露一个邻近的、高度对称的参考构型；该参考Hessian具有超出权重对称性的丰富不变性，可精确刻画其谱（高维核与大重数特征值）。再回到原构型，对称性被打破，从而产生所观察到的簇与离群值层级结构。框架在一般情形下建立，并详细分析三层ReLU网络，应用于卷积、图与Transformer模型及NTK。
AI.result: 对称参考构型的谱可被精确描述，包含高维核与大重数特征值；回到原构型后对称性破缺，重现聚类与离群值层级。该机制在卷积、图、Transformer模型及NTK中均成立。
AI.conclusion: 同一机制还能在逐层Hessian与Gauss-Newton矩阵中产生类似的谱结构，表明该对称性破缺视角对理解深度模型Hessian谱具有普遍性。

title: On the Necessity of Attention-FFN Split in Vision Transformers
summary: The standard Transformer architecture relies on a rigid pattern that alternates Attention and Feed-Forward Network (FFN) layers. Despite its widespread adoption, the inductive bias imposed by this strict separation has not been systematically examined. In this work, we investigate the necessity of the Attention-FFN dichotomy in Vision Transformers (ViTs). To facilitate this analysis, we introduce the AttenFeed module, a unified component that integrates the functional properties of both Attention and FFN. Based on this module, we devise the unified Vision Transformer (uViT), which replaces the conventional alternating Attention-FFN structure with a sequence of AttenFeed modules. We then use uViT as a control group that relaxes the Attention-FFN dichotomy of the standard ViT and systematically compare the two models across multiple datasets and model scales. Our experiments reveal that the Attention-FFN dichotomy can hinder performance at smaller model scales due to the rigid parameter allocation of ViTs. The AttenFeed module and uViT serve as new analytical tools for understanding the Attention-FFN structure and offer theoretical insights into the heuristically designed architecture of conventional ViTs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过提出统一的AttenFeed模块和uViT，系统检验Vision Transformer中Attention-FFN二分结构的必要性，发现该二分结构在小模型尺度下因参数分配僵化而损害性能。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer依赖严格交替的Attention与FFN层，这种架构带来的归纳偏置虽被广泛采用，却未被系统性地检验；作者希望探究在视觉Transformer中Attention-FFN二分的必要性。
AI.method: 提出AttenFeed模块，将Attention与FFN的功能特性整合为统一组件；基于该模块构建uViT，用一系列AttenFeed模块替代传统的交替Attention-FFN结构；将uViT作为放松二分结构的对照组，在多个数据集和模型尺度上与标准ViT进行系统对比。
AI.result: 实验表明，Attention-FFN二分结构在较小模型尺度下会因ViT参数分配的刚性而阻碍性能表现。
AI.conclusion: AttenFeed模块与uViT为理解Attention-FFN结构提供了新的分析工具，并为传统ViT中启发式设计的架构提供了理论启示。

title: KGATE : a Knowledge Graph Embedding Training Environment
comment: Main paper (7 pages, 1 figure) and supplementary materials (4 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables) provided
summary: Knowledge graph embedding (KGE) models encode the entities and relations of a knowledge graph into a low-dimensional latent space, enabling tasks such as classification or link prediction. Most KGE models follow an autoencoder architecture, in which an encoder projects the knowledge graph into the latent space and a decoder reconstruct it. Combining both encoder and decoder components is increasingly needed, yet existing libraries rarely support complete autoencoders, are often unmaintained, rely on undocumented default hyperparameters, and produce results that cannot be compared across libraries. Here we present KGATE (Knowledge Graph Autoencoder Training Environment), a modular Python library built on PyTorch Geometric and TorchKGE. KGATE lets users assemble initializers, encoders, decoders, losses, negative samplers, and evaluation metrics as building blocks, or plug in their own block. KGATE includes a preprocessing procedure that controls data leakage, a builtin training pipeline, and reproducibility by design. Benchmarks against six existing KGE libraries show that KGATE training time is comparable with the fastest libraries while offering a broader set of features.

AI.tldr: KGATE是一个基于PyTorch Geometric与TorchKGE的模块化Python库，用于组装知识图谱自编码器（初始化器、编码器、解码器、损失、负采样、评估），内置防数据泄漏预处理与训练流程，训练速度与最快库相当且功能更全。
AI.motivation: 现有知识图谱嵌入库较少支持完整的自编码器（编码器+解码器）组合，且常缺乏维护、依赖未记录的默认超参数，跨库结果无法比较。
AI.method: 以PyTorch Geometric和TorchKGE为基础构建模块化库KGATE，用户可将初始化器、编码器、解码器、损失函数、负采样器和评估指标作为积木自由组装或自定义替换；同时提供控制数据泄漏的预处理流程、内置训练管线，并通过设计保证可复现性。
AI.result: 与六个现有KGE库进行基准对比，KGATE的训练时间与最快的库相当，同时提供更广泛的功能集合。
AI.conclusion: KGATE为知识图谱嵌入提供了一个兼顾完整自编码器支持、模块化扩展、可复现性与高效训练的解决方案。

title: One-Shot Adaptive Segmentation For Scientific Images
summary: Scientific image segmentation methods rely on extensive annotation and task-specific training, limiting adaptation across imaging modalities and experimental conditions. We present a training-free, one-shot framework that specializes vision foundation models using a single annotated reference image. The framework combines DINOv3 representations with background-adaptive feature orthogonalization to suppress artifact-related feature directions, after which cosine similarity localizes candidate regions for SAM segmentation. We evaluate the framework on red-blood-cell microscopy, structured-illumination pool boiling, and chest radiography. Relative to the strongest baseline, the proposed method improves mean IoU by 5.91% and 78.62% on the microscopy and pool-boiling datasets, respectively, while achieving comparable performance on chest radiographs. These results demonstrate that one-shot reference conditioning can adapt general-purpose vision models to specialized scientific segmentation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练、单样本的科学图像分割框架，用一张标注参考图定制视觉基础模型。
AI.motivation: 现有科学图像分割依赖大量标注和特定任务训练，难以跨成像模态和实验条件迁移适应。
AI.method: 结合DINOv3表示与背景自适应特征正交化以抑制伪影相关特征方向，再用余弦相似度定位候选区域，交由SAM完成分割。
AI.result: 在红细胞显微、结构光照池沸腾和胸部X线数据集上评估；相比最强基线，显微与池沸腾数据集平均IoU分别提升5.91%和78.62%，胸部X线性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 单样本参考条件化可将通用视觉模型适配到专业科学分割任务，且无需训练。

title: Expected Sample Complexity in Multi-Armed Bandits
summary: Sample complexity is a widely used metric in sequential decision-making problems, defined as the number of suboptimal decisions during the interaction between the agent and an environment. We study the sample complexity of stochastic multi-armed bandit problems and introduce the expected sample complexity performance measure, analyzing it in a novel framework called approximately correct in expectation (ACE). We show that ACE guarantees imply almost sure convergence to the optimal expected reward, in contrast to high-probability guarantees found in other frameworks, and also show how to convert ACE guarantees into explicit expected regret bounds. We further show that, in contrast to existing measures, deterministic algorithms cannot obtain favorable ACE bounds, and analyze stochastic algorithms in two settings: when the allowed suboptimality level $ε$ is known to the algorithm and when it is unknown. In the former, we devise an explore-then-$ε$-greedy algorithm, and in the latter, we analyze the expected sample complexity of Thompson sampling. Finally, we establish nearly matching lower bounds for both settings, showing that the algorithms are tight in $ε$ and proving a performance separation between the two regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究随机多臂老虎机问题中的样本复杂度，提出"期望近似正确"(ACE)框架，分析已知与未知次优水平ε两种设定下的算法并给出近乎紧的下界。
AI.motivation: 样本复杂度是序贯决策中的常用指标，定义为智能体与环境交互过程中的次优决策次数。现有框架多采用高概率保证，作者希望引入期望样本复杂度这一性能度量并从新的ACE框架进行分析。
AI.method: 提出ACE(approximately correct in expectation)框架。证明ACE保证蕴含对最优期望奖励的几乎必然收敛，并给出将ACE保证转化为显式期望遗憾界的方法。分析两种设定：ε已知时设计explore-then-ε-greedy算法；ε未知时分析Thompson采样的期望样本复杂度。同时建立两种设定下近乎匹配的下界。
AI.result: ACE保证可推出几乎必然收敛，并能转化为期望遗憾界；与现有度量不同，确定性算法无法获得有利的ACE界；所提算法在下界意义上对ε是紧的，并证明了两种设定之间存在性能分离。
AI.conclusion: ACE为随机老虎机样本复杂度提供了新的分析框架，揭示了期望度量与高概率度量的差异，并明确了ε已知与未知两种情形间的性能分离。

title: From Digital Human Interactions to Physics-Based Humanoid Skills: Physics-Grounded Post-Training of Interaction Generators
summary: Recent methods have made promising progress in generating interactions between two humanoids, largely relying on physics-based tracking policies to convert digital reference motions into executable trajectories. However, limited tracking capabilities restrict the range of reference motions that can be successfully executed, reducing data utilization. Moreover, even successful tracking does not guarantee physically plausible responses or faithful realization of the intended interactions. In this paper, we introduce DIGHT, a co-adaptive framework that couples a Digital human Interaction Generator with a Humanoid Tracking policy. Our DIGHT first executes multiple text-conditioned interaction candidates in simulation using a fixed tracker. It then constructs physics-grounded preferences from the resulting rollouts, covering both general executability and interaction fidelity. Rather than collapsing these signals into a single scalar reward for candidate ranking, we align the pretrained generator using physics-decoupled diffusion direct preference optimization (DPO), preserving criterion-specific supervision without differentiating through the simulator. To improve executability, preference pairs are derived from tracking error, friction, and floating. Additionally, to improve interaction fidelity, we propose to incorporate force feedback from simulator as a measure of contact fidelity and construct preferences over contact occurrence, location, duration, and force magnitude. The aligned generator then supplies reference motions for fine-tuning the tracker, improving compatibility between generation and physical execution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach not only improves the physical plausibility of generated motions but also enables more reliable and faithful humanoid interactions in simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DIGHT框架，通过生成器与跟踪策略协同自适应，提升双人交互动作的物理合理性与执行成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖基于物理的跟踪策略执行参考动作，但跟踪能力有限，限制了可用参考动作范围，且跟踪成功也不保证物理合理或忠实交互。
AI.method: DIGHT用固定跟踪器在仿真中执行多个文本条件交互候选，构建涵盖可执行性与交互保真度的物理偏好；采用物理解耦的扩散直接偏好优化（DPO）对齐预训练生成器，偏好对来自跟踪误差、摩擦、漂浮，以及接触发生、位置、时长与力的反馈；对齐后的生成器再为跟踪器微调提供参考动作。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法提升了生成动作的物理合理性，并在仿真中实现更可靠、更忠实的双人交互。
AI.conclusion: 生成器与跟踪器的协同自适应能够改善生成与物理执行之间的兼容性，提高数据利用与交互质量。

title: Learning Traffic Flow Dynamics with Stochastic Physics-Informed Neural Cellular Automata
summary: Traffic flow modeling is essential for understanding and predicting the collective dynamics of vehicles on road networks. Cellular automata provide a simple, interpretable yet powerful framework for representing these dynamics via local interaction rules, while retaining the ability to reproduce complex macroscopic traffic phenomena. However, learning local transition rules from data while preserving physically meaningful constraints remains challenging, particularly for stochastic models. In this work, we propose a physics-informed neural cellular automaton (PI-NCA) for data-driven traffic flow modeling. Building on the standard neural cellular automaton (NCA), we design a neural architecture that is physically consistent with the road topology and guarantees conservation of the total number of vehicles, thereby constraining the learned transition rules to physically admissible dynamics. We further extend this framework to stochastic dynamics by parameterizing probabilistic transition rules while preserving the same physics-informed constraints. We evaluate the proposed models on multiple traffic scenarios generated by the well-established Nagel-Schreckenberg and Kerner-Klenov-Wolf cellular automata. The results demonstrate that the PI-NCA successfully learns the dynamics of both traffic models and consistently outperforms a standard NCA, while the stochastic extension captures probabilistic transition rules without compromising the imposed physical constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出物理信息神经细胞自动机（PI-NCA）用于数据驱动的交通流建模，通过保证车辆总数守恒和与路网拓扑一致的架构约束学习局部转移规则，并扩展到随机动力学，在多种交通场景下优于标准NCA。
AI.motivation: 交通流建模对理解与预测车辆群体动力学至关重要。细胞自动机虽简单可解释且能重现复杂宏观交通现象，但从数据中学习局部转移规则同时保持物理有意义的约束仍具挑战，尤其对随机模型而言。
AI.method: 在标准神经细胞自动机（NCA）基础上，设计一种与道路拓扑物理一致、并保证车辆总数守恒的神经架构，从而将学习到的转移规则约束为物理上可容许的动力学。进一步通过参数化概率转移规则将该框架扩展到随机动力学，同时保持相同的物理信息约束。
AI.result: 在由经典Nagel-Schreckenberg和Kerner-Klenov-Wolf细胞自动机生成的多种交通场景上进行评估，结果表明PI-NCA能成功学习两种交通模型的动力学，并持续优于标准NCA；随机扩展能够捕捉概率转移规则而不破坏所施加的物理约束。
AI.conclusion: PI-NCA为数据驱动的交通流建模提供了一种物理一致的框架，兼顾可解释性与物理约束，并可推广至随机动力学，具有优于标准NCA的表现。

title: Performance at What Cost? A Sustainability-Aware Performance Index for Cell and Nucleus Instance Segmentation
summary: Pretrained models for cell and nuclear instance segmentation differ substantially in architecture, pretraining data and objectives, parameter count, inference strategy, adaptation requirements, postprocessing pipeline, and computational demand. Large pretrained and foundation models are increasingly adopted because of their strong zero-shot capabilities, but their use also imposes greater energy consumption, memory requirements, computational demands, adaptation costs, and operational carbon emissions. Whether these additional demands are justified by meaningful gains in segmentation performance remains unclear. We address this question by introducing the Sustainability-Aware Performance Index (SAPI), a configurable metric that combines segmentation performance, energy consumption, and model size. We benchmark 19 pretrained and foundation models across six CellBinDB datasets under zero-shot inference and evaluate 16 fine-tunable models using few-shot adaptation with both frozen encoder and full-model fine-tuning. We estimate energy consumption for GPU, CPU, and RAM using software-based monitoring tools. Our results show that larger and more computationally demanding models do not consistently achieve proportionate improvements in segmentation quality. While few-shot adaptation benefits several models, the gains and resource costs vary considerably across architectures, datasets, and adaptation strategies, causing SAPI-based rankings to differ from rankings based on performance alone. This study provides a practical framework for comparing segmentation models more comprehensively and supports more computationally accessible and environmentally responsible model selection in biomedical image analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可持续性感知性能指数（SAPI），综合分割性能、能耗与模型规模，对19个预训练/基础模型在6个CellBinDB数据集上评测，发现更大模型并不必然带来成比例的分割质量提升。
AI.motivation: 细胞与核实例分割的预训练模型在架构、预训练数据、参数量、推理策略、适配需求、后处理与算力需求上差异巨大。大型预训练与基础模型因零样本能力强而被广泛采用，但也带来更高能耗、内存、算力、适配成本与碳排放。这些额外代价是否被分割性能的提升所证明仍不明确。
AI.method: 引入可配置的可持续性感知性能指数（SAPI），将分割性能、能耗与模型规模结合。在六个CellBinDB数据集上对19个预训练与基础模型做零样本推理基准测试，并对16个可微调模型采用少样本适配（冻结编码器与全模型微调两种方式）。用基于软件的监控工具估算GPU、CPU与RAM能耗。
AI.result: 更大、算力需求更高的模型并未稳定取得成比例的分割质量提升。少样本适配对部分模型有益，但收益与资源代价因架构、数据集与适配策略而异，导致基于SAPI的排序与仅基于性能的排序不一致。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一个更全面比较分割模型的实用框架，支持在生物医学图像分析中做出算力更可及、环境更负责的模型选择。

title: Force without transmission: a depth-induced rank collapse that no loss on the representation reopens
summary: Training can drive a transformer into a rank collapse: all token representations point in one direction, and learning stops. In a related collapse of attention, a loss term with a bounded corrective force repairs the network during the run. We ask whether such a term repairs rank collapse. We collapse small transformers by weakening their skip connection and treat copies of the collapsed network. No added loss term repaired the collapse, although the stronger kind pushed with about a tenth of the task gradient. The reason was the path, not the strength. The task gradient no longer reached the query and key weights, which decide where attention looks, and the added term's gradient faded before the blocks where the collapse forms. Restoring the skip connection, which changes no weight, reopened this path at once. The rank then recovered, but only far above the scale of collapse. After a burst of high learning rate the path stayed open and the rank recovered untreated. Registered predictions from the path ranked recovery times but did not transfer to this cause. In every case the loss stayed above that of a healthy network after the rank recovered. Whether a collapsed network can be repaired depends on whether the gradient still reaches the weights that must change, not on how strongly a loss term pushes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究秩坍缩（rank collapse）的修复问题：坍缩网络是否可修复取决于梯度能否到达必须改变的权重，而非附加损失项的推力强度。
AI.motivation: 训练可使 transformer 发生秩坍缩——所有 token 表示指向同一方向，学习停止。已有工作用有界纠正力的损失项修复了注意力的相关坍缩，作者因此追问：这类损失项能否同样修复秩坍缩，以及坍缩网络在何种条件下可被修复。
AI.method: 通过削弱 skip connection 使小型 transformer 发生秩坍缩，并对坍缩网络的副本进行处理。尝试加入不同的损失项（其中较强的一种推力约为任务梯度的十分之一），并分析梯度路径：考察任务梯度是否还能到达决定注意力方向的 query/key 权重，以及附加损失项的梯度在何处衰减。随后恢复 skip connection（不改变任何权重），并测试高学习率突发后的效果。
AI.result: 没有任何附加损失项修复了坍缩，较强的一种仅以约任务梯度十分之一的力度推动。原因是路径而非强度：任务梯度不再到达 query/key 权重，附加项的梯度在坍缩形成的模块之前就已衰减。恢复 skip connection 立即重新打通这条路径，秩随之恢复，但仅在远高于坍缩时的尺度上。一次高学习率突发后路径保持畅通，秩在无处理下自行恢复。路径给出的注册预测能对恢复时间排序，但无法迁移到这一成因。所有情况下，秩恢复后损失仍高于健康网络。
AI.conclusion: 坍缩网络能否被修复，取决于梯度是否仍能到达必须改变的权重，而不取决于某个损失项推力有多强。

title: How Private is Private? A Comparative Study for Face De-Identification
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project Page: https://cv-ac.github.io/hifd/
summary: Face de-identification (FDeID) has emerged as a critical privacy-preserving technology, yet its evaluation remains fundamentally fragmented. Existing protocols rely on inconsistent metrics, heterogeneous datasets, and partial annotation coverage, so methods targeting different utility dimensions, such as landmark versus expression preservation, are reported on different benchmarks under different metrics, rendering cross-method comparison infeasible. We revisit FDeID evaluation from both the data and metric perspectives. On the data side, we introduce UtilFace, a curated, demographically balanced benchmark with high identity diversity, assembled from four large-scale face datasets through identity-aware cleaning, resolution enhancement, and stratified filtering. On the metric side, we propose HiFD, a Hierarchical Face De-identification metric that unifies identity suppression, multi-level utility preservation, and image quality under a single consistency-based paradigm: every component is computed from pretrained estimators' outputs on the original face and its de-identified counterpart, directly quantifying how much identity is suppressed and how much downstream-perceivable utility survives. HiFD organizes facial signals into a three-level utility hierarchy spanning macro cues (L1), micro cues (L2), and imperceptible cues (L3), and aggregates the five resulting components into a single interpretable score via weighted harmonic mean, with configurable application-specific profiles. Using this unified protocol, we conduct a comprehensive comparative study spanning adversarial, GAN-based, and diffusion-based methods, surfacing trade-offs and failure modes that remain invisible under existing protocols. We release the benchmark and evaluation toolkit to foster systematic and reproducible research in privacy-preserving human face analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文针对人脸去身份识别（FDeID）评估碎片化的问题，从数据和指标两方面提出统一的评估方案：构建了身份多样性高、人口统计平衡的基准数据集 UtilFace，并提出分层人脸去身份识别指标 HiFD，实现跨方法的系统性比较。
AI.motivation: 现有 FDeID 评估协议依赖不一致的指标、异构数据集和部分标注覆盖，导致针对不同效用维度（如关键点保留与表情保留）的方法在不同基准、不同指标下报告，无法进行跨方法比较。因此作者从数据和指标两个角度重新审视 FDeID 评估。
AI.method: 数据方面，提出 UtilFace 基准，通过身份感知清洗、分辨率增强和分层过滤，从四个大规模人脸数据集构建，具有身份多样性高、人口统计平衡的特点。指标方面，提出 HiFD（分层人脸去身份识别指标），基于一致性范式统一身份抑制、多层级效用保留和图像质量：每个组件均通过预训练估计器对原始人脸与去身份人脸输出的对比计算。HiFD 将面部信号组织为三层效用层级（宏观线索 L1、微观线索 L2、不可感知线索 L3），并将五个组件通过加权调和平均聚合为单一可解释分数，支持可配置的应用特定配置。
AI.result: 使用该统一协议，对对抗式、基于 GAN 和基于扩散的方法进行了全面的比较研究，揭示了在现有协议下不可见的权衡关系和失效模式。
AI.conclusion: 作者发布了该基准和评估工具包，以促进隐私保护人脸分析领域的系统性和可复现研究。

title: TR-PTQ: High-Accuracy Integer-Only Transformer Post Training Quantization via Taylor Region Reformulation
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment, yet transformer architectures remain challenging to quantize due to nonlinear layers. While existing methods attribute accuracy loss to insufficient numerical precision, often necessitating floating-point fallbacks, we demonstrate that degradation is actually driven by specific structural error sources. We find that learned scale parameters in normalization layers and compounded approximations in GELU are the primary error contributors, whereas SoftMax remains inherently robust to aggressive quantization. To address these bottlenecks, we introduce TR-PTQ, a unified integer-only formulation using shared Taylor Region (TR) exponential and logarithm primitives. This approach allows computationally expensive operations, including division and square roots, to be performed entirely in the log-domain via standard integer arithmetic. Combined with a calibration-free, outlier-aware optimization for LayerNorm parameters, our method eliminates the need for floating-point hardware units for nonlinearities, achieving less than 1.5\% absolute accuracy degradation across vision and language benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出TR-PTQ，一种纯整数后训练量化框架，用共享泰勒区域指数/对数原语将除法、开方等操作转入对数域执行整数运算，并配合免校准的异常值感知LayerNorm优化，消除非线性层的浮点回退需求。
AI.motivation: Transformer后训练量化中非线性层难以量化。现有方法将精度损失归因于数值精度不足，因而往往需要浮点回退（fallback），但作者认为退化实际由特定结构性误差源导致，需要定位真正的瓶颈。
AI.method: 分析发现归一化层中可学习的缩放参数与GELU的复合近似是主要误差来源，而SoftMax对激进量化本身鲁棒。据此提出统一的整数化公式TR-PTQ，使用共享Taylor Region（TR）指数与对数原语，使除法、平方根等昂贵操作全部在对数域以标准整数算术完成；并对LayerNorm参数采用免校准、异常值感知的优化。
AI.result: 在视觉与语言基准上实现小于1.5%的绝对精度下降，同时在非线性运算中无需浮点硬件单元。SoftMax被验证可承受激进量化而不显著损失精度。
AI.conclusion: 精度损失主要来自LayerNorm缩放参数和GELU近似等结构性误差，而非单纯的数值精度不足；通过统一的对数域整数原语与LayerNorm优化，可在完全整数算术下保持精度，为Transformer非线性层的高效部署提供无需浮点回退的方案。

title: When to Unpair: Regulating Pairing Dependence in Medical Visual In-Context Learning
summary: Visual in-context learning (ICL), well suited to label-scarce medical imaging, uses support image-label pairs to demonstrate input-output mappings, while the labels collectively indicate the requested task. We diagnose dependence on individual pairings with a test-time derangement that reassigns every support label to another support image while preserving the query, support images, and label multiset. The resulting pairing gap, defined as shuffled-minus-matched performance, shows that all four released models depend on the pairing, to widely varying degrees. Further analysis of a paired-trained model reveals support-associated spurious regions and lesion-size biases even with real, unaltered supports, alongside sensitivity to mis-registered support labels. To regulate this dependence, we introduce a late unpairing curriculum (LUC), which starts with matched training and then applies random unpairing, replacing each support label with that of another support in the same episode. LUC nearly closes the pairing gap on two backbones while maintaining or improving matched-support performance across all evaluated task types, with gains extending to held-out tasks and cross-dataset episodes. It also mitigates these failure modes. On BraTS whole-tumor segmentation, matched-support DSC rises from 0.733 to 0.857 while the gap shrinks from -0.184 to -0.008. In a released model, brief fine-tuning with random unpairing reduces the gap. A reversed curriculum that places the same number of unpairing epochs at the start of training leaves a large gap. This shows that pairing dependence is shaped by the order of training and not only by the amount of unpaired training.

AI.tldr: 该论文诊断了视觉上下文学习模型对支持图像-标签配对关系的依赖性，并提出"晚期解配对课程"（LUC）来缓解这一问题。
AI.motivation: 视觉上下文学习适合标签稀缺的医学影像，但模型可能过度依赖单个支持图像-标签配对，而非真正理解任务。论文旨在诊断这种配对依赖性及其引发的失败模式。
AI.method: 提出"测试时重排"（derangement）证明配对依赖，定义"配对差距"（打乱减去匹配性能）；提出LUC课程——先匹配训练，后随机解配对（将每个支持标签替换为同一episode内其他支持样本的标签）；并在BraTS全肿瘤分割上验证，同时对比反转课程。
AI.result: 所有四个已发布模型均依赖配对，程度差异大；配对训练模型存在支持相关虚假区域和病灶大小偏差。LUC在两个骨干网络上几乎消除配对差距，维持或提升匹配性能。BraTS上匹配DSC从0.733升至0.857，差距从-0.184缩小至-0.008。反转课程仍保留大差距。
AI.conclusion: 配对依赖由训练顺序塑造，而不仅仅由解配对训练量决定；LUC能有效调控该依赖性并缓解失败模式。

title: Efficient Patch-Based Anomaly Detection Fused with Diffusion Driven Generative Modeling for Semiconductor Wafer Bin Map Open Set Anomaly Detection
summary: Spatial defect signatures on wafer bin maps (WBMs) trace yield loss to specific process faults, yet supervised classifiers recognize only the defect types seen during training, and one-class detectors built on a single mechanism tend to capture either local structural deviations or global distributional violations, but rarely both. This work proposes a hybrid one-class framework that couples a patch-based student-teacher detector (EfficientAD) with a denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) used for partial-diffusion reconstruction, and fuses their percentile-calibrated scores through a fixed convex combination. Trained on only 700 normal wafers from the WM-38K mixed-type dataset and evaluated on 18,658 held-out wafers, the fused detector reached an AUROC of 0.9985 and reduced misclassifications from 852 (DDPM) and 1,412 (EfficientAD) to 618, with all pairwise differences significant at p < 0.001. Beyond aggregate accuracy, the analysis shows that the gain arises from weakly overlapping errors between the two modules, yet fixed-weight fusion recovers only 40-70% of the correction available to an oracle selector. Under the benchmark's inverted class balance, average precision and F1 saturate, while the Matthews correlation coefficient and negative predictive value expose unreliable normal predictions. Pixel-level maps further show that strong image-level separability does not imply spatial localization, and the diffusion module succeeds as a local density prior rather than through global geometric reasoning. These findings motivate sample-adaptive fusion and imbalance-aware evaluation of hybrid wafer anomaly detectors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合单类框架，结合EfficientAD与DDPM部分扩散重构，经百分位校准分数后以固定凸组合融合，用于晶圆图缺陷检测。
AI.motivation: 监督分类器只能识别训练中见过的缺陷类型，而基于单一机制的单类检测器往往只能捕捉局部结构偏差或全局分布违规，难以兼顾两者。
AI.method: 将基于图块的师生检测器EfficientAD与用于部分扩散重构的去噪扩散概率模型DDPM耦合，对两者的百分位校准分数采用固定凸组合进行融合。仅在WM-38K混合型数据集的700片正常晶圆上训练。
AI.result: 在18,658片留出晶圆上评估，融合检测器AUROC达0.9985，误分类数从DDPM的852和EfficientAD的1,412降至618，所有成对差异p<0.001。增益源于两模块误差的弱重叠，但固定权重融合仅能恢复oracle选择器可实现修正的40-70%。在基准的反向类别平衡下，平均精度与F1饱和，而MCC和负预测值揭示正常预测不可靠。像素级图显示强图像级可分性并不意味着空间定位能力。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模块作为局部密度先验而非全局几何推理发挥作用；研究结果支持采用样本自适应融合与不平衡感知评估来改进混合晶圆异常检测器。

title: Position Forcing: Self-Conditioning 3D Generation
